companyDescription:
Kairos Power has a mission to enable the world’s clean energy transition to improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment.

We are an engineering company focused on the delivery of a clean, affordable and safe energy solution through the integrated design, licensing and demonstration of advanced reactor technology.

Growing from a broad research effort at U.S. universities and national laboratories, Kairos Power was founded to accelerate the development of an innovative nuclear technology that has the potential to transform the energy landscape in the United States and internationally.

Kairos Power is focused on reducing technical risk through a novel approach to test iteration often lacking in the nuclear space. Our schedule is driven by the goal of a U.S. demonstration plant before 2030 and a rapid deployment thereafter. 

The challenge is great, but so too is the opportunity.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

We are searching for an IT Infrastructure Engineer II to support the reliable operation of end-user computing and core infrastructure services, with primary responsibility for infrastructure supporting the Kairos Power Alameda, CA site. You will work as part of a team of Infrastructure Engineers to independently implement, operate, troubleshoot, and maintain infrastructure enabling corporate, engineering, and manufacturing services. The role contributes to the design, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of cloud and on-premises infrastructure. The successful candidate will have previous IT systems and/or network engineering experience; experience in engineering or industrial/manufacturing organizations and regulated environments is preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Independently install, configure, and maintain cloud and on-premises networking, compute, and infrastructure resources, using Infrastructure as Code where practical.
  • Contribute to the design, standardization, implementation, and ongoing management of hybrid infrastructure across offices, labs, manufacturing spaces, and datacenter environments.
  • Monitor and independently troubleshoot routine and moderately complex network, systems, and application issues, and identify opportunities to improve performance and reliability.
  • Build reliable, secure, and automated solutions that improve infrastructure scalability and operational efficiency.
  • Administer and support server, endpoint, identity, endpoint management, and cloud infrastructure technologies.
  • Collaborate with security, engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and business teams to define requirements and deliver infrastructure that supports operational needs.
  • Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and external partners to implement secure and reliable infrastructure solutions.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, diagrams, and operating procedures.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, upgrades, migrations, incident response, and continuous improvement efforts, taking ownership of assigned infrastructure deliverables.
  • Apply modern IT and security best practices across supported systems and environments.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the role.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar field; or an equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and applicable work experience.
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience in network engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a similar role in a medium-to-large-scale organization or similarly complex environment.
  • Experience independently supporting and troubleshooting datacenter operations, physical and logical networking, and systems infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud IaaS platform, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Practical experience with configuration management, automation, or Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
  • Prior work experience in a highly regulated industry, including government environments, is preferred.
  • Prior work experience in an engineering or industrial/manufacturing company is preferred.
  • Prior work experience in a high-growth or rapidly scaling environment is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts and services, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Ability to apply Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and infrastructure automation principles and practices.
  • Ability to independently implement, maintain, and troubleshoot reliable and supportable infrastructure solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve routine and moderately complex infrastructure issues across networking, systems, endpoint, identity, and cloud technologies.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical and business teams, vendors, and service providers to define requirements and implement infrastructure solutions.
  • Ability to create and improve technical standards, architecture and network diagrams, operating procedures, and system documentation.
  • Working knowledge of server and endpoint technologies and modern enterprise IT environments.
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, with practical experience using mobile device management, single sign-on, and endpoint management tools.
  • Working knowledge of modern information security practices and their application to infrastructure environments.
  • Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, supportable solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage assigned priorities and adapt to changing technical and operational requirements.

Physical Demands

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

  • General office environment
  • Noisy environments
  • Prototyping/Test Facilities
  • Manufacturing/Industrial Environments

Safety and PPE

  • Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs
  • Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions
  • Wearing proper PPE, to include safety glasses, safety footwear, or other PPE as required

Travel

  • Some travel may be required (5%)

Certification

  • Relevant professional certification in networking, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, infrastructure automation, or information security, such as CCNA/CCNP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, RHCSA/RHCE, Security+, or comparable certification is desirable but not required

Additional Requirements

  • Occasionally requires working weekends.
  • Occasionally equires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines.

The salary range for this position is $108,735 to $127,923 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. Factors that maybe used to determine your actual salary may include your education, experience, knowledge, skills, ability and the market data for your work location, and a comparison to other employees already in the role.

About Our Benefits

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents
  • Paid Vacation
  • 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

Note: You are applying for a position that is located in a facility that handles information that is subject to export control restrictions by the Department of Energy under 10 CFR Part 810. To work in this facility, you need to be authorized by the Department of Energy to access Part 810-controlled information. Foreign nationals who are citizens of countries that are not on the Department of Energy’s general authorization list (link below) are not permitted to work in our facility unless the Department of Energy issues an export control license to the company to permit that individual to have access to Part 810-controlled information. The following questions are intended to determine the licensing requirements that may apply. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/10/appendix-A_to_part_810

descriptionHtml:
OzarksGo, based in Fayetteville, Arkansas a telecommunications subsidiary of Ozarks Electric Cooperative, offering all-fiber gigabit internet and premium television and telephone services to Northwest Arkansas and Northeast Oklahoma.

Ozarks provides its employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive wages, fully paid medical and dental coverage for both you and your dependents, a 401(k) plan with robust employer matching contributions. Additionally, we provide paid time off, nine paid holidays, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Job offers are contingent on passing a background check, proof of eligibility to work in the U.S., and passing a drug test. Ozarks does not accept medical marijuana cards because all our positions are considered safety sensitive.**

Education

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

Associate's degree in computer information systems or related technical field and/or 2 or more years of related work experience in System Support leadership and Infrastructure Administration and training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

Experience

Leadership and project management experience in IT infrastructure areas such as servers, data centers, networking and end-user support is preferred. Experience with VMWare, Azure, O365 is preferred.

Job Knowledge & Skills

Must demonstrate the ability to communicate technical information both written and verbally to immediate supervisors, peers, and end users. Must be able to perform complicated research, reporting, and querying of data. Advanced training and certification in server/desktop administration, Microsoft, CCNA, and other IT industry recognized skills is preferred.

Major Job Tasks

  • Develop Python scripts to automate business objectives.
  • Assist in management of security posture and policies.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code systems and processes
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and mentor junior staff.
  • Implement advanced monitoring, visualization, and automation toolsets to increase efficiency and decrease mean-time-to-repair.
  • Implement Windows and Linux servers to meet business objectives.
  • Manage and maintain critical server virtual infrastructure, physical infrastructure, and Storage Area Network
  • Manage next generation firewall and VPN services.
  • Administration of Active Directory and Azure Domain Services
  • Administration of DNS and DHCP services
  • Ensure high availability and acceptable performance of mission critical systems such as file servers, email servers, Customer Information Systems, and application servers
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of networking, including TCP/IP, VLANs, ethernet, switching, and routing
  • Administer backup & recovery applications
  • Perform and test disaster recovery processes to ensure that enterprise data is effectively protected
  • Perform and monitor software patching to maintain a low vulnerability on server resources
  • Develop and maintain training materials and server documentation as it relates to system configuration and best practices.
  • Completes any IT/Security training as assigned.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

The Systems Engineer II shall be required to perform any other duties assigned to fulfill the objectives of the Cooperative.

External Relationships

  • Vendors: To evaluate and order new equipment. To report equipment malfunctions, resolve hardware and software issues, and/or to keep updated on current technology.

Other Requirements

  • Must have valid driver's license without violation, which would prohibit insurability.
  • All specific equipment related to Information Technology as well as routine office equipment. Work is performed in an office environment with higher and/or longer noise level than average. Weekends, evening hours, overtime and/or overnight travel may often be necessary.

Physical Requirements

  • Occasional lifting, up to 50 pounds, required. Normal vision and hearing required.
  • The physical activities and environmental characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.

Supervises

  • None

OzarksGo, LLC, is an EOE/AA/W/M/VETERAN/Disability employer.

Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.

–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.

Compliance & Security:

–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management:

–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.

–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.

–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:

–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning:

–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.

–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.

Compliance & Security:

–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.

–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

Planning & Execution:

–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.

–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

Position Overview

The Sr. Systems Engineer collaborates with the Architecture and Engineering teams in the implementation and operation of Verra Mobility. This position works closely with the IT Operations Manager and various technology disciplines to implement best-in-class cloud technology deployment to support business initiatives. This role includes implementing, supporting, securing, and monitoring services on premises, in Microsoft Azure and cloud ecosystems. The position is preferred in Indy, Mesa, Phoenix, or Chicago.

Primary Job Responsibilities

  • Implement on premise technologies, private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid solutions primarily in Azure.
  • Manage and support hyperconverged platforms such as Cisco UCS, VxRail and VMware
  • Implement availability and performance monitoring frameworks.
  • Implement and test system-level High Availability and Disaster Recovery plans.
  • Track, control, and report the status of system conditions, software, documentation, and infrastructure changes to management.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts or frameworks.
  • Provide high-quality support to customers, prospects, management, and peers.
  • Interpret and provide solutions on complex technologies/architectures.
  • Design and deliver secure cloud solutions on Azure or AWS.
  • Deep Windows Server expertise and Linux knowledge.
  • Cloud Formation / Automation / PowerShell / DSC / Comparable Linux Scripting.
  • Architecture design, system evaluation, system analysis, and infrastructure assessment.
  • Leverage resource tagging to allocate costs and optimize resource planning.
  • Lead incident management, involving other support organizations and outside vendors.
  • Participate in a global follow-the-sun support model, including after-hours and on-call responsibilities, as needed.
  • Provide work breakdown and estimates for complex tasks.

Additional Skills And Knowledge

  • Knowledge of Tanium, Windows/Linus patching, 3rd party application patching and Reporting.
  • Knowledge of Rubrik backups, hands on experience with cloud storage (Qumulo, NetApp)
  • Knowledge of Azure, Networking, NSG, EntraID, Storage Accounts, Private Endpoints, Virtual Machines, etc.
  • Expertise in VMware, including Template Creation and VM Management.
  • Experience with Zerto, including VPG Migration and VPG Setup.
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, DNS, and Account Management.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in on premise datacenter environments, private/public cloud, SAN, and networking.
  • Relevant Datacenter or Cloud certification accreditations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Self-directed approach with a high degree of initiative to propose new solutions, troubleshoot, and resolve issues.
  • BS in Computer Science or related experience.
  • Experience in data center installation and operations.
  • Strong understanding of hyper-converged infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting multi-site and hot-hot architectures.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server operating systems is a must.
  • Expertise in VMware data center stack; VxRail, vSphere, NSX, vROP’s, and storage.
  • Experience implementing scripts for automation and systems management.
  • Familiar with multi-tiered escalation and on-call procedures.
  • Experience working in SOX, SOC2, ISO, and PCI compliant multi-tenant environments.
  • Hands-on experience assisting Software Engineering and Quality Assurance with deployment issues related to the different classes of environments that comprise the infrastructure

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

descriptionHtml:
First Century Bank, N.A. – IT Infrastructure Engineer


First Century Bank is a relationship-focused community bank providing financial services to consumers and businesses through financial technology partners. We are committed to delivering exceptional service, maintaining strong relationships, and providing innovative banking solutions while fostering a collaborative workplace where employees can grow and succeed.


The Infrastructure Engineer supports and maintains First Century Bank's on-premises datacenter and cloud environments. This role is a generalist, hands-on role responsible for implementing infrastructure changes, resolving incidents, performing system maintenance, and supporting disaster recovery activities while following established standards, change management procedures and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities


  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot the Bank's network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPN's, and wireless technologies.
  • Administer and maintain on-premises VMware (vSphere / ESXi / vCenter), Windows Server, and Linux environments including physical server infrastructure and datacenter operations.
  • Operate and maintain cloud workloads, preferably Microsoft Azure (compute, networking, identity, storage), in a hybrid model.
  • Support secure connectivity and consistent configuration across on-prem and cloud.
  • Administer enterprise storage, backup, and replication solutions, including backup verification, data restoration, and recovery testing.
  • Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity activities, including failover testing and maintaining recovery documentation.
  • Administer Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and user access in accordance with security and least-privilege standards.
  • Apply security updates, system hardening, and configuration standards while supporting audit and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, respond to system alerts and incidents, and perform routine maintenance and patch management.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools, primarily using PowerShell, to improve operational efficiency.
  • Provide advanced infrastructure support, participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support, and maintain accurate technical documentation, including configurations, diagrams, and runbooks.


Required Qualifications


  • Three (3) or more years of hands-on infrastructure experience supporting network, compute, virtualization, and storage/backup.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.
  • Experience administering VMware vSphere, Windows Server, and Active Directory.
  • Working knowledge of networking technologies, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Experience with backup and recovery solutions and an understanding of high availability (HA), disaster recovery, RTO, and RPO concepts.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably using PowerShell.
  • Experience working within formal change management processes and maintaining technical documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience working in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Industry certifications such as VMware VCP, CCNA, Microsoft AZ-104, Security+.
  • Experience with disaster recovery testing, enterprise storage (SAN), and backup platforms.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management tools.


First Century Bank is an equal opportunity employer. It is the Company's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all qualified persons without regard to race, color, sex, gender or gender identification, religious creed or religious beliefs, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, military or veteran's status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by state or federal law.

descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Staff Systems Engineer, Microsoft Infrastructure to own Crusoe's corporate IT infrastructure end to end: the servers, virtualization, storage, networking, and cloud platforms that keep our offices, warehouses, manufacturing (CI) facilities, and data centers running. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will personally build, migrate, and support servers, and you will be the escalation owner when infrastructure breaks.

At the staff level, you also set the direction. You'll own the infrastructure roadmap, prioritize across projects, and work directly with business stakeholders to understand requirements before you build. Some of our hardest problems sit here: moving specialized applications, such as manufacturing software with licensing tied to physical hardware, off on-prem servers and into the cloud when the vendor never designed them to run there.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Manage and modernize Windows Server environments—including Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, certificate services, and file infrastructure—across Hyper-V, VMware, and bare-metal systems
  • Drive on-premises to multi-cloud server migrations (Azure, GCP, AWS), navigating complex software dependencies, restrictive vendor licensing, and legacy workloads
  • Architect and operate core compute, storage, and server networking resources, collaborating with Network Engineering on site connectivity and infrastructure deployments
  • Deploy Azure Arc to standardize governance, security policies, and operational monitoring across hybrid server environments
  • Design and maintain IaC configurations using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates to enable auditable, version-controlled automation
  • Oversee Microsoft 365 and Entra ID tenant health, securing access via Conditional Access and MFA while managing Okta identity federation
  • Lead system monitoring, backups, disaster recovery strategies, and incident response, acting as the primary escalation point during on-call rotations
  • Execute hands-on physical server deployment—racking, cabling, and provisioning—at corporate offices, data centers, and manufacturing facilities, requiring occasional site travel
  • Establish infrastructure roadmaps and technical standards, managing priorities while ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and SOX controls
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior IT systems team members and produce detailed architecture diagrams and runbooks


What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ years of hands-on infrastructure experience, including recent, day-to-day ownership of Windows Server environments on current versions
  • A track record of migrating production servers and applications from on-prem to cloud, including troubleshooting dependencies and licensing issues yourself
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS) at the level needed to build, network, and run virtual servers; experience across more than one is a strong plus
  • Solid foundations in storage, virtualization, and networking as they relate to server workloads
  • Infrastructure-as-code you've written yourself (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM), plus PowerShell or CLI scripting for automation
  • Entra ID and Microsoft 365 administration; experience integrating Entra with Okta or another identity provider
  • Experience owning backup, disaster recovery, and incident response for production systems
  • Comfort with hands-on physical server work (racking, cabling, firmware) and regular travel to sites
  • Experience setting technical direction and prioritizing a roadmap while staying hands-on; clear, patient communication with non-technical stakeholders


Bonus Points

  • Experience migrating specialized or industrial applications (manufacturing, CNC, OT) to virtualized or cloud environments
  • Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-800/801 (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator), or MS-102
  • Linux server administration in hybrid Windows/Linux environments
  • Experience supporting new site builds alongside facilities teams, cabling vendors, and ISPs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or similar SIEM tooling and log pipelines


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages
  • Restricted Stock Units
  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
  • Employer contributions to HSA account
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement
  • Mental health & wellness support
  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
  • Cell phone stipend
  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
  • Volunteer time off
  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
  • Daily meals allowance
  • Additional perks & programs specific to location


Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $155,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

companyDescription: The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a science-based company whose specialty chemistry delivers sustainable solutions to advance mobility, improve well-being and enhance modern life. Every day, the innovators of Lubrizol strive to create extraordinary value for customers at the intersection of science, market needs and business success, driving discovery and creating breakthrough solutions that enhance life and make the world work better. Founded in 1928, Lubrizol has global reach and local presence, with more than 100 manufacturing facilities, sales and technical offices and 8,000 employees around the world.
companySlogan: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science.™
descriptionHtml:
Shape the Future with Us.

At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.

Why We’re Growing

Berkshire Hathaway, Lubrizol’s parent company, announced its acquisition of OxyChem (formerly part of Occidental Petroleum) at the start of this year. As part of this transition, Lubrizol will provide certain corporate functional services, including IT Infrastructure & Platform support toOxyChem as it continues operating as an independent business.

This role allows you to be part of a high‑visibility initiative, strengthen cross‑company partnerships, and contribute to the success of two industry‑leading chemical organizations.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a Cloud Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our innovation, driving the delivery, automation, support, and continuous improvement of Azure-first cloud and hybrid infrastructure platforms that support our Next-Generation Infrastructure strategy. You'll collaborate with a diverse group of passionate individuals to deliver sustainable solutions to advance mobility, improve wellbeing, and enhance modern life. In this role, you will:

  • Implement, maintain, and support Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud infrastructure solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, networking, identity integrations, subscriptions, and platform services.
  • Execute cloud platform deployments, upgrades, lifecycle activities, and workload modernization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using tools such as Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Bicep, Terraform, and PowerShell.
  • Contribute to automation initiatives that improve consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, capacity, and availability while supporting incident response and recovery activities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud platform issues within defined service levels.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to deliver scalable and secure technology solutions.
  • Document solutions, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks to support operational excellence.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through automation, process optimization, and adoption of emerging cloud technologies.

Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of relevant information technology experience in infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering roles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure or cloud platforms in a production environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, virtualization, networking, or systems administration.
  • Knowledge of cloud networking, identity, security fundamentals, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, automation concepts, and PowerShell scripting.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned services while balancing speed, reliability, security, and operational discipline.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with cross-functional technology teams.

Preferred Qualifications That Drive You Forward

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate certification or similar Azure certification.
  • Experience with ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or other Infrastructure-as-Code platforms.
  • Experience implementing automation and cloud governance best practices.

Your Work Environment

Role

At Lubrizol, we’re committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and empowering environment where you can do your best work—whether in a lab, on the production floor, or in a hybrid office setting. Depending on your role, your work environment may include:

  • Standing, walking, or operating equipment for extended periods
  • Working in a lab or manufacturing setting with appropriate PPE provided
  • Use of computers and digital tools in an office or hybrid environment
  • Occasional lifting or movement of materials
  • Adherence to rigorous safety protocols and ergonomic standards

We continuously invest in our facilities and technologies to ensure they support your well-being, productivity, and growth. If you require reasonable accommodation, we are committed to working with you to ensure an inclusive and accessible experience.

Benefits That Empower You

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus plans
  • 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and parental leave
  • Flexible work environment
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Career and professional growth
  • Inclusive culture and vibrant community engagement

Learn more at https://benefits.lubrizol.com/!

descriptionHtml:
Join a high-impact infrastructure team where you’ll help keep critical systems reliable, secure, and ready to support business growth. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges, improving observability, and contributing to infrastructure strategy in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and support VMware environments, including vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers across Windows and/or Linux environments.
  • Support enterprise storage, backup, recovery, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
  • Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud to support hybrid infrastructure needs.
  • Create and manage monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and reports using Datadog or a similar observability tool.
  • Review logs, metrics, events, and performance trends to improve reliability and reduce noise.
  • Perform patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and other maintenance tasks on schedule.
  • Respond to incidents and participate in an on-call rotation when needed.
  • Investigate infrastructure issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
  • Lead infrastructure projects from planning through implementation, testing, documentation, and handoff.
  • Track capacity, availability, performance, and security across the infrastructure environment.
  • Document technical procedures, operational processes, asset details, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Partner with security, networking, application, cloud, and business teams on shared initiatives.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Support infrastructure planning, roadmap discussions, risk awareness, and continuous improvement efforts.


Skills

  • 6–10 years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware technologies such as vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux administration.
  • Experience with enterprise storage concepts such as SAN, NAS, RAID, snapshots, replication, and capacity planning.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience using Datadog or another monitoring platform to build monitors, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
  • Ability to interpret infrastructure metrics, logs, events, and performance data.
  • Experience with patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and incident response.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
  • Proven ability to lead projects and coordinate work across technical teams.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience managing Datadog through APIs, Terraform, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or similar automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, identity and access management, and Microsoft 365.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments and cloud migration initiatives.
  • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and security best practices.
  • Relevant certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft Azure Administrator, or AWS Solutions Architect.


Horizontal is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds are valued and respected. We welcome candidates who share a collaborative mindset and a commitment to creating equitable opportunities for everyone.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and agree that Horizontal Talent may contact you regarding your application using automated technology, including phone calls, SMS/text messages, or email, which may be delivered by our virtual AI recruiter, Alex.

Please apply through this online posting or by visiting our Job Board at www.horizontaltalent.com/job-board. Applications will be accepted for 4 weeks. For those that join the team, we offer competitive compensation and benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement. Check out all we have to offer and how you can become part of the Horizontal Talent Team. The pay range for this role is $170,000 - $195,000 per year based on qualifications and experience.

descriptionHtml:
Valero is the best-in-class producer of essential fuels and products that are foundational to modern life. We invite you to join our ~10,000 employees to drive exceptional results for our company, the energy industry and our community.

As a Hosting and Infrastructure Platform Engineer working at our San Antonio headquarters office, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise I/S infrastructure primarily focused on operating systems, server hardware, virtualization, containerization across on-premises and cloud environments.

Key Competencies

  • Problem-Solving
  • Initiative
  • Results Orientation
  • Interpersonal Skills

Our Goal At Valero Is To Continue To Be The Premier Manufacturer, Distributor, And Marketer Of Quality Transportation Fuels And Petrochemical Feedstocks, While Serving The Needs Of Our Employees, Communities And Stakeholders. You Can Help Achieve This Goal If You Can

  • Support, design, and implement enterprise infrastructure technology solutions aligned with industry and company standards, incorporating on-prem, virtualization, container platforms, and modern cloud.
  • Contribute to long-term planning for Infrastructure solutions related to hosting
  • Design, implement, and operate enterprise solutions based on RHEL Linux, Windows Server OS, container orchestration platforms, Broadcom VCF, and systems that enable emerging technologies such as AI/ML workloads.
  • Design, implement, and operate Cisco UCS server hardware
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including infrastructure, application development, and security to ensure solutions meet organizational needs
  • Manage and maintain infrastructure lifecycle operations, workload domain configuration, and integration with storage and network platforms.
  • Documents knowledge acquired and technical specifications into a knowledge management system. This includes adhering to established documenting standards.
  • Coordinate the adoption of new procedures resulting from software and hardware changes, including the development of system specifications, documentation, training, and communication plans.
  • Performs analysis on (including performance and capacity) as well as recommending quality complex solutions
  • Understand and applies the various IT methodologies which include project management, development, service management, and system architecture.
  • Follow ITIL based service management processes (Change, Incident, Request)

This position is salaried exempt status, which means you are not eligible for overtime pay.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine is a global nonprofit organization created by Congress in 1983 to assist in accelerating the progress of military medicine. Our unmatched experience in military medical research makes us uniquely qualified to assist investigators and clinicians in managing scientific research. By providing exceptional program management services, we relieve the administrative burden associated with medical research, empowering researchers to make the medical discoveries our warfighters need.  

Our mission is to advance Military Medicine and our objectives are clear: to carry out medical research and education projects that provide answers and drive change while removing barriers to success; to serve as a trusted and responsive link between the military medical community, its private partners and American service members, veterans and civilians; to encourage engagement of the medical community for the mutual benefit of military and civilians, who benefit from this work. 

HJF is committed to supporting Military Medicine serving as the connective tissue between its industry partners and the research environment. 

We are driven to solve the biggest puzzles and hardest problems by using the resources necessary to support the mission. We anticipate needs, responding at the pace of change to focus on continually adding value to military medical research.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Systems Engineer II - Cloud Engineer to develop, implement, and maintain systems in the cloud supporting large-scale biological data analysis for research. The Systems Engineer works independently; establishes internal priorities, work schedules and goals and uses their own initiative and sound judgment. Work is evaluated based on results achieved towards established goals and requirements, timeliness, application of sound business practice and efficient use of resources.

This position will be in support of the Uniformed Services University (USU) Department of Surgery and the USU School of Medicine.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

Responsibilities

  • Performs IT infrastructure architecting, deployment, and maintenance for public cloud technologies using an infrastructure-as-code approach.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into system requirements; formulates new solutions or enhancements to existing systems employing public cloud technologies.
  • Acts as a lead technical resource for project requirements gathering with independent analysis and formulation of solutions.
  • Independently designs, develops, tests, (upon government official's approval) deploys, and maintains systems using software development lifecycle best practices to ensure high quality solutions.
  • Documents software design, development, and deployment processes.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor. This may include attendance of and participation in required training for the role.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • High school Diploma or GED required. Vocational or technical degree/Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 6-8 years experience required.

Licenses and Certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ Certification.
  • Vendor training/certification preferred (e.g. Google Cloud Professional certifications, AWS Professional certifications, etc.) but not required.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Experience in cloud computing concepts and tools for public cloud platforms, preferably with experience using an infrastructure-as-code approach such as Terraform for Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure.
  • Proficient in working with Linux/Unix operating systems, and experience with containerization technologies like Docker.
  • Proficient in DevOps tools, including but not limited to version control with Git, remote repository solutions such as GitHub or BitBucket, and automated build tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Experience with or willingness to learn Python or R for data analysis applications.
  • Must be willing to acquire domain specific knowledge and understand the technical aspects of research projects, preferably with a primary focus on scientific computing or bioinformatics.
  • Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner using both written documentation and oral presentations.
  • This position may require U.S. Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a T3/Secret Clearance.

Physical Capabilities

  • Ability to stand or sit at a computer for prolonged periods.

Work Environment

  • This position will take place primarily in an office setting.

Compensation

  • The annual salary range for this position is $77,600-$115,000. Actual salary will be determined based on experience, education, etc.

Benefits

  • HJF offers a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on your health and well-being, from medical, dental, and vision coverage to health savings and retirement plans, and more.

Employment with HJF is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include, but is not limited to, contacting your professional references, verification of previous employment, education and credentials, a criminal background check, and a department of motor vehicle (DMV) check if applicable. Any qualifications to be considered as equivalents, in lieu of stated minimums, require the prior approval of the Chief Human Resources Officer.

  • Group Policy Management

  • Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity
  • Performance Monitoring & Capacity Planning

  • Reduce manual operational effort through automation.
  • Timely remediation of vulnerabilities and patch compliance.

At Saia, your success is our success! That’s why we work hard to provide you with what you need to build an awesome career. We are committed to rewarding superior employee performance so that when you work hard, your achievements won’t go unnoticed.

At Saia, our people are the reason we’ve been successful for over a century in the industry. So, if you’re ready to put your career on a solid path, let’s go further.

Position Summary

The Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for the design, operation, optimization, security, and resiliency of the company's Microsoft Azure and hybrid infrastructure environment.

The role provides hands-on engineering support across Azure, identity, Windows infrastructure, virtualization, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, monitoring, and infrastructure services supporting business applications. It also partners closely with DevOps, Information Security, Application Development, Application Support, PPMO, and managed-service providers.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Azure

  • Design, implement, administer, and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services.
  • Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, networking, compute, storage, identity integration, monitoring, and related platform services.
  • Monitor Azure service health and proactively coordinate responses to platform incidents and degradation. This reflects current operational work such as identifying an Azure Container Registry image-pull degradation and determining its impact on non-production environments.
  • Establish and maintain cloud engineering standards for availability, performance, scalability, security, and supportability.
  • Support cloud services used by application and DevOps teams, including Azure-hosted and AKS-based workloads.

Cloud Cost Management & Optimization

  • Continuously review Azure consumption, run rates, forecasts, budgets, and resource utilization.
  • Identify cost anomalies and optimization opportunities and work with technical owners to remediate them.
  • Ensure new infrastructure builds are reviewed for both technical requirements and cost efficiency.
  • Develop proactive monitoring and reporting for cloud spend.

Windows, Identity & Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Engineer and support enterprise Windows Server and hybrid infrastructure services.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD-related infrastructure capabilities and integrations.
  • Support On-Premises Active Directory, DNS, authentication, certificates, service accounts, and related enterprise services.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure problems spanning cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Provide senior-level escalation support to internal IT teams and managed service providers.
  • Identify Azure AD and advanced Windows knowledge as important components of the current position.

Virtualization & Infrastructure Modernization

  • Support the modernization and reduction of legacy on-premises infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement virtualization technologies and migration strategies.
  • Participate in the organization's transition away from legacy VMware dependencies where appropriate.
  • Support Nutanix or comparable virtualization/hyperconverged platforms based on the approved infrastructure architecture.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery

  • Administer and support enterprise backup and recovery platforms, including Rubrik.
  • Assist with backup policies, monitor backup health, investigate failures, and support data-restoration requests.
  • Strong knowledge of e-Discovery
  • Serve as a technical contributor for Disaster Recovery planning, testing, documentation, and remediation.
  • Participate in production DR exercises and maintain infrastructure recovery procedures.
  • Develop sufficient knowledge and documentation to eliminate single-person dependencies for critical recovery functions.

Monitoring, Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Implement and maintain proactive infrastructure and application-platform monitoring.
  • Support Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerting, capacity management, and infrastructure observability.
  • Investigate service degradation, performance issues, unusual consumption patterns, and platform incidents.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and preventative remediation.
  • Improve availability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency through automation and standardization.

Security, Compliance & IT Controls

  • Partner with Information Security to maintain secure infrastructure configurations and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Support internal and external audits and provide infrastructure evidence as required.
  • Ensure identified security and audit findings are remediated within agreed timelines.
  • Follow privileged-access, change-management, configuration-management, and infrastructure-security standards.
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure and operational documentation.

Project & Business Support

  • Provide infrastructure engineering support for PPMO-led business and technology initiatives.
  • Develop technical requirements, estimates, implementation plans, and infrastructure designs.
  • Deliver assigned project work on schedule and within approved budget.
  • Coordinate infrastructure dependencies with Application Development, DevOps, Application Support, Security, vendors, and MSP resources.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering or administration experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise Microsoft infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD and hybrid identity.
  • Experience supporting enterprise backup and recovery solutions, ideally Rubrik.
  • Experience with VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Azure virtualization, or comparable platforms.
  • Practical experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or similar observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of DNS, networking, firewalls, load balancing, certificates, storage, and authentication.
  • Experience supporting disaster recovery and business-continuity exercises.
  • Experience with ITSM practices and platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across multi-tier cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Registry, and cloud-native application infrastructure.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or comparable tooling.
  • PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation experience.
  • Experience with cloud financial management/FinOps practices.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience supporting enterprise audit, ITGC, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Familiarity with GitHub-based infrastructure or DevOps workflows.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • Nutanix, Rubrik, VMware, or relevant Microsoft security certification

Salary range: $150,000-$175,000 annual plus discretionary 15% performance bonus

TRAC offers an industry-leading benefits package including: medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage, 401k with company match, FSA, HSA, group life insurance, and generous PTO, sick and holiday time.

descriptionHtml:
Chicago Trading Company (CTC) is a premier proprietary trading firm specializing in options market making. Our collaborative culture fuels innovation in quantitative research, systematic trading strategies, and cutting-edge trading technology. For over three decades CTC has provided critical liquidity across derivatives exchanges worldwide - making them fairer, more transparent, and more efficient.

We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and implement components of Windows Server solutions, with a strong emphasis on availability, operational excellence, and latency‑sensitive trading workloads.
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure‑as‑code to improve deployment consistency, reduce manual work, and scale operations.
  • Contribute to Active Directory modernization and Entra ID hybrid identity work, helping keep access across the firm secure and reliable.
  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Development teams to plan and deliver changes safely and predictably.
  • Take part in incident response: solve problems, contribute to root cause analysis, and follow through on preventive fixes.
  • Support workload assessment and performance tuning so systems hold up during peak market activity.
  • Write and maintain documentation (runbooks, diagrams, post-incident reviews) to support information exchange and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in an on‑call rotation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including picking the right message and channel for the audience.
  • A pragmatic approach that balances fast delivery with long‑term maintainability, and chooses solutions based on sound, data‑driven assessment.
  • Ability to prioritize what matters most and to own issues through to resolution.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on Windows Server administration experience, ideally in critical, high‑availability environments.
  • Solid working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Failover Clustering, including resolving issues and performance tuning.
  • Solid PowerShell scripting and automation skills. Experience with infrastructure‑as‑code or configuration management tools, or a clear willingness to learn them.
  • Understanding of how changes to production systems affect users, and close attention to procedure, change management, and service expectations.
  • Willingness to participate in an on‑call rotation.
  • Interest in helping the team grow, for example by taking part in interviews and recruiting.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with enterprise platforms such as SCCM/MECM, endpoint/server monitoring, backup systems, and/or load balancers.
  • Familiarity with ITIL concepts, operational workflows, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
  • Experience supporting financial services infrastructure, trading systems, or market data platforms.
  • Exposure to modern deployment approaches (e.g., containerization, orchestration).

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The discretionary bonus will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, and firm performance.

Salary Range

$140,000—$160,000 USD

Most teams at CTC, with the exception of Trading, follow a hybrid workplace model, subject to change based on business need.

OUR BENEFITS

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families so we offer outstanding benefits to support you both professionally and personally. These benefits include generous time off, insurance coverage, paid parental leave, free breakfast and lunch (plus healthy snacks, of course), wellness reimbursement, and a variety of other benefits focused on providing the best employee experience.

(Disclaimer: interns and contractors are not eligible for benefits at CTC)

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY and INCLUSION

At CTC, we aim to cultivate a workplace that celebrates diversity and each person feels included, engaged and empowered. Where each of us feels we belong. We are committed to having a diverse workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. CTC does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us at info@chicagotrading.com. Note that emails sent to this email account for non-disability related issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI)

Information submitted by job applicants may be subject to review and analysis by automated systems, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), as part of the recruitment process. Such systems are utilized to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our hiring procedures. Applicants are advised that any information provided may be evaluated by AI tools to ensure an equitable and thorough assessment.

Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality infrastructure-as-code and automations to make systems reliable and easier to maintain
  • Act as technical lead for infrastructure projects. Set the roadmap and pacing, break work into milestones and tasks, and coordinate work among team members
  • Provide quality support for your systems. Respond urgently to issues and identify root causes to prevent recurrence


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience designing, deploying, and managing enterprise IT infrastructure
  • Proficiency with public cloud systems (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, including terraform, gitops, ansible, and/or puppet
  • Broad IT expertise, can integrate infrastructure with networking, security, DevOps, and software development


Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with self-hosted AI systems, AI agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) platforms
  • Experience writing Lambdas and scripts to automate configuration and recurring tasks
  • Understanding of networking protocols and infrastructure (BGP, VPNs, DNS, DHCP)
  • Experience working with ITAR, NIST, FIPS, and FedRAMP compliant systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain technical concepts to people unfamiliar with them and gather requirements from cross-functional partners


Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work overtime, or weekends to support critical mission milestones


Pay Range: California

$146,000—$208,000 USD

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team. You will be a hands-on technical expert, helping to design, build and run the corporate IT infrastructure that keeps the group companies productive and secure. You will work on complex, high-impact projects, act as an escalation point for the team, and help raise engineering standards through mentoring and example.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy and maintain corporate infrastructure, including servers, storage, domain services, cloud services and enterprise applications.
  • Act as a senior technical authority for the team, providing guidance, design reviews and mentorship to more junior engineers.
  • Contribute to the team’s technology strategy and roadmap, helping to shape priorities and technical direction.
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies that improve reliability, security and operational efficiency.
  • Lead and deliver infrastructure projects from design to handover, on time, within scope and to a high standard.
  • Own the resolution of complex incidents and problems, leading root cause analysis and driving lasting fixes.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities for critical systems, including regular testing.
  • Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code to reduce manual effort, improve consistency and make the estate easier to run.
  • Build security into designs and solutions from the outset, working with our security teams to meet policy and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, standards and runbooks.
  • Take part in the team’s on-call and out-of-hours support arrangements where required.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience:

  • Significant experience in an infrastructure engineering role, with a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure components (e.g. networking, virtualization, storage, cloud computing, domain services).
  • Strong proficiency in both Microsoft and Linux operating systems.
  • Substantial hands-on experience designing, operating and troubleshooting large VMware estates or alternate virtualization platforms.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps tooling (e.g. Ansible, Python, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines), with a track record of automating real operational work.
  • Sound knowledge of IT security principles and practices, and the ability to build security into designs and solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to diagnose complex issues under pressure.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering projects, with working knowledge of Agile or other delivery methodologies.
  • A collaborative approach, and a willingness to mentor and develop others.

Therefore, the above job description is not comprehensive or exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to adjust, add to or eliminate any aspect of the above description. The Company also retains the right to require all employees to undertake additional or different job responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Benefits & Perks

  • Company-Paid Lunch Stipend: Lunch is provided via GrubHub
  • Company-Paid Benefits: 100% Employer-Paid Medical in our High Deductible Health Plan, Dental and Vision benefits for employees and their families, 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program, Life insurance, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability
  • 401(k): Company will match 100% of your contributions up to 6%
  • Optional Employee-Paid Benefits: Medical insurance in our PPO plan and a variety of other benefits such as Health Savings Accounts (with Company Contribution!), Flexible Spending Accounts, Supplemental Life Insurance, Wellhub and more.
