Assignment Type: Direct Hire

Pay: $120,000–$130,000 annually, plus an annual bonus.

Work Schedule: Onsite Monday–Friday for the first 90 days. After 90 days, eligible for one remote day per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). Occasional travel to other offices may be required.

Benefits: This position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).

Our client is an established professional services organization offering a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional development, and a strong commitment to technology modernization. The organization is investing in its IT infrastructure and security capabilities and is seeking a motivated technical professional to help support its continued growth.

We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to support and enhance a multi-location technology environment. This is a hands-on technical position with primary responsibility for server infrastructure and secondary responsibility for networking, security, and cloud technologies.

The ideal candidate will bring a solid technical foundation, strong troubleshooting skills, and a desire to continue developing professionally. This individual will partner with internal IT professionals and external technology providers to improve infrastructure reliability, strengthen security practices, and support ongoing technology initiatives.

We are especially interested in candidates who have worked within established IT organizations and understand the importance of processes, accountability, teamwork, and professional communication.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and optimize Windows Server environments, virtualization platforms, and supporting infrastructure to ensure dependable system performance.
  • Assist with the administration and troubleshooting of enterprise networks, including firewalls, switches, wireless connectivity, and remote access solutions.
  • Support Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, and Entra ID.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure security, system performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate on cybersecurity initiatives involving access management, endpoint protection, threat prevention, and Zero Trust strategies.
  • Monitor backup systems and assist with disaster recovery planning, testing, and business continuity efforts.
  • Investigate and resolve complex technical problems involving servers, network connectivity, cloud applications, and security systems.
  • Work closely with internal technology teams and outside vendors on infrastructure upgrades, implementations, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Introduce automation and process improvements to reduce repetitive administrative tasks and improve reliability.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, and procedures.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects supporting multiple office locations, including equipment deployments and technology upgrades.
  • Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with other IT team members.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, networking, or a related technical field. Candidates with less experience and strong technical potential will also be considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting network technologies, including firewalls, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and VPN connectivity.
  • Understanding of infrastructure security principles and best practices.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and identity management.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues and identify effective solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple responsibilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated initiative, professionalism, accountability, and willingness to learn new technologies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience administering Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, and Entra ID.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust security concepts and modern cybersecurity frameworks.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting or other infrastructure automation tools.
  • Exposure to enterprise backup, storage, and disaster recovery platforms.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation technologies such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Experience supporting technology operations within a structured corporate IT environment.
  • Relevant Microsoft, networking, infrastructure, or cybersecurity certifications.

Additional Details:

  • Team Environment: Work alongside an established IT team and external technology partners.
  • Technical Focus: Server infrastructure, virtualization, networking, Microsoft technologies, and security.
  • Career Growth: Opportunity to expand technical expertise and participate in infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Pre-Employment Requirements: Successful completion of a background check.

This opportunity is ideal for a technically skilled, motivated professional who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, collaborating with experienced IT teams, and taking ownership of meaningful technology initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

The Cloud Engineer will design, operate, and continuously improve Rivian’s multi-cloud infrastructure with a strategic focus on our expansion into Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AI/LLM enabled workloads, and our already mature AWS environment. This is a hands-on, operations-focused role that drives infrastructure automation, security, observability, and cost optimization for mission-critical cloud workloads.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to deliver cloud solutions that enable teams to operate cloud workloads that are performance and cost optimized.
  • Operate and secure core networking, accounts, and workload identities (IAM/SSO) in GCP .
  • Enable and operationalize cloud services to support AI/ML and LLM workloads, including AWS Bedrock and GCP AI platforms.
  • Automate infrastructure end-to-end using Terraform (IaC), AWX/Ansible, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot critical workloads, including EKS/Kubernetes environments, HPC clusters, and large-scale storage.
  • Implement and improve observability best practices (e.g. AWS CloudWatch, GCP Monitoring) and participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
  • Drive cost eﬃciency (FinOps mindset) by supporting ongoing cost reviews and optimization efforts.

Qualifications

  • Growth mindset with the ability to evaluate/learn new technologies quickly and apply them to deliver solutions that meet Business needs.
  • Hands-on experience operating production workloads on GCP (AWS is a plus).
  • Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (Cloud Formation, CDK, Terraform) and configuration management (Ansible/AWX).
  • Strong knowledge of coreGCP services (GKE, networking, Vertex AI/Gemini).
  • Practical experience with observability tools (e.g., Datadog) and strong debugging skills across distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming or scripting language for tooling and automation (e.g., Python, Go).
  • Proficiency in generating software using coding agents; productionizing vibe-coded applications.

Pay Disclosure

Salary Range for this role is $97,700 - $122,100 for Georgia based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.

Interview Integrity & AI Policy

Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore, the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted. We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.

Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The Sr. Systems Engineer collaborates with the Architecture and Engineering teams in the implementation and operation of Verra Mobility. This position works closely with the IT Operations Manager and various technology disciplines to implement best-in-class cloud technology deployment to support business initiatives. This role includes implementing, supporting, securing, and monitoring services on premises, in Microsoft Azure and cloud ecosystems. The position is preferred in Indy, Mesa, Phoenix, or Chicago.

Primary Job Responsibilities

  • Implement on premise technologies, private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid solutions primarily in Azure.
  • Manage and support hyperconverged platforms such as Cisco UCS, VxRail and VMware
  • Implement availability and performance monitoring frameworks.
  • Implement and test system-level High Availability and Disaster Recovery plans.
  • Track, control, and report the status of system conditions, software, documentation, and infrastructure changes to management.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts or frameworks.
  • Provide high-quality support to customers, prospects, management, and peers.
  • Interpret and provide solutions on complex technologies/architectures.
  • Design and deliver secure cloud solutions on Azure or AWS.
  • Deep Windows Server expertise and Linux knowledge.
  • Cloud Formation / Automation / PowerShell / DSC / Comparable Linux Scripting.
  • Architecture design, system evaluation, system analysis, and infrastructure assessment.
  • Leverage resource tagging to allocate costs and optimize resource planning.
  • Lead incident management, involving other support organizations and outside vendors.
  • Participate in a global follow-the-sun support model, including after-hours and on-call responsibilities, as needed.
  • Provide work breakdown and estimates for complex tasks.

Additional Skills And Knowledge

  • Knowledge of Tanium, Windows/Linus patching, 3rd party application patching and Reporting.
  • Knowledge of Rubrik backups, hands on experience with cloud storage (Qumulo, NetApp)
  • Knowledge of Azure, Networking, NSG, EntraID, Storage Accounts, Private Endpoints, Virtual Machines, etc.
  • Expertise in VMware, including Template Creation and VM Management.
  • Experience with Zerto, including VPG Migration and VPG Setup.
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, DNS, and Account Management.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in on premise datacenter environments, private/public cloud, SAN, and networking.
  • Relevant Datacenter or Cloud certification accreditations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Self-directed approach with a high degree of initiative to propose new solutions, troubleshoot, and resolve issues.
  • BS in Computer Science or related experience.
  • Experience in data center installation and operations.
  • Strong understanding of hyper-converged infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting multi-site and hot-hot architectures.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows Server operating systems is a must.
  • Expertise in VMware data center stack; VxRail, vSphere, NSX, vROP’s, and storage.
  • Experience implementing scripts for automation and systems management.
  • Familiar with multi-tiered escalation and on-call procedures.
  • Experience working in SOX, SOC2, ISO, and PCI compliant multi-tenant environments.
  • Hands-on experience assisting Software Engineering and Quality Assurance with deployment issues related to the different classes of environments that comprise the infrastructure

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Verra Mobility Applicant Privacy Notice

Verra Mobility is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:

Essential Functions:

Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design, deploy, and optimize secure Azure infrastructure solutions.
  • Manage hybrid and cloud-native directory services (AD, Azure AD / Entra ID).
  • Implement IaC using ARM/Bicep/Terraform.
  • Integrate infrastructure into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Apply Azure monitoring, diagnostics, baselines, and performance best practices.

Intune / Modern Endpoint Management

  • Lead Microsoft Intune & SCCM/MECM operations.
  • Deploy Autopilot, compliance baselines, secure configurations.
  • Create and manage Windows 11 SOE & gold images.
  • Manage patching across cloud & on-prem endpoints.
  • Provide Tier 3 mobility and endpoint escalation.

Systems Engineering & Operations

  • Document systems, standards, workflows, and architecture diagrams.
  • Lead root-cause analysis & improve resiliency.
  • Build automation for provisioning, monitoring, reporting.
  • Maintain compliance, regulatory controls.

Collaboration, Documentation & Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and serve as SME.
  • Provide training for technical support & logistics teams.
  • Participate in maintenance windows, travel, and on‑call rotation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years infrastructure engineering or cloud operations experience.
  • Expertise with Azure, Intune/SCCM, Active Directory, Windows Server.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation background.
  • Ability to architect and support large-scale enterprise systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Azure certifications (AZ‑104, AZ‑305, AZ‑800/801).
  • M365, Intune, and security certifications (MS‑102, MD‑102).
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, Zero Trust, conditional access.
  • Experience with virtualization, VMware, endpoint security.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and evolving our enterprise business platforms landscape across commercial and government environments. You will be responsible for maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud and infrastructure services while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable business solutions.

You will:

  • Design, implement, and support infrastructure solutions across Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, and AWS environments.
  • Manage and maintain Windows Server, Linux, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure platforms to ensure stability, performance, and security.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Service Principals, Managed Identities, and related authentication services.
  • Support enterprise applications, databases, and business-critical platforms by ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, database, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, security, and availability while proactively identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Lead and participate in cloud modernization, migration, automation, and digital transformation efforts.
  • Develop automation solutions using tools such as PowerShell, Python, and AI-enabled technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Evaluate and leverage Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and other AI-driven technologies to streamline IT operations, support processes, and user experiences.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, application, identity, database, and networking issues across enterprise environments.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to continuously improve platform reliability, security, and service delivery.


This is a site‑based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.

The day-to-day

In this role, you will balance operational support, infrastructure engineering, security administration, and continuous improvement activities across cloud and on-premises environments. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Managing and supporting infrastructure across Azure Commercial, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid environments.
  • Administering Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, IAM, Service Principals, Managed Identities, and authentication services.
  • Monitoring system health, security, performance, and availability, and responding to incidents, alerts, and service requests.
  • Supporting Windows and Linux servers, cloud resources, enterprise applications, and business-critical platforms.
  • Troubleshooting infrastructure, application, database, networking, and access-related issues to minimize business impact.
  • Managing SSL/TLS certificates, PKI integrations, and identity-related services.
  • Working closely with application owners, security teams, database administrators, and network engineers to resolve technical issues and implement improvements.
  • Supporting SQL Server and Oracle environments, including connectivity, access, and infrastructure-related administration.
  • Implementing and maintaining security controls to meet organizational and regulatory requirements, including NIST, CMMC, ITAR, and FedRAMP frameworks.
  • Automating routine operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Evaluating and supporting AI-enabled solutions, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, and automation technologies that improve operational efficiency.
  • Participating in cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Maintaining technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Participating in on-call support and incident response activities as required.


What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Service Principals, and Managed Identities.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting or administering SQL Server and/or Oracle database environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills across infrastructure, application, identity, and networking technologies.
  • Experience managing certificates, SSL/TLS, PKI, and security-related technologies.
  • Exposure to cloud automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, or SOX.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or other AI-enabled automation solutions.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to improve operational efficiency, support processes, and system management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and eligible to support government-regulated environments.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Experience working in hybrid cloud environments spanning Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity governance, authentication, and access management concepts.
  • Familiarity with Service Principals, Managed Identities, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Experience supporting environments subject to government, defense, or regulated industry compliance requirements such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, or FedRAMP.
  • Proficiency with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, and AI-assisted operational workflows.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve troubleshooting, operational efficiency, documentation, monitoring, and incident response processes.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, modernization, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across infrastructure, security, networking, database, and application teams.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and mission-critical systems in production environments.
  • Ability to prioritize work effectively, manage multiple activities simultaneously, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), Azure AI Engineer (AI-102), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, or similar cloud and security certifications.


Salary range

$121,000.00 - $191,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $150,000.00- $225,000.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits.

EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic.   • Design, build and maintain Windows Server and Desktop environments
  • Design, build and maintain virtualization and cloud environments
  • Leverage automation for deploying and supporting on-premises and cloud infrastructure
  • Partner with the Security team on the design, implement, and support of our centralized identity and access management solution
  • Partner with the Security team to ensure we are adhering to security best practices across all environments including patch remediation and system hardening
  • Review and improve upon existing monitoring systems and process
  • Perform Windows OS performance tuning
  • Author and maintain computer system design documentation, diagrams, processes and procedures
  • Promote and adopt Infrastructure as Code across all IT
  • Be a mentor to junior IT staff
  • Participate in an on-call rotation

Requirements:

  • Self-starter with a passion for technology and problem solving
  • Experience as a senior infrastructure engineer
  • Deep knowledge and practical implementation of Windows, virtualization, and cloud computing infrastructure
  • Deep knowledge of Windows operating systems
  • Deep knowledge of virtualization technologies
  • Experience implementing and supporting identity platforms such as Azure AD and Active Directory
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP and multicast
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Powershell and Python
  • Extensive experience configuration management systems such as Ansible, Salt, or Terraform
  • Extensive experience with endpoint management systems such as Microsoft Endpoint Manager
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Ability to present complex, technical ideas in a clear and concise manner to non-technical audiences

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus eligibility
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Options
  • Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary LTD, Life & AD&D insurance

  • Retirement plan with employer match

This role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus (at DV Trading's discretion) and DV Trading's benefits package, including the benefits listed above.

Base Salary Range

$200,000—$250,000 USD

Job Description:

Position Overview

The primary responsibility of the Infrastructure Engineer is to design, implement, and support hybrid enterprise infrastructure platforms including on-premise networks and servers, cloud IAAS/PAAS solutions, and integrations between environments to enable secure, scalable, and reliable deployment of internally developed software applications.

This role bridges traditional on-premise infrastructure (network, compute, data center) with modern cloud platforms (Azure), ensuring seamless integration, high availability, and operational readiness. The position collaborates closely with enterprise architecture, software development, cyber security, and IT operations teams to deliver resilient infrastructure solutions aligned with business and technology objectives.

All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and Las Vegas Sands Corp.’s policies, practices, and procedures. All Las Vegas Sands Corp. Team Members are expected to conduct and carry themselves in a professional manner at all times. Team Members are required to observe the company’s standards, work requirements and rules of conduct.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise infrastructure.
  • Manage and support physical network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, and connectivity services.
  • Configure and maintain network technologies such as DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Web Proxies, and firewalls.
  • Build and support on-premises infrastructure at multiple locations, including but not limited to Physical servers, Vmware, Windows, Linux, and Containerization platforms.
  • Support hybrid cloud environments bridging on-premises infrastructure with Azure platforms.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure standards to support application deployment, scalability, and resiliency.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and application teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for CI/CD pipelines and software releases.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related issues impacting application performance or availability.
  • Implement and enforce security controls, network segmentation, and identity/access integration aligned with Cyber Security standards.
  • Implement and support containerized and distributed application environments (e.g., Kubernetes/AKS, virtualized workloads).
  • Ability to deploy, monitor, and support Azure-based applications across development, test, and production environments.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to optimize application build, release, and deployment processes.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability of deployed applications and infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to deployment failures, performance bottlenecks, and system outages.
  • Manage source control and branching strategies using Git-based repositories.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts for operational efficiency and repeatability.
  • Ensure proper logging, monitoring, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tools.
  • Document deployment processes and operational runbooks to support internally developed software transition to operations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance release velocity, system resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Perform job duties in a safe manner.
  • Attend work as scheduled on a consistent and regular basis.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Proof of authorization to work in the United States.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Cisco network certifications desirable, but not required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain any certification or license, as required by law or policy.
  • 5-8 years of experience building and supporting Windows/Linux server infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with enterprise networking – vlans and routing, switching, LAN/WAN technologies, SDWAN, 802.1x security (Cisco preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure (compute, networking, storage, identity).
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or similar).
  • Experience supporting hybrid environments (on-prem + cloud integration).
  • Experience with Active Directory services and Group Policy management.
  • Experience with scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar).
  • Experience deploying enterprise-grade, vendor, SaaS, and internally developed applications.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, ARM, or Bicep).
  • Experience with containerization orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, on-prem and cloud).
  • Experience supporting application deployment environments and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools within On-prem and Azure ecosystems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and interact appropriately with management, other Team Members and outside contacts of different backgrounds and levels of experience.


Physical Requirements

Must be able to:

  • Physically access assigned workspace areas with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Work remotely as necessary.
  • Work indoors and be exposed to various environmental factors such as, but not limited to, CRT, noise, and dust.
  • Utilize laptop and standard keyboard to perform essential functions of the job.
  • Occasional travel to sites in Nevada and Texas as needs arise (less than 10%).

Wintrust provides community and commercial banking, specialty finance and wealth management services through its 16 bank charters and nine non-bank businesses. Wintrust delivers the sophisticated solutions of a large bank while staying true to the relationship-focused, personalized service of our community banking roots. We serve clients in all 50 states with more than 200 branch banking locations in Illinois, southwestern Florida, northwestern Indiana, west Michigan and southern Wisconsin and commercial banking offices in Chicago, Denver, Milwaukee, Grand Rapids, Mich., and in key branch banking locations throughout Illinois. Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Wintrust is a $66 billion financial institution based in Rosemont, Illinois, and listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “WTFC.”

Why join us?

  • An award-winning culture! We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe & Mail (past 6 years)
  • Competitive pay and discretionary or incentive bonus eligible
  • Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company match and tuition reimbursement to name a few
  • Promote from within culture

Why join this team?

  • This position has the opportunity to interface with and have a positive impact on multiple areas of Wintrust's business
  • We hold ourselves accountable to high standards, share wins, operate ethically, and have fun

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Azure Cloud Engineer to design, implement, manage, and optimize cloud-based solutions within Microsoft Azure. This individual will join our growing IT Infrastructure Operations team and will partner closely with the Cloud Architect and other technology teams to maintain secure, scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure while driving automation, cloud governance, and modernization initiatives.

The Senior Azure Cloud Engineer will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the organization's Azure environment through cloud engineering best practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps automation, performance optimization, and resiliency planning.

In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, this role will serve as a senior technical resource for the team, providing mentorship and technical guidance to existing cloud and Microsoft 365 team members to help mature internal cloud capabilities.

This is full time, hybrid role based at our corporate headquarters in Rosemont, IL, reporting to the Principal System Engineer Manager.

What You’ll Do

Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner with peers to implement and manage Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, and Storage Accounts.
  • Configure and support Azure Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings.
  • Monitor cloud resource utilization and optimize performance and costs.

Security & Cloud Governance

  • Implement and maintain Azure security best practices and cloud governance standards.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID/Azure Active Directory, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and identity access management.
  • Identify, monitor, and remediate cloud security vulnerabilities.
  • Help ensure appropriate controls, policies, and standards are incorporated into the Azure environment.

Automation & DevOps

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and Bicep.
  • Build and support automated deployments using Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop scripts and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or Python.

Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Production Support

  • Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, cloud, and application issues.
  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for Azure-related incidents and service requests.
  • Participate in on-call support rotations as required.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Implement and maintain backup and recovery solutions using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Perform disaster recovery testing and validation.
  • Develop and improve high-availability, resiliency, backup, and recovery strategies for cloud-based systems.

Collaboration, Mentorship & Technical Leadership

  • Partner closely with application, security, network, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  • Work with the Cloud Architect to implement and mature the organization's Azure cloud strategy.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations related to Azure infrastructure and cloud engineering.
  • Mentor and train team members, including existing cloud and Microsoft 365 staff, to strengthen internal cloud engineering capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing, deploying, administering, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure infrastructure services, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Storage Accounts, and PaaS offerings.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and/or Bicep.
  • Proficiency with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation scripting using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or Python.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC, cloud security, governance, and compliance best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical teams while providing mentorship, technical leadership, and knowledge transfer.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud migration and modernization projects.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, or comparable certifications).

Benefits

Medical Insurance

  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life insurance
  • Accidental death and dismemberment
  • Short-term and long-term Disability Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Traditional and Roth 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan at 5% discount
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Transportation and Commuting Benefits
  • Banking Benefits
  • Pet Insurance

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this role is $100,000.00 - $132,000.00, along with eligibility to earn an annual bonus. Actual salaries may vary based on several factors, such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills and experience.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and evolving our enterprise business platforms landscape across commercial and government environments. You will be responsible for maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud and infrastructure services while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable business solutions.

You will:

  • Design, implement, and support infrastructure solutions across Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, and AWS environments.
  • Manage and maintain Windows Server, Linux, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure platforms to ensure stability, performance, and security.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Service Principals, Managed Identities, and related authentication services.
  • Support enterprise applications, databases, and business-critical platforms by ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, database, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, security, and availability while proactively identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Lead and participate in cloud modernization, migration, automation, and digital transformation efforts.
  • Develop automation solutions using tools such as PowerShell, Python, and AI-enabled technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Evaluate and leverage Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and other AI-driven technologies to streamline IT operations, support processes, and user experiences.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, application, identity, database, and networking issues across enterprise environments.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to continuously improve platform reliability, security, and service delivery.


This is a site‑based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.

The day-to-day

In this role, you will balance operational support, infrastructure engineering, security administration, and continuous improvement activities across cloud and on-premises environments. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Managing and supporting infrastructure across Azure Commercial, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid environments.
  • Administering Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, IAM, Service Principals, Managed Identities, and authentication services.
  • Monitoring system health, security, performance, and availability, and responding to incidents, alerts, and service requests.
  • Supporting Windows and Linux servers, cloud resources, enterprise applications, and business-critical platforms.
  • Troubleshooting infrastructure, application, database, networking, and access-related issues to minimize business impact.
  • Managing SSL/TLS certificates, PKI integrations, and identity-related services.
  • Working closely with application owners, security teams, database administrators, and network engineers to resolve technical issues and implement improvements.
  • Supporting SQL Server and Oracle environments, including connectivity, access, and infrastructure-related administration.
  • Implementing and maintaining security controls to meet organizational and regulatory requirements, including NIST, CMMC, ITAR, and FedRAMP frameworks.
  • Automating routine operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Evaluating and supporting AI-enabled solutions, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, and automation technologies that improve operational efficiency.
  • Participating in cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Maintaining technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Participating in on-call support and incident response activities as required.


What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Service Principals, and Managed Identities.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting or administering SQL Server and/or Oracle database environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills across infrastructure, application, identity, and networking technologies.
  • Experience managing certificates, SSL/TLS, PKI, and security-related technologies.
  • Exposure to cloud automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, or SOX.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or other AI-enabled automation solutions.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to improve operational efficiency, support processes, and system management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and eligible to support government-regulated environments.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Experience working in hybrid cloud environments spanning Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity governance, authentication, and access management concepts.
  • Familiarity with Service Principals, Managed Identities, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Experience supporting environments subject to government, defense, or regulated industry compliance requirements such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, or FedRAMP.
  • Proficiency with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, and AI-assisted operational workflows.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve troubleshooting, operational efficiency, documentation, monitoring, and incident response processes.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, modernization, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across infrastructure, security, networking, database, and application teams.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and mission-critical systems in production environments.
  • Ability to prioritize work effectively, manage multiple activities simultaneously, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), Azure AI Engineer (AI-102), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, or similar cloud and security certifications.


Salary range

$121,000.00 - $191,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $150,000.00- $225,000.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits.

We require people to be on-site, 4 days/week at our Denver or NYC office and are unable to offer relocation support.

LG Ad Solutions

LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape.

The Opportunity

We're growing our infrastructure team in Denver and looking for an engineer who has gotten their hands dirty with both physical infrastructure and cloud environments — someone who's moved past tutorials and has real scars from production systems. You don't need to have all the answers yet, but you should be able to own a task end-to-end, ask good questions, and learn fast in a hybrid environment that spans data centers and AWS.

You'll work alongside senior engineers on a team that's actively building out our on-premises layer — provisioning servers, managing network infrastructure, extending our IaC practices, and keeping everything running reliably. This is a role where you'll be doing real work from day one, with mentorship and context from engineers who've built these systems before.

A Note On What We're Not Looking For

This role isn't for someone who's only worked in fully managed cloud environments and wants to stay there. The on-prem side of this team is real and growing — if physical infrastructure sounds boring or intimidating, this probably isn't the right fit. If it sounds interesting and you want to learn it properly, we'd love to talk.

Responsibilities

Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Assist with deployment and maintenance of on-premises compute, storage, and networking infrastructure alongside our AWS environment
  • Participate in bare metal server provisioning and OS deployment workflows
  • Support day-to-day network operations: troubleshoot connectivity issues, help maintain firewall rules, VLANs, and VPN configurations under senior guidance
  • Help maintain and document storage systems and cloud connectivity configurations

Automation & Platform Support

  • Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible for both on-prem and cloud resources
  • Support CI/CD pipeline maintenance and help onboard teams to existing platform tooling
  • Assist with Kubernetes cluster operations — deployments, troubleshooting, resource management — across bare metal and EKS environments
  • Contribute automation scripts and tooling improvements in Python or Bash

Security & Reliability

  • Follow established security standards for on-prem and cloud: help maintain RBAC configurations, apply patches, and support access management processes
  • Participate in on-call rotation with support from senior engineers; help investigate and resolve infrastructure incidents
  • Contribute to monitoring dashboards and alert configuration across hybrid environments

Collaboration

  • Work closely with senior engineers and application teams to understand infrastructure needs and translate them into tickets and tasks
  • Keep runbooks, wikis, and operational documentation current as you learn systems
  • Flag issues, ambiguities, and potential improvements — your observations from ground-level operations matter

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, systems administration, or a related role
  • At least one full-time industry role beyond your first job (internships and co-ops count toward the foundation, but we're looking for professional experience in a production environment)
  • Comfortable with Linux system administration: file systems, networking, process management, bash scripting
  • Hands-on experience with at least one IaC tool — Terraform or Ansible preferred
  • Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and basic networking concepts
  • Basic networking understanding: IP addressing, DNS, VLANs, firewalls — you don't need to configure BGP from scratch, but you should be able to troubleshoot a connectivity issue
  • Experience with or exposure to Kubernetes — doesn't need to be bare metal, but you should understand the basics of pods, deployments, and services
  • Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automation tasks

Nice to Have

  • Any exposure to physical infrastructure: data center work, homelab, or on-prem environments in a professional setting
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible, Salt, or similar)
  • AWS certification (any level) or in-progress certification
  • Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK

LG Ad Solutions provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@lgads.tv to let us know the nature of your request.

Application Deadline: December 31, 2026

Compensation & Benefits

  • Tier 1* (San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Tri-State Area, Los Angeles Metro Area, and Seattle Metro Area)$128,000 - $176,000/year
  • Tier 2* (all other U.S. Locations outside of Tier 1)$112,000 – $154,000/yr
  • Offers Bonus
  • Benefits & Perks: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents. Company-paid life and AD&D, STD and LTD insurance, plus optional supplemental coverage. 401(k) with company match. Flexible Time Off (FTO). Paid parental leave.
  • Certain markets, including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Tri-State Area, Los Angeles Metro Area, and Seattle Metro Area, are aligned to Tier 1 compensation bands. All other U.S. locations are aligned to Tier 2 compensation bands. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge

The Systems Engineering team crafts, builds, deploys and maintains a wide variety of IT infrastructure using the latest standards and technologies.

We are actively looking for a Cloud Systems Engineer with a broad range of systems infrastructure related and general purpose programming skills. Our ideal candidate has a rich and diverse technical background, is creative and passionate about IT systems, as well as standardization, optimization, and automation. Furthermore, this candidate will have experience architecting, engineering, implementing, and supporting large scale enterprise networks, storage, and system infrastructures in public and private cloud, and on-prem solutions to accommodate end-users, developers, and internal/external customers.

Candidates are expected to stay aware of industry changes and plan to keep ahead of industry advancements to help guide the use and implementation of technology at Take-Two.

What You’ll Take On

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure across AWS and GCP, following cloud-native best practices.
  • Manage all infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, writing, reviewing, and enforcing IaC standards across the team.
  • Develop and maintain automation tooling and internal platforms using Python, reducing manual toil.
  • Lead the design and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub workflows..
  • Proactively monitor system performance and availability, participate in an on-call rotation and drive post incident reviews to improve reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with development, security, and networking teams to evaluate and adopt new cloud services and technologies.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, establishing standards for code quality.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture decision records.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on cloud engineering experience, with significant depth in AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, EBS, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, and more) and working knowledge of GCP.
  • Write terraform modules, manage state, enforce policy, and review IaC PRs.
  • Use GitHub for pull requests, branch strategy, actions workflows, and repository management..
  • Python is your primary scripting and automation language. You write clean, tested, maintainable code.
  • Proficiency with Linux system administration, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls), and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS).
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles and experience building or maintaining delivery pipelines.
  • Experience architecting for high availability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization in a cloud-native environment.
  • Communicate clearly to explain complex infrastructure topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Great to Have

  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Familiarity with observability stacks like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CheckMK, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of service mesh or advanced networking patterns (e.g., AWS Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, GCP VPC peering).
  • Background in gaming, media, or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive industries.
  • Experience with cost management tooling and FinOps practices in large AWS environments.

What We Offer You

  • Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
  • Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
  • Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
  • Benefits. Medical (HSA & FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!
  • Perks. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events and stocked pantries.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). If you need to report an issue or otherwise have questions, please contact Careers@take2games.com

As an equal opportunity employer, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (“Take-Two”) is committed to fostering and celebrating the diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds of its talent, partners, and communities throughout its organization. Consistent with this commitment, Take-Two does not discriminate or retaliate against any employee or job applicant because of their race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, and genetic information (including family medical history), or on the basis of any other trait protected by applicable law. If you need to report a concern or have questions regarding Take-Two’s equal opportunity commitment, please contact Careers@take2games.com.

What You Bring

companyDescription:
Tennessee Oncology is one of the nation’s largest community-based cancer care specialists and home to one of the leading clinical trial networks in the country.

Established 1976 in Nashville, Tennessee Oncology’s mission remains unchanged: To provide access to high quality cancer care and the expertise of clinical research for all patients at convenient locations within their community and close to their home. To this day, our growing network of physicians and number of locations is based on this mission.  In 2018, Tennessee Oncology joined OneOncology, a partnership of oncologists and industry leading experts driving the future of community-based cancer care in the United States, as a founding practice partner.  

Physicians specializing in gynecologic oncology, palliative care, radiation oncology, and health psychology comprise our group.

Tennessee Oncology provides a full range of diagnostic services, including oncology specific expertise in PET/CT and laboratory services. Clinic locations provide on-site chemotherapy treatments so that patients receive care in their community and close to their home.

Our physicians utilize the latest in molecular diagnostics and profiling to choose treatments specific to the genetics of your cancer.

Oncology research is the largest area of new drug development. Self -administered medications, those taken by mouth or injected by the patient, comprise approximately 40% of these investigative medications. Tennessee Oncology’s in house pharmacy, Park Pharmacy, stocks oncology and hematology medications not readily available at community retail pharmacies. A URAC accredited Specialty Pharmacy, Park provides insurance and benefits investigation, prior authorization services for insurance coverage, co-pay assistance through manufacturer or foundation programs, extensive medication education, and access to a pharmacist 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Job Description

The Systems Engineer works to build company success through maintaining, expanding and improving our core infrastructure, systems and services. Working closely with peer team members, the Systems Engineer will collaborate on best practices, resolve technical issues and introduce emerging technologies and automation to realize the company’s technological and business goals. The right person for this position must have excellent problem solving and analytical skills, a strong attention to detail, strong customer service ideals and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel, as well as vendors and other third parties.

Essential Functions

  • Maintain and enhance existing core infrastructure (compute/storage/network/software) in our production data center and cloud environments
  • Handle day-to-day system operations supporting Windows, VMware, and Azure environments which include monitoring of system alerts, maintenance, troubleshooting, hardware/software installation, and system backups
  • Perform installation, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance of virtual and physical servers, as well as storage area networks
  • Troubleshoot and maintain public cloud Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) in Azure including Microsoft 365 SaaS cloud environment components in a hybrid, federated model as well as Azure Active Directory, Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services, Exchange Online and Exchange on-premise
  • Develop and maintain automation initiatives to augment core systems and infrastructure
  • Administer systems and software related to endpoint services functionality as needed
  • Create and maintain documentation of configurations, specifications, processes and procedures.
  • Work with outside vendors on implementation projects for new systems/technologies
  • Promote a team atmosphere and maintain good relations with Tennessee Oncology’s internal and external user base and its partners
  • Participate in rotation to provide after-hours support

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Willingness to learn new systems and skillsets
  • PowerShell proficiency
  • Windows Server administration
  • Active Directory integration and administration
  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • Microsoft Azure IaaS deployment/operations experience
  • Citrix XenApp/Virtual Apps and/or Citrix Cloud
  • VMware vSphere/ESXi
  • iSCSI SAN (Storage Area Network)
  • Microsoft SQL Server administration
  • Strong communication, documentation, research, and problem-solving/analytical skills
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong knowledge of industry best practice and security standards
  • Self-motivated and directed, with advanced ability to prioritize and execute tasks

Education & Experience

  • REQUIRED: Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in an appropriate field, or equivalent full-time work experience
  • PREFERRED: 2+ years of experience in the role of a Systems or Infrastructure Administrator
  • Experience operating hybrid cloud/multi-cloud environments a strong plus
  • Experience in healthcare industry a strong plus

Physical Requirements

  • Day travel may be required to and from our co-location data center as well as our other clinic locations throughout Middle Tennessee; on rare occasions overnight travel to a few of the more distant clinics may be required
  • Must be willing and able to lift at least 40 pounds
