descriptionHtml:
About Us

UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach. We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. UJET's AI solutions empower agents, optimize customer journeys, and transform contact center operations for elevated experiences and actionable insights. Built on a cloud-native architecture with a unique CRM-first approach, UJET ensures unmatched security, scalability, and prioritized data insights (without storing PII). Designed for effortless use, UJET partners with businesses to deliver exceptional interactions, smarter decision-making, and accelerated growth in the AI-driven world.

Learn more at www.ujet.cx.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in Austin, TX, Los Angeles, CA, or Portland, ME to design, build, and evolve the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure that powers our cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role requiring strong production experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform, and cloud networking, preferably on GCP.

You will be responsible for the foundational infrastructure that supports our engineering organization, including Kubernetes clusters, GCP networking, infrastructure automation, identity and access management, and shared infrastructure services.

We are looking for engineers who have directly designed, built, operated, and troubleshot complex Kubernetes environments running on cloud providers—not simply deployed applications into existing clusters.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, operate, and maintain production infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including GKE, VPC networking, load balancers, Cloud DNS, IAM, and related cloud services.
  • Own the architecture and lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters, including provisioning, upgrades, node pool management, autoscaling, networking, capacity planning, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and automated provisioning workflows that enable consistent, reliable infrastructure management.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, DNS, cloud services, and distributed systems.
  • Design and maintain GCP networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnetworks, firewall rules, routing, NAT, load balancing, and connectivity between services and environments.
  • Build and improve infrastructure observability using Prometheus, logging systems, metrics, alerting, and related monitoring tools.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls, including IAM policies, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege access patterns.
  • Drive infrastructure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization across our GCP environment.
  • Plan and execute major infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and architectural improvements while minimizing production risk.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Security teams to establish scalable infrastructure patterns and clear technical ownership.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and mentorship of other engineers.

Required Qualifications

Cloud Native Infrastructure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred

  • 3+ years of hands-on production experience, including designing, provisioning, operating, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.
  • Deep practical knowledge of GCP networking, including VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, routing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, and Cloud Load Balancing.
  • Experience managing GCP projects, IAM policies, service accounts, and infrastructure security configurations.
  • Demonstrated experience debugging production infrastructure problems involving multiple GCP services.
  • Requires periodic in-person collaboration at a UJET office or designated location.

Kubernetes / GKE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Direct experience provisioning, administering, upgrading, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and internals, including the control plane, worker nodes, scheduling, networking, services, ingress, storage, and resource management.
  • Experience managing node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, cluster capacity, and Kubernetes version upgrades.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex Kubernetes infrastructure issues involving networking, DNS, node health, scheduling, resource pressure, and cluster-level failures.
  • Experience using tools such as kubectl, Helm, and Kubernetes monitoring and diagnostic utilities.

Experience limited to deploying containerized applications into Kubernetes does not satisfy this requirement.

Infrastructure as Code and Automation

  • 3+ years of professional experience using Terraform to provision and manage production cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, managing remote state, and implementing safe infrastructure change processes.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience with Git-based infrastructure management workflows, code reviews, and automated validation.

Systems and Networking

  • Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
  • Ability to diagnose difficult infrastructure problems using logs, metrics, traces, packet-level analysis, and systematic debugging techniques.
  • Experience designing secure, resilient, and scalable production infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional engineering experience
  • Extensive experience operating GKE clusters in large-scale, multi-cluster, or multi-region production environments.
  • Experience with GKE networking, Workload Identity, Gateway API, Ingress controllers, and cluster autoscaling technologies.
  • Experience designing multi-project GCP architectures with centralized networking, IAM governance, and infrastructure guardrails.
  • Experience operating Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging infrastructure.
  • Experience with Kubernetes infrastructure security, including RBAC, network policies, workload identity, and secrets management.
  • Experience performing major Kubernetes or GCP infrastructure migrations with minimal production disruption.
  • Experience with infrastructure cost optimization, capacity modeling, and cloud resource efficiency.
  • Experience supporting highly available SaaS platforms or distributed systems operating at significant production scale.
  • Mentors senior engineers and drives improvements in engineering practices, reliability, maintainability, and infrastructure scalability.

What Success Looks Like

  • Our GCP infrastructure is secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient.
  • Kubernetes clusters are well-managed, observable, consistently maintained, and upgraded with minimal production disruption.
  • Infrastructure provisioning is automated, repeatable, and maintainable through Terraform.
  • Complex infrastructure incidents are diagnosed quickly, with sustainable improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Engineering teams can depend on stable, well-designed cloud infrastructure foundations.
  • Infrastructure architecture and operational practices continuously improve as the company scales.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging infrastructure problems at the foundation of a cloud-native SaaS platform. You'll help shape our GCP and Kubernetes architecture, drive meaningful technical improvements, and work with experienced engineers across Infrastructure, Platform, SRE, and Security.

This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, take pride in technical excellence, and want direct ownership of the cloud environment that powers a modern production platform.

Annual US Hiring Range: $150,000 - $175,000

  • A candidate’s actual placement within this range will depend on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Why UJET?

  • Impactful Work: Be at the forefront of innovation, directly shaping the future of customer experience.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a collaborative, inclusive team that values big ideas, creative solutions, and powerful relationships.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, wellness benefits, and more.

UJET is an Equal Opportunity Employer

UJET provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compliance Responsibilities

Security, data protection and compliance (SDPC) are paramount to the success of our partnerships. All roles at UJET require compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and acceptance and adherence to all policies and standards within UJET. Personnel acknowledges they are personally responsible for reporting any suspected violations or abuse and are required to complete SDPC training and fulfill role-specific SDPC responsibilities.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

UJET uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the initial review and filtering of job applications against the qualifications listed in this posting. AI does not make hiring decisions, does not conduct interviews, and has no authority to reject or advance a candidate on its own. All application review decisions, candidate screening, and interviews are conducted by members of our human recruiting and hiring teams.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, including an alternative to AI-assisted screening, please contact peopleteam@ujet.cx.

Work Authorization & Sponsorship

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which this position is located, without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa sponsorship. UJET does not sponsor employment visas for this role.

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Engineer to design, build, automate, and support secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services.

  • Support backup, disaster recovery, resiliency, and business continuity requirements.
  • Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud costs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  • Strong PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar automation experience.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones and enterprise cloud governance.
  • Experience with AKS, containers, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Backup, or Azure Site Recovery.
  • Experience supporting hybrid and regulated enterprise environments.
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-700, or AZ-400.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $160,000.00/Yr. - USD $200,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Job Description

AWS Cloud Engineer – Infrastructure & Operations

We are seeking a technically capable and motivated Cloud Engineer to support the administration, security, reliability, and ongoing improvement of cloud-based infrastructure. This position will play an important role in maintaining cloud environments, supporting server operations, managing containerized applications, and ensuring the stability and security of critical business systems.

The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in cloud computing, systems administration, networking, and infrastructure security. We are open to considering both experienced professionals and early-career candidates who demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, initiative, and the ability to learn quickly.

Position Details

  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Work Arrangement: Fully onsite
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • On-call participation required for critical infrastructure support

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain, configure, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure across multiple environments.
  • Administer Linux and Windows-based systems, including configuration, updates, security controls, and performance improvements.
  • Support containerized applications and orchestration platforms.
  • Configure and troubleshoot web servers, reverse proxies, load balancing solutions, and network connectivity.
  • Monitor system availability, performance, and security using cloud-native and third-party monitoring solutions.
  • Identify and address infrastructure vulnerabilities, operating system exposures, and security-related findings.
  • Apply industry-recognized security frameworks and configuration standards to strengthen infrastructure environments.
  • Develop and maintain automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration processes.
  • Manage infrastructure code through version control and collaborative development practices.
  • Track technical issues, operational activities, maintenance requests, and remediation efforts through project management and ticketing platforms.
  • Investigate production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement solutions to prevent recurring issues.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, disaster recovery, backup processes, and ongoing operational improvements.
  • Work alongside technical teams across multiple business functions to support infrastructure initiatives.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and change-management records.

Required Technical Qualifications

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of AWS services, including compute, networking, identity management, storage, databases, and load balancing.
  • Understanding of cloud architecture, high availability, access controls, and infrastructure security.
  • Familiarity with managing and troubleshooting cloud-hosted production environments.

Systems Administration

  • Strong understanding of Linux operating systems and command-line administration.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server environments.
  • Knowledge of system services, user permissions, log analysis, patch management, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of operating system security configuration and hardening standards.

Networking & Security

  • Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, routing, firewalls, and network security.
  • Experience or familiarity with web server and reverse proxy configuration.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability assessment, security patching, and remediation practices.

Containers & Automation

  • Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration technologies.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and managed container environments.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code concepts and automated provisioning tools.
  • Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.

Monitoring & Operations

  • Familiarity with cloud monitoring, logging, and infrastructure performance tools.
  • Exposure to vulnerability scanning and security assessment platforms.
  • Familiarity with ticketing, incident management, and change-control systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and adapt to evolving technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in cloud engineering, systems administration, infrastructure operations, or information security.
  • Industry-recognized cloud certifications or relevant technical credentials.
  • Hands-on experience supporting production cloud environments and business-critical applications.
  • Experience with container orchestration, workload troubleshooting, and container management.
  • Practical experience developing and maintaining infrastructure automation configurations.
  • Experience with web servers, reverse proxies, load balancing, and network security controls.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms and established security configuration standards.
  • Exposure to Shell scripting, Python, automation tools, deployment pipelines, or related technologies.
  • Experience working with relational database platforms.
  • Background supporting highly available systems and responding to production incidents.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments, security audits, compliance requirements, and remediation activities.

Communication Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Additional language capabilities are a plus, particularly experience communicating technical information across international teams.
  • Ability to explain technical issues clearly and maintain accurate operational documentation.

Early-Career Candidates

Candidates with limited professional experience are encouraged to apply. Individuals demonstrating strong technical aptitude and a genuine interest in cloud infrastructure will be considered.

Relevant Experience May Include

  • Academic coursework or projects involving cloud computing, networking, operating systems, or cybersecurity.
  • Technical internships or entry-level IT experience.
  • Personal projects, home labs, or hands-on cloud environments.
  • Relevant certifications or independent technical training.
  • Strong analytical abilities, curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership of new challenges.

Work Environment & Availability

  • This is a fully onsite position based in Jacksonville, Florida. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.
  • Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation is required to support critical infrastructure and production incidents.
  • Must be available to respond to urgent system or security issues outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when scheduled.
  • Occasional planned maintenance activities may take place outside standard business hours.
  • On-call scheduling, response expectations, and applicable compensation are governed by company policies.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $120,000.00/ Annually

Senior Cloud Engineer

Accountability Statement

The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback.

This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on-call support rotation.

  • Responsible for day-to-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud-based systems.
  • Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on-call rotation with other cloud engineers.
  • Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates.
  • Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers.
  • Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on-premises operations.

descriptionHtml:
Systems Engineer III-V

Build, Secure, and Evolve the Infrastructure Behind Critical Operations

Georgia System Operations Corporation (GSOC) is seeking a Systems Engineer III-IV to support the technology infrastructure that enables the success of OPC, GTC, and GSOC. This role designs, deploys, and manages Windows and Linux desktop and server environments and implements cloud-based solutions across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft 365.

The Systems Engineer manages and optimizes physical and virtual servers, core cloud services, and workstation infrastructure while monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues, implementing automation and configuration management, and planning and performing system upgrades.

This role also helps ensure systems are secure and compliant with applicable standards and requirements, supports technical and business teams, documents configurations and processes, and contributes to continuous improvement. Depending on business needs, the position may specialize in a subset of infrastructure technologies.

What You'll Do

As a Systems Engineer III-V, you will combine hands-on infrastructure engineering, cloud technologies, troubleshooting, security, automation, and cross-functional support to improve system scalability, reliability, and security.

You Will

  • Design, deploy, and manage Windows and Linux desktop and server environments and related storage infrastructure.
  • Architect and implement cloud-based solutions using AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft 365 to support business needs.
  • Maintain and optimize physical and virtual servers and workstation infrastructure.
  • Monitor system performance, conduct system audits, troubleshoot issues, and perform routine maintenance activities including backup and recovery, patching, and file management.
  • Implement automation and configuration management and plan and perform system upgrades.
  • Implement and manage system security measures and configurations to support secure and compliant operations.
  • Participate in security audits and assessments and promptly address findings.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, support, technical, and business teams to support seamless system integration and operation.
  • Provide technical support for releases, upgrades, and changes and provide Tier 3 support for complex issues and escalations.
  • Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, processes, procedures, incidents, maintenance activities, and system performance.
  • Use ITSM tools to support ITIL practices including incident management, change management, problem management, asset management, and service requests.
  • Engage in continuous improvement activities to enhance system performance and reliability and stay current with emerging technologies and best practices.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited college or university. An equivalent combination of education, training, and directly related work experience may be considered.
  • Ideally 4 - 8+ years of experience designing and managing technology infrastructure environments, cloud-based solutions, system assessments, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Active Directory, Windows Server, Linux distributions, Microsoft Windows desktop operating systems, and desktop management systems.
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft 365.
  • Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or Proxmox.
  • Experience with Microsoft Exchange Online and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with configuration management and patch management tools and proficiency in scripting with PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Experience with ITSM tools and knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Strong understanding of network and system security best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, customer-service focus, and strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Preferred QualificationsCloud, Infrastructure & Virtualization

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft 365, VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, Proxmox, or related infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with databases and storage solutions, including SQL or NoSQL environments.

Automation, DevOps & Containers

  • Experience with configuration management, patch management, and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or Jenkins.

Security, Service Management & Certifications

  • Experience with security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, or EDR.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Ivanti ITSM.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft Exchange Online Support Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, Red Hat Certified Engineer, VMware Data Center Virtualization, Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator, ITIL Foundation, or CISSP.

Advantages of Working at GSOC

Working at GSOC means more than just a job--it's an opportunity to contribute to technology infrastructure that supports OPC, GTC, and GSOC.

Broad Technical Exposure

Work across Windows and Linux environments, physical and virtual infrastructure, cloud services, workstation technologies, automation, security, and service management.

Technical Ownership & Growth

At Level III, independently manage environments and begin leading small projects. At Level IV, lead infrastructure and cloud projects and take a leadership role in system design and troubleshooting.

Cross-Functional Impact

Partner with development, operations, support, technical, and business teams to improve system integration, reliability, and support.

Continuous Improvement

Contribute to improvements in system performance, reliability, documentation, automation, and technology practices while continuing to build expertise.

Why Join GSOC

At GSOC, you will help design, operate, secure, and continuously improve the infrastructure that supports critical business and technology operations. This role offers the opportunity to work across a diverse technology stack while growing technical ownership and project leadership at the Systems Engineer III-IV level.

Apply Today

If you're ready to bring your infrastructure, cloud, automation, security, and troubleshooting expertise to a role with broad technical impact, we encourage you to apply.

GSOC does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a valid, executed agreement will become the property of GSOC, and no placement fee will be paid.

Georgia System Operations Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including veterans and disabled. We are a drug-free workplace. All applicants are subject to substance abuse testing.

Salary: $100000 - $175000 per year

Steptoe, a Washington, DC-based Am Law 100 law firm, is seeking an Enterprise Cloud & Systems Engineer responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise cloud and hybrid infrastructure with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. This position plays a hands‑on engineering role in implementing cloud foundations, managing hybrid connectivity, automating infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of core IT platforms.

The Enterprise Cloud and Systems Engineer work deeply at the technical level deploying and configuring Azure resources, managing identity services, building Infrastructure as Code, automating operational processes, and maintaining enterprise storage platforms. This role collaborates closely with architecture, security, operations, and application teams to integrate on‑premises systems with Azure and to provide stable, well‑governed platform services that support firm‑wide applications and data.

Essential Functions

  • Design, deploy, and operate Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, networking, identity services, storage, and supporting platform services (IaaS and selected PaaS)
  • Build and maintain Azure landing zones, subscription structures, resource organization, policies, and governance controls
  • Implement and manage hybrid infrastructure, including connectivity between on‑premises environments and Azure (identity synchronization, networking integration, and access controls)
  • Administer and support Active Directory and Azure AD (Entra ID), including directory synchronization, authentication flows, conditional access, and role‑based access control
  • Design and manage Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks (VNets), ExpressRoute or VPN Gateway connectivity, routing, and Network Security Groups (NSGs)
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform and/or Bicep to provision and manage Azure resources consistently across environments
  • Engineer and operate enterprise Azure storage solutions, including Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files, and Azure Blob Storage, ensuring security. performance, availability, and appropriate data protection
  • Build automation and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub to support infrastructure deployment, updates, and operational workflows
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and security controls to ensure visibility, compliance, and operational stability across cloud platforms
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud and hybrid infrastructure issues related to performance, connectivity, identity, or service availability
  • Participating in incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation activities to improve platform reliability and resilience
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks to support IT Operations and ensure repeatable processes
  • Provide advanced technical support and subject matter expertise for cloud and hybrid infrastructure services

Non-Essential Functions

  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualification

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and operational responsibilities effectively
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving skills
  • 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, platform, or infrastructure engineering roles
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure services, architecture, and operational best practices
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments integrating on‑premises and cloud systems
  • Strong Windows Server and Active Directory administration experience
  • Hands‑on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and operational tasks
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, routing, and connectivity concepts
  • Familiarity with Azure networking services such as VNets, ExpressRoute or VPN Gateways, and Network Security Groups (NSGs) Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, equivalent technical certification, or comparable professional experience Certifications (Preferred)
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate
  • Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Or equivalent certifications supporting Azure, hybrid infrastructure, or infrastructure automation

Success Factors

  • Attention to detail: Designs and implements accurate, secure, and repeatable infrastructure solutions with minimal errors
  • Critical thinking and problem solving: Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues across cloud and hybrid platforms
  • Customer service: Responsive and dependable technical partner to internal IT teams and stakeholders
  • Initiative and continuous improvement: Proactively automates manual processes and improves platform reliability and efficiency
  • Teamwork: Works effectively across architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to deliver stable platform services

Work Environment

  • Non-smoking environment
  • Ability to maintain a flexible work schedule
  • Available to work 9:00 - 5:30 pm Monday through Friday.
  • Hybrid work arrangements may be available for this position.
  • Extra weekday and weekend hours may be required for special programs or events
  • Must be available to work beyond regular hours when necessary
  • Must be able to work under tight deadlines and stressful situations
  • Must have ability to work independently

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $117,000 - $127,000. The actual base salary offered will be dependent upon the applicant’s experience and qualifications, as well as other job-related factors, including but not limited to, relevant skills, education, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, geographic location.

 Steptoe offers a full range of benefits for you and your eligible dependents. Benefits currently include: medical, dental, vision, life, disability, dependent care, health care flexible spending accounts, 401K Plan, Profit-Sharing, Paid Time-Off and a robust Wellness Program.

Steptoe LLP is an equal opportunity employer EOE/Disability/Veteran. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information, or any basis proscribed by applicable statutes.

descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

We're looking for a Lead Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, automate, and operate infrastructure across our GCP environment. This role suits an engineer who came up through hands-on operations, built deep expertise in automation and infrastructure as code, and moved on to public cloud (preferably GCP). You'll set technical direction for infrastructure, mentor engineers, and own the systems that scale our global operations.

As a Commerce brand, Feedonomics is a leading product feed management platform that helps brands, retailers, and agencies list and optimize products across top ecommerce channels worldwide. Feedonomics manages everything from onboarding to ongoing feed optimization, enabling our clients to scale faster with less effort. Feedonomics has earned a strong reputation for a full-service model and powerful technology—all rooted in a commitment to excellence.

What You'll Do

  • Design and operate large scale infrastructure supporting international operations, spanning both GCP and AWS.
  • Lead automation of infrastructure deployment and configuration management, driving migration from legacy tooling and operating systems to modern IaC (Terraform, Puppet, Ansible).
  • Design and maintain traffic management, load balancing, and DNS systems at scale.
  • Build and operate observability systems in cloud environments.
  • Develop tooling for managing distributed, auditable systems administration.
  • Write and maintain process, policy, and procedural documentation for the infrastructure organization.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in infrastructure or systems engineering, including direct operational ownership of production systems.
  • Deep Linux systems administration experience (Red Hat and Debian, or similar) at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with core networking: DNS, load balancing, and traffic management.
  • Proven track record automating infrastructure with tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or similar.
  • Proficiency in Python or a similar language for infrastructure tooling and automation.
  • Production experience with GCP (Compute Engine, networking, storage, IAM).

At VyStar, our work is inspired by the people, businesses and communities we serve every day. We are focused on helping our members achieve their financial goals and building stronger communities for everyone. VyStar membership is open to everyone who lives or works in the 49 contiguous counties of Central to North Florida, 10 Southern Georgia counties, and past and present military members and their families all over the world. 

We’ve always been about helping people in their financial lives.

Our story began 70 years ago when 12 founding members had one bold idea: to create a safe place for our military and civil service members to save and borrow money. Stationed at Naval Air Station Jacksonville, they called the credit union Jax Navy Federal Credit Union.

Still headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, VyStar has grown to serve anyone who lives or works within our areas of service from Central Florida through Georgia. We’ve made it easy to join VyStar because we believe the more we grow, the more good we can do. 

VyStar Credit Union is the second-largest credit union headquartered in Florida and now serves more than 900,000 members with assets totaling over $13.5 billion. VyStar is the largest mortgage lender in Northeast Florida and a major employer in the region with over 2,000 employees across the communities it serves. VyStar membership is open to everyone who lives or works in the 49 contiguous counties of Central to North Florida, 26 Georgia counties and past and present military members and their families all over the world.

Working at VyStar is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to build a lasting career and impact your community. If that sounds good to you, you may be the right fit for our team.

descriptionHtml:
At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on-the-job training program, and tuition reimbursement--available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week.

We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees.

Senior Cloud Engineer

ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT:

The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback.

This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on-call support rotation.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Responsible for day-to-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud-based systems.
  • Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on-call rotation with other cloud engineers.
  • Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates.
  • Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers.
  • Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on-premises operations.
  • Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor
  • All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance.

Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job:

  • Focus - Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member.
  • Connect - Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care.
  • Understand - Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule).
  • Counsel - Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives.
  • Advance - Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded.
  • Verify necessary follow-up actions.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • This position requires a 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education.

Experience

  • 5 - 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry).
  • 3+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment
  • Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices
  • Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025).
  • Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus.
  • Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus.
  • Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps
  • Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN.
  • Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud.
  • A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus.
  • A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams.

DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management.

The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.

No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.

Thank you for your inquiry regarding our current job opening. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements. Should your experience and skills match, you will be contacted by one of our Human Resources department staff members.

Thank you again for your interest in this position!

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251686

AWS CloudOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a skilled AWS CloudOps Engineer to support and manage our AWS environment. In this role, you will be responsible for building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining our AWS infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and security. Your combination of people skills and system administrator expertise makes you the team hero, solving one problem after another. What if you could use those skills to improve the technology to support our client?

As an AWS CloudOps Engineer on our project, you’ll ensure the current infrastructure is functional and available. You’ll constantly look for ways to make the infrastructure better using the latest technology and the best implementation strategies. You’ll provide your customers insight into their network through monitoring and performance management, helping them understand the network by turning metrics into information, and explaining their meaning. Your systems and CloudOps expertise will be vital as you identify problem areas and opportunities for improvement in a mission-critical network.

This is an opportunity to broaden your skill set into areas like cloud computing. We focus on growing as a team, so you’ll share your expertise through leadership and mentoring as you help the team work through challenges and develop new methodologies. As a system administrator leader, you’ll identify new opportunities to modernize the network so your clients achieve their goals. Work with us and resolve daily challenges as we improve warfighter communications.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience with deployment or management of Cloud environments, including AWS or Azure
  • 5+ years of experience with system administration of Windows or Linux Operating Systems
  • Experience supporting the migration, architecting, building, and deploying of systems and applications in Cloud platforms
  • Knowledge of foundational system administration principles
  • Ability to design cloud environments
  • Ability to collaborate with RMF teams to flush out security controls and initiate or maintain cloud services
  • Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree
  • DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher Certification


Nice If You Have:

  • Knowledge of DoD accreditation processes
  • AWS or Azure Certification


Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required. 

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, maintenance, and automation of the organization’s on-premises and cloud infrastructure. This role ensures reliable, secure, and scalable server, storage, and network solutions while supporting business operations and growth. The Infrastructure Engineer serves as a technical escalation point, collaborates closely with internal teams and third-party vendors, and drives infrastructure modernization through automation and best practices.

Role And Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain physical and virtual servers, storage platforms, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Administer and manage cloud services, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure, including computer, storage, networking, identity, and security services.
  • Design, implement, and maintain network solutions to support on-premises and cloud environments, ensuring performance, availability, and security.
  • Manage server, infrastructure, and device patching processes to ensure systems remain secure and compliant.
  • Identify, prioritize, and perform vulnerability remediation across infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure automation using scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and configuration management tools.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams to support application deployments, integrations, and system upgrades.
  • Serve as a technical liaison with third-party vendors, managed service providers, and cloud partners.
  • Participate in infrastructure planning, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Assist with disaster recovery planning, backup strategies, and business continuity testing.
  • Provide escalation support for complex infrastructure and network issues.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, security practices, and industry trends.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong experience managing Windows Server environments and virtualization platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and administration.
  • Basic knowledge of LAN, WAN, VPN, and firewall concepts, with hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting network-related issues.
  • Experience with patch management tools and vulnerability remediation processes.
  • Experience working with third-party vendors and service providers.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Availability to support after-hours maintenance or incident response as needed.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, or similar).
  • Experience with Fortinet network solutions
  • Experience with hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation tools such as PowerShell, Azure Automation, ARM/Bicep, Terraform, or similar is preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, and talk or hear.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Goodwill Central Texas is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Background Check Requirement

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment background check. This may include verification of employment history, education, criminal background, and other information relevant to the position.

descriptionHtml:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.

Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.

Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement scalable cloud infrastructure using Terraform (or equivalent IaC tools)
  • Design high-performance compute environments, including optimized networking and storage stacks
  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters in cloud environments
  • Automate infrastructure workflows and build complex CI/CD pipelines
  • Build and maintain custom cloud images
  • Implement robust monitoring and observability for performance-critical workloads
  • Lead on-prem to cloud and cloud-to-cloud migrations of HPC and distributed workloads
  • Collaborate with research/engineering teams to optimize compute, storage, and scheduling efficiency

Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • At least 5 years of experience
  • Proficiency in Bash, Python, or Go for automation
  • Strong expertise in HPC and distributed workloads to design scalable, high-performance cloud infrastructure
  • Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, Linux systems, cloud networking, and storage architectures
  • Ability to build automated, production-grade cloud platforms for compute-intensive environments
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, storage architectures, and storage protocols (NFS, object, block, parallel/distributed storage)
  • Expertise with Terraform or equivalent IaC tools
  • Experience with HPC schedulers (Slurm/HTCondor)
  • Experience with distributed computing frameworks such as Ray

Anticipated annual base salary range $150,000-250,000, plus eligible for discretionary bonus.

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.

At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.

Our benefits include:

  • Generous paid time off policies
  • Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
  • Hybrid working opportunities
  • Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
  • In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
  • Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
  • Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
  • Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
  • Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.

Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

AWS CloudOps Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a skilled AWS CloudOps Engineer to support and manage our AWS environment. In this role, you will be responsible for building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining our AWS infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and security. Your combination of people skills and system administrator expertise makes you the team hero, solving one problem after another. What if you could use those skills to improve the technology to support our client?

As an AWS CloudOps Engineer on our project, you’ll ensure the current infrastructure is functional and available. You’ll constantly look for ways to make the infrastructure better using the latest technology and the best implementation strategies. You’ll provide your customers insight into their network through monitoring and performance management, helping them understand the network by turning metrics into information, and explaining their meaning. Your systems and CloudOps expertise will be vital as you identify problem areas and opportunities for improvement in a mission-critical network.

This is an opportunity to broaden your skill set into areas like cloud computing. We focus on growing as a team, so you’ll share your expertise through leadership and mentoring as you help the team work through challenges and develop new methodologies. As a system administrator leader, you’ll identify new opportunities to modernize the network so your clients achieve their goals. Work with us and resolve daily challenges as we improve warfighter communications.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience with deployment or management of Cloud environments, including AWS or Azure
  • 5+ years of experience with system administration of Windows or Linux Operating Systems
  • Experience supporting the migration, architecting, building, and deploying of systems and applications in Cloud platforms
  • Knowledge of foundational system administration principles
  • Ability to design cloud environments

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Potential for Remote Work ORA_ON_SITE

Description

SAIC is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer to provide provision of Global Enterprise IT services, specifically focusing the design and management of the core cloud infrastructure. With a deep understanding of AWS & Azure service such as EC2/Azure Virtual Machines, VPC/Virtual Networks and S3/Storage accounts. In addition to these responsibilities, the Cloud Engineer create and maintain the foundational elements that support cloud applications and services. The Engineer is expected to deliver Tier 3 level support to SITEC 3 EOM mission partners. This critical support role involves the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of system outages, all while guaranteeing optimal service uptime and mission operational capabilities.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is a pivotal role within our IT infrastructure team, providing tier three systems support in line with the SIE OPORD. This position demands a comprehensive understanding of government PAAS, SAAS coupled with advanced skills in analysis, troubleshooting, and system design. Effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders is a critical component of this role. The engineer will be integral to the systems engineering process, leveraging data for performance enhancement, and participating actively in working groups, design reviews, and system testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and administer the AWS & Microsoft Azure cloud environment, including provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, policy governance and security.
  • Design, develop, and implement highly available, multi-region solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Analyze existing operational standards, processes, and/or governance to identify and implement improvements.
  • Migrate existing infrastructure services to cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage security and access controls of cloud-based solutions.
  • Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) leveraging cloud native tooling to ensure automated and consistent platform deployments.
  • Develop and implement policy driven data protection best practices to ensure cloud solutions are protected from data loss.
  • Support cloud adoption of applications as they are being transformed and/or modernized.
  • Ensure all resources components meet proper performance and capacity standards.
  • Provide training and mentorship to Cloud Administrators, enhancing their understanding of Cloud capabilities and standard configurations.
  • Innovate and implement new technologies to advance mission readiness.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance

  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of 3+ years of AWS/Microsoft Azure experience involving design, deployment, configuration, and optimization.
  • Proven track record in managing production Windows Servers and implementing top-tier security practices within an enterprise environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft operating platforms and office applications.
  • At least 3 years of relevant IT experience.
  • Demonstrated ability in performance optimization and system engineering processes.

Required Certifications

  • DoW 8570 IAT II Certification.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Intermediate level or higher.

Desired Skills

  • Microsoft Certified Expert in the Azure product line OR.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Target salary range $80,001 - $120,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Requisition Id 17389

An active TS, Q, or TS/SCI clearance is required for consideration.

Overview:

The Field Intelligence Operations Division are seeking an experienced High-Performance Computing (HPC) Infrastructure Engineer to design, deploy, integrate, and sustain advanced computing infrastructure supporting classified Department of War (DoW), Department of Energy (DOE), and Intelligence Community (IC) missions.

The successful candidate will provide technical expertise in HPC architecture, GPU-accelerated computing, Linux clusters, high-performance storage, networking, and infrastructure automation. Working within a national laboratory environment, this position will deliver secure, scalable, and reliable computing capabilities while ensuring compliance with federal cybersecurity requirements and supporting evolving mission needs.

This position is critical to advancing classified HPC capabilities supporting national security missions. The successful candidate will strengthen computational capacity, infrastructure resilience, cybersecurity compliance, and operational readiness while enabling the integration of emerging technologies and mission-driven computing requirements.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

  • HPC Infrastructure Engineering: Design, deploy, integrate, and sustain HPC clusters, GPU-accelerated platforms, high-density servers, and supporting infrastructure to meet mission performance, scalability, and availability requirements.
  • Systems Administration and Optimization: Configure, maintain, and optimize Linux-based HPC environments, including cluster provisioning, workload scheduling, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
  • Storage and Networking: Engineer and integrate high-performance storage, parallel file systems, high-speed interconnects, and associated data center infrastructure.
  • Classified Security and Compliance: Collaborate with cybersecurity and Information Assurance teams to implement security controls, system hardening, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes.
  • Automation and Modernization: Develop and implement infrastructure automation, configuration management, and technical improvements to strengthen operational efficiency, system reliability, and mission readiness.
  • Technical Planning and Integration: Translate mission requirements into infrastructure designs, technical specifications, capacity plans, procurement recommendations, and implementation strategies.
  • Mission Support and Collaboration: Partner with DoW, DOE, IC, program management, and technical stakeholders to resolve complex engineering challenges, identify infrastructure risks, and deliver mission-critical computing capabilities.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, or related technical discipline, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, administering, or sustaining HPC clusters or large-scale Linux computing infrastructure.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Linux systems, cluster management, GPU computing, high-performance networking, and enterprise storage.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting, system troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to develop technical documentation, evaluate infrastructure requirements, and independently resolve complex engineering challenges.
  • An active TS, Q, or TS/SCI clearance is required for consideration as well as the ability to obtain and maintain required federal security clearances and access authorizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in a related technical field and 10 or more years of relevant infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting classified computing environments within a national laboratory, DoW, DOE, or Intelligence Community organization.
  • Active DOE Q, DoD Top Secret, or TS/SCI clearance, as applicable.
  • Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms, including H100/H200, accelerated computing, and AI/ML infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with HPC technologies such as Slurm, InfiniBand, RDMA, Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS, and container technologies.
  • Advanced Linux administration experience, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Ansible, Python, Bash, and automated system provisioning.
  • Familiarity with NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-53, ICD 503 where applicable, DISA STIGs, system accreditation, and ATO processes.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure modernization, data center integration, capacity planning, and lifecycle sustainment.

Special Requirements:

  • Q clearance with SCI: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. In addition, due the SCI, you may also be subject to random polygraph testing.
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

About ORNL:

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

If you have difficulty using the online application system or need an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please email: ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.
