Description

SAIC is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer to provide provision of Global Enterprise IT services, specifically focusing the design and management of the core cloud infrastructure. With a deep understanding of AWS & Azure service such as EC2/Azure Virtual Machines, VPC/Virtual Networks and S3/Storage accounts. In addition to these responsibilities, the Cloud Engineer create and maintain the foundational elements that support cloud applications and services. The Engineer is expected to deliver Tier 3 level support to SITEC 3 EOM mission partners. This critical support role involves the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of system outages, all while guaranteeing optimal service uptime and mission operational capabilities.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is a pivotal role within our IT infrastructure team, providing tier three systems support in line with the SIE OPORD. This position demands a comprehensive understanding of government PAAS, SAAS coupled with advanced skills in analysis, troubleshooting, and system design. Effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders is a critical component of this role. The engineer will be integral to the systems engineering process, leveraging data for performance enhancement, and participating actively in working groups, design reviews, and system testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and administer the AWS & Microsoft Azure cloud environment, including provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, policy governance and security.
  • Design, develop, and implement highly available, multi-region solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Analyze existing operational standards, processes, and/or governance to identify and implement improvements.
  • Migrate existing infrastructure services to cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage security and access controls of cloud-based solutions.
  • Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) leveraging cloud native tooling to ensure automated and consistent platform deployments.
  • Develop and implement policy driven data protection best practices to ensure cloud solutions are protected from data loss.
  • Support cloud adoption of applications as they are being transformed and/or modernized.
  • Ensure all resources components meet proper performance and capacity standards.
  • Provide training and mentorship to Cloud Administrators, enhancing their understanding of Cloud capabilities and standard configurations.
  • Innovate and implement new technologies to advance mission readiness.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance

  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of 3+ years of AWS/Microsoft Azure experience involving design, deployment, configuration, and optimization.
  • Proven track record in managing production Windows Servers and implementing top-tier security practices within an enterprise environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft operating platforms and office applications.
  • At least 3 years of relevant IT experience.
  • Demonstrated ability in performance optimization and system engineering processes.

Required Certifications

  • DoW 8570 IAT II Certification.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Intermediate level or higher.

Desired Skills

  • Microsoft Certified Expert in the Azure product line OR.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Target salary range $80,001 - $120,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

This role supports the reliability, performance, security, and availability of technology systems across the organization and works closely with Technology and business teams to identify needs, resolve issues, and implement effective solutions.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, document, maintain, and improve policies, procedures, and standards related to system administration, infrastructure, cloud services, and appropriate use of technology.
  • Manage end user accounts, permissions, access rights, storage allocations per privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Manage and maintain identity and access management solutions, including authentication, authorization, security groups, single sign-on, and related security controls.
  • Architect, schedule, and perform software and hardware improvements, upgrades, patches, reconfigurations, and purchases.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure and services within Microsoft Azure and other applicable cloud environments.
  • Anticipate, identify, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, server, network, and cloud issues.
  • Administer and support Windows Servers, Active Directory, Exchange, Office 365, Azure Active Directory, and other enterprise systems and services.
  • Install and configure software and hardware.
  • Monitor system, network, server, and cloud performance and availability. Identify trends, capacity concerns, and potential issues before they impact business operations.
  • Design, implement, and maintain solutions that support system availability, scalability, performance, security, and business continuity.
  • Manage and maintain cloud resources, configurations, permissions, monitoring, and security controls.
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and other automation solutions to improve system administration, monitoring, provisioning, reporting, and operational efficiency.
  • Support virtualization environments and associated infrastructure, including VMware and related technologies.
  • Manage system and cloud configurations, including DNS, DHCP, RADIUS, VMware, networking, firewalls, load balancers, VoIP, and other infrastructure technologies as applicable.
  • Assist with disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and system recovery processes. Participate in testing and improvement of recovery procedures.
  • Evaluate new technologies and make recommendations regarding infrastructure, cloud services, security, and system improvements.
  • Work with Technology team members and vendors to plan and implement infrastructure projects, system integrations, migrations, and other technology initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and technical records.
  • Work Technology infrastructure, services, and software tickets.
  • Provide escalation support for complex technical issues.
  • Support security initiatives and assist with identifying, mitigating, and monitoring technology risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable company policies, security standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage KPIs and performance reports as assigned.
  • Work collaboratively with teams across the organization to understand business needs and deliver effective technology solutions.
  • Protect the legal, financial, and moral well-being of the company.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

 

Proficiencies:

  • Builds and delivers technology solutions that meet customer and business expectations.
  • Works cooperatively across the organization to achieve shared objectives.
  • Anticipates potential issues and develops or adjusts contingency plans as needed.
  • Pushes self and others toward achieving results.
  • Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and outcomes.
  • Effectively identifies, evaluates, and manages technology and business risk.
  • Demonstrates strong technical judgment and problem-solving skills.
  • Communicates technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 7 years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • The following certifications are preferred: Any AWS or Azure certs, CCNA, Microsoft 365 Modern Desktop Engineer Associate, VMWare Certified Professional, Okta Certified Professional, ITIL Foundations, and any CompTIA certs.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of PowerShell scripting, Azure Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, desktop and server operating systems, patch management, DNS, DHCP, RADIUS, VoIP, VMware, Cisco networking, call management systems, firewalls, load balancers, cloud systems and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven experience as a System Engineer, Network Engineer, or similar role.
  • Experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with identity and access management, security controls, system monitoring, automation, and infrastructure management.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure architecture, networking, virtualization, cloud computing, and enterprise systems.
  • Resourcefulness and problem-solving aptitude.
  • Strong business acumen.
  • Excellent communication skills.

 

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS or Azure certifications
  • CCNA
  • Microsoft 365 certifications
  • VMware Certified Professional
  • Okta Certified Professional
  • ITIL Foundations
  • CompTIA certifications

Senior Systems & Cloud Engineer III

  • Serves as a senior technical resource and subject matter expert for systems, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.
  • Leads the design and architecture of complex systems, infrastructure, and cloud solutions.
  • Leads complex technology projects, migrations, integrations, and infrastructure initiatives from planning through implementation.
  • Establishes and improves technical standards, architecture guidelines, security practices, and infrastructure processes.
  • Provides advanced troubleshooting and technical guidance for complex or enterprise-wide issues.
  • Evaluates emerging technologies and makes recommendations regarding long-term infrastructure and cloud strategy.
  • Mentors and provides technical guidance to other engineers and Technology team members.
  • Takes significant ownership of system reliability, scalability, security, performance, and business continuity.
  • Typically requires extensive experience and demonstrated expertise in systems engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure architecture, and related technologies.

 

 

Physical Requirements:

Ability to remain stationary for continuous periods of time. Constantly operate a computer and phone. Frequently communicates with customers, coworkers, and managers about accounts. Able to exchange accurate information in these situations.  Work performed in an office setting. Able to bend, reach, lift, sit and walk. Ability to lift 50 lbs.

descriptionHtml:
Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us!

At Atlas Air Worldwide, we’re not just an airline, we’re a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we’re built on a foundation of safety, service excellence, integrity, innovation, teamwork, and responsibility. With over 30 years of history, a modern all-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we’re driven by purpose.

If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.

The Senior Cloud Systems Engineer designs, engineers, automates, and continuously improves the enterprise cloud platforms and services that support Atlas Air’s business-critical airline operations, digital transformation initiatives, and data and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for a technologist with a proven track record of building resilient, secure, and cost-optimized cloud environments at enterprise scale.

Operating primarily in AWS, the Senior Cloud Systems Engineer owns Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering outcomes—not day-to-day manual provisioning. The role partners with cloud architects, security, DevOps, and application teams to modernize workloads, accelerate delivery, and raise engineering standards across the organization. The engineer serves as a subject matter expert and technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges.

Values And Behavioral Standards

To ensure the effective communication and application of company values and behavioral standards, as stated in our company “Code of Conduct” policy, and to respond appropriately in the event of any known departure.

Major Job Accountabilities (in Priority Order)

Platform Engineering & Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, including reusable modules, service templates, and enterprise guardrails.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD deployment pipelines using Git-based workflows (GitHub) to accelerate and standardize infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Enable self-service infrastructure capabilities and automate operational processes to reduce toil and improve consistency and governance.
  • Develop automation and tooling using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

Cloud Architecture & Engineering

  • Engineer AWS-based infrastructure supporting production, disaster recovery, and non-production environments.
  • Translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  • Design and implement disaster recovery and resiliency solutions across multiple Availability Zones and AWS Regions.
  • Support enterprise data and AI platforms (e.g., Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) through robust cloud infrastructure engineering.
  • Participate in solution architecture and design reviews; recommend improvements and evaluate emerging cloud services and technologies.

Security & Compliance

  • Engineer solutions aligned with enterprise security standards and implement cloud-native security controls.
  • Maintain least-privilege access principles across IAM and enforce network and data protection controls.
  • Support audit, compliance, and vulnerability remediation initiatives.

Cost Optimization (FinOps)

  • Analyze cloud consumption trends and identify optimization and rightsizing opportunities.
  • Implement FinOps best practices and automation to reduce waste and support budgeting and forecasting.

Operational Excellence & Support

  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure incidents and problems.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Keep IT management apprised of critical issues, systemic problems, and risks in a timely manner.

Collaboration, Documentation & Delivery

  • Partner with application teams to modernize workloads and improve deployment velocity.
  • Champion high-quality documentation of technical processes, architectures, and runbooks that yield reproducible results.
  • Lead knowledge-transfer activities and mentor junior engineers to raise overall team capability.
  • Deliver assigned projects on time, within scope, and within budget, adhering to change control standards and coordinating internal and vendor resources.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in cloud, systems, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years designing and supporting enterprise cloud environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS delivering highly available, secure, and reliable services (e.g., IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, ECS/EKS).
  • Proven experience implementing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub or equivalent Git-based workflows.
  • Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar).
  • Solid foundation in Linux and Windows administration, cloud networking, and IAM/security controls.
  • Experience supporting production environments with high-availability and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills; demonstrated results orientation, initiative, and ownership.
  • Minimum 5+ years of Microsoft Windows Server environments
  • Minimum 5+ Citrix Cloud Enterprise experience

Desired Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional (or equivalent).
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification.
  • Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, serverless, and multi-account AWS environments.
  • Experience supporting data/AI platforms (Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) or large-scale cloud migrations.
  • Experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and comfort presenting to technical and non-technical audiences.

Special Demands

This position may require travel on an as-needed basis to domestic and international company locations, data centers, and training events. The role participates in an on-call rotation and may be required to respond to major incidents outside of standard business hours.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship or employer immigration support either now or in the future.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to afford equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, place of birth, age, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

If you'd like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please download the available EEO is the Law document by clicking "EEO Is The Law" .

To view our Pay Transparency Statement, please click here: Pay Transparency Statement

Competitive compensation will be offered based on a variety of factors, including a candidate's experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity and other factors. In addition, a range of benefits to include medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, as well as generous paid time off, and 401K contributions are offered as a part of the total compensation package.

Pay Range

$136,500—$185,000 USD

Program Description: The program provides end to end IT Infrastructure support services, including Tier 1 Help Desk, Tier 2 End User Support, Tier 3 Server, Platform, and Network Infrastructure Support and Engineering with responsibility for incident resolution, service requests, monitoring, lifecycle support, and escalation management.

Position Description: The Senior Microsoft Platform Engineer is a Tier 3 role responsible for the administration, operation, and continuous improvement of the agency's Microsoft Azure platform, Microsoft 365 services, and on-premises and cloud-hosted Windows and Linux servers. The engineer receives incidents escalated from Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, owns them through resolution, and engages vendors such as Microsoft support when needed. As a senior technical resource, the engineer works with minimal direction, leads technical work within assigned areas, guides other administrators, and helps project and application teams adopt new Azure capabilities while maintaining security and compliance. The role works closely with architecture, cybersecurity, networking, and engineering teams to keep services aligned with enterprise standards.

Work Model: The engineer concurrently manages Tier 3 incidents, recurring operations and maintenance (O&M), and small-scale projects that modernize Microsoft platform capabilities. Priorities may change daily. The engineer must respond to urgent incidents, communicate resulting schedule impacts, and resume planned work without losing ownership of existing commitments.

Requirements

Platform Administration

  • Manage and maintain Azure environments, including subscriptions, resource groups, landing zones, governance and tagging, virtual networks, virtual machines, storage accounts, and platform services
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and role-based access control (RBAC)
  • Implement and maintain Azure networking, including Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Application Gateways, VPN connectivity, private endpoints, and hybrid network integration
  • Administer Microsoft 365 services
  • Administer and patch on-premises and cloud-hosted (Azure) Windows and Linux servers, including builds, configuration, and lifecycle maintenance, using Microsoft Configuration Manager (MCM) and other approved tools
  • Build automation and infrastructure as code using PowerShell, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform
  • Monitor platform health using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Microsoft Defender
  • Maintain backup, disaster recovery, and high availability using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery
  • Perform security hardening and vulnerability remediation in line with agency security requirements, NIST controls, and federal cloud security standards
  • Participate in architecture reviews and recommend performance, cost, and security improvements

Tier 3 Incident Support

  • Own Tier 3 incidents from assignment to closure: assess impact and urgency, restore service, and confirm resolution with the end user or requesting team
  • Troubleshoot complex Azure, identity, network, and server issues using a structured method: define the symptom and scope, gather evidence (logs, sign-in data, monitoring alerts), isolate the failing layer, test one change at a time, and verify the fix
  • Escalate to Microsoft or other vendors with a complete case record, and identify recurring incidents for permanent fixes through problem management
  • Participate in the on-call rotation

Operations and Change Management

  • Complete recurring O&M tasks on schedule and record completion in ServiceNow
  • Follow the NCUA change management process: submit change requests with scope, risk, test, implementation, and rollback plans; obtain approval before implementing; and close each change with results documented

Projects

  • Lead small-scale projects from planning through closeout, including scope, requirements, milestones and dependencies, stakeholder agreement, phased implementation with rollback planning, user communications, and status reporting in Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • Support cloud migration projects for servers, applications, databases, and hybrid workloads

Communication and Documentation

  • Communicate directly with end users, government stakeholders, and contract counterparts: explain issues and impact in plain language, set expectations on timelines, and confirm outcomes
  • Write clear ticket notes and work logs in ServiceNow as work happens, so another engineer can pick up the issue without re-contacting the user
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, and architecture diagrams, and update them after incidents, changes, and projects
  • Guide other administrators and review their runbooks, change requests, and ticket documentation when asked

Required Skills:

  • 10+ years of Microsoft infrastructure administration experience, including 5+ years of hands-on Azure administration and engineering
  • Strong experience with:
  • Microsoft Azure (networking, virtual machines, storage, Backup and Site Recovery)
  • Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid Active Directory
  • Windows Server and Linux server administration
  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • PowerShell automation
  • Microsoft Configuration Manager (MCM)
  • Experience administering controls that support Zero Trust, such as Conditional Access and PIM
  • Demonstrated experience resolving Tier 3 incidents in a ticketed (ITSM) environment while carrying O&M and project assignments, using a repeatable troubleshooting process
  • Demonstrated experience following a formal change management process (change requests, change board review, implementation and rollback plans)
  • Demonstrated experience planning and delivering small-scale IT projects through closeout
  • Experience as a senior or lead technical resource, including guiding other administrators and owning technical decisions within an assigned area
  • Experience working directly with end users and government or customer stakeholders, verbally and in writing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft certifications: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), or Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102) or its successor
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent IT service management training
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps (ADO), NinjaOne, and Datadog
  • Prior experience supporting a federal agency

Benefits

SES provides a competitive salary and the following benefits:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • AD&D
  • STD
  • LTD
  • Company paid Life Insurance
  • 401k with employer contribution
  • Paid Time Off
  • Pet Insurance

Job Description

Designs, implements, and manages enterprise cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Ensures cloud and supporting Windows infrastructure is reliable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with architecture and operational standards. Applies advanced technical judgment to evaluate design options, resolve complex issues, automate operations, and recommend improvements across cloud, container, networking, security, and infrastructure services. Partners with development, security, and IT teams and provides technical guidance, documentation, and project support for enterprise initiatives.

  • Designs, deploys, manages, and optimizes GCP infrastructure and core services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC networks, load balancing, Cloud CDN, and related platform components, to meet availability, scalability, performance, and cost requirements.
  • Designs and supports Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) environments and collaborates with development teams to integrate, deploy, and operate applications using reliable container and cloud architecture practices.
  • Leads or contributes to cloud and infrastructure projects, manages assigned milestones and stakeholder communications, maintains technical and operational documentation, and provides technical guidance and support to IT team members.
  • Investigates and resolves complex cloud, server, networking, and platform incidents; evaluates possible causes and recovery options, coordinates escalation when needed, and supports backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Designs, administers, and troubleshoots Windows Server and Active Directory services that support cloud and enterprise infrastructure, including integration, authentication, availability, and operational support requirements.
  • Monitors cloud infrastructure, logging, capacity, performance, reliability, and cost using GCP tools and Datadog; analyzes trends and exceptions and recommends or implements corrective and optimization actions.
  • Automates cloud and infrastructure operations using infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Jenkins, or similar technologies to improve consistency, security, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Preferred: Google Cloud Professional, Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or other relevant Google Cloud certification.
  • Preferred: Datadog certification or demonstrated hands-on experience with Datadog monitoring and logging.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or platform engineering experience, including at least 3 years working with Google Cloud Platform.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or comparable enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
  • Preferred 5 years of progressively responsible cloud and infrastructure engineering experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Preferred 5 years experience supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, security, automation, CI/CD, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of GCP architecture and services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, identity and access management, encryption, security controls, compliance requirements, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
  • Ability to analyze ambiguous or complex technical issues, compare alternatives, assess risk and operational impact, and make or recommend sound architecture and troubleshooting decisions.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Datadog, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including integrating security and operational controls into automated delivery pipelines.
  • Familiarity with GCP database services, including Cloud SQL, Spanner, Alloy DB, Bigtable, and BigQuery.
  • Strong project management, documentation, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage milestones, communicate with stakeholders and management, and provide technical guidance.

Additional Information

  • Primarily office-based in Frisco, Texas, with extended periods of computer use.
  • Expected to work in the office five days per week, with up to three flexible remote days per month in accordance with company policy.
  • Requires occasional work outside normal business hours, including weeknights and weekends, to support maintenance, incidents, releases, or project activities.
  • May require participation in scheduled on-call or escalation support based on business needs.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionHtml:
Requisition Id 17316

Overview

The High-Performance Computing Systems Section within the National Center for Computational Sciences (NCCS) is seeking an HPC Infrastructure Engineer to join the HPC Infrastructure group. The preferred candidate will possess commensurate knowledge, skills and abilities in addition to relevant education, certifications, experience and demonstrated ability to work as a member of a team.

NCCS Provides state-of-the-art computational and data science infrastructure coupled with dedicated technical and scientific professionals tackling large-scale problems across a broad range of scientific domains for accelerating scientific discovery and engineering advances. NCCS hosts the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility (OLCF), one of the Department of Energy’s (DOE) National User Facilities which operates Frontier, the nation’s first exascale supercomputer.

Major Duties/Responsibilities

Linux Administration:

  • Deploy, configure and manage HPC-scale services in a Linux environment, primarily RedHat and Rocky.
  • Perform regular patches, updates and backups.
  • Monitor systems using tools like Nagios and Grafana.
  • Respond to and assist in troubleshooting issues.

Virtualization And Automation

  • Design, deploy and manage the Infrastructure platform using IaC tools such as Terraform, Ansible and Puppet.
  • Deploy and manage resources in the NCCS virtualization environment.
  • Identify potential automation targets and lead efforts to automate processes.
  • Define policies and procedures for automation and configuration management for the team and organization as a whole.

Kubernetes Administration

  • Work with the NCCS Kubernetes Platform team to deploy and manage services for the HPC Infrastructure group.
  • Design standardized and automated workflow patterns, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop, maintain and review high-quality code for internal tools using programming languages such as Python and Bash.

Project Management And Leadership

  • Lead small Infrastructure projects through the project lifecycle.
  • Mentor and train junior staff, creating training documentation, holding knowledge sharing sessions, and fostering skill growth throughout the team.
  • Propose and implement improvements to existing Infrastructure systems as well as new systems, processes and procedures.

Basic Qualifications

  • BS degree in computer science or closely related field and a minimum of 5 years of experience in Linux systems and Kubernetes platform administration, or a master’s degree and a minimum of 4 years of experience in Linux systems and Kubernetes platform administration.
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent interpersonal/communication skills and the ability to work within a team.
  • Strong experience designing, building and maintaining Kubernetes platform tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux system fundamentals and common network protocols.
  • Programming and scripting skills in common languages such as Python and Bash.
  • Understanding of versioning and code review tools like GitHub and GitLab.
  • Experience implementing and supporting highly-available systems and services.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining virtual environments using VMWare.
  • Experience deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting a variety of infrastructure services such as OpenLDAP, DNS, DHCP, etc..
  • Ability to plan, prioritize and complete assigned projects with minimal supervision.

Special Requirements

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program.

About ORNL

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

They help ensure our cloud platforms are secure, reliable, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective while establishing strong standards for cloud architecture, governance, automation, and operational excellence. The Senior Cloud Engineer works closely with Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Security, and Application Development to deliver and support cloud infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, disaster recovery, and DevOps capabilities. Essential Functions

  • Manages the organization’s Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, backup, SFTP services, application platforms, resource governance, and integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Develops secure, scalable, highly available, and standardized Azure architecture; leads technical design decisions for cloud infrastructure patterns, hybrid connectivity, resource organization, and platform modernization.

Manager Systems Engineering

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities

  • 7+ years of experience in systems, infrastructure, or cloud engineering.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, monitoring, and governance.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid cloud, and enterprise networking.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Experience with cloud security, IAM, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability.
  • Working knowledge of Git, REST APIs, relational databases, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and lead complex technical initiatives.

Preferred Skills, Education And Experience

  • Microsoft Azure certifications, including Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate or other relevant cloud/infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Service Bus, and Container Apps.
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, VMware, AWS, Cloudflare, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with Azure Site Recovery and enterprise backup/disaster recovery solutions.
  • Experience with DNS, network security, firewalls, VPNs, and private connectivity.
  • Experience working in a financial institution or other highly regulated environment.
  • Knowledge of NCUA, FFIEC, GLBA, or related financial-services regulatory and security requirements.
  • Experience with ITIL, incident management, change management, Agile, and enterprise technical documentation.

Work Environment

Elevations uses multi-factor authentication to keep our data safe. As such, a personal smartphone is a requirement for employment with us. This job operates in an office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment.

Full time/ 40 hours a week

The University Of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) Appreciates Your Interest In Employment. We Ask That You Keep In Mind The Following When Completing Your Application:

  • Once you start the application process you cannot save your work. Please ensure you have all required attachment(s) available to complete your application before you begin the process.
  • Required attachments are listed below on the posting. Your application will not be considered without the required attachments.
  • Please note that applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

Once a recruitment has closed, applications will no longer be accepted. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact Human Resources at (702) 895-3504 or unlvjobs@unlv.edu.

Job Description

The University of Nevada, Las Vegas invites applications for Senior Cloud Engineer, Information Technology [R0150849].

ROLE OF THE POSITION

This position calls for an engineer whose primary expertise is in public cloud architecture, paired with demonstrated depth in traditional systems engineering, including virtualization, Linux administration, and server lifecycle management.

In this role, the engineer will design, deploy, secure, and operate production workloads across UNLV’s hybrid infrastructure, spanning on-premises virtualization and major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform).

Responsibilities:

  • Designing, deploying, and managing virtualized and cloud compute infrastructure, including hypervisor platforms (Nutanix, VMware), backup and recovery (Veeam), and public cloud compute, storage, and networking services
  • Administering and securing Linux and Windows server environments across physical, virtual, and cloud platforms
  • Managing server and systems lifecycle across physical, virtual, and cloud environments: provisioning, patching, version upgrades, performance tuning, and decommissioning
  • Building and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation) and automation/scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to reduce manual systems work
  • Provisioning and managing GPU and specialized compute resources for research and academic workloads
  • Designing and supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) and custom compute solutions for campus use cases
  • Implementing and enforcing security and governance standards across systems and cloud platforms, including identity and access management and compliance controls
  • Monitoring system and service health, planning for capacity and growth, and leading problem analysis, documentation, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Supporting modernization and operational transparency initiatives, requiring effective collaboration with university faculty, business teams, and vendors

Customer Service Expectations: This position is responsible for maintaining a customer-focused approach in all duties, ensuring professional, timely, and effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders. To provide excellent service the employee will: listen to customers and understand their needs; help customers solve problems; demonstrate an eagerness to help; exhibit a professional disposition; be approachable, respectful, and team-oriented; take ownership of inquiries and assignments; provide updates for customers; and be familiar with the basic operations of the university in order to understand customer needs better.

BACKGROUND SCREENING

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment background screening.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree
    • Bachelor’s degree must be from an accredited college or university as recognized by the United States Department of Education and/or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA)
  • Seven (7) years of related professional experience in systems engineering.
ACCEPTED EQUIVALENCIES FOR DEGREE REQUIREMENT

UNLV may consider additional relevant experience in place of formal education requirements: In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, applicants may qualify with four additional years of relevant experience, or with an associate's degree plus two additional years of relevant experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working in a higher education environment
  • 10 years or more related professional experience in systems engineering
  • Industry Linux Certification
  • Industry Cloud Certification
  • Industry Project Management Certification
  • Industry Major Service Certification

Credentials must be obtained prior to the employment start date.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

The incumbent must have specific knowledge, skills, and abilities in the following areas:

KNOWLEDGE

Required

  • How to maintain applications and perform system version upgrades at a senior level.
  • How to apply patches to ensure the stability of applications and/or systems at a senior level.
  • How to perform system performance tuning at a senior level.
  • How to perform system troubleshooting methodology at a senior level.
  • How to perform system and/or application security monitoring and enforcement at a senior level.
  • How to create and maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation at a senior level.
  • How to plan, manage, and supervise applications at a senior level.
  • How to identify tasks, milestones, completion criteria, and the creation of timetables at a senior level.
  • How to plan and meet project goals while ensuring quality deliverables at a senior level.
  • How to complete projects in a timely fashion at a senior level.
  • How to plan server and client migration between software releases, such as at a senior level:
    • planning for growth,
    • performing disaster recovery planning and implementation;
    • ensuring that the servers are tuned for peak performance
  • How to proactively research and evaluate new technology at a senior level.
  • How to incorporate applicable new technology into existing topologies at a senior level.
  • How to improve server performance and availability at a senior level.
  • How to perform advanced system administration at a senior level.
  • How to maximize system security at a senior level.
  • How to create and maintain IP addressing, firewalls, routing, switching, server virtualization management, local and federated account security, system hardening, service and service failover, fault tolerance, and multi-tiered and public cloud configurations.
  • How to plan, engineer, implement, deploy, and iterate hybrid infrastructure to accomplish institutional goals.
  • How to engineer automation workflows that encumber IaC, including provisioning of infrastructure in a hybrid environment.
Preferred

  • Expert knowledge of a major cloud provider architecture (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)

     

SKILLS

 Required

  • Effective communication at a senior level.
  • System administration at a senior level.
  • Project planning and implementation at a senior level.
  • Research and development at a senior level.

Preferred

  • None

ABILITIES

Required

  • To have high ethical standards.
  • To pay attention to details.
  • To be a team player and be team-oriented.
  • To perform at a high level of customer service.
  • To analyze issues.
  • To communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
  • The ability to organize and prioritize.
  • Ability to Exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally (Occasionally: activity or condition exists up to 1/3 of the time) and/or a
  • negligible amount of force frequently (Frequently: activity or condition exists from 1/3 to 2/3 of the time)
  • To lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body.
  • To perform work, it can involve sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time.
  • Ability to exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, particularly when system installations are performed, is also required.

Preferred

  • None

PROFILE OF THE OFFICE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

With a focus on excellent customer service, UNLV Information Technology (UNLV IT) provides a full range of IT services, from leadership and enterprise solutions to training and support, for our students, faculty, and staff.

As a partner in teaching, learning, research, and administration at a Top-Tier university, we are seeking team members who value innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We believe that every person brings unique experiences and perspectives that strengthen our team and help us serve UNLV’s broad community with empathy, which is a key to our success.

Applicants seeking a values-driven environment that celebrates individuality and that are committed to service are highly encouraged to apply.

COMMITMENT TO CAMPUS VALUES

Successful candidates will advance UNLV's mission by cultivating an environment of mutual respect and belonging. They will model our Campus Values in their decision-making and inspire excellence across our community.

SALARY

Salary is competitive with those at similarly situated institutions.

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT UNLV

  • Competitive total rewards package including:
    • Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays
    • Excellent health insurance including medical, dental and vision
    • Comprehensive retirement plans and voluntary benefits programs
  • No state income tax (For Nevada Residents)
  • Tuition discounts at Nevada System of Higher Education (NSHE) schools
  • Tuition discounts for spouses, domestic partners, and dependents
PERKS & PROGRAMS

  • Employee recognition and appreciation programs
  • UNLV athletics ticket discounts
  • Statewide employee purchase program discounts
  • RebelCard discounts on and off campus
  • Wellness programming for all UNLV faculty and staff at no cost
  • Opportunity for career advancements to leadership roles
  • Connect with colleagues with shared interests
  • Personal and professional development opportunities
  • A comprehensive onboarding program, Rebels: Onboard
  • Support and resources available for veteran applicants — contact vetjobseekers@unlv.edu or visit our Veterans Webpage.

HOW TO APPLY

The following attachments are required for consideration:

  • A letter of interest
  • A detailed resume listing qualifications and experience
  • The names, addresses, and telephone numbers of at least three (3) professional references. References will not be contacted until the search chair notifies you in advance.

Applicants should fully describe their qualifications and experience, with specific reference to each of the minimum and preferred qualifications because this is the information on which the initial review of materials will be based.

Review of candidates’ materials will begin the week of November 23, 2026 and preference will be given to applications received prior to that date. This position will remain open until filled.

Applications must be submitted electronically through Workday. Please note that emailed materials will not be accepted.

UNLV values the skills of those who have served. If you are a veteran or eligible family member, we encourage you to apply. Learn more about resources and support for veterans at www.unlv.edu/jobs/veterans or contact vetjobseekers@unlv.edu for support.

For assistance with the application process, please review the instructions on How to Apply. For further assistance, contact UNLV IT Human Resources at (702) 895-1806 or oithumanresources@unlv.edu.

SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR INTERNAL NSHE CANDIDATES

Current UNLV and Nevada System of Higher Education (NSHE) employees must apply through Workday. Type Find Jobs in the Workday search bar or access the page directly here: JOB HUB

Search for this position using the job requisition number R0150849.

To ensure your application is processed correctly, current UNLV and NSHE employees should apply internally through Workday. If you submit an application through the external careers site, you will be asked to reapply as an internal application, which may delay your application.

PROFILE OF THE UNIVERSITY

Job Description

The University of Nevada, Las Vegas invites applications for Senior Cloud Engineer, Information Technology [R0150849].

ROLE OF THE POSITION

This position calls for an engineer whose primary expertise is in public cloud architecture, paired with demonstrated depth in traditional systems engineering, including virtualization, Linux administration, and server lifecycle management.

In this role, the engineer will design, deploy, secure, and operate production workloads across UNLV’s hybrid infrastructure, spanning on-premises virtualization and major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform).

Responsibilities:



- Designing, deploying, and managing virtualized and cloud compute infrastructure, including hypervisor platforms (Nutanix, VMware), backup and recovery (Veeam), and public cloud compute, storage, and networking services
- Administering and securing Linux and Windows server environments across physical, virtual, and cloud platforms
- Managing server and systems lifecycle across physical, virtual, and cloud environments: provisioning, patching, version upgrades, performance tuning, and decommissioning
- Building and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation) and automation/scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to reduce manual systems work
- Provisioning and managing GPU and specialized compute resources for research and academic workloads
- Designing and supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) and custom compute solutions for campus use cases
- Implementing and enforcing security and governance standards across systems and cloud platforms, including identity and access management and compliance controls
- Monitoring system and service health, planning for capacity and growth, and leading problem analysis, documentation, backup, and disaster recovery
- Supporting modernization and operational transparency initiatives, requiring effective collaboration with university faculty, business teams, and vendors

Customer Service Expectations: This position is responsible for maintaining a customer-focused approach in all duties, ensuring professional, timely, and effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Credentials must be obtained prior to the employment start date.

 Required

descriptionHtml:
Platform Engineer (Azure), Boulder, CO (Hybrid or Remote)

Ascend's Azure platform runs the hosted environments behind Market Intelligence (MI), PowerVAL (PV), PowerSIMM (PS), SmartBidder (SB), Ascend Power Procurement (APP), and Ascend Energy Exchange (AEX). As Platform Engineer, you'll design, build, and operate that platform alongside our Senior Platform Engineer, working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and identity and security administration. You'll partner with Development, Model Support, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable environments, move clients from on-premises hosting into Azure, and help maintain our security and compliance posture.

You'll do well here if you have strong hands-on Azure skills, automate and document what you build, and can explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Our Mission @ Ascend

At Ascend Analytics, our mission centers on creating sustainable economic value for energy buyers and producers to transform the power industry. Our team combines advanced analytics, cloud-based technology, and deep market expertise to help our clients solve complex challenges across grid reliability, power market volatility, renewable integration, infrastructure development, and energy investment strategy. As a high-growth, private equity–backed company, Ascend continues to expand its market leadership while investing in innovation, talent, and scalable solutions for an increasingly dynamic energy market.

Your Impact @ Ascend

Real influence. Real outcomes. At every level.

  • High-impact work. Shape the tools and decisions that drive the clean energy transition.
  • Direct exposure. Work alongside executive leadership and key utility and corporate clients.
  • Room to grow. A rapidly scaling SaaS business with real advancement opportunities.
  • Collaborative culture. A team that values creative thought, inclusion, and work-life balance.

Key Responsibilities

Azure infrastructure and networking

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Azure resources, including virtual machines, App Services, container apps, batch accounts, storage accounts, file shares, and key vaults.
  • Build and maintain Azure networking: VNets and subnets, site-to-site and point-to-site VPN, private endpoints, NAT gateways for static IP requirements, and Front Door routing.
  • Configure and manage Azure Virtual Desktop host pools, images, scale plans, and published applications for analyst and developer workstations.
  • Maintain backup, monitoring, and alerting coverage across development and production environments.

Automation and DevOps

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform, delivered through Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for application build, versioned deployment, and environment promotion, including service connections, self-hosted agents, and federated identity credentials.
  • Help development teams move build and test workloads from legacy on-premises environments into Azure.

Identity, security, and compliance

  • Administer Entra ID: user and group provisioning, conditional access, MFA, SSO integrations, and app registrations, with automated monitoring of expiring secrets and certificates.
  • Manage Privileged Identity Management role eligibility, access reviews, and approval of elevation requests.
  • Administer role-based access for client-facing platforms and resolve customer authentication and MFA issues escalated through the IT case queue.
  • Deploy and maintain endpoint security tooling, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Provide evidence, control descriptions, and technical input for SOC 2 Type II audits and customer security assessments, and advise on audit scope for newly production-hosted systems.

Client support and documentation

  • Support client onboarding and migrations, including storage access, VPN connectivity, and third-party integrations.
  • Serve as an escalation point for platform incidents affecting internal users and hosted clients.
  • Maintain network diagrams and hosting documentation as environments change, and lead internal cross-training sessions on Azure architecture.
  • Provide weekly status updates on priorities, progress, and blockers.

Required

Key Qualifications

  • 4+ years in cloud platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • AZ-104 or a similar intermediate-level Azure certification.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS and PaaS: VMs, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Container Apps, and Azure Batch.
  • Strong working knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Azure networking experience: VNet design, VPN gateways, private endpoints, NAT, DNS, and firewall rules.
  • Hands-on Entra ID administration: conditional access, MFA, SSO, app registrations, and PIM.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and KQL for automation and reporting.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
  • Clear technical writing and the ability to communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a SOC 2 Type II audit cycle.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop administration at scale.
  • Bicep infrastructure-as-code experience.
  • Power BI Embedded capacity management.
  • Oracle Database or Autonomous Database on Azure.
  • Background supporting SaaS products in energy, utilities, or another regulated industry.
  • Advanced certifications: AZ-305, AZ-400, or SC-300.

If you don't meet every qualification but this role excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Our Values @ Ascend

Ascend promotes a culture of teamwork, inclusion, and work-life balance. We operate by five core pillars:

  • Integrity: We act with honesty and uphold the highest ethical standards, doing the right thing even when it's difficult.
  • Purpose Driven: We are united by a shared purpose — to deliver meaningful impact for our customers, our industry, and the energy transition to a low-carbon future.
  • Belonging: We foster a respectful, inclusive environment where everyone is valued, diverse perspectives are embraced, and equitable opportunities are provided for all.
  • Innovation: We anticipate and address new challenges, embracing change and continuous improvement.
  • One Team Mindset: We collaborate across teams and functions, supporting one another and prioritizing shared success over individual wins.

Your Value @ Ascend

Join a team that values your work, supports your growth, and invests in your future.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • FSA, HSA, and dependent care accounts
  • 401(k) with 3% non-elective contribution
  • Flexible PTO and work hours

Salary range: $85,000-$115,000 USD annually, calibrated to your experience and structured to grow with you.

Compensation is flexible and tailored to your qualifications, relevant experience, and location of hire.

We thrive on collaboration, whether in our Boulder office or across a screen.

That's why our Boulder, CO office runs on a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 days remote). We prefer candidates who can work from Boulder HQ, but it isn't a requirement: we're open to strong remote candidates, and we make it easy to collaborate across both.

Need accommodations? Contact us at recruiting@ascendanalytics.com.

Ascend Analytics is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or genetic information.

Note: We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Job Description

This position supports next generation infrastructure with unified communications through a virtualized environment. Responsible for system improvements in reliability, security, efficiency, and performance. Provides support for implementation, troubleshooting, deployments, and maintenance of IT systems, to include building, patching, and maintaining servers.

Key Skills And Responsibilities

  • Experience building/managing servers in the AWS (Amazon Web Services) environment.
  • Experience with cloud/server/network/storage implementation and support.
  • Experience with VMware implementation and support.
  • Maintains up-to-date documentation, and prepares documentation for infrastructure changes.
  • Solid Linux (CentOS, RedHat, and Oracle Linux).
  • The servers are a combination of physical servers and virtual machines in several different environments:

Physical servers – located on multiple networks in various server rooms

EDC (Enterprise Data Center) - The EDC still consists of both VMs on VMware infrastructure and Solaris systems.

MASH (MachineShop) – build/support VMs (not the hardware or infrastructure in this environment).

DHE (Database Hosting Environment) – physical servers, RHEV (RedHat Virtual Environment) and VMware.

MUC VMware – build/support VMs (not the hardware or infrastructure for this environment).

  • Standard services – Active Directory/Centrify, McAfee (Nails/ePO/CMA), etc.
  • PUPPET (to manage system configuration).
  • Monitor systems using XYMON. Assists with design implementation, and maintenance of monitoring systems (physical & virtual).

To Qualify, Candidate Must Also Meet These Basic Qualifications

  • Must be open to the possibility of travel (CONUS & OCONUS), anticipate less than 5%.
  • Must be available for on-call support.

Position Requirements

  • Must currently have and be able to maintain a TS/SCI Clearance with Poly
  • One of the following DoD approved certifications is required to meet the category/level IAT-2 (DoD 8570) requirement for this position: Security+ CE, GSEC, SSCP, CCNA-Security, CISA, CISSP (or Associate), CASP+ CE, GCIH, GCED, CCNP Security, CySA+, or GICSP.
  • Required Education & Related Experience: High School/GED + 9 years OR Associates + 7 years OR Bachelors + 5 years OR Masters + 3 years OR Doctorate + 1 year

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer will be responsible for assisting in the design, development, and implementation of virtualization, storage and cloud solutions which support the current and future needs of the business. Day-to-day, the optimizations and performance of these solutions allow HomeServe USA to achieve its rapid growth. This is a critical IT Infrastructure component, so the candidate must have extensive experience in virtual, cloud and storage technologies. This role requires deep expertise in Microsoft Active Directory services and Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Windows-based enterprise systems, identity and access management (IAM), and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles. The focus of the Sr. Infrastructure Engineer will entail the engineering and support of all the virtualized systems across multiple data centers and cloud while ensuring the environment is managed to meet best practice standards and agreed service availability (SLA’s). The successful candidate will also have experience in cloud platforms and will drive strategies for implementing cloud platforms at HomeServe USA.

Responsibilities

  • Design and manage scalable, secure, and high-performance cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Implement AWS IAM policies, roles, and federated identity integrations with AD.
  • Build and maintain cloud automation and provisioning using CloudFormation, Terraform, or similar IaC tools.
  • Manage AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda, and Systems Manager.
  • Support hybrid-cloud architecture, including AD domain controllers and workloads in AWS.
  • Optimize costs and resource utilization through monitoring, automation, and lifecycle management.
  • Design, implement, and manage Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
  • Maintain the existing enterprise virtualization environment (VMware), including troubleshooting, performance monitoring and optimization, capacity, and continuity planning.
  • Assist in the planning, design, and implementation of new virtualization technology solutions.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and operational standards are met across both on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell, AWS CLI, and Python.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on cloud migration, DR planning, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Maintain and manage Citrix environments (Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix Cloud).
  • Using observability tools, ensure high availability, and quickly respond to incidents and outages.
  • Document system configurations, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintain an expert level of knowledge by maintaining current certifications, attending seminars or other related activities.
  • Interact with hardware and software vendors to ensure timely resolution to any issues or outages.
  • Respond quickly and effectively to production issues and take responsibility for seeing those issues through resolution.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for support of systems outside of normal business hours.
  • Assist with the planning and deployment of infrastructure security measures.
  • Analyze existing operations and make recommendations for the improvement and development of the relevant IT systems.
  • Participate in Post-Mortem meetings to discuss any outage occurrences, develop safeguards and, where appropriate, implement any recommended changes to avoid reoccurrence.

Essential Functions

Essential Job Function

% of Time on Function

Provide operational support to ensure IT infrastructure is running at 100%.

30%

Process level-3 requests & incidents from user community, ensuring SLAs are met.

30%

Implement new systems or improve existing systems to better align with company objectives and goals.

20%

Collaborate with different teams across the organization to realize company objectives.

10%

Documentation of system configurations, procedures and best practices.

10%

Total

100%

Job Requirements

  • University degree in the field of computer science, engineering, or information systems.
  • A minimum of 10 years of strong technical IT infrastructure/systems experience with a strong emphasis towards virtualization technologies, with proven analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience working with Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform or Microsoft Azure.
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in virtualization technologies, including expert knowledge of optimization and industry best practices.
  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory in a large enterprise.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting and administering Citrix environments (Citrix XenApp/XenDesktop or Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops).
  • Deep understanding of Windows Server OS (2016/2019/2022).
  • Proficient in administering Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Azure AD, Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Experience managing a PKI infrastructure including both internal and external CAs.
  • Advanced experience in systems and network observability tools such as DataDog.
  • Subject Matter Expert knowledge of VMware ESX(i) Server 7.0 and above, and VMware vCenter.
  • Advanced experience in SAN storage technologies and integration with VMware, specifically with Pure Storage.
  • Advanced experience in the use of SAN replication and SRM.
  • Advanced experience and knowledge in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Perl, or Python.
  • Excellent knowledge of DNS, DHCP, SMTP, SNMP and other TCP/IP protocols and services in support of the virtualization and storage technologies.
  • Exceptional customer service skills, in addition to extensive experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Capable of accomplishing tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with all IT Infrastructure groups.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in emergency situations.
  • Understanding and application of ITIL principles and practices, and how they relate to the goals and objectives of the organization.
  • Continually update and maintain, where necessary, all related documentation, technical or otherwise, for new and existing systems. This is to include inventory, change control, or process functionality documentation.

Desired Skills

  • Certification in ITIL.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
  • MCSE, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator.
  • Citrix Certified Associate/Professional (CCA-V/CCP-V).
  • VMware VCP Certification.
  • Expert knowledge or working knowledge of Cisco UCS and HPE Intel based server hardware and deployment.
  • Expert knowledge or working knowledge of supporting Windows Server operating systems in a virtual environment.
  • Good understanding of virtualization platforms beyond VMware such as Citrix, KVM, Hyper-V.
  • Knowledge and understanding of enterprise-class solutions in storage and networking such as Pure Storage, EMC VNX, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Nexus.
  • Experience dealing with vendors for providing timely solutions as required by their support contracts.
  • Knowledge and understanding in adhering to company policies and procedures, such as the use of RFCs, procurement procedures and asset tracking.

Minimum Physical Requirements

The physical demands described represent those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions of the position for which they work. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to listen, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls while executing tasks like working on a computer or talking on the telephone. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to low.

This job description is intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

descriptionHtml:
Exceptional systems engineers sought to develop and manage systems infrastructure, software, and networks for a New York–based drug discovery and computational biochemistry research company. Opportunities are available in our New York City offices or our Durham, NC and Pittsburgh, PA data centers. Successful hires will be responsible for our server, cloud, and data environment, including:


  • Kubernetes-powered applications
  • Tens of petabytes of storage
  • Identity management infrastructure
  • Public cloud environments
  • State-of-the-art GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs
  • High-performance RDMA fabrics and wide-area networks
  • Linux fleet with over a hundred thousand CPU cores
  • Massively parallel custom supercomputers
  • Making all of the above available to machine learning and drug discovery researchers and agents in a secure and convenient way


Ideal candidates will have strong fundamental knowledge of Linux concepts such as file systems, networking, and processes in addition to practical experience administering Linux systems. Relevant areas of expertise might include large-installation systems administration, HPC systems engineering, programming and scripting of distributed systems in Python, high performance data-parallel computing, systems software, software development, email and data retention processes, Kubernetes systems engineering, and user support, but specific knowledge of and level of experience in any of these areas is less critical than intellectual curiosity, versatility, and a track record of achievement. Candidates should have excellent communication skills, and we will consider candidates at all levels of experience.


We are looking to add innovative contributors who share our commitment to fostering a stimulating, positive, and collaborative work environment.

Shaw Research (DESRES) develops and uses advanced computational technologies to understand the behavior of biologically and pharmaceutically significant molecules at an atomic level of detail, and to design precisely targeted, highly selective drugs for the treatment of various diseases. Among its core technologies is Anton, a proprietary special-purpose supercomputer that DESRES designed and constructed to vastly accelerate the process of molecular dynamics simulation. DESRES uses Anton machines and high-speed commodity hardware, together with machine learning methods and other computational techniques, in both internal and collaborative drug discovery programs. For more information, visit www.DEShawResearch.com.


To submit an application, please use the link provided below:


https://apply.deshawresearch.com/careers/Register?pipelineId=967&source=LinkedIn

The applicable annual base salary paid to a successful applicant will be determined based on multiple factors including the nature and extent of prior experience, educational background, and location. We follow a hybrid work schedule, in which employees work from the office three days per week, and have the option of working from home the other two days per week.
