ABOUT SECOND HARVEST HEARTLAND


Second Harvest Heartland is the second-largest food bank in the United States, sourcing and delivering food to nearly 1,000 food shelves and food distribution partners throughout 59 counties across central and southern Minnesota and western Wisconsin. Our work begins with a bold vision: a community where no one goes hungry. We help fill plates, shelves, and fridges throughout the region while shining a light on food insecurity and its root causes and inspiring action at home and across the country. By utilizing new and better data, engaging and mobilizing partners, and advancing innovative solutions, we are on the leading edge of a movement to address hunger and food insecurity in our communities.


If you’re ready to turn your passion into purpose, join us and help build a future where every neighbor has the food they need to thrive.


POSITION SUMMARY


The IT Infrastructure & Systems Engineer leads the operational management and continuous improvement of Second Harvest Heartland's core technology environment, including Microsoft 365, hybrid identity, server and virtualization infrastructure, networking, and endpoint management. As the technical subject matter expert and functional lead, this role establishes standards, develops roadmaps, recommends priorities, and executes strategic infrastructure initiatives while remaining accountable for system reliability, security, lifecycle management, and service outcomes. The role partners across the organization to deliver sustainable technology solutions and move decentralized tools into secure, supported, centrally managed platforms.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive. As Second Harvest Heartland continues to grow and organizational needs evolve, additional or modified duties may be assigned.



  • Technical leadership: Lead the infrastructure function's day-to-day priorities and long-term direction as the technical subject matter expert for Second Harvest Heartland's core technology stack. Establish standards, develop roadmaps, and make sound engineering recommendations across infrastructure, identity, cloud, network, and endpoint environments.

  • Network infrastructure: Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and monitor enterprise network infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, wireless access points, and VPN, to ensure high availability, performance, and security.

  • Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity: Engineer and administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive), Active Directory, Entra ID, and Entra Connect, including Group Policy, MFA, Conditional Access, and SSO, ensuring secure access and identity lifecycle management.

  • Server infrastructure: Administer Windows Server infrastructure (DNS, DHCP, file services) and own server patching, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Virtualization: Design, manage, and maintain virtualization platforms (Hyper-V, VMware, Citrix) to support scalable and resilient operations.

  • Backup and disaster recovery: Administer backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes, including regular restore testing and documented recovery procedures.

  • Endpoint management: Lead endpoint management and device lifecycle using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and related tools, including OS deployment, configuration, patch compliance, and organizational standards.

  • Security: Partner with the Cyber Security team to implement security best practices, including vulnerability remediation, access controls, least privilege, and system hardening.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Build strong, trusted relationships across the organization to understand business needs, partner on technology decisions, and lead solutions from initiation and design through implementation and ongoing support.

  • Centralizing technology: Identify decentralized tools and processes and lead cross-functional efforts to consolidate them into supported, secure, centrally managed platforms. Serve as technical owner for business SaaS applications, including SSO integration, access governance, lifecycle planning, and vendor coordination.

  • Escalation and mentorship: Serve as the escalation point for the Service Desk on complex technical issues across hardware, operating systems, applications, and network connectivity. Strengthen team effectiveness through coaching, knowledge transfer, runbooks, and training that grow the Service Desk's technical capability.

  • Automation: Apply scripting and automation (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph) to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support scalable administration.

  • Documentation and standards: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and system standards.



  • Vendor engagement: Support resource planning and operational stewardship for infrastructure services through vendor and carrier coordination, renewals, license tracking, lifecycle forecasting, and evaluation of new solutions. Provide recommendations that balance reliability, security, organizational need, and responsible use of resources.

  • Continuous improvement: Develop and execute infrastructure improvement plans aligned with organizational priorities. Monitor service health, lifecycle risks, and emerging technology needs; recommend changes; and lead implementation efforts that improve reliability, security, scalability, and operational effectiveness.


VALUES



  • We Deliver: We use our head and heart to make decisions, we make the best use of donor dollars, and we achieve results safely and reliably. 

  • We Lead with Our Hearts: We keep our neighbors, partners, and teams at the center of our work. We seek to understand and anticipate their needs. 

  • We are all in this Together: We collaborate, internally and externally. We communicate openly, seeking feedback and sharing knowledge. 

  • We Innovate: We seek out bold new ideas, we embrace change, and we commit to continuous improvement for ourselves and our work. 

  • We Believe our Differences Make us Stronger: We value inclusion and embrace the variety of backgrounds that make up our team and our community. Our different experiences and perspectives empower us to fulfill our mission.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



  • 6+ years of progressive IT experience, including 4+ years in a systems administration or systems engineering role in a Windows/Microsoft 365 environment.

  • 4+ years administering Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 in a hybrid environment, including Group Policy, MFA, and Conditional Access.

  • 4+ years of Windows Server administration, including DNS, DHCP, file services, patching, and backup/restore processes.

  • 3+ years of hands-on network administration (firewalls, switching/routing, wireless, VLANs, VPN), with a solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and firewall concepts.

  • 3+ years of administering virtualization platforms such as Hyper-V, VMware, or Citrix.

  • 2+ years with endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, or SCCM.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell for automation and administrative efficiency.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex infrastructure initiatives from planning and design through implementation, adoption, and ongoing support.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional partnerships, translate organizational priorities into technology plans, and guide teams through change toward supported, standardized solutions.

  • Experience strengthening team capability through mentorship, technical coaching, knowledge transfer, and service escalation support.

  • Strong knowledge of information security principles and best practices (MFA, patching, least privilege, hardening).



  • Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, manage competing demands, exercise sound judgment, and remain accountable for reliable, high-quality service outcomes.

  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • Availability for occasional after-hours maintenance and/or on-call support.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS



  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-102), Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (AZ-800/801), CCNA or Network+, Security+, or VCP.

  • Experience serving as the functional lead for infrastructure operations in a small to mid-sized organization, including roadmap development, standards, lifecycle planning, and cross-functional execution.

  • Experience consolidating decentralized applications or integrating SaaS platforms with SSO.

  • Experience with Microsoft Graph, Azure services, and modern cloud management.

  • Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow), runbooks, and working with vendors/MSPs.

  • Experience supporting warehouse or logistics operations. 


Second Harvest Heartland is an equal opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
About the Opportunity

A well-established national manufacturer is growing its infrastructure team. After several acquisitions, the company’s server footprint has roughly doubled, and it needs a hands-on engineer to help bring a mix of inherited environments under one standard. This is a working engineer role, not a management or pure architecture seat. You’ll build, fix, and improve the systems yourself.


What You’ll Do

  • Run and maintain core Windows and Linux services: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file and print
  • Support on-prem, virtualized, and cloud environments end to end: builds, patching, upgrades, monitoring, security, and cost control
  • Manage AWS resources across compute, storage, databases, monitoring, and security
  • Maintain and harden VMware environments, including troubleshooting and performance tuning
  • Automate repeatable work with PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools
  • Build scripts, reports, and integrations that cut manual effort
  • Own backup, recovery, and DR testing for assigned systems, aligned to RTO/RPO targets
  • Write and maintain runbooks, standards, and technical documentation
  • Assess legacy systems, plan consolidations and migrations, and help decommission what’s no longer needed
  • Give input on lifecycle planning, hardware refreshes, and infrastructure budgets
  • Work within ITIL change, incident, and problem processes
  • Partner with vendors, security, network, and application teams on projects and issues
  • Take part in a light on-call rotation and occasional after-hours maintenance windows


What You Bring

  • 5+ years in server administration, infrastructure engineering, or cloud engineering (server side, not desktop or endpoint)
  • Solid hands-on Windows Server and Linux experience in multi-site environments
  • Experience running VMware or a comparable virtualization platform
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or another public cloud
  • Scripting or automation skills in PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar
  • Working knowledge of patching, monitoring, backup, DR, hardening, and lifecycle management
  • Comfort pushing back on requirements and proposing better solutions
  • Clear communication and strong documentation habits
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Puppet, SaltStack, or other IaC and config management tools
  • Hybrid environments spanning on-prem and cloud
  • Azure, Nutanix, or AIX exposure
  • Cloud migration or platform consolidation projects
  • Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect or SysOps, Azure Administrator, VMware VCP, or Red Hat

Company Description

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard Medical School?

Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership.

You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine.

Job Description

As an Enterprise Services Infrastructure Engineer, your role involves active contribution to the team, supporting, implementing, and optimizing critical IT infrastructure. You'll engage in hands-on work with cloud platforms, manage virtualization infrastructure, and oversee Windows Server environments. This role includes operational support, collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement projects that support scalable system designs, solutions, and policies, troubleshoot and resolve complex issues, and administer various software systems within the portfolio.

Core Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Implement and manage enterprise cloud infrastructure, optimizing performance, cost, and scalability, ensuring compliance with security measures, and automating tasks for efficient management.
  • Oversee daily operations of the VMware virtualization infrastructure, managing ESXi hosts, vCenter, and related components, with in-depth knowledge of VMware ESX fundamentals.
  • Configure virtual machines, templates, clusters, and storage within the VMware environment, including the design and implementation of virtual desktop infrastructure or AVD.
  • Install, configure, and manage Windows Server operating systems, handling updates, patches, and security configurations. Design and administer critical Windows Server services such as Active Directory and Group Policy, while monitoring and optimizing system performance to ensure reliability and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to seamlessly integrate cloud, VMware, and Windows Server technologies working closely with engineers, administrators, and developers to troubleshoot and optimize system performance, providing technical expertise and guidance for successful system integration and collaboration.
  • Develop and maintain relevant documentation for enterprise infrastructure utilizing the ServiceNow platform to assist with daily operations and requests.
  • Ensure continuous operational uptime and optimal performance by actively collaborating with teams, troubleshooting issues, and improving service effectiveness.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:


  • Minimum of five years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:


  • Proficient in cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), VMware virtualization, and Windows Server operating systems.
  • Familiarity with automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Relevant certifications like, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or Microsoft Certified: Windows Server are a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team and adapt to evolving technologies and priorities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to build and cultivate strong relationships and work effectively with diverse groups.
  • Demonstrated “can do” work ethic coupled with effective time management.

Certificates and Licenses:


  • Completion of Harvard IT Academy specified foundational courses (or external equivalent) preferred.

Additional Information


  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week. Occasionally required to work outside of normal business hours and may be called during off hours. Participate in off hours on-call schedule.
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Criminal
  • Staying Informed About Your Application: Due to the high volume of applications, we may not always be able to reach out right away, but you can track your status anytime through the Careers@Harvard portal.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 058. Please visit  Harvard's Salary Ranges  to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:


  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The following position is to join our RTX Corporate Enterprise Services team:

Provide services for infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, and general IT support to enable the Enterprise Services SIOP application suite. Participate in support, planning, definition of best practices, and collaborative meetings in support of these goals.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for provisioning, installation/configuration, operation, and maintenance of systems hardware and software related to a Windows/Linux infrastructure in the cloud (Azure or AWS) environments. Duties include, but are not limited to, server management; storage management (logical and physical); cross platform authentication and access management; software and license configuration.

Important Note:

During the first few months, this role will require working occasional non‑standard or off‑hours shifts. You will partner closely with another team member to help automate existing manual tasks currently performed during off‑hours. Once these processes are fully automated, off‑hours support will no longer be required on a regular basis.

What You Will Do:

  • Work with a small team on cloud projects and system support.
  • Deliver practical solutions to complex problems.
  • Design and support new and existing cloud applications infrastructure.
  • Overseeing cloud operations and designing infrastructure for new workloads
  • Continuously improving and maturing cloud services
  • Provide IT systems administration in a heterogeneous RedHat Enterprise Linux and Microsoft Windows environment. 
  • Working in both cloud (Azure or AWS) and on-prem environments.
  • Create and maintain system documentation, including best practices, procedures, and policies.
  • Work effectively in a geographically distributed team environment.
  • Engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Work independently with users to define concepts
  • Systems are operational 24x7 and occasionally require work effort beyond standard work hours.

Possesses a robust understanding of computers, networks, servers, storage, and databases, along with experience in server architecture and troubleshooting methodologies with experience developing solutions and documenting various technical issues.

descriptionHtml:
Founded in 1999, Geneva Trading is a premier global principal trading firm with strategically located offices in Chicago, Dublin, and London. Our relentless focus on trading excellence combined with technological innovation has equipped us with a best-in-class proprietary trading platform, enabling us to compete at the highest levels in the global markets. Rooted in a culture of integrity, collaboration, and an unwavering passion for progress, we foster an environment of personal and professional excellence. Our nimble organizational structure and entrepreneurial spirit attract top-tier talent with a passion for innovation, laying the foundation and driving our consistent success in the industry.

Role Overview Geneva Trading is seeking a driven, mid-level Systems Engineer to join our Chicago Infrastructure team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our core Linux infrastructure, powering high-performance, low-latency trading strategies. You will play a pivotal role in modernizing our tech stack by driving cloud integration, container orchestration, and AI-assisted automation, ensuring our systems remain fast, scalable, and resilient.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Linux Systems Engineering: Administer, troubleshoot, and optimize production and development Linux servers (RHEL/Ubuntu) to guarantee maximum uptime, uncompromising stability, and strict security.
  • Cluster & Workload Orchestration: Deploy and manage distributed workload orchestration platforms. You will oversee scheduling, cluster networking, service discovery, and resource allocation—starting with HashiCorp Nomad or Docker Swarm, and scaling into Kubernetes.
  • Containerization & Application Delivery: Package, deploy, and scale microservices and proprietary trading applications using Docker and modern container runtimes across both bare-metal and cloud environments.
  • Hybrid Cloud Management: Architect and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and GCP, ensuring seamless and secure hybrid connectivity between our on-premises trading environments and public cloud resources.
  • AI-Driven Automation & Scripting: Write robust operational automation using Python and Bash. Leverage Claude Code and other advanced LLMs to accelerate development, troubleshoot complex issues, and build custom Claude Skills and agentic workflows that eliminate manual infrastructure toil.
  • Security Hardening & Maintenance: Execute proactive system maintenance, including kernel updates, OS patching, software deployments, and comprehensive security hardening.
  • Windows & Identity Support: Provide supplementary support for Windows server components, Active Directory, and user identity services.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, and Trading teams to optimize system reliability. Participate in an on-call rotation and execute planned off-hours maintenance.

Required Qualifications

  • Linux Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, and supporting enterprise Linux environments (RHEL/Ubuntu) in highly available production settings.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Strong practical experience with Docker and workload schedulers (e.g., HashiCorp Nomad, Docker Swarm, or Kubernetes), with the adaptability to manage current lightweight platforms while driving future Kubernetes adoption.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Proven track record of provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure in AWS or GCP.
  • AI & Agentic Automation: Hands-on experience coding and troubleshooting alongside Claude Code or modern LLMs, with a proven ability to write, build, and deploy custom AI-driven workflows and skills for IT operations.
  • Scripting & IaC: High proficiency in Bash and Python, coupled with practical experience using configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or SaltStack.
  • System Internals: Deep understanding of Linux OS internals, low-latency networking concepts, TCP/IP, storage systems, and advanced system diagnostics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hybrid Architecture: Experience designing hybrid networks that bridge low-latency, on-premises trading infrastructure with AWS/GCP cloud environments.
  • Windows Administration: Working knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO), and DNS/DHCP.
  • PowerShell: Practical experience writing PowerShell scripts for Windows automation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000, plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s skills, experience, education, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, Geneva Trading offers a competitive total rewards package, including a comprehensive benefits program. Learn more about our employee incentives here.

Application expected to close: 1/5/2027

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior System Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team. This role is critical for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise IT infrastructure solutions across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and containerized environments. The successful candidate will ensure systems meet performance, availability, security, and compliance requirements while supporting physical servers, virtual machines, cloud platforms, and container orchestration.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with extensive experience in Linux administration, virtualization including VMware vSphere and vSAN, and enterprise storage platforms. This position requires strong technical expertise in cloud infrastructure management across multiple platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and AWS. Additionally, proficiency in scripting with Python, Bash, or PowerShell and automation tools is required to optimize resource utilization and support infrastructure lifecycle management. Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment processes is also essential to enhance development and operational workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise IT infrastructure solutions across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and containerized environments
  • Develop infrastructure architecture plans and deployment strategies
  • Ensure systems meet performance, availability, security, and compliance requirements
  • Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes platforms including Google Kubernetes Engine, self-managed Kubernetes, and K3s clusters on bare-metal servers
  • Manage Kubernetes cluster networking, storage, upgrades, scaling, monitoring, and high availability
  • Manage and maintain Linux Server systems, virtualization platforms, and storage solutions
  • Perform system monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and capacity planning
  • Manage physical servers, virtual machines, provisioning, configuration, and infrastructure lifecycle management
  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise storage technologies including SAN, NAS, NFS, block, and file storage
  • Support and maintain cloud infrastructure across multiple platforms
  • Manage cloud resource provisioning, compute, storage, and infrastructure services
  • Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure availability, connectivity, and performance issues
  • Monitor cloud resource utilization and identify opportunities for optimization

Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of experience as a Senior Systems Engineer or in a similar enterprise infrastructure engineering role
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Linux Server administration
  • Experience with virtualization technologies including VMware vSphere and vSAN
  • Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes platforms including Google Kubernetes Engine, self-managed Kubernetes, and K3s clusters on bare-metal servers
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes networking, persistent storage, ingress, cluster management, and high availability
  • Hands-on experience with one or more cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, or AWS with multi-cloud exposure preferred

descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career- and customer-oriented Cloud System Administrator to join the team in Annapolis Junction, MD.

Our team delivers enterprise infrastructure capabilities for a global workforce performing a wide range of missions in defense of our Nation. This effort supports the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS) organization, which oversees MPO’s Enterprise Information Technology (EIT)—the backbone platform for all enterprise users.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Provide administration and support for Windows Server 2022 environments, including Active Directory, and manage Windows 10/11 client systems.
  • Architect, deploy, and maintain robust cloud environments, primarily within AWS, while also supporting existing on-premise server infrastructure.
  • Develop, implement and maintain automation scripts and configurations using SaltStack to streamline infrastructure provisioning, configuration management and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with development teams to support integration and operational stability of CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployment and reliable software deployments.
  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot AWS cloud resources, including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, and other core services
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and security, responding to incidents and performing root cause analysis
  • Administer and troubleshoot various Linux distributions (e.g., Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL) within both cloud and on-premise contexts

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or Cloud Engineer supporting programs and contracts of similar scope and complexity
  • Bachelor’s degree in system engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering Science, Engineering Management or related professional engineering discipline; an additional 5 years of System Engineer experience might be substituted for a degree.
  • Must hold an IAT II certification (e.g., Security+ or equivalent); candidates will have 60 days from program start to obtain it
  • Experience with Windows Server 2022 administration, including Active Directory and networking
  • Proven experience as a System Administrator or Cloud Engineer with practical knowledge of cloud environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in enterprise or government environments
  • Familiarity with cloud security and compliance practices
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) for infrastructure deployment, management, and troubleshooting
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively in a team environment

Clearance Requirements

  • Must have a current/active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Physical Requirements

  • The candidate must be able to move, carry, and deliver workstations from the office to customer desks
  • The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time
  • Must communicate with co-workers, management, and customers via email, phone, or virtual meetings, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

descriptionHtml:
Department

Publix Technology

Job Category

Information Technology/Systems

Description

Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400+ stores and 200,000+ associates across 8 states.From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level—internships through technical leadership.Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” and help us build more than great subs—build the future of technology at Publix.

The Infrastructure Platform Engineering Team is responsible for defining, developing, implementing, maintaining, and advising on the effective use of the Publix VMware based technology solutions to maximize their value. This position will play a key active role towards those efforts with a focus on implementation, security, administration, iterative automation, and ongoing platform optimizations.

Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL)Work Model:

Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborate in person and innovate remotely.

Why Join Us?

  • Hybrid Flexibility: Work remotely when you need focus time and join us onsite for high-impact collaboration and brainstorming sessions.
  • Operational Efficiency: Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Cutting-Edge AI Projects: Drive innovation in AI platforms, integrating advanced tools and frameworks to solve complex business challenges.
  • Empowered Culture: We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization.

Your Impact

  • Software and hardware installation, configuration, integration, and support
  • Project design and architecture
  • Systems, platform, and network management activities
  • Problem determination, resolution, and prevention
  • Systems security, vulnerability remediations, and regular audit tasks
  • Facilitate project team participation, provide technical excellence, and foster a culture of shared growth through collaboration & shared responsibility
  • Maintain new technology awareness through self-driven research & practical proof of concept efforts with an end goal towards systems integration of current and future Publix technology state
  • Maintain vendor relationships while extracting maximum value for Publix with effective time utilization.
  • Create, review, collaborate, and update documentation for internal and peer customers
  • Programmatically gather, analyze, and correlate data points across the VMware product stack in diverse and siloed environments
  • Maintain consistent and iterative data collection while preserving data integrity and adhering to company security and audit standards for access and storage
  • Collaborate with engineering peers and management to iteratively develop and maintain simplified internally accessible dashboards that facilitate data-driven decision-making
  • Champion, develop and iterate automation processes, self-service portals, and monitoring tools to ensure consistency, maintain deployment velocity, and increase efficiency.
  • Drive and operationalize responsible corporate use of AI to enhance collaboration, code development, process efficiency, and documentation while upholding security and data governance standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or analytical discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years implementing, supporting, upgrading, securing, and migrating to VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF 5.2 or higher), including core components (SDDC, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN, and NSX) and adjacent VMware appliances such as Aria, vROPS, vRLI, LCM, vIDM, SRM, and vRNI.
  • 4+ years implementing, supporting, upgrading, securing, and operationalizing infrastructure platform management tools such as SDDC Manager, HPE OneView, and Dell OpenManage.
  • 4+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and migrating Windows Server & Red Hat operating systems in a highly segmented and secure virtual infrastructure
  • 4+ years of experience with various hardware vendors product stack
  • 4+ years of experience leading medium to large projects from requirements through implementation
  • 4+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering for public cloud or on-premises Infrastructure as Code Automation using scripts and tools such as PowerShell, Terraform and Ansible
  • 2+ years of experience in developing PowerBI, Data Bricks operational dashboards, or equivalent reporting within VMware Aria Operations, SharePoint, Data Lakes, or similar internally accessible data warehouses

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in managing, capacity planning, supporting, and migrating guest virtual machines of various operating systems in a highly segmented and secure virtual infrastructure
  • Experience with platform-related dependencies to include server, containers, NAS/SAN, hyperconverged solutions, core network design concepts, and hybrid cloud solutions
  • Experience in developing, maintaining, and executing operational automation technologies, such as Azure DevOps, VRA, Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Orchestrator or SCCM OS Deployments
  • Good understanding of various System Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies including traditional waterfall as well as agile methodologies (i.e., SCRUM, Kanban, etc.)
  • Experience working with vulnerability management tools, compliance audits, and remediation implementation & tracking activities
  • Experience working in a process structured environment which includes Change Management and Disaster Recovery (DR) Preparedness
  • Solid understanding of the functional and operational practices necessary to operate in a highly available, highly secure, and highly regulated environment to meet business, security, and compliance requirements
  • Experience in converting raw platform data points into insights for identifying & communicating potential issues, cost-effective solutions, or proactive platform actions to meet predicted just-in-time business needs during normal operations and DR situations
  • Experience with responsible use of enterprise AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and agentic patterns to improve individual and team efficiency, accuracy, and consistency across automation, orchestration, and daily engineering tasks through custom agents and shared prompt repositories

Benefits Information

  • Employee stock ownership plan that contributes Publix stock to associates each year at no cost
  • An opportunity to purchase additional shares of our privately-held stock
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Group health, dental and vision plans
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Free hot lunches (buffet-style) at facilities with a cafeteria
  • Visit our website to see all of our benefits: https://jobs.publix.com/benefits/

Year End Bonus

As a year-end bonus to associates, Publix issues one month’s extra pay (pro-rated in the first year) each year if associate remains employed through issue date of the bonus check that year. This is calculated as a 13th month of pay in the Potential Annual Pay with Bonus line above.

Additional Information

Your application may have additional steps that you will need to complete in order to remain eligible for consideration. Please be sure to monitor your email, including your spam folder, on a daily basis for critical, time-sensitive emails that could require action within 24-48 hours. Please do not use your Publix email address when applying. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive a confirmation email.

***Relocation/Household Good Shipment Allowance will NOT be provided.***

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of intelligence systems? CACI is seeking a talented Senior Infrastructure/System Administrator to join our team in Sterling, VA. In this role, you'll design cutting-edge system architectures for new and existing computer systems, coordinating all aspects of development including design, modeling, security, integration, and testing. Your expertise will be crucial in achieving project milestones and developing innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. Join us at CACI and be part of a team that's pushing the boundaries of technology in support of our nation's intelligence capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Support the design, security and maintenance across the cloud and hybrid/cloud computing environments that power our software development lifecycle.
  • Act as a critical bridge between system operations and development teams, managing a robust infrastructure that spans AWS cloud services and on-premises data centers.
  • Manage a highly available, scalable, and automated environments, ensuring developers have the secure access, CI/CD tools, and computing resources they need to build, test, and deploy code efficiently.
  • Perform systems design, development, and integration throughout the entire system life cycle.
  • Implement moderately complex infrastructure, including installing, configuring, testing, and maintaining operating systems, application software, and system management tools.
  • Conduct systems modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize performance and efficiency.
  • Maintain robust security measures, including backup and redundancy strategies.
  • Prepare and comprehensive documentation for processes and procedures related to engineering projects.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance (Willing and able to obtain a polygraph)
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, a relevant field or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 5 years as an IT system administrator, or related experience.
  • Technical understanding of: Cloud Infrastructure: Deep expertise in AWS core services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and Systems Manager (SSM). Hybrid Networking: Proven experience configuring AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPNs, and hybrid DNS architectures. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on proficiency with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation to provision multi-environment stacks. CI/CD Platform Support: Experience maintaining and scaling the infrastructure for GitLab CI or GitHub Actions. Operating Systems & Scripting: Advanced administration of Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Windows Server environments, utilizing Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation.
  • Demonstrated proficiency as a Linux system administrator.
  • Scripting and coding skills, particularly in Python, or similar languages.

Desired

  • Expertise in operational support and system maintenance.
  • Familiarity with Containerization & Orchestration, managing native Kubernetes clusters and AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) or native Kubernetes clusters with Ansible automation.
  • Certifications (Preferred): AWS Certified SysOps Administrator
  • Experience with automation and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, virtual networking)

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$86,600 - $181,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Location: Beachwood, OH

Shift: Monday - Friday 8am -5pm (Onsite 4 days a week)

Position Summary

The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and support of Penske Logistics’ enterprise infrastructure environment, including server, storage, virtualization, cloud, and backup technologies. This role provides day-to-day operational support for both Windows and Linux server platforms while ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and security across enterprise systems.

The Senior Systems Engineer will lead and support infrastructure initiatives involving virtualization platforms, storage systems, automation, disaster recovery, and cloud-integrated technologies. This position requires strong technical expertise, project leadership capabilities, and the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to deliver reliable and innovative IT solutions that support Penske’s business operations.

The role includes participation in after-hours support, maintenance windows, and on-call rotation responsibilities.

Major Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, monitor, and support enterprise Windows and Linux server environments
  • Manage and support virtualization platforms including VMware vSphere, Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, and related infrastructure technologies
  • Support enterprise storage environments including Dell EMC, SAN/NAS, and fiber channel and ethernet technologies
  • Design, implement, and maintain highly available virtual infrastructure solutions
  • Monitor system health, performance, and capacity planning for servers, storage, and virtualization platforms
  • Ensure systems and infrastructure adhere to organizational security standards and remediation practices
  • Implement automation and operational efficiencies using PowerShell, PowerCLI, Bash, Python, or similar scripting tools
  • Perform disaster recovery planning, testing, documentation, and ongoing operational readiness activities
  • Install, configure, upgrade, and patch operating systems, hypervisors, and enterprise applications
  • Support cloud and hybrid-cloud infrastructure initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Manage enterprise backup and recovery solutions and ensure data protection standards are maintained
  • Lead infrastructure projects from planning and design through implementation and operational support
  • Develop project plans, timelines, risk assessments, contingency plans, and status reporting
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders on infrastructure solutions and strategic initiatives
  • Create and maintain infrastructure documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures
  • Maintain server inventory, lifecycle management documentation, and asset tracking
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations for infrastructure modernization and optimization
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to support staff
  • Ensure proper management processes are followed for all infrastructure modifications
  • Provide after-hours support for infrastructure-related incidents and scheduled maintenance activities
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant infrastructure administration experience will be considered
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure administration, or enterprise IT support
  • 2–3 years of experience leading or supporting mid-to-large scale infrastructure projects
  • Strong experience administering Windows Server and Linux server operating systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu, or similar)
  • Experience supporting enterprise virtualization platforms including VMware vSphere, Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, or similar technologies
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies including Dell EMC, SAN, NAS, and fiber channel infrastructure
  • Experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity/access management concepts
  • Experience with cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure environments preferred
  • Experience with monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions
  • Strong scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, PowerCLI, Bash, Python, or similar tools
  • Knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, VLANs, and network interface configuration
  • Experience implementing security remediation and infrastructure hardening best practices
  • Strong documentation, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills
  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications including Visio

Preferred Certifications

  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
  • Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP)
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or equivalent Linux certification
  • Relevant cloud or infrastructure certifications preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job
  • Ability to work the required schedule, travel as necessary, and participate in after-hours support rotations
  • Ability to read, analyze, and communicate technical information verbally and in writing
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus

Penske Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Penske Logistics engineers state-of-the-art transportation, warehousing and freight management solutions that deliver powerful business results for market-leading companies. With operations in North America, South America, Europe and Asia, Penske and its associates help businesses move forward by increasing visibility and driving down supply-chain costs. Visit Penske Logistics to learn more.

Redstone Arsenal/Huntsville, AL  

At IPT Associates (IPTA), we enjoy solving real-world problems with technology. We work closely with our customers, teammates, experts, and partners to come up with practical solutions that actually make a difference. Whether it's a government or business organization, we focus on understanding the need and building something that works.

Our Team

At IPTA, everything starts with our people. We're big believers that when you invest in your team, great things happen. That's why we encourage learning, growth, and trying new things-even if you don't have all the answers yet.

Our culture is rooted in fierce determination, fearless integrity, and passionate service-but we also like to keep things collaborative, supportive, and down-to-earth.

We're Looking For People Who

  • Are curious and excited about technology
  • Like solving problems and figuring things out
  • Can take initiative but also enjoy working with a team

If you're someone who's eager to jump in, learn something new, and make an impact-you'll fit right in here.

IPTA is seeking a Platform Infrastructure Engineer responsible for installing, configuring, managing and maintaining virtualized systems to ensure data integrity, availability and security. The selected candidate will work with leadership and the architect team to design a virtualization strategy to meet mission requirements. They will provide technical expertise supporting information systems components, infrastructure integration and maintenance to meet architectural and business requirements.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Engineer, deploy, and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, and enterprise server infrastructure.
  • Engineering, installation and maintenance of server hardware and ESXi virtualization platform.
  • Evaluate and incorporate emerging technologies into the virtualization software solutions to enhance system performance and resource efficiency.
  • Evaluate virtualization software solutions vigilantly to reduce systems complexity while maintaining robust cybersecurity measures.
  • Support VMware technologies including vSAN, vROps, and NSX.
  • Monitor virtualization performance and resolve any issues.
  • Monitor tools that provide critical insights into workloads, depletion of resources, and peak loads of servers.
  • Assess network and server architecture for efficiency, improvements, or upgrades.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of the data centers virtualization software, hypervisors, interfaces, layout, system, and processes.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of the data center's layout, systems, and processes.

Job Requirements And Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field
  • 10 years prior experience in a similar role
  • DoD 8570 Level II/III certification desired
  • VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization
  • Proven work experience providing Data Center virtualization software solutions.
  • Experience working in cloud environments.
  • Active Security Clearance Required

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Experience designing, deploying, and administering VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments, ESXi, vCenter Server, NSX, vSAN, and VMware Aria Suite.
  • Experience administering enterprise VMware virtualization platforms, including High Availability (HA), Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS), vMotion, Storage vMotion, Distributed Switches, and resource optimization.
  • Experience deploying and supporting enterprise compute infrastructure using Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, or equivalent x86 server platforms.
  • Experience implementing software-defined data center (SDDC) architectures and virtualization best practices.
  • Experience deploying and administering enterprise storage technologies, including VMware vSAN, NAS, iSCSI, and storage replication.
  • Experience configuring VMware NSX, software-defined networking (SDN), virtual networking, VLANs, distributed switching, and network segmentation.
  • Experience administering Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating systems within enterprise virtualized environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical leadership skills with the ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional infrastructure and engineering teams.

IPTA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on individual merit, including qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, consistent with applicable federal laws and federal contracting requirements. IPTA provides equal opportunity and utilizes merit-based principles to make employment-related decisions.

descriptionHtml:
Bennett Thrasher is seeking an Azure Infrastructure Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for our Azure server environment and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) platform. This role will design, administer, secure, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure while establishing operational standards and mentoring other IT team members. The position requires deep Azure engineering experience, sound judgment in a production environment, and the ability to lead complex infrastructure work from design through implementation and ongoing support.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, administer, and optimize secure, scalable, and highly available Azure infrastructure aligned with business, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Administer Azure-hosted Windows Server environments, including deployment, configuration, patching, performance tuning, capacity planning, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management.
  • Engineer and support Azure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, network security groups, private endpoints, storage, Azure Files, Recovery Services vaults, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, firewalls, load balancing, and related platform services.
  • Lead administration and optimization of Azure Virtual Desktop and Nerdio, including host pools, session hosts, workspaces, application groups, golden images, autoscaling, user assignments, FSLogix profiles, and application delivery.
  • Monitor availability, capacity, security, cost, and user experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, dashboards, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and platform-native diagnostic tools.
  • Implement and maintain identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control, managed identities, privileged access practices, Conditional Access, and multifactor authentication.
  • Develop PowerShell, Azure CLI, or infrastructure-as-code automations to standardize deployments, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and support repeatable recovery procedures.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex incidents, coordinate remediation across internal teams and vendors, and participate in planned maintenance and escalated after-hours support when required.
  • Perform architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, cost optimization, resource governance, and capacity forecasting; recommend improvements and lead approved implementation work.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, runbooks, disaster recovery documentation, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and role-appropriate training to service desk and infrastructure team members while partnering with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of progressive infrastructure engineering or systems administration experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, migrating, and supporting enterprise Azure environments rather than administering only preconfigured services.
  • Advanced knowledge of Azure compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, governance, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
  • Deep experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, patching, certificates, permissions, performance analysis, and backup and recovery operations.
  • Hands-on administration of Azure Virtual Desktop and Nerdio Manager for Enterprise, including image management, autoscaling, host pool configuration, FSLogix, application delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Azure CLI, ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, or another infrastructure-as-code approach.
  • Experience applying Azure Well-Architected Framework principles, operational controls, security baselines, naming and tagging standards, and policy-based governance.
  • Current Microsoft Azure certification (AZ-104, AZ-140, AZ-305), or equivalent documented training and senior-level hands-on experience; willingness to complete role-specific Azure and Nerdio training as assigned.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, servers, networking, identity, endpoint access, security, and end-user experience.
  • Strong ownership, change management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical work and communicate risks, options, and recommendations to technical and leadership audiences.


Nice to Have

  • Microsoft certifications or completed training in Azure Solutions Architecture, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Security, or Azure Networking.
  • Nerdio certification or formal Nerdio Manager for Enterprise administrator training.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Intune, and hybrid identity or connectivity.
  • Experience building and testing business continuity and disaster recovery solutions using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Experience supporting professional services, accounting, or another security- and compliance-conscious business environment.

Job Description:

Advance how our customers operate while you advance your career. Join GDIT as a Senior Linux Systems Engineer and build an impactful career in enterprise IT, collaborating with people who are driven and resourceful like you.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a Senior Linux Systems Engineer, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of USCENTCOM. You will play a crucial role in configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Linux-based server environments supporting a large-scale enterprise infrastructure. This role supports mission-critical systems across an environment of more than 5,000 users, 1,000 servers, and 10,000 endpoints. The administrator will collaborate closely with other Enterprise Services teams to ensure system availability, performance, security compliance, and operational efficiency in support of USCENTCOM mission requirements.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Configure, deploy, and maintain Linux server environments, including physical and virtual systems.
  • Administer Red Hat and CentOS Linux systems, ensuring stability, performance, and security compliance.
  • Configure and manage Linux services such as Apache, Nginx, DNS, DHCP, LDAP, and related system services.
  • Monitor system performance and availability, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact operations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex system issues, including problems without existing documented solutions.
  • Implement system patches, updates, and security hardening in accordance with DoD and organizational policies.
  • Manage SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle activities supporting Linux-based services.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, network, storage, and security teams to design and implement Linux-based solutions aligned with enterprise requirements.
  • Participate in system upgrades, migrations, and the deployment of new Linux infrastructure components.
  • Ensure incidents, problems, and service requests are tracked, prioritized, escalated, and resolved appropriately.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
  • Produce reports and data sets to inform leadership of system performance, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior administrators and team members.
  • Support projects focused on improving the security, efficiency, scalability, and resilience of Linux environments.
  • Assist in developing and enforcing system policies and best practices.
  • Participate in enterprise initiatives to modernize and standardize infrastructure services.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across Enterprise Services teams.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Systems Administrator Senior must have:

  • Certification: Applicable DoW 8140 or DoW 8570 Certification
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience
  • Required skills:
    • Demonstrated proficiency administering Red Hat and CentOS Linux systems in enterprise environments.
    • Strong experience building, deploying, and maintaining Linux server infrastructures.
    • Expertise in system performance tuning, availability management, and security hardening.
    • Experience implementing patches, updates, and configuration changes in controlled environments.
    • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex systems issues under operational constraints.
    • Strong documentation skills for system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
    • Proven ability to work collaboratively across multiple IT disciplines.
  • Desired Skills:
    • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher
    • ITIL 4 Foundation Certification
    • Experience supporting USCENTCOM environments and familiarity with mission systems and operational requirements.
    • Knowledge of enterprise-scale infrastructure operations.
    • Experience mentoring junior administrators and contributing to team development.
  • Security clearance level: TS/SCI
  • US citizenship required

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals

Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.

–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.

Compliance & Security:

–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management:

–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.

–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.

–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:

–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning:

–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Qualifications

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
