Job Summary

An established and growing organization in the financial services industry is looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to its Infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will bring proven design, architecture, and engineering skills across systems, networking, and security in a hybrid on-premises and Microsoft Azure environment.

This individual will evolve the platform environment to keep pace with ongoing application product development and a growing, highly regulated business. The role is responsible for the stability, availability, and security of the environment, and for operating it in a way that is documented, change-controlled, and audit-ready (SOC 2). This is a hybrid systems and network role: in addition to core systems engineering duties, the individual will serve as the organization's primary network engineer, owning the Cisco network, Cisco Meraki wireless, and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, as well as Azure and hybrid cloud networking.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain the Cisco switching and routing infrastructure, Cisco Meraki wireless, and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls
  • Administer FortiGate firewalls, including security policies, NAT, site-to-site and remote-access VPN, and security profiles (IPS, web filtering, application control); perform periodic firewall rule reviews
  • Manage LAN/WAN services and segmentation, including VLANs, IP address management, routing, and wireless SSIDs, authentication, and RF tuning in the Meraki Dashboard
  • Design and maintain Azure networking, including VNets, hub-and-spoke topology, NSGs, route tables (UDRs), private endpoints, private DNS, VPN Gateway, and Application Gateway
  • Maintain hybrid connectivity and network redundancy between on-premises, Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including ExpressRoute, site-to-site VPN, and BGP routing
  • Design, install, administer, and upgrade VMware vSphere/ESXi virtualization infrastructure, including lifecycle management and version upgrades
  • Implement and maintain Azure governance, including group-based RBAC, least privilege, Privileged Identity Management (PIM/JIT), naming conventions, and dev/prod separation
  • Manage hybrid identity across on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including Entra Connect, single sign-on, Conditional Access, and group-based access controls
  • Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., Logic Monitor, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics), tuning alerting to detect issues early and reduce noise
  • Provide daily support of Windows Server, VMware, and Microsoft Azure environments
  • Install, configure and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools (e.g., patching, endpoint protection/EDR)
  • Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability
  • Monitor and test application performance for potential bottlenecks, identify possible solutions, and work with developers to implement those fixes
  • Own backup, replication, and disaster recovery strategies (e.g., Rubrik, Zerto), including scheduled DR testing, documented recovery runbooks, and validation of RPO/RTO targets
  • Write and maintain scripts using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or Python to automate repetitive tasks, increase system efficiency, and produce audit evidence, with logging, error handling, and source control
  • Design, deploy, and support Microsoft Azure services, including IaaS, App Services, Azure Front Door, and networking, in alignment with Azure landing zone standards
  • Serve as the escalation point and provide 2nd and 3rd level support, managing work through the ITSM platform (Freshservice) within defined SLAs
  • Monitor network performance, capacity, and internet circuits; coordinate with ISPs and carriers on outages and upgrades
  • Maintain firmware and OS lifecycle, configuration backups, and current network diagrams for all network and security devices
  • Plan and execute changes through the formal change management process, including risk assessment, testing, and documented rollback plans
  • Support SOC 2 and client security audits by producing evidence, supporting quarterly user access reviews, and remediating findings
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and runbooks
  • Mentor systems administrators and support specialists, and share knowledge across the IT team
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting a 24x7 production environment, including after-hours maintenance and change windows

Requirements

Required Skills/Experience:

  • 7-10+ years of industry experience as a Senior Systems Engineer performing design and engineering across systems and networking, preferably in financial services or another regulated industry
  • Networking – Strong working knowledge of routing and switching (TCP/IP, VLANs, STP, OSPF/BGP), with hands-on experience administering Cisco switches and routers (IOS/IOS-XE).
  • Firewalls – Hands-on experience administering Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, including policies, NAT, IPsec/SSL VPN, and security profiles.
  • Wireless – Experience designing and supporting Cisco Meraki wireless networks, including SSID/authentication design (e.g., 802.1X/RADIUS) and RF troubleshooting.
  • Azure networking – Experience designing and supporting Azure VNets, hub-and-spoke topologies, NSGs, UDRs, private endpoints, and hybrid DNS resolution.
  • Identity – Experience administering Microsoft Entra ID, including hybrid identity (Entra Connect), Conditional Access, MFA, and Privileged Identity Management.
  • Proven working experience in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Microsoft based environments (e.g., Windows Server, Remote Desktop Services).
  • Experience designing and implementing Windows Infrastructure services (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Certificate Authority/PKI).
  • Active Directory – Experience designing, planning, configuring, and supporting domain trusts.
  • Cloud – Hands-on experience with Azure IaaS, networking, and security, including supporting hybrid connectivity (ExpressRoute/VPN) between on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Experience in the administration and performance tuning of application stacks and web servers
  • VMware – Experience designing, implementing, and upgrading VMware vSphere/ESXi virtualization; exposure to containerization is a plus
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and alerting systems
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint/OneDrive
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell; working knowledge of Azure CLI and/or Python
  • Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned practices, including incident, problem, and change management
  • Experience operating within a compliance framework (e.g., SOC 2) and producing audit evidence
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Experience:

  • Cisco routers and switches
  • FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer
  • Zerto
  • SOC 2 audit support
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
  • Exchange Online PowerShell administration
  • Microsoft Intune/Windows Autopilot endpoint management
  • Azure Front Door
  • Rubrik Backup
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Azure Landing Zones/Cloud Adoption Framework
  • Microsoft Defender or other EDR platforms
  • Freshservice or similar ITSM platform
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE 4, AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-305, VMware VCP)

Remote Work Information

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure employees can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 50 MBps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

Compensation Information

The average salary for this position is expected to be between $108,000-$140,000 per year however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We do not anticipate candidates to be paid at the top of the range however, from time to time, it may occur on a case-by-case basis. Other rewards and benefits may include: 401(k) match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid-time off, etc.

Additional Information

As an employer, we believe our success depends on diversity, inclusion, and mutual respect among our team members. We want to look like our customers, and we recruit, develop, and retain the most hardworking people from a diverse candidate pool. We are committed to making all employment decisions based on business need, merit, capability, and equality of opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Job Description

At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future.

We believe that diverse teams with unique backgrounds, skills and experiences yield more innovative solutions. This is reflected in our commitment to engage, hire, and retain bright, committed people to work in partnership within an inclusive environment that allows each person to achieve personal success and add value to our teams and communities.

We are currently looking for Core Infrastructure Engineer – Professional to join our Technology team in Minneapolis, MN.

The Role

The Core Infrastructure Engineer – Professional will support and improve our on-premises and cloud infrastructure. This mid-level role is ideal for an engineer with several years of hands-on experience who can work independently, contribute to technical decisions, lead small-to-medium infrastructure projects, and continue developing their technical expertise.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will keep critical infrastructure reliable, observable, and secure; respond effectively to operational issues; complete patching and maintenance on schedule; and independently deliver infrastructure projects. They will improve Datadog monitoring coverage, build useful dashboards, and create actionable alerts that help teams identify and resolve issues quickly. Over time, this engineer will become a trusted contributor to the company’s infrastructure architecture and technology strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot VMware environments, including vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.
  • Support physical and virtual servers, Windows and/or Linux operating systems, enterprise storage, backup platforms, and related infrastructure.
  • Maintain infrastructure across cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Use monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog to:
    • Create and maintain infrastructure and application monitors.
    • Build operational, capacity, availability, and service-health dashboards.
    • Configure actionable alerts, thresholds, notification routing, and escalation procedures.
    • Analyze metrics, logs, events, and performance trends.
    • Reduce alert noise and improve monitoring coverage.
  • Perform operating system and infrastructure patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation and respond to infrastructure incidents outside normal business hours when required.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement durable solutions.
  • Lead selected infrastructure projects, including requirements gathering, planning, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Monitor and manage infrastructure capacity, performance, availability, reliability, and security.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures, asset information, and disaster-recovery plans.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, application, cloud, and business teams.
  • Automate routine operational tasks using scripting, configuration-management, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Assist infrastructure leadership with architecture planning, technology roadmaps, budgeting, risk management, and the company’s overall infrastructure and cloud strategy.
  • Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to other team members.
Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience administering VMware technologies such as vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux administration.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies and concepts, including SAN, NAS, RAID, snapshots, replication, and capacity planning.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or a comparable monitoring and observability platform, including creating monitors, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
  • Ability to interpret infrastructure metrics, logs, events, performance data, and capacity trends.
  • Experience with server patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, backup, recovery, and incident response.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead infrastructure projects and coordinate work across technical teams.

About Us

Atto Trading, a dynamic quantitative trading firm founded in 2010 and leading in global high-frequency strategies, is looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to join our team.

We are expanding an international, diverse team, with experts in trading, statistics, engineering, and technology. Our disciplined approach combined with rapid market feedback allows us to quickly turn ideas into profit. Our environment of learning and collaboration allows us to solve some of the world’s hardest problems, together. As a small firm, we remain nimble and hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity, ingenuity, and effort.

We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer who has experience designing, building, and deploying scalable infrastructure for research and production trading. As we are rapidly growing, this role will have a major impact on the future of our software systems. Less manual, more automation!

  • Troubleshoot complex issues across the OS, storage, networking, and HPC clusters, working closely with other teams
  • Automate server provisioning and configuration management
  • Maintain and scale data storage systems
  • Identify manual or repetitive workflows and design automation to improve reliability and user experience
  • Deploy and support containerized applications
  • Administer observability and source control platforms
  • Evaluate emerging hardware and software relevant to trading, HPC, and storage, and propose improvements
  • Coordinate with remote data center technicians on hardware installs and repairs
  • Maintain clear documentation and a structured knowledge base

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in Linux systems engineering or administration
  • Solid understanding of Linux internals
  • Strong understanding of computer system architecture
  • Good grasp of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting skills in Python and/or Bash
  • Experience with configuration management and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Ansible
  • Experience with containers (Docker, Podman; Kubernetes is a plus)
  • AI & Productivity Tools: Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage modern AI tools (e.g., generative AI, code assistants, research and productivity tools) to improve quality, speed, decision-making, and workflow efficiency while maintaining strong judgment, accuracy, and ownership of outcomes

Nice To Have

  • Hands-on experience with observability tools
  • Experience with low latency L1/1.5 network devices
  • Experience with Solarflare or Mellanox network cards
  • Experience with Kubernetes (bare-metal and cloud environments)
  • Experience with Big-Data Processing and Analysis Pipelines such as Jenkins or similar
  • Experience Working in a Trading Firm is a significant plus
  • Genuine Interest in Finance and Trading

Additional Expectations

  • Passion for Continuous Learning
  • Strong Sense of Responsibility
  • Ability to Make Independent and Timely Decisions
  • Skill in Finding Innovative Solutions
  • Service-Oriented Mindset

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities
  • 401k plan
  • Mental health support, including access to therapy
  • Paid time off (4 weeks)
  • Relocation support (where applicable)
  • International team meet-ups
  • Learning and development support, including courses and certifications
  • Access to professional tools, software, and resources
  • Fully equipped workstations with high-quality hardware
  • Modern office with paid lunches

Annual base salary range of $120,000 to $180,000. Pay (base and bonus) may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

Our Motivation

We are a company committed to staying at the forefront of technology. Our team is passionate about continual learning and improvement. With no external investors or customers, we are the primary users of the products we create, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact on our company's growth.

Ready to advance your career? Join our innovative team and help shape the future of trading on a global scale. Apply now and let's create the future together!

The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, implementation, deployment, documentation, testing, and ongoing capacity planning of infrastructure solutions, such as hardware, software, and systems configuration solutions. 

The individual in this role is expected to think strategically, drive long-term infrastructure improvements, influence technical roadmap decisions, and handle critical, company-wide outages. A key responsibility involves serving as a mentor and coach, where they guide our junior engineers through direct training and technical leadership. 

Your Day to Day

    • System Reliability & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable distributed systems. Define Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to measure and ensure system health. 
    • Release Engineering & CI/CD Pipelines: Architect and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid, safe, and repeatable software delivery. 
    • Automation & Engineering: Reduce manual, repetitive work by writing code and automation scripts using languages like Python, PowerShell, or Java to improve efficiency and system reliability.  
    • Advanced Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms. This individual serves as the final point of escalation for high-impact technical challenges, utilizing command-line mastery and interactive shells to resolve deep-system anomalies. 
    • Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Serve as the technical lead for hybrid infrastructure, managing the full lifecycle of on-prem and cloud-based resources. 
    • Monitoring & Observability: Develop the strategic roadmap for monitoring and observability across the hybrid environment.  
    • Capacity Planning & Performance: Analyze system resource usage to forecast and manage capacity, ensuring systems handle traffic growth. 
    • Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior team members, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE best practices across the organization. 
    • Security & Compliance: Maintain a high-security baseline for all platform services, ensuring compliance with SOC 2, PCI-DSS, or CIS Benchmarks where applicable. Conduct regular security audits, manage encryption protocols, and ensure all infrastructure follows the principle of least privilege. 
What We Need From You

  • Deep expertise and hands-on experience in infrastructures such as Active Directory, PKI, IPAM, Backup, Nutanix, Windows and Linux OS. Expertise in automation process from the beginning to end. Expertise in PowerShell and other scripting languages. Design and build experience in orchestration tools.  
  • Deep expertise and hands-on experience in Windows and Linux (RHEL) and Gloden image automation.
  • Good understanding and knowledge of Enterprise storage, Backup (Veeam /Other solutions), Virtualization (Nutanix), hyper-converged systems, networking and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) 
  • Experience evaluating and integrating AI-driven tools into existing IT infrastructure workflows to optimize operational efficiency and enhance automated processes.
  • Proven ability to lead infrastructure projects from design through deployment. 
  • Experience building and managing physical infrastructure in on-prem or hybrid environments. Experience providing technical guidance to external vendors and partners. 
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Excellent skills in communication, documentation, and mentoring others. 
  • Create and update technical documentation, standards, and procedures to support consistency and knowledge sharing. 
  • Industry certifications such as Microsoft, Nutanix, VMware, Backup / Storage solution are a plus. 

Travel - limited 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in the ATLANTA office. This expectation may be adjusted with the changing needs of the business.

descriptionHtml:
Schrödinger seeks a Cloud Engineer to join us in our mission to transform the discovery of therapeutics and materials.

Schrödinger has pioneered a physics-based software platform that enables discovery of high-quality, novel molecules for drug development and materials applications more rapidly and at lower cost compared to traditional methods. The software platform is used by biopharmaceutical and industrial companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories around the world. Our multidisciplinary drug discovery team also leverages the software platform to advance collaborative programs and its own pipeline of novel therapeutics to address unmet medical needs.

As a member of our Information Technology team, you’ll play a crucial role in facilitating the partnership between our development and operations teams. By building solutions in a highly collaborative environment, you’ll help scientists accelerate their R&D activities, reduce costs, and make discoveries that wouldn’t otherwise be possible.

Who Will Love This Job

  • An experienced cloud engineer who focuses on designing, implementing, and rectifying scalable cloud solutions and has an in-depth knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and other platforms like AWS or Azure
  • An excellent problem-solver who enjoys collaborating in an Agile environment
  • A proficient user of Infrastructure as Code tools (such as Github/GitLab, Terraform, Ansible) and automating change management via CI/CD
  • A networking, security, and data storage expert
  • A skilled scripter and programmer (Python, Bash, etc.)
  • An advanced Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL) administrator (and we’d like to hire someone with some macOS and Windows administration background as well)
  • Experience in a compliance-heavy environment will be helpful (ISO, SOX, GxP, etc.)

What You’ll Do

  • Participate in the design and architecture of cloud solutions that strategically meet the company's scalability, performance, and security requirements
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including technical and non-technical colleagues, to understand their business needs and requirements and align efforts and strategies across teams
  • Empower Schrödinger staff to make effective use of cloud resources holistically, including scalability, performance, cost optimization, security, and compliance as components of solutions
  • Leverage industry best practices in areas such as automation, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, logging, diagnosis, and troubleshooting
  • Leverage industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices while introducing and advocating for new technologies that can enhance the company's cloud capabilities

What You Should Have

  • At least five years of real-world, hands-on experience with cloud engineering in an enterprise environment
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or comparable experience in a professional setting
  • A proven track record of creating and improving internal standards, processes, and policies

Pay And Perks

Schrödinger understands it’s people that make a company great. Because of this, we’re prepared to offer a competitive salary, equity-based compensation, and a wide range of benefits that include healthcare (with dental and vision), a 401k, pre-tax commuter benefits, a flexible work schedule, and a parental leave program. We have catered meals in the office, a company culture that is relaxed but engaged, and over a month of paid vacation time. Our Administrative and Human Resources departments also plan a myriad of fun company-wide events. New York is home to our largest office, but we have teams all over the world. About The Department

The City of San José innovates to provide exceptional civic services using advanced technologies to help our community thrive.

The Information Technology Department’s (ITD) mission is to enrich the quality of life in San José through innovation, collaboration, and engagement. ITD enables that mission through business and infrastructure systems, cybersecurity, data management and analysis, responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), productivity and collaboration tools, the San José 311 resident experience platform, data equity and privacy programs, and strategic planning. Promoting the City’s commitment to equity and inclusion, we believe that all members of the community, regardless of background, have access to the tools and resources needed to thrive in the digital age. Over half of San José residents speak a language other than English at home, highlighting the importance of language accessibility in all City services. By fostering inclusivity, promoting digital literacy, and building accessible platforms, we are advancing technology while creating a more equitable future for everyone.

This is an exciting opportunity in the Information Technology Department. The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will be a subject matter expert in the server infrastructure team. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in administering, supporting, troubleshooting, and managing hybrid Cloud environment. The candidate should be familiar with hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) platform, enterprise file share/storage, backup and recovery, antivirus software, SolarWinds monitor software, and PowerShell script automation.

As a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will need to possess strong technical leadership skills, be able to work well with both technical and non-technical staff and have excellent communication skills. In this position, you will own, manage, and be able to complete projects from beginning to end in a timely fashion and must be able to work in a dynamic environment with a mixture of operational tasks and project assignments.

Position duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage Public Cloud (Azure) governance and operations, distributed file systems (and/or FileShare), and enterprise storage
  • System management and monitoring
  • Provide service improvement through automation
  • Perform hands-on system configuration and advanced troubleshooting of infrastructure issues to ensure service availability to meet service level expectations
  • Design and implement Azure cloud backup and Disaster Recovery of infrastructure services
  • Upgrade Windows server and FileShare cluster
  • Administer and monitor server backup operations



Please note that the Cloud Infrastructure Engineer position is eligible for a hybrid telework schedule, which is subject to change. The City is currently on a 32-hour onsite workweek.

Salary Information: The final candidate’s qualifications and experience shall determine the actual salary. In addition to the starting salary, employees in the Enterprise Information Technology Engineer (EITE) I/II classification shall also receive approximately five percent (5%) ongoing non-pensionable compensation pay.

The EITE I/II classification is represented by the Municipal Employees' Federation (MEF) AFSCME, Local 101 bargaining unit.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience:

  • EITE I: A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS, Business and Public Administration, or a closely related field AND three (3) years of increasingly progressive experience equivalent to performing technical work of complex difficulty to provide desktop, data security, application and system administration, and server or network administration or software applications to support end users, electronic business systems/solutions, and software applications for high availability and uptime.
  • EITE II: A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS, Business and Public Administration, or a closely related field AND four (4) years of increasingly progressive experience equivalent to performing technical work of complex difficulty to provide desktop, data security, applications and system administration, and server or network administration or software applications to support end users, electronic business systems/solutions, and software applications for high availability and uptime.



Acceptable Substitution:

  • Two (2) years of related experience may be substituted for up to two (2) years of the education requirement.



Required Licensing (such As Driver’s License, Certifications, Etc.)

  • Possession of a valid State of California driver’s license.
  • EITE I: Possess an industry certification that demonstrates expertise in the relevant information technology field, such as a Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA) certificate for Windows Server Enterprise, Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Network Associate (CCNA) certification, Brocade Professional IP Administrator (BPIPA) certification, OR an equivalent professional, industry-recognized certification acceptable to the City.
  • EITE II: Possess and maintain a current (non-expired) industry certification that demonstrates expertise in the relevant information technology field, such as a Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA) certificate for Windows Server Enterprise, Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Network Associate (CCNA) certification, Brocade Professional IP Administrator (BPIPA) certification, OR an equivalent professional, industry-recognized certification acceptable to the City.



Passing a San José Police Department background check is a condition of employment.

Other Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following competencies, as demonstrated in past and current employment history. Desirable competencies for this position include:

Job Expertise – Demonstrates knowledge of and experience with applicable professional/technical principles and practices, Citywide and departmental procedures/policies, and federal and state rules and regulations.

The ideal candidate will also possess a combination of the following knowledge and experience:

  • Ability to understand complexities of enterprise infrastructure and how to leverage technologies (Windows networking, Windows server clustering, storage, load balancing, etc.) for citywide benefits.
  • Strong technical hands-on experience in designing, configuring, implementing, managing, troubleshooting and administering current technologies such as:



  • Hybrid virtual/physical infrastructure
  • Single Sign-On (SSO)
  • Web Application Proxy
  • PowerShell scripting
  • Disaster Recovery
  • SSL certificates and domain registration
  • Windows Server administration
  • Active Directory and Group Policy
  • Enterprise Storage
  • Azure resource management
  • Load balancing
  • Cloud governance
  • Network troubleshooting
  • Distributed File System and/or Fileshare
  • Solarwinds system monitoring and alerting

Problem Solving – Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue; determines the significance of the problem; collects information and uses logic and intuition to arrive at decisions or solutions to problems that achieve the desired outcome.

Teamwork & Interpersonal Skills – Develops effective relationships with co-workers and supervisors by helping others accomplish tasks and using collaboration and conflict resolution skills.

Communication Skills – Effectively conveys information and expresses thoughts and facts clearly, orally and in writing; demonstrates effective use of listening skills; displays openness to other people’s ideas and thoughts.

Project Management – Ensures support for projects and implements agency goals and strategic objectives.

The selection process will consist of an evaluation of the applicant's training and experience based on the application and responses to all the job-specific questions. You must answer all questions to be considered, or your application may be deemed incomplete and withheld from further consideration. Only those candidates whose backgrounds best match the position will be invited to proceed in the selection process. Additional phases of the selection process will consist of one or more interviews.

If you have questions about the duties of these positions, the selection, or the hiring processes, please contact Felipa Perez at felipa.perez@sanjoseca.gov.

Please be informed that the City of San Jose will NOT sponsor, represent or sign any documents related to visa applications/transfers for H1-B or any other type of visa which requires an employer application.

You must answer all job-specific questions to be considered for this vacancy or your application will be deemed incomplete and withheld from further consideration. Applicants are expected to write their own essays/responses.

Please note that applications are currently not accepted through CalOpps or any other third party job board application system.

This recruitment may be used to fill multiple positions in this, or other divisions or departments. If you are interested in employment in this classification, you should apply to ensure you are considered for additional opportunities that may utilize the applicants from this recruitment.

Please allow adequate time to complete the application and submit before the deadline or the system may not save your application. If your online application was successfully submitted, you will receive an automatic confirmation email to the email address you provided. IF YOU DO NOT RECEIVE THE CONFIRMATION, please email CityCareers@sanjoseca.gov and we will research the status of your application.

AI and the Hiring Process

We recognize that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming part of daily life and can be a valuable tool for learning, research, and professional growth. We encourage candidates to use AI responsibly as a support in preparing application materials, live assessments, and interviews. However, we value authenticity, accuracy and truthfulness. Application responses and interview answers must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences. While AI can supplement preparation, it cannot replace the originality and judgment we look for in our employees. This ensures fairness, transparency, and equity for all applicants in the hiring process.

companySlogan: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science.™
descriptionHtml:
Location: Wickliffe, OH preferred. Deer Park, TX considered

Schedule: Onsite 4 days, 1 day remote each week

Shape the Future with Us.

At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a Systems Engineer focused on next-generation infrastructure, you'll be at the forefront of our innovation: driving cloud modernization, AI-assisted operations, infrastructure automation, and resilient platform engineering initiatives. You'll collaborate with a diverse group of passionate individuals to help evolve our environment as we adopt emerging technologies, enhance service reliability, and accelerate delivery through automation. In this role, you will:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise infrastructure across on-premises datacenters, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Manage Windows and Linux server platforms, virtualization platforms, storage systems, and enterprise backup and recovery technologies.
  • Engineer and support workloads across Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and hybrid multi-cloud environments.
  • Develop and maintain cloud landing zones, governance standards, resource blueprints, tagging strategies, and cost optimization practices.
  • Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, Ansible, or PowerShell Desired State Configuration (DSC).
  • Implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows for infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps) capabilities to improve monitoring, incident detection, capacity planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Design automation solutions using Power Automate, Logic Apps, PowerShell, and Python to reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.
  • Participate in complex incident resolution, modernization programs, documentation development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications That Enable Your Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related technology roles.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, virtualization, networking fundamentals, storage technologies, HPE platforms, and Pure Storage solutions.
  • Familiarity with observability platforms and AIOps concepts.
  • Understanding of security best practices, identity and access management, and zero-trust principles.

Preferred Qualifications That Drive You Forward

  • Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience administering Horizon Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Azure Virtual Desktop, and Microsoft 365 Cloud PC environments.
  • Scripting and automation experience with PowerShell and/or Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Ansible, or DSC.
  • Experience with low-code platforms such as Power Apps or Logic Apps.
  • Exposure to Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or AI-assisted tools for IT operations.
  • Curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn emerging technologies with an automation-first mindset.

descriptionHtml:
Bennett Thrasher is seeking an Azure Infrastructure Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for our Azure server environment and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) platform. This role will design, administer, secure, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure while establishing operational standards and mentoring other IT team members. The position requires deep Azure engineering experience, sound judgment in a production environment, and the ability to lead complex infrastructure work from design through implementation and ongoing support.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, administer, and optimize secure, scalable, and highly available Azure infrastructure aligned with business, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Administer Azure-hosted Windows Server environments, including deployment, configuration, patching, performance tuning, capacity planning, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management.
  • Engineer and support Azure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, network security groups, private endpoints, storage, Azure Files, Recovery Services vaults, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, firewalls, load balancing, and related platform services.
  • Lead administration and optimization of Azure Virtual Desktop and Nerdio, including host pools, session hosts, workspaces, application groups, golden images, autoscaling, user assignments, FSLogix profiles, and application delivery.
  • Monitor availability, capacity, security, cost, and user experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, dashboards, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and platform-native diagnostic tools.
  • Implement and maintain identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control, managed identities, privileged access practices, Conditional Access, and multifactor authentication.
  • Develop PowerShell, Azure CLI, or infrastructure-as-code automations to standardize deployments, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and support repeatable recovery procedures.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex incidents, coordinate remediation across internal teams and vendors, and participate in planned maintenance and escalated after-hours support when required.
  • Perform architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, cost optimization, resource governance, and capacity forecasting; recommend improvements and lead approved implementation work.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, runbooks, disaster recovery documentation, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and role-appropriate training to service desk and infrastructure team members while partnering with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of progressive infrastructure engineering or systems administration experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, migrating, and supporting enterprise Azure environments rather than administering only preconfigured services.
  • Advanced knowledge of Azure compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, governance, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
  • Deep experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, patching, certificates, permissions, performance analysis, and backup and recovery operations.
  • Hands-on administration of Azure Virtual Desktop and Nerdio Manager for Enterprise, including image management, autoscaling, host pool configuration, FSLogix, application delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Azure CLI, ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, or another infrastructure-as-code approach.
  • Experience applying Azure Well-Architected Framework principles, operational controls, security baselines, naming and tagging standards, and policy-based governance.
  • Current Microsoft Azure certification (AZ-104, AZ-140, AZ-305), or equivalent documented training and senior-level hands-on experience; willingness to complete role-specific Azure and Nerdio training as assigned.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, servers, networking, identity, endpoint access, security, and end-user experience.
  • Strong ownership, change management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical work and communicate risks, options, and recommendations to technical and leadership audiences.


Nice to Have

  • Microsoft certifications or completed training in Azure Solutions Architecture, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Security, or Azure Networking.
  • Nerdio certification or formal Nerdio Manager for Enterprise administrator training.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Intune, and hybrid identity or connectivity.
  • Experience building and testing business continuity and disaster recovery solutions using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Experience supporting professional services, accounting, or another security- and compliance-conscious business environment.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support enterprise cloud and infrastructure initiatives within a collaborative, high-performing systems engineering team. This role involves designing, building, deploying, and maintaining cloud and on-premise infrastructure using modern automation and configuration management practices. The engineer will contribute to system lifecycle activities including development, integration and test, deployment, and operations.

What you'll do:

  • Support system lifecycle activities across development, integration and test, deployment, and operations.
  • Build and maintain highly available, high-performance networked systems in a team-oriented environment.
  • Deploy cloud instances and applications, leveraging automation tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for automated deployment and system patching within large-scale environments.
  • Create systems engineering documentation including concepts of operation, requirements, specifications, and interface documents.
  • Assist with system planning, scaling, and design activities.
  • Support infrastructure-related trade studies.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 7+ years of experience; OR bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 5+ years of experience; OR master's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 3+ years of experience. An additional four (4) years of equivalent experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
  • This position requires the candidate to possess a minimum of Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI. The candidate must maintain the clearance.
  • Meet DoD 8140 foundational qualifications for the work role of System Administrator at an Intermediate or Advanced proficiency level
  • Proficiency with Linux and Windows operating systems, including building and configuring systems from scratch, troubleshooting system functionality, and leveraging automation tools where possible.
  • Experience installing, configuring, and deploying services following industry-standard security and authentication practices.
  • Experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Ansible playbooks for configuration and sustainment activities.
  • Experience using scripting languages such as Bash, Ansible, or Python for automation across physical and/or virtual hosts.
  • Experience using Git for collaboration, configuration management tracking, and code review.
  • Experience creating and updating process documentation related to infrastructure deployments and system sustainment.
  • Experience integrating hosts and applications with Identity and Access Management (IDAM) systems such as Active Directory, FreeIPA, or similar.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting PKI infrastructure and PKI-related issues.
  • Experience with RHEL 8.x or similar Linux OS, including system build, package installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience troubleshooting issues related to PKI configuration, networking, firewalls, or similar infrastructure layers.
  • Experience using automation tools to perform security hardening, vulnerability patching, and SELinux configuration and troubleshooting.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Current/active certification that meets DoD 8140 foundational qualifications for the work role of System Administrator at an Intermediate or Advanced proficiency level such as Security+, Cloud+, SSCP, CASP+, etc. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including troubleshooting containerized workloads, node issues, and deploying/upgrading configurations using YAML, Helm, or GitOps.
  • Experience with Red Hat technologies or similar, such as OpenStack, OpenShift, OpenStack Services on OpenShift, or Satellite.
  • Experience deploying and managing relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Experience configuring and managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) technologies and associated identity protocols (e.g., SAML, OIDC).
  • Experience with monitoring and logging solutions such as Splunk, Elasticsearch, Sensu, Prometheus, Grafana, or Kibana.
  • Experience developing infrastructure solutions that maximize uptime, reduce repetitive tasks, and minimize human error.
  • Experience with out-of-band management technologies including iDRAC, iLO, or IPMI.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-oriented and able to work independently.

Benefits:

Peraton offers enhanced benefits to employees working on this critical National Security program, which include heavily subsidized employee benefits coverage for you and your dependents, 25 days of PTO accrued annually up to a generous PTO cap and eligible to participate in an attractive bonus plan

Details

Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support enterprise cloud and infrastructure initiatives within a collaborative, high-performing systems engineering team. This role involves designing, building, deploying, and maintaining cloud and on-premise infrastructure using modern automation and configuration management practices. The engineer will contribute to system lifecycle activities including development, integration and test, deployment, and operations.

What you'll do:



- Support system lifecycle activities across development, integration and test, deployment, and operations.
- Build and maintain highly available, high-performance networked systems in a team-oriented environment.
- Deploy cloud instances and applications, leveraging automation tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
- Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for automated deployment and system patching within large-scale environments.
- Create systems engineering documentation including concepts of operation, requirements, specifications, and interface documents.
- Assist with system planning, scaling, and design activities.
- Support infrastructure-related trade studies.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:



- Associate's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 7+ years of experience; OR bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 5+ years of experience; OR master's degree in engineering, Computer Technology or related field and 3+ years of experience. An additional four (4) years of equivalent experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
- This position requires the candidate to possess a minimum of Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI. The candidate must maintain the clearance.

- Proficiency with Linux and Windows operating systems, including building and configuring systems from scratch, troubleshooting system functionality, and leveraging automation tools where possible.

- Experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Ansible playbooks for configuration and sustainment activities.

- Experience deploying and troubleshooting PKI infrastructure and PKI-related issues.
- Experience with RHEL 8.x or similar Linux OS, including system build, package installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
- Experience troubleshooting issues related to PKI configuration, networking, firewalls, or similar infrastructure layers.

- Experience deploying and managing relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Experience configuring and managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) technologies and associated identity protocols (e.g., SAML, OIDC).
- Experience with monitoring and logging solutions such as Splunk, Elasticsearch, Sensu, Prometheus, Grafana, or Kibana.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Position Summary

The Cloud Engineer maintains and supports enterprise application delivery and integration infrastructure across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. This role implements solutions that enhance reliability, accessibility, and performance across multiple business units. It helps ensure cloud and on-premises remain secure, optimized, and function effectively. The position contributes to the successful deployment and ongoing maintenance of both cloud and core on-premises infrastructure including middleware, traffic management/load balancing, and hybrid connectivity. The position supports secure and reliable technology services used across corporate, customer, and utility operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploys, configures, and maintains cloud and on-premises systems and integration services
  • Monitors hybrid systems to ensure performance and availability
  • Troubleshoots complex technical issues and supports incident resolution
  • Implements updates, patches, and changes to cloud and on-premises configurations
  • Assists in integrating cloud tools with existing on-premises operational and enterprise systems
  • Maintains documentation related to infrastructure builds and processes
  • Supports security controls and compliance requirements in a hybrid environment
  • Performs routine system health checks and maintenance activities
  • Coordinates with teams on resource needs and usage
  • Contributes to automation and efficiency improvements in hybrid operations

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or Associate's degree in a related field and 2+ years of directly related experience; or High school diploma or GED and 4+ years of directly related experience

Preferred Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience

Compensation Information

$104,620 - $130,770 (min. - mid.)

Compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s education, experience, and qualifications.

Work is primarily sedentary and performed in an office or control-center environment with prolonged periods of sitting and computer use. Troon’s Corporate office, located in Scottsdale, AZ, is pleased to announce an excellent career opportunity for a Systems Engineer! We are seeking a highly motivated individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and advance their career within a rapidly growing organization. The ideal candidate will bring a strong commitment to professional development and a desire to succeed in a dynamic corporate environment. 

Job Summary: 

We are seeking a mid-level Systems Engineer with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure infrastructure to support and maintain our cloud-first environments. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on technical work across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, and Microsoft cloud services, while collaborating closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams.

This is a full-time role based out of the Troon corporate headquarters in Scottsdale and may require occasional travel for business needs.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $115,000 annually

Key Responsibilities:   

  • Deploy, support, and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage, and Azure Virtual Networks (VNets).
  • Administer Azure networking components such as VNets, subnets, NSGs, VPN connectivity, private endpoints, and load balancing services.
  • Manage identity and access using Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), RBAC, Conditional Access, and MFA.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, security, and cost using Azure-native tools.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects such as cloud deployments, upgrades, and platform improvements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and identity-related issues.
  • Maintain technical documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver secure, reliable cloud solutions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3–6 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure, or cloud operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services.
  • Practical experience with Azure Virtual Networks and cloud networking concepts.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Strong understanding of Windows operating systems and cloud-based identity.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and work independently on assigned tasks.
  • Experience with Azure monitoring, security, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Hands-on experience using PowerShell and automation tools to streamline administrative tasks, improve consistency, and support infrastructure operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
  • Exposure to Microsoft Intune

 

Why Join Us:

  • Cloud-first Microsoft environment.
  • Opportunity to work on modern Azure infrastructure technologies.
  • Collaborative team culture with professional growth opportunities.

 

Education Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

 

Physical Requirements: 

  • Ability to sit/stand/look at computer for long periods of time. 
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 40 lbs (e.g., servers, switches, UPS units etc..)

 

Environment/Noise: 

  • Typical office environment.

Benefits & Other Compensation:

This position includes eligibility for the following benefits, subject to applicable plan terms:

  • Healthcare Benefits – Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Retirement Benefits – 401(k) with employer match (19 years of age and older)
  • Time Off – Paid time off (PTO) and leaves of absence, in accordance with applicable law and eligibility criteria

Eligibility for benefits and the specific terms, conditions, and offerings are governed by the applicable plan documents and company policies, which may be amended at the Company’s discretion.

descriptionHtml:
At FHLB Des Moines, we work each day to develop an inclusive culture that supports and leverages the complexity of a diverse workforce. This enables us to effectively serve the needs of our members and help them succeed.

This position will support the Bank’s cloud-based systems and infrastructure within the Information Technology department. The Cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining cloud-based solutions and work proactively to diagnose problems and provide recommendations for new and existing cloud-based systems.

Accountabilities:

Responsibilities/Duties/Function/Tasks:


  • Administer, configure, and maintain the Bank’s Microsoft cloud services and other cloud-based solutions used by the Bank.
  • Ensure system backups and recovery using cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage and plan project work related to platform upgrades, patches, and modifications to services as needed.
  • Evaluate the Bank’s cloud services utilized by the Bank, to understand how they integrate with infrastructure services.
  • Design integration of cloud application and infrastructure services into existing IT systems.
  • Implement and manage cloud security controls, identity and access management policies.
  • Secure systems to meet corporate standards and best practices.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of disaster recovery processes and procedures.
  • Develop scripts for configuration management automation and process improvements.
  • Support existing applications and projects by responding to incidents, problems, and service requests.
  • Participate in research and recommend new cloud technologies to meet the Bank’s business objectives.
  • Operate in accordance with the Bank’s control processes and comply with the Bank’s policies and procedures.
  • Manage administrative tasks.
  • Crosstrain others on the team as requested.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve cloud-based system issues, involving third-party vendor support as needed for quick resolution of problems.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-based procedures related to Microsoft cloud services and other cloud-based solutions used by the Bank.
  • Consulted in the development of IT roadmaps around infrastructure and cloud services; understand and convey potential impact to Bank services and architecture.
  • Develop and implement performance metrics and monitoring to report on cloud configurations, performance, and security baselines.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 5-7 years’ experience in cloud engineering or a related role.

About Us

We’re a fast-growing, privately held insurance company on a path to become a leading U.S. retail platform. We believe every client and customer relationship holds the potential to grow into something greater, and the same is true for our people. As we grow, we’re redefining how great talent connects with meaningful work, enabling our ambitious strategy while building a culture of high performance, creativity, and partnership. If you’re driven by building reliable, secure infrastructure that supports critical financial operations, and you enjoy blending technical expertise with real-world business impact, you’ll thrive here!

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Engineer who brings deep infrastructure expertise, a problem-solver mindset, and a passion for building and maintaining resilient, secure systems. In this role, you’ll own and advance our data center, Cloud, and Microsoft 365 environments, with a strong focus on server infrastructure, identity, data protection, and disaster recovery.

You’ll play a key role in provisioning, configuring, and optimizing infrastructure across Nutanix HCI, Windows Server, AWS, and Microsoft 365 platforms—while ensuring seamless integration across systems, identity services, and proprietary applications. You’ll lead efforts to modernize legacy infrastructure, harden identity and policy controls, and maintain robust backup, recovery, and monitoring capabilities.

This role partners closely with IT teams and business stakeholders to ensure our environment remains scalable, secure, and built for the future—bringing together technical expertise and practical execution to drive meaningful impact across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Build and Maintain Core Infrastructure

  • Own and optimize Nutanix HCI infrastructure, including cluster upgrades, health monitoring, and capacity planning
  • Own Windows Server environments spanning legacy (2003+) through current versions, including hands-on upgrade and migration projects
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Microsoft Failover Clusters and SQL Server deployments in clustered and standalone configurations
  • Support AWS infrastructure and services as a strong complement to on-premises workloads
  • Perform ongoing performance tuning, capacity planning, and resource optimization to support business growth
  • Lead legacy-to-modern server upgrade initiatives, ensuring minimal disruption and full documentation of the migration path

Data Protection and Disaster Recovery

  • Design, implement, and maintain data protection strategies, including backup policies, replication, and retention management
  • Own disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure business continuity across all critical systems
  • Support and optimize Wasabi object storage for backup targets and archival workloads
  • Leverage Nutanix-native data protection features, including snapshots, replication, and DR runbooks

Identity, Directory, and Access Management

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Active Directory—including AD Sites and Services, OU structure hardening, Group Policy design and enforcement, and schema management
  • Support hybrid Active Directory environments, including synchronization between on-premises AD and Entra ID
  • Support and troubleshoot Entra ID for SSO, SAML-based application integrations, Conditional Access policies, and identity governance
  • Own the enterprise PKI and certificate infrastructure, including CA hierarchies, certificate lifecycle management, renewal processes, and integration with public certificate authorities such as DigiCert
  • Support and troubleshoot Intune device management policies, including compliance, configuration profiles, and patch management

Microsoft 365 and Cloud Productivity

  • Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive
  • Provide deep technical support and guidance on SharePoint architecture, permissions, and content governance across the organization
  • Troubleshoot, validate, and support Conditional Access policies aligned to Zero Trust principles
  • Act as the escalation owner for Mimecast email security, including policy troubleshooting, threat protection, DMARC enforcement and monitoring, and continuity services

DNS, Networking, and Security

  • Serve as the DNS authority for both public and private DNS—managing zones, records, delegation, split-horizon configurations, and DNS security practices
  • Design, implement, and support network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls (including Fortinet), and connectivity solutions
  • Leverage deep knowledge of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), and network architecture to maintain a stable and resilient infrastructure
  • Support and optimize storage, compute, network, and security resources across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Troubleshoot complex network, system, and application issues—resolving connectivity and performance challenges across the environment
  • Implement and support security tools, protocols, and controls to protect infrastructure and data
  • Partner on vulnerability remediation efforts, system hardening, and ongoing monitoring of security risks

Monitoring, Automation, and Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage Site24x7 for deep infrastructure and application monitoring, alerting, and uptime reporting
  • Lead efforts to evaluate, test, and deploy infrastructure upgrades, patches, and enhancements
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, and reliability through proactive analysis and innovation

Collaborate and Support Across the Organization

  • Partner with IT teams and system administrators to maintain and troubleshoot the environment
  • Provide support for network-related issues impacting the user community, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption
  • Create and maintain clear documentation of systems, configurations, and processes to support knowledge sharing and operational efficiency

What You’ll Bring

  • BS in Computer Science or related discipline, advanced degree desirable.
  • 7+ years of experience as a Systems, Infrastructure, or Senior Network Engineer in an enterprise environment
  • Broad hands-on experience across server infrastructure, networking (LAN/WAN/WLAN), identity, and cloud platforms

Required Experience

  • Nutanix: Hands-on experience with Nutanix HCI infrastructure, cluster upgrades, and data protection features
  • Windows Server: Deep expertise in administering, troubleshooting, and upgrading Windows Server from 2003 through current versions
  • Active Directory: Extensive experience with AD design, AD Sites and Services, OU hardening, Group Policy management, and hybrid AD architecture
  • Certificate Services: Strong PKI and certificate lifecycle management experience in enterprise environments, including public certificate authorities such as DigiCert
  • Entra ID: Proven experience with SSO, SAML integrations, Conditional Access, and identity governance
  • Intune: Experience managing device compliance, configuration, and patching policies across Windows and mobile platforms
  • Microsoft 365: Solid M365 administration including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive
  • SQL Server: Experience deploying and maintaining SQL Server in standalone and clustered configurations
  • Microsoft Failover Clustering: Experience designing and maintaining Windows Server failover clusters
  • DNS: Expert-level understanding of public and private DNS, split-horizon configurations, and DNS security
  • Networking: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), LAN/WAN/WLAN architecture, and enterprise network hardware, including routers, switches, and firewalls; hands-on experience with Fortinet platforms (FortiGate, FortiManager, or FortiAnalyzer)
  • Data Protection & DR: Experience designing and maintaining backup, replication, and disaster recovery solutions
  • Mimecast: Experience supporting Mimecast for email security, policy troubleshooting, DMARC enforcement and monitoring, and continuity
  • Site24x7: Experience configuring and managing infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and reporting
  • Wasabi: Familiarity with Wasabi object storage for backup and archival use cases

Strong Plus

  • AWS infrastructure experience spanning compute, containers, networking, and storage (EC2, Workspaces, ECS/Fargate, ECR, ALB, S3, Direct Connect, CloudFormation); comfortable operating in multi-region, multi-account AWS Organizations environments with an understanding of security boundary design.
  • Redwood ActiveBatch for enterprise job scheduling and automation
  • Experience leading legacy-to-modern server platform migrations

Core Competencies

  • Execution Excellence: Delivers high-quality infrastructure solutions while balancing speed, reliability, and operational stability
  • Technical Depth: Demonstrates strong expertise in networking, cloud (Azure), and infrastructure technologies to solve complex challenges
  • Problem Solving: Analyzes and resolves complex system, network, and performance issues with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset
  • Security & Risk Awareness: Prioritizes system security, data protection, and adherence to regulatory and compliance standards
  • Communication: Clearly translates technical concepts and issues to both technical teams and business stakeholders
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across IT and business teams to maintain and improve system performance and reliability
  • Ownership & Accountability: Operates independently with sound judgment, taking full ownership of systems, issues, and outcomes
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and evolving infrastructure needs
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to enhance system performance, scalability, and resilience through innovation and optimization

What We Offer:  

  • A collaborative, inclusive environment that values authenticity, accountability, and partnership
  • The opportunity to join the company at an exciting stage of growth, where colleagues are empowered to build what’s next  
  • A variable compensation package with a base range of $100k-$147k  
  • A competitive benefits package including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; an HSA and 401(k) company match; paid time off; and employer-paid life and disability insurance  
  • Remote/hybrid work arrangement with significant travel  

  

At Prosperity, we are committed to equal employment opportunities and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We make hiring decisions based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status. 

 We strive for a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you need an adjustment or accommodation due to a disability or medical condition during the hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
