At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

Knack Works provide a secure, multi-tenant, enterprise-scale platform for automated deployment in cloud, on-prem, air-gapped and hybrid environments. We are seeking a highly motivated DevOps engineer who is looking to craft and deliver unique high-impact solutions! We are a collaborative team that thrives on solving hard problems. This position is located on-site in our Chantilly, VA office. The role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing, configuring, and maintaining computer systems, servers, networks, and IT infrastructure to ensure high availability, security, and reliable operations.

Responsibilities

  • Operate Windows and Linux systems
  • Manage systems hardware and software infrastructure for both on-prem and in the cloud
  • Collaborate with a team of engineers to design, implement, and test features and functionality to support Knack Works’ high-performance computing products
  • Develop and define techniques and tools to support the most efficient solution to meet program needs
  • Collaborate with systems, security, and support teams as needed
  • Work in a cross-collaborative environment, across DevSecOps disciplines plus related functions.
  • Proficient in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Powershell, C#, C++, XML, JSON, etc…)
  • Execute and coordinate the end-to-end remediation of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, including analysis, patching, mitigation, and validation.
  • Deploy, upgrade, and manage containerized applications in a Kubernetes Cluster
  • Build containerized applications, including building containers, writing Helm charts, and testing Helm deployments in Dev and Test Kubernetes Clusters
  • Automate infrastructure tasks using tools such as Ansible, Python, or Bash
  • Ability to troubleshoot systems, performance, and security issues
  • Provide hardware and software support for users, customers, and personnel
  • Support the development of system documentation
  • Maintain and provide technical expertise in all areas of hardware, software, and networking
  • Perform hardware and software installation, cabling coordination, and some networking
  • Follow change management and implementation best practices


Here's what you'll need

Active TS/SCI

  • 5 – 10 years of hands-on Windows Server OS and Linux system administration experience
  • Solid understanding of Windows OS and Linux
  • Experience with installation and implementation of hardware, software, and networking equipment
  • Familiarity with hardware vendors (e.g., HP, Dell, etc.) and cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in a team environment
  • Experience with LAN/WAN operations and protocols
  • Experience working in development and operational environments
  • Experience working in development and operational networking environments
  • VMware vSphere configuration and maintenance experience
  • Experience with system monitoring tools
  • Exposure to cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or similar)
  • Experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment
  • CompTIA Security+ CE certification


Minimum Education & Preferred Focus Areas

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and Profit-Sharing Plan (PSP) which includes both PSP contributions and an optional 401(k) plan (available immediately (i.e., no deferment or wait period), and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $170,000.00 to $240,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on October 26, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

Onsite employees are expected to attend a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of their role.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Senior Systems Engineer!!

Location: Salt Lake City, Utah

Job ID: 48497

The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the reliability, performance, and security of the organization’s core systems and infrastructure. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong operational discipline to ensure systems run efficiently, issues are resolved quickly, and future growth is supported with scalable solutions. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail ‑ oriented, and comfortable owning mission-critical environments.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

Identity and Access Management Solutions (IAMS):

HID Global IAM products protect more than 85 million user identities.

HID Global Identity and Access Management Solutions products protect more than 85 million user identities. At HID Global, we understand that no person, device, or workplace can go unprotected. This philosophy of Zero Trust drives us to create new advances in risk-based multi-factor authentication, leads us to secure user identities in converged access environments and drives the need to expand implementations with our industry-leading digital certificates and PKIaaS solution to manage them at scale.

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.

As our Senior Systems Engineer, you’ll support HID’s success by:

  • Engaging in the design, deployment, and maintenance of server, storage, and cloud infrastructure across production and non-production environments.
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing system performance, ensuring high availability and adherence to SLAs.
  • Building and maintaining automation for system provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and incident handling.
  • Serving as an escalation point for complex operational issues, driving root-cause analysis and long-term remediation.
  • Developing and maintaining detailed system architecture documentation, runbooks, and operational standards.
  • Implementing and managing robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.
  • Collaborating closely with Security, DevOps, Network Engineering, and Application teams to ensure end ‑ to ‑ end platform stability.
  • Driving lifecycle management for infrastructure components, including patching, upgrades, and capacity planning.
  • Participating in the on-call rotation and leading response efforts during major incidents.
  • Evaluating and recommending new technologies, tools, and processes to continuously improve operational maturity.
  • Designing and deploying new infrastructure solutions.
  • Automating workflows, provisioning, and system management tasks.
  • Leading root ‑ cause analysis and driving long ‑ term remediation strategies.
  • Collaborating with cross ‑ functional teams for projects and platform improvements.
  • Evaluating and recommending new technologies and tools.
  • Supporting SAFe/Agile ceremonies and contributing to iterative delivery cycles.
  • Participating in capacity planning and infrastructure roadmap development.

Your Experience and Background include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or operations, with emphasis on production-grade infrastructure.
  • Strong expertise with Linux and/or Windows server administration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience managing containerized applications and orchestration tools (Docker, containerd, Kubernetes, Nomad, etc.)
  • Proficiency with Git-based version control systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts (DNS, load balancing, firewalls, routing).
  • Experience with IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Proven experience in incident management and root ‑ cause analysis.
  • Experience designing, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise ‑ grade networks, including Layer 2/3 switching, routing protocols, load balancers, and network security controls.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe and Agile practices, including participation in ceremonies and alignment to iterative delivery workflows
  • Background with identity management, SSO, and enterprise authentication systems.
  • Certifications in cloud or systems engineering fields (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator or Architect, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), ITIL Foundation, etc.)

What we can offer you:

  • Competitive salary and rewards package
  • Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
  • A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
  • Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
  • To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

  • Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
  • Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. You'll have opportunities to share insights and contribute forward-thinking ideas that shape future outcomes.
  • Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

HID does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity. If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact accommodations-ext@hidglobal.com .

Immigration Sponsorship Not Available

  • Applicants for this position must be currently and legally authorized to reside and work in the hiring country.
  • HID Global will not offer immigration sponsorship or assume sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.
  • International relocation or remote work arrangements outside of the hiring country will not be considered.

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Grow Your Career at Cedars-Sinai

We were recently named one of the “Best Places to Work in IT” by Computerworld and ranked #2 among large organizations for hybrid work.

The organization’s Healthtech excellence was acknowledged again through the esteemed CHIME Digital Health Most Wired recognition program. Cedars-Sinai was assigned a Level 10—the most prestigious level of certification—among more than 300 surveyed healthcare organizations. Cedars-Sinai earned high scores across multiple verticals and particularly excelled in infrastructure, interoperability, and population health innovation.

Why Work Here

Beyond an outstanding benefits package and competitive salaries, we take pride in hiring the best and most committed employees. Our staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They demonstrate our dedication to creating a multifaceted, inclusive environment that fuels innovation and supports the gold standard of patient care we strive for.

What Will You Be Doing in This Role:

The Senior Windows Platform Engineer role works to ensure that technology services and infrastructure throughout the company operate at peak performance. The role provides technical mentorship and performs the engineering activities required to build, support, automate, and continuously improve a large, sophisticated on-premises and cloud-based computing environment. The Senior Engineer applies standard methodologies for enterprise management, architecture, configuration, disaster recovery, administration, automation, incident management, and operational support.

  • Investigate complex system-level early-design engineering proofs of concept and prototypes.
  • Provision, configure, and maintain cloud resources, including service instances, load balancers, security groups, DNS, certificates, and related services.
  • Perform cloud computing environment buildouts, site setup, user training, hardware and software installation, maintenance, support, and documentation of operating procedures and processes.
  • Design, configure, implement, and support automated workflows for Windows Server provisioning and post-build configuration, including PowerShell and Desired State Configuration (DSC).
  • Develop, test, document, and maintain automation scripts and processes that improve consistency, security, and operational efficiency across the data center.
  • Develop and design high-availability solutions and standards. Build and design solutions that mitigate risk and increase efficiency within IT.
  • Evaluate and certify hardware platforms for use in a data center environment. Cisco UCS experience is preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Imagine being a pioneer, venturing through the uncharted territories of the cloud. You're not just navigating; you're shaping the landscape, constructing robust architectures that withstand the tests of time and scale. At Mercury, your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to help steer our cloud infrastructure into the future. We are building ephemeral environments in Kubernetes, building the foundations for non-technical folks to ship changes via an agent coding platform and building safe and secure networks for other platform teams to build inside.

As a senior member of our infrastructure team, you will be equipped with essential tools and technologies designed for scaling and enhancing Mercury's infrastructure:

  • AWS Services: Proficiently utilize EC2, RDS, IAM, Networking, ECS and EKS to build and manage robust cloud environments.
  • Terraform: Leverage Terraform for infrastructure as code to efficiently manage and provision our cloud resources.
  • Agentic Infrastructure: Build the frameworks around using AI safely in our infrastructure, both for the agents and the users that kick off those agents.
  • Monitoring and Observability Tools: Employ Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry to maintain high availability and monitor system health.
  • Version Control and CI/CD: Manage code and automate deployments using GitHub & GitHub Actions.

As we gear up for the next stages of Mercury's growth, you will:

  • Build our “Infrastructure Platform” to support the growing needs of the Engineering Organization.
  • Focus on building a platform that is AI friendly while still usable for engineers. We want our users to be humans and Agents.
  • Lead key infrastructure projects, break-down complex initiatives, and define our infrastructure strategy through detailed RFCs and technical specifications.

Must haves:

  • You have 5+ years of experience with AWS.
  • You have extensive experience, ideally 3 years or more, with observability and monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, optimizing system performance and reliability.
  • You are interested in scaling and building a fledgling EKS infrastructure platform from the ground up.
  • You have demonstrated ability in technical writing, with at least 3 years of experience creating detailed technical documentation, RFCs, and tech specs that clearly communicate complex ideas.

The ideal candidate should:

  • You bring at least 2 years of experience leading infrastructure projects in regulated environments such as HITRUST or SOC2, ensuring compliance and security.
  • You have 3+ years of experience managing large-scale Terraform implementations, including the setup and maintenance of Terraform CI/CD pipelines.
  • You have 2+ years of experience writing code. We are building an Infrastructure Platform from scratch and there is plenty of code to write to support that.
  • Experience mentoring and elevating those around you, we are force multipliers for the engineering org.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

  • Hands-on experience with automated configuration management or system hardening
  • Proven track record of planning, coordinating and executing IT initiatives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, conflict resolution, and customer service skills

  • Family coverage available with Liberty contributing 50% of the premium
  • Fully vested 401(k) with employer match

  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Adoption expense reimbursement
  • Confidential counseling resources for mental health, financial planning, and more, via Optum EAP
  • Fully stocked breakroom

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to take ownership of the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of our Windows, Microsoft 365, and enterprise network environments.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with:

    • Group Policy
    • DNS and DHCP
    • Hybrid identity environments
  • Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience, including:
    • Exchange Online

  • Deep understanding of enterprise networking concepts and technologies, including:

    • VPNs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise technologies such as Cisco Meraki, CrowdStrike, Mimecast, or similar networking and cybersecurity platforms.

    • Microsoft Certifications
    • Cisco Certifications
    • CompTIA Security+
    • CISSP
    • Azure Certifications

  • A self-motivated infrastructure professional who can work independently and make sound technical decisions.

  • Someone who is comfortable balancing strategic infrastructure initiatives with hands-on operational support.

Role Summary

We’re seeking a Senior Network / Infrastructure Engineer with strong experience designing,

deploying, and supporting enterprise networks and modern infrastructure platforms. This hands-on

role focuses on secure data transfer, infrastructure optimization, and day-to-day management of

networking hardware, virtualization, and cloud workloads, with a strong bias toward automation

and operational rigor.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Management

 Own day-to-day operations of the VMware environment (vSphere/ESX/ESXi): lifecycle

management, capacity, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, backup/DR coordination,

and incident response.

 Partner on the virtualization roadmap, including planning and execution for migration from

VMware to Nutanix (or Nutanix-based platforms), minimizing downtime and risk.

 Operate and optimize storage and compute platforms (e.g., Cisco UCS, SAN/NAS such as

NetApp FAS/AFF, FlexPod), including performance troubleshooting and resilience planning.

Cloud & Platform Operations

 Manage and optimize Microsoft Azure workloads: networking, compute, storage, security

controls, cost optimization, and operational monitoring.

 Operate Kubernetes environments (cluster upgrades, reliability, networking, ingress,

policy, and workload troubleshooting).

 Build, deploy, and support Docker containerized applications and supporting infrastructure

(registries, image hygiene, runtime security, scaling).

 Implement and maintain load balancing solutions (L4/L7), including TLS configuration and

operational monitoring.

Network Engineering & Communications

 Design, implement, and support enterprise data/voice/video networks across

LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi.

 Configure and support routing/switching and core network services (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF,

VLANs, QoS, DHCP/DNS).

 Administer and harden firewalls/VPNs (SonicWall, Cisco ASA, Palo Alto) and support

secure remote access patterns.

Security, Secure Transfers, and Compliance Support

 Maintain secure internal and external data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP/managed file

transfer), including certificate/keys, access controls, and auditing.

 Support vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and practical control

implementation aligned to customer/security expectations (e.g., PCI/SOC-related controls

where applicable).

 Own SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management across infrastructure components.

Operational Excellence & Automation

 Build repeatable, automated operations (Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration

management preferred), reducing manual work and increasing reliability.

 Improve observability and troubleshooting practices (monitoring, alerting, packet capture,

traffic analysis) and drive root-cause prevention.

 Participate in on-call/after-hours support rotations as needed for high-priority incidents

and maintenance windows.

Collaboration

 Collaborate across internal teams and external vendors/clients to plan changes, execute

upgrades, resolve incidents, and document outcomes.

 Create and maintain clear technical documentation (runbooks, diagrams, standards) to

improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

Required Qualifications

 5+ years in a senior network/infrastructure engineering role supporting enterprise

environments (hybrid datacenter + cloud).

 Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes, VMware (vSphere/ESX/ESXi), and Microsoft

Azure (these are must-haves).

 Proven experience designing/supporting enterprise networks: LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi,

routing/switching, VPNs, QoS, and troubleshooting (packet capture/traffic analysis).

 Firewall administration experience with one or more of SonicWall, Cisco ASA, and Palo Alto

(policy, VPN, logging/triage).

 Experience with virtualization operations and performance tuning (compute, storage,

networking).

 Windows Server administration experience (including legacy environments as needed),

Active Directory, Group Policy, and Exchange in enterprise contexts.

 Working knowledge supporting SQL Server environments (AlwaysOn preferred).

 Strong operational habits: change management discipline, incident response,

documentation, and clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in a related field and significant datacenter operations experience.

 Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, VCP, Nutanix (NCP), Azure (AZ-104/AZ-305), Security+,

or equivalent experience.

 Experience with Cisco UCS, NetApp FAS/AFF, and FlexPod architectures in production

environments.

 Familiarity with IIS/Tomcat administration and email security tooling (e.g., SpamTitan).

 Experience with tools such as Jira, Kace, SolarWinds, PRTG, Cerberus SFTP, Zerto, Trend

Micro, WSUS, and related monitoring/endpoint/security platforms.

Compensation & Benefits

 Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

 Paid time off and holidays.

 Retirement savings plan options.

 Opportunities for career advancement and professional growth

Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer

Job Number: 26-01607

Use your skills where innovative technology solutions begin. ECLARO is looking for a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer for our client in Costa Mesa, CA.

ECLARO’s client is a leading technology solutions provider, collaborating with customers to manage their needs and achieve success in their business goals. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Position Overview:

  • A Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer to lead the vision, execution, and long-term stability of how Company trains with GPUs at scale.
  • In this role, you will take absolute ownership of cluster robustness, ensuring our high-performance GPU systems are highly available, fault-tolerant, and resilient for ML platform and research teams company-wide.
  • This is a highly hands-on role where your primary focus is logical stability and automated resilience-building self-healing mechanisms to proactively detect and isolate hardware faults, tuning NCCL and high-speed networking, and optimizing Kubernetes, Run:AI, and Ray scheduling.
  • By replacing manual triage with automated deployment tooling and deep observability, you will ensure our massive-scale training infrastructure runs seamlessly and scales without linear headcount growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Rack, stack, cable, and bring up GPU compute (H200/B200/B300, NVL72) including physical topology, power, cooling, firmware/BIOS, and burn in validation.
  • Build and tune the interconnect fabric (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE, Spectrum-X) connecting hundreds of GPUs into low latency training and inference clusters.
  • Integrate high performance parallel storage (VAST, DDN, Weka) to sustain the throughput demanded by distributed training and terabyte scale multi modal datasets across Company's programs.
  • Automate cluster deployment and configuration end to end, including infrastructure as code for bring up, firmware/driver management, and fabric config, so new capacity comes online with minimal manual work.
  • Operate and extend our Kubernetes/Run:AI environment for GPU scheduling, quota management, and multi tenant workload isolation across research and engineering teams company wide.
  • Own fleet health: monitoring, alerting, and rapid triage of hardware and network faults (bad transceivers, GPU Xid errors, NCCL/collective failures, RoCE congestion).
  • Onboard engineers and researchers onto the platform and act as their escalation point, working directly alongside them to debug, train, and optimize their workloads whenever infrastructure, not the model, is the bottleneck.
  • Partner with product facing teams across Company to understand emerging compute needs and translate them into platform capability.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in a hands on infrastructure, HPC, or datacenter engineering role supporting GPU compute at scale.
  • Hands on experience with H200/B200/B300 (or comparable) GPU systems: bring up, cabling, firmware/driver management.
  • Experience with high performance interconnects (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE, Spectrum-X) in clusters of hundreds of GPUs.
  • Experience with high performance parallel storage (VAST, DDN, Weka, Lustre, or similar).
  • Kubernetes required; Run:AI or similar GPU scheduling/orchestration experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong automation background. You build repeatable, automated deployment pipelines rather than manual processes.
  • Able to lift/move 50+ lbs. and perform physical datacenter work (rack/stack/cable/troubleshoot).
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NVIDIA NVL72 rack scale systems.
  • Experience supporting LLM token serving/inference infrastructure alongside training clusters.
  • Network fabric tuning experience (congestion control, adaptive routing, QoS) for RoCE/InfiniBand at scale.
  • Familiarity with GPU/network observability tooling (DCGM, fabric telemetry) and automated fault detection.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure as a shared platform serving multiple internal customer teams with differing requirements.

Salary: $166000.00-$220000.00/Year.

Location: Denver, CO (Hybrid: in office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm MT, plus on-call rotation

Compensation: $110,000–$125,000 base + annual performance bonus

Type: Direct Hire

About The Opportunity

AimHire is partnering with a growing B2B software company to hire an Infrastructure & Operations Engineer for its Denver office. The company’s platform serves large enterprise customers and runs on a mix of production infrastructure the team manages directly.

This is a hands-on, wide-ranging role. Most of your time will go to keeping production infrastructure reliable: systems, networking, virtualization, and storage. You’ll also be the go-to person for IT in the Denver office. You’ll work closely with the engineering, support, and services teams, and you’ll have plenty of room to automate and improve how things run. It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys owning infrastructure from top to bottom and likes variety in their work.

What You’ll Do

Production infrastructure

  • Keep Linux and Windows production systems healthy, patched, and performing well.
  • Run and troubleshoot virtualization environments (VMware or similar), plus the containerized workloads and the infrastructure underneath them.
  • Manage network infrastructure, including switches, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and DNS.
  • Support production storage, and resolve capacity, performance, and availability issues.
  • Take part in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and trace problems to their root cause across multiple layers of infrastructure.
  • Plan and carry out upgrades and maintenance with as little disruption as possible.
  • Build automation using scripting, APIs, configuration management, and AI-assisted tools to reduce manual work.
  • Improve monitoring and logging so problems are caught early and recurring issues go away.

Corporate IT and compliance

  • Own office IT: laptops, office networking, conference room technology, and software.
  • Handle employee onboarding and offboarding, access management, and device setup.
  • Administer identity and device management, productivity suite, and HR systems.
  • Carry out SOC 2 and internal security controls, including access reviews, endpoint compliance, asset tracking, and audit evidence.

What You’ll Bring

  • Solid hands-on experience administering production infrastructure, including Linux, Windows, containers, and scripting.
  • Strong networking and network security skills, including routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and DNS.
  • Experience supporting production storage systems.
  • Strong experience with VMware or a comparable virtualization platform.
  • A proven ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues.
  • Comfort handling corporate IT and end-user support as a secondary responsibility.
  • Willingness to take part in on-call and occasional after-hours work.

Nice to Have

  • Data center or colocation experience.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace and cloud-based identity or device management platforms.
  • SOC 2 or similar compliance experience.
  • AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Experience using AI tools for troubleshooting, scripting, and automation.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Generous paid time off and holidays
  • Hybrid schedule in a modern downtown Denver office
  • Additional perks and amenities

AimHire is an equal opportunity employer.

Erias Ventures was founded to serve its customers with an entrepreneurial mindset. We value creative problem-solving, open communication, and empowering our employees to make decisions and put forth new ideas.

We are seeking engineers who wish to grow their careers and want to become part of a technically strong and growth-oriented company focused on bringing innovative solutions to the difficult mission problems facing our customers.

Description As an Infrastructure Engineer in this role, you will be responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable, resilient systems that support high-volume data alerting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will leverage your expertise in Kubernetes to orchestrate containerized workloads, ensuring seamless deployment and management of applications. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include optimizing cloud infrastructure on AWS, utilizing services such as EKS, EC2, and S3, and implementing infrastructure as cod with Terraform to automate provisioning and configuration. You will also be tasked with designing robust routing and DNS solutions to guarantee high availability and performance across distributed systems.

Success in this position will be driven by your hands-on experience with messaging platforms like RabbitMQ and Kafka, which are essential for handling large-scale data streams and ensuring reliable communication between services. You will benefit from familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, as well as logging and alerting frameworks that enable proactive incident response. Exposure to DevOps methodologies will be crucial, as you will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and enhance operational efficiency. Your ability to troubleshoot complex issues and implement best practices in cloud security and automation will set you apart in this challenging and rewarding role.

  • EKS

This position is a key functional role within our organization's Project Delivery team. The Systems Engineer provides Tier 3 escalation support and serves as the senior technical resource for server, cloud, and Microsoft 365 environments, while also delivering project work migrations, infrastructure buildouts, backup and security implementations, and automation initiatives from design through completion. The right person will be able to anticipate needs, think critically, balance project deliverables against day-to-day escalations, and support a wide variety of tasks with high levels of professionalism, confidentiality, tact, and precision.

Location and Work Expectations

  • Design, build, and maintain automated processes for various tasks.

  • Perform other tasks and duties as assigned by Management

  • A willingness and commitment to learn new things and grow new skill sets.
  • Critical thinking and creative problem solving.
  • Ability to efficiently multitask and independently complete projects and tasks.
  • Outstanding communication skills - both written and verbal.
  • Must be highly focused on customer service.
  • Extreme attention to detail, a passion for accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.
  • Discretion and confidentiality when required.
  • Self-motivated with a positive attitude.
  • Effectively handle deadline pressures and manage conflicting priorities.
  • Excellent judgment and situational awareness.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and administering Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Experience managing Entra ID and Active Directory synchronization, including identity and access troubleshooting.
  • Strong working knowledge of Exchange Online administration, mail flow, and issue resolution.
  • Experience administering and supporting SharePoint Online and OneDrive environments.
  • Proficiency supporting and administering Microsoft Teams, including configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune for device, application, and policy management.
  • Knowledge of Windows Autopilot deployment, provisioning, and troubleshooting.
  • PowerShell scripting experience and an automation-focused mindset; broader automation experience is preferred.


Bonus points for

  • Experience deploying, configuring, and managing Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to strengthen endpoint security and threat response.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Defender for Office 365, including email protection, anti-phishing, and threat investigation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, including data loss prevention, retention policies, and sensitivity labels.
  • Experience designing and implementing Conditional Access policies that balance security requirements with user access needs.
  • Hands-on experience supporting and administering Microsoft Azure cloud environments.


Benefits And Perks

  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employee and family
  • 401k + company-matched contributions 4% match on 5% contribution - no vesting period! (Employee and Company contribute after 90 days)
  • Group Term Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment coverage (company provided)
  • Short-Term (voluntary enrollment) and Long-Term Disability coverage (company provided)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) Options / PPO Options
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) + Volunteer Time Off (VTO) + 8 Paid Holidays + 3 Floating Holidays
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Generous Employee Referral Program - cash bonus for successful referrals!
  • Dynamic Recognition and Rewards
  • Clear Promotion and Advancement Tracks
  • Work with Industry-Leading Talent

How You’ll Make An Impact

This position is a key functional role within our organization's Project Delivery team. Location and Work Expectations



- This position is 100% onsite in our Tampa, FL office.
- Monday – Friday, approximately 8am – 5pm EST
- This position may have on call needs to cover evening and weekend hours for special projects


What You Will Be Doing



- Install, Configure, Manage, and Troubleshoot Physical, Virtual, and Cloud Servers Per Ntiva and Industry Best practices. 
- Respond to Day-to-Day Critical Issues or Requests where Advanced Expertise or Experience is needed. 
- Microsoft 365 Migration, Configuration, Troubleshooting, and High-Level Administration for new and existing clients. 
- Understand and Manage our RMM solution used to remotely support the client and internal servers and workstations. 
- Provide Tier 3 support for escalations and outages, in some cases requiring communications with customers and end users. 
- Maintain Client Backup Solutions for Cloud and On-Prem Infrastructures. 
- Monitoring of Alerting and Identifying Trends - Perform root cause analysis to resolve the problem. 
- Participate in the development and design of Client Support efforts and systems. 
- Design, build, and maintain automated processes for various tasks. 
- Employ good communication and documentation habits. 
- Perform other tasks and duties as assigned by Management 


You’ll be successful in this role if you bring 



- At least 5+ years of Hands-On IT MSP or Other Relevant experience. 
- Keen ability to troubleshoot IT issues and dedication to follow an issue to resolution. 
- A willingness and commitment to learn new things and grow new skill sets. 
- Critical thinking and creative problem solving. 
- Ability to efficiently multitask and independently complete projects and tasks. 
- Outstanding communication skills - both written and verbal. 
- Must be highly focused on customer service. 
- Extreme attention to detail, a passion for accuracy, and excellent organizational skills. 
- Discretion and confidentiality when required. 
- Self-motivated with a positive attitude. 
- Effectively handle deadline pressures and manage conflicting priorities. 
- Excellent judgment and situational awareness. 
- Hands-on experience configuring and administering Microsoft 365 environments. 
- Experience managing Entra ID and Active Directory synchronization, including identity and access troubleshooting. 
- Strong working knowledge of Exchange Online administration, mail flow, and issue resolution. 
- Experience administering and supporting SharePoint Online and OneDrive environments. 
- Proficiency supporting and administering Microsoft Teams, including configuration and troubleshooting. 
- Experience with Microsoft Intune for device, application, and policy management. 
- Knowledge of Windows Autopilot deployment, provisioning, and troubleshooting. 
- PowerShell scripting experience and an automation-focused mindset; broader automation experience is preferred.

- Experience deploying, configuring, and managing Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to strengthen endpoint security and threat response. 
- Experience administering Microsoft Defender for Office 365, including email protection, anti-phishing, and threat investigation capabilities. 
- Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, including data loss prevention, retention policies, and sensitivity labels.

Summary Statement

The Platform Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of enterprise infrastructure platforms including compute, storage, virtualization, and core networking. This role ensures high availability, performance, and scalability of systems supporting business-critical applications. Responsible for translating business and technical requirements into infrastructure solutions, driving automation and standardization, and maintaining platform health through monitoring, patching, and lifecycle management. Collaborates across teams to support deployments, migrations, and continuous improvement of infrastructure services.

Primary Job Duties: Includes but is not limited to:

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure platforms including compute, virtualization, storage, and core networking.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, highly available infrastructure solutions.
  • Deploy and support platforms such as VMware, Nutanix, Cisco UCS, and enterprise storage systems.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability; provide recommendations for optimization, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  • Perform system patching, firmware upgrades, and hardware/software maintenance to ensure platform stability and security compliance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across compute, storage, networking, and operating systems.
  • Support disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience of critical systems.
  • Collaborate with application, database, security, and network teams to support deployments, migrations, and operational needs.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
  • Communicate regularly with management and stakeholders on project status, risks, and operational updates.
  • Obtain and maintain position-specific licensing as required by regulatory or gaming authorities.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications: Includes but is not limited to:

  • Strong proficiency in enterprise infrastructure platforms and enterprise storage solutions (e.g., SAN/NAS)
  • Experience in design, deployment, and support of compute, virtualization, storage, and core networking infrastructure.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, and data center fabrics.
  • Strong experience with Linux operating systems (e.g., Red Hat, Oracle Linux, Rocky Linux), including system administration, patching, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with automation and scripting tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Ansible) to improve operational efficiency.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex, multi-tier infrastructure issues across compute, storage, and networking.
  • Proficiency in identifying and resolving database performance issues.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work varied shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred

  • Experience with data center technologies including Cisco UCS, Cisco ACI, and enterprise networking environments.
  • Experience with enterprise virtualization platforms
  • Familiarity with Linux system hardening, security best practices, and audit compliance.
  • Experience with enterprise storage solutions (e.g., Pure Storage, NetApp) and backup platforms such as Veeam.
  • Experience in hospitality systems and business intelligence systems.
  • Previous experience working in a large, luxury resort setting.

Minimum Education And Experience

  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related role supporting enterprise environments.
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator) or equivalent.

Certificates, Licenses, Regulations

  • Proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
  • Ability to obtain the following:
    • Gaming Registration
Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Work is typically performed in an office
  • Must be tolerant of varying conditions of noise level, temperature, illumination, and air quality.
  • Prolonged sitting/standing.
  • Bending and reaching.
  • Transporting, pushing, pulling, lifting, and maneuvering items weighing up to 25lbs.
  • Eye/hand coordination.
  • Ability to comply with Policies and Procedures, Job Description, daily memorandums, chemical labels (SDS) and other instructions.

At Resorts World Las Vegas, we believe that every member of our team is an ambassador and is essential to the success of our company. We expect all Team Members to take personal ownership in ensuring everything they do is in the best interest of the company and that all will adhere to our five core non-negotiable responsibilities.

  • Everyone is an Ambassador–No matter where you work at Resorts World Las Vegas, it is your responsibility to treat this property like you would your own home. No one gets hurt, everyone feels secure, the environment is clean, and every guest gets what they need.
  • Everyone works in Safety–If you have a safety concern, it is your responsibility to address it by correcting it or notifying the appropriate department or individual.
  • Everyone works in Security–If you See Something, it is your responsibility to Say Something. You must notify the appropriate department or individual if you feel there is a security concern.
  • Everyone works in EVS–If there is trash on the floor, it is your responsibility to pick it up. If it is a mess that needs more attention, it is your responsibility to notify the appropriate department or individual.
  • Everyone works in Guest Experience–If a guest needs assistance, it is your responsibility to assist that guest and do so with a smile. If the guest needs more assistance than you can provide, it is your responsibility to notify the appropriate department or individual.

Job Description Summary

‎

The Senior IT Cloud and Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and optimizing complex Azure and hybrid infrastructure solutions. The role provides advanced support, leads medium to large projects, develops technical standards, and serves as an escalation point.

This position requires broad technical expertise, independent decision-making, mature project execution, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence outcomes across teams.

‎

How Will You Make An Impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable Azure infrastructure solutions based on business and technical requirements.
  • Engineer Azure compute, networking, storage, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, identity integration, and governance capabilities.
  • Design Azure storage solutions using Blob Storage, Azure Files, managed disks, private connectivity, encryption, lifecycle management, replication, immutability, and appropriate redundancy models.
  • Lead hybrid integration across Azure, Windows Server, Linux, enterprise storage, backup platforms, VMware, Active Directory, DNS, and network services.
  • Diagnose complex issues involving performance, availability, storage latency, networking, authentication, replication, backup, and application dependencies.
  • Design automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Azure CLI, Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, JSON, YAML, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, deployment patterns, configuration standards, and automated validation controls.
  • Establish technical standards for availability, resiliency, security, monitoring, patching, backup, disaster recovery, capacity, and lifecycle management.
  • Analyze Azure utilization, performance, and cost data and recommend rightsizing, reservations, savings plans, storage tiering, and architecture improvements.
  • Lead medium to large infrastructure projects, including requirements, design, planning, scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, implementation, and operational transition.
  • Create and review architecture diagrams, design documents, implementation plans, support models, risk assessments, test plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Communicate complex concepts, options, risks, and recommendations to engineers, architects, project managers, application owners, vendors, and leadership.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for major incidents and lead root-cause analysis, restoration, corrective action, and preventive improvement.
  • Mentor Level I and II engineers, provide technical reviews, delegate work, and support development of team capabilities.
  • Proactively identify emerging risks, technical debt, process gaps, and modernization opportunities, then develop and lead improvement plans.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required. 4-6 years of systems engineering or enterprise infrastructure experience
  • Advanced expertise in Windows Server and/or Linux environments and enterprise virtualization platforms
  • Experience with storage area networks, backup systems, and high-availability configurations
  • Proficiency with automation tools and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Ansible)
  • Strong knowledge of systems performance tuning, capacity planning, and infrastructure security
  • Microsoft MCSA/MCSE, VMware VCP, or equivalent certification required.

‎

Compensation Range

$93,675.00

to

$140,513.00

The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.

Responsibilities

Kforce has a client that is seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer in Memphis, TN. Summary: We are seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer to design, implement, optimize, and support enterprise cloud infrastructure within Microsoft Azure. This individual will play a key role in building secure, scalable, resilient cloud environments and partnering across infrastructure, security, application development, and technology teams. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on Azure engineering experience with the ability to operate at a senior level, troubleshoot complex cloud environments, automate infrastructure, and contribute to cloud architecture and technical direction. What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Build secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient Azure environments
  • Deploy and manage Azure resources including virtual machines, storage, networking, databases, identity, and related infrastructure services
  • Design and support Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, subnets, routing, load balancing, private connectivity, and network security
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, and/or ARM templates
  • Develop automation using tools such as PowerShell, Azure CLI, and Python to improve cloud provisioning and operational efficiency
  • Partner with application development, security, networking, and infrastructure teams to support cloud-based applications and services
  • Monitor and optimize Azure environments for performance, availability, security, scalability, and reliability
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure, connectivity, performance, and deployment issues
  • Support cloud security and identity practices using technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and managed identities
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions, engineering standards, best practices, and technical documentation

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred; Equivalent professional experience will also be considered
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role
  • Significant hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions within Microsoft Azure
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale, production Azure environments
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, Bicep, and/or ARM templates
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or similar technologies
  • Experience designing solutions with scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery in mind
  • Strong understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and cloud architecture
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity, access management, and networking concepts
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex cloud infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Experience operating at a Senior Azure Engineer, Azure Infrastructure Engineer, Cloud Platform Engineer, or Azure Architect level
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Experience supporting cloud migrations or modernization initiatives
  • Experience working within hybrid cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments
  • Familiarity with cloud governance, monitoring, automation, and cost-optimization practices

The pay range is the lowest to highest compensation we reasonably in good faith believe we would pay at posting for this role. We may ultimately pay more or less than this range. Employee pay is based on factors like relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, location, performance, union contract and business needs. This range may be modified in the future.

We offer comprehensive benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k), and life, disability & ADD insurance to eligible employees. Salaried personnel receive paid time off. Hourly employees are not eligible for paid time off unless required by law. Hourly employees on a Service Contract Act project are eligible for paid sick leave.

Note: Pay is not considered compensation until it is earned, vested and determinable. The amount and availability of any compensation remains in Kforce's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified in its discretion consistent with the law.

This job is not eligible for bonuses, incentives or commissions.

For more information about Axiom Space, visit www.axiomspace.com.

Axiom Space fosters a work environment inclusive of all perspectives. We are the pioneers of commercial space, leading the transformation of low-Earth orbit into a global space marketplace. Our mission-driven team is seeking a bold and dynamic Platform Engineer (AWS Cloud) who is fueled by high accountability, execution horsepower, and driven to understand our world, science/technology, and life itself, for the benefit of all on Earth and beyond.

Position Summary

Since Axiom Space is a very complex work environment, we are looking for a resilient, high-energy Platform Engineer (AWS Cloud), who designs, builds, and operates the AWS-first cloud infrastructure that Axiom's engineering and business teams run on. This person drives automation, infrastructure-as-code, and platform reliability practices that let internal teams ship faster and safer, while maintaining working familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 to support occasional cross-platform workloads. This role serves as an escalation point for platform architecture and technical issues beyond the scope of entry-level engineers, and contributes to the continuous improvement of Axiom's enterprise cyber security program under the direction of senior IT leadership.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Designs, builds, and maintains infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) to provision and manage AWS GovCloud environments — accounts, networking (VPC), and compute — in a repeatable, version-controlled way via AWS Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA) based architecture
  • Serves as the primary escalation point for AWS platform architecture, systems design, and technical issues beyond the scope of entry-level engineers
  • Builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines (AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) that automate build, test, and deployment workflows for internal engineering teams
  • Administers and evolves Axiom's AWS environment as the primary cloud platform — accounts, networking, compute, and core services (EC2, S3, and related)
  • Builds and maintains container and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) to support internal application workloads
  • Manages identity and access management (IAM) within AWS IAM and supports SSO/SAML/SCIM integrations, ensuring least-privilege access across the platform
  • Implements monitoring, logging, and observability (e.g., CloudWatch) to track platform health, and reviews incidents and performance data to determine root cause and drive remediation
  • Preserves platform assets by implementing disaster recovery and backup automation, and develops, maintains, and tests business continuity plans for cloud environments
  • Develops and maintains internal tooling and self-service capabilities that give engineering teams safe, automated access to the AWS platform
  • Recommends cloud platform engineering strategies, tooling, and standards by evaluating organizational outcomes, identifying problems, and anticipating requirements
  • May provide technical guidance to entry-level platform and IT engineers and review their AWS-related work as needed
  • Maintains basic working familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 administration to support occasional cross-platform workloads
  • Communicating project progress, status, and potential issues to stakeholders and leadership
  • Implementing and maintaining agile project management methodologies throughout the project lifecycle
  • Perform additional job duties as assigned

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education & Experience

  • The majority of that experience should be spent building and operating production workloads on AWS
  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Engineering Science, or Engineering Management, 4+ years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Track record of making things happen in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Uses good judgement to problem-solve proactively, positively impacting hard challenges
  • Demonstrated organization skills to meet tight deadlines with high quality results

Core Skills

  • Passion for space and the mission
  • Entrepreneurial, growth mindset
  • High EQ and ability to collaborate within teams and cross-functionally
  • Tech-solutioning in using systems and tools to move smarter and faster

Computer Skills

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of:

  • Strong AWS administration (IAM, VPC networking, EC2/compute, S3, and core services) as the primary cloud platform — deep, hands-on expertise expected
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible or equivalent)
  • CI/CD pipeline experience (AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) and scripting proficiency in Python or Bash
  • Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, or equivalent)
  • Identity and access management (IAM): users, groups, roles, and least-privilege policy design within AWS
  • Working knowledge of Azure Cloud administration (compute, networking, storage, governance) and Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint and OneDrive administration) sufficient to support occasional Azure-hosted workloads
  • General server hardware familiarity (Windows and Linux), general IT security and firewall management, and backup administration experience
  • Wired and wireless networking, DHCP, and DNS; virtualization via VMware or equivalent; patch management via Windows Update or third-party
  • Storage administration (users, access controls, and content governance across cloud storage)

Preferred Certifications

Candidates holding one or more of the following are strongly preferred:

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate

Core Competencies

Embody our core values of leadership, innovation, and teamwork. In addition, to perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Accountability
  • Technical Rigor
  • Execution Discipline
  • Pride of Delivery

Work Environment

Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on the task

Requirements

  • This position may require access to export controlled technical data or technology subject to NASA regulations, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). In accordance with U.S. export control laws, final candidates may be required to undergo additional export control screening to determine eligibility for access. Meeting these requirements is a condition of employment
  • Management has the prerogative to select at any level for which the position is advertised
  • Must be willing to work evenings and weekends as needed to meet critical project milestones

Physical Requirements

  • Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods (90% of the time)
  • May require lifting and carrying up to 25 lbs. (5% of the time)
  • Equipment and Machines
  • Standard office equipment (PC, phone, printer, etc.)

Axiom Space does not discriminate on the basis of race, regional color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

descriptionHtml:
Description

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

Position Summary

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on the Network and Data Center team, you'll design, build, and support the physical and virtual infrastructure that powers the SPS Commerce SaaS platform. This is a hands-on role focused on VMware Cloud Foundation, enterprise storage, backup and recovery, and data center operations. You'll provide the infrastructure building blocks for development and help ensure our operational systems meet their service level goals.

This role reports to the Manager II, Network and Data Center. You'll be the on-site infrastructure engineer for our centralized Minneapolis data center, working alongside teammates in New Jersey and Canada, with hands-on exposure to the new technologies we're adopting, including on-premises AI infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the deployment, configuration, and ongoing operations of server hardware, VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments, storage, and backup systems across SPS Commerce production environments
  • Manage Pure Storage arrays, including provisioning, capacity and performance monitoring, snapshots, and upgrades
  • Administer Rubrik backup and recovery, including SLA policies, backup monitoring, restore testing, and RPO/RTO reporting
  • Rack, stack, and decommission servers, storage, and network equipment; perform and oversee structured copper and fiber cabling, patching, and labeling; and maintain accurate asset and rack records
  • Manage rack power, including PDU monitoring, A/B power balancing, and power capacity planning for new deployments
  • Develop automation and infrastructure as code to provision, configure, patch, and report on infrastructure
  • Partner with Development and Product Management to scale and improve production systems and services
  • Monitor and administer assigned systems, providing documentation, cross-training, capacity management, and recommendations for future state
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation
  • Stay current on developments in the field to evaluate, propose, and implement enhancements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience working in an enterprise infrastructure environment
  • Experience administering VMware vSphere and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), including vSAN, NSX, and SDDC Manager
  • Experience administering Windows Server and Linux (Red Hat, Oracle Enterprise Linux, or similar) as VM guests and physical hosts
  • Working knowledge of data center networking at an associate network engineer level, including VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, routing and switching basics, and TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP troubleshooting
  • Experience administering enterprise storage, specifically Pure Storage
  • Experience administering enterprise backup and recovery, specifically Rubrik
  • Experience with data center rack power management, including PDUs and capacity planning
  • Experience with physical copper and fiber cabling in a data center environment
  • Experience with scripting and infrastructure as code, such as PowerShell/PowerCLI, Python, Ansible, or Terraform, plus Git-based workflows
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with VMware Live Recovery (formerly VMware Cloud Disaster Recovery, VCDR), including DR plans, failover testing, and cyber recovery
  • Associate-level networking certification or equivalent experience, with hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco or similar switches, including VLANs, LACP, spanning tree, and IP subnetting
  • VMware certification such as VCP-DCV or VCP-VCF, and Pure Storage or Rubrik certifications
  • Demonstrated knowledge of storage networking, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, and NFS

Location:

  • Hybrid – Minneapolis, MN, with on-site work at our Minneapolis office and data center as needed
  • The selected candidate is expected to start in January 2027.

What We Offer

At SPS Commerce, we are committed to ensuring that each employee's compensation reflects their unique experiences, performance, and skills in their role. The salary range for this role considers several factors, including education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, location, and more.

The annual salary range for this role is $108,200 – $115,700 USD + Bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on the factors outlined above and may fall anywhere within the applicable range.

SPS Commerce offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits are country-specific and aligned with local laws and market practices.

Commitment To Our Employees

At SPS we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward, and our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering unparalleled customer solutions, and driving outstanding business performance. We achieve this by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring everyone feels accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Description

Leidos is looking for our next TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Platform Engineer/Linux Systems Administrator to join a high-energy team deploying and maintaining common application-runtime capabilities in support of the DIA-NDOC (National Digital Exploitation OSINT Center) DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP). This role is part of a 10-year program supporting the DOMEX Data Discovery Platform (D3P) Modernization effort, where you’ll contribute to mission-critical capabilities alongside a collaborative, innovative, and growth-oriented team.

While the majority of work is performed on-site at our customer location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and occasional opportunities for remote work.

As a Platform Engineer, you’ll operate and maintain the organization’s Kubernetes-based application platform and shared runtime services, including Elastic and Redis by performing platform configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, security hardening, capacity management, version upgrades, and automation to provide reliable, secure, and scalable platform services. You’ll also support the implementation of automation, continuous integration and delivery, and DevOps best practices across cross-functional engineer teams. In this fast-paced environment, you’ll collaborate closely with systems engineering, architecture, development, security, operations, and integration teams.

You will work with a multidisciplinary group of developers, integrators, and system administrators to:

  • Deploy, troubleshoot, monitor, and maintain the platform for a production big-data pipeline built on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, and Kafka.
  • Administer and maintain Linux-based applications, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and system hardening.
  • Integrate with the underlying physical and virtual infrastructure, ensuring system availability, reliability, security, and performance.
  • Design and support scalable, redundant application infrastructure across physical and virtual environments.
  • Contribute technical input to engineering documentation, diagrams, and models.
  • Participate in Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, bug triage, and related team activities.

To be successful in this role you need the following (required qualifications):

Qualifications

You’re enthusiastic, collaborative, and comfortable working with teammates across a range of technical backgrounds. You also meet the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Sciences, Systems Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) with 4+ years of relevant experience; 2+ years with a Master’s
  • Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to obtain/maintain a TS/SCI with CI Polygraph
  • Possess at least one DoD 8140.03-M IAT Level II or higher certification, e.g., CySA+, Security+CE, etc.
  • Ability to obtain Privileged User Account (PUA) certification per DoD 8140 policy
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and operations
  • Helm or comparable Kubernetes package/configuration-management tools
  • Troubleshooting pod failures, networking issues, image pulls, scheduling constraints, and application connectivity
  • Experience with Linux command-line administration and troubleshooting, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, logs, certificates, and system resource analysis
  • Experience supporting or administering at least one shared data or application platform service, such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, API gateways, or similar distributed services
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and platform automation tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Bash, Python, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of platform security practices
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools and practices
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills

You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:

  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies
  • Development experience (Bash, PowerShell, SALT, Python, Groovy, Java, etc.)
  • Familiarity with:
    • Kafka or other messaging systems
    • GPU-based Kubernetes
    • SALT for deployment automation
    • Helm/Helmfile
    • CI/CD tools such as Gitlab, Nexus, ArgoCD
