descriptionHtml:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer


This is an on-site role in Charlotte, NC, in the office Monday – Thursday and remote on Fridays.

About Us

Millennium Advisors is a global leading technology-driven broker-dealer specializing in providing liquidity in fixed income securities, including corporate and municipal bonds, treasuries, fixed income ETFs, and MBS. Millennium Advisors is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, with offices in London and Singapore.


Founded in 2009, Millennium has consistently ranked among the top 10 trading firms by par amount and trade volume for both high-yield and investment-grade bonds. We have leveraged our superior trading technology and data modeling to create a high-margin, high-productivity business model. Our trading counterparties include institutional investors, asset managers, banks, registered investment advisors, wealth managers, insurance companies and other broker-dealers.


Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Infrastructure Engineer to manage our data centers and our information security needs.


In this role, you will be a key member of the firm, responsible for managing our data centers (hardware & software), cloud infrastructure, and trader desktops, with a strong emphasis on information security.


Our overall infrastructure philosophy centers around Infrastructure as Code (IaC). As such, the ideal candidate will be comfortable managing modern IaC environments, customizing open-source software (OSS) tools, and leveraging modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Center Management: Manage Servers, Switches, Firewalls, Storage and Connectivity to our trading counterparts.
  • Systems Hardening: Manage phishing-resistant Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) system through configuration and scripting, port and configuration scanning activities.
  • Network Security: Strengthen network egress and DNS security.
  • Customizing OSS tools: Extend OSS tools, typically written in Python or Go, to meet the firm’s security and deployment requirements.
  • Vulnerability Management: Evaluate and implement resources and technology to implement a penetration testing program.
  • Data Governance: Enforce data security at rest and in transit through (but not limited to) encryption, database protection and the establishment of a formal data classification program.
  • Disaster Recovery: Maintain and enhance our Disaster Recovery (DR) playbook and participate in tabletop exercises (TTXs).
  • Backup and Archival: Design and maintain a robust backup and archival solution using both on-premises and cloud-based resources.
  • Configuration Management: Implement and maintain an enterprise asset management solution.


Typical week:

  • Participate in the daily Dev/SecOps scrum.
  • Redesign network topology to improve segmentation, resilience, and routing efficiency.
  • Spend a couple of hours architecting enhanced storage solutions with various Technology & Quantitative leaders.
  • Modify Terraform scripts to rebuild portions of the non-PROD environment.
  • Write a Go module to implement an authentication plugin.
  • Evaluate a new secure Database Authentication mechanism.


Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or similar discipline
  • 8+ years’ experience with Infrastructure/DevOps/SecOps
  • Demonstrated knowledge of managing Firewalls, Routers, and other critical network components
  • Demonstrated knowledge of at least one Intrusion Detection product
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins, and Jira
  • Experience with IaC scripting (such as Terraform)
  • Strong proficiency with Linux
  • Deep understanding of File Systems
  • Experience with observability frameworks such as ELK (Elastic, Logstash and Kibana)
  • Mastery of at least one scripting language such as Bash, Python, etc.
  • Working knowledge of SQL/S3


Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of front and middle office trading and risk systems
  • Knowledge of storage systems
  • A technical blog or other relevant publications


Compensation and Benefits

In return for a long-term commitment, Millennium Advisors offers a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary commensurate with experience, and incentive compensation, which could include equity in the firm. We have a comprehensive benefits package that includes:


  • Daily breakfast (Charlotte) and lunch provided
  • Paid time off and various leave options
  • Company-sponsored medical and dental plans
  • 401(k) (US) / Pension plan (UK) with company matching contributions


Culture

At Millennium, you will join a team of intelligent, ambitious, and positive professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration and innovation. Our Charlotte office features amenities such as pool and ping pong tables, music, and comfortable spaces for meetings and team activities. We maintain a casual dress code and a strong focus on building meaningful relationships among team members.


We are committed to building an outstanding small company culture, where people like to work and like each other, where engineers can be challenged intellectually, exercise their creative and entrepreneurial interests, and still have a life outside of work.


If you’re seeking to join a company focused on global expansion and are a forward-thinking individual with a passion for driving impactful innovation, we invite you to join us and shape the future of Millennium Advisors.


How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter via this link: https://millenniumadvisors.recruitee.com/o/senior-infrastructure-engineer

In this role, you will be a key member of the firm, responsible for managing our data centers (hardware & software), cloud infrastructure, and trader desktops, with a strong emphasis on information security.


Our overall infrastructure philosophy centers around Infrastructure as Code (IaC). As such, the ideal candidate will be comfortable managing modern IaC environments, customizing open-source software (OSS) tools, and leveraging modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.


Key Responsibilities

- Data Center Management: Manage Servers, Switches, Firewalls, Storage and Connectivity to our trading counterparts.
- Systems Hardening: Manage phishing-resistant Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) system through configuration and scripting, port and configuration scanning activities.
- Network Security: Strengthen network egress and DNS security.
- Customizing OSS tools: Extend OSS tools, typically written in Python or Go, to meet the firm’s security and deployment requirements. 
- Vulnerability Management: Evaluate and implement resources and technology to implement a penetration testing program.
- Data Governance: Enforce data security at rest and in transit through (but not limited to) encryption, database protection and the establishment of a formal data classification program.
- Disaster Recovery: Maintain and enhance our Disaster Recovery (DR) playbook and participate in tabletop exercises (TTXs).
- Backup and Archival: Design and maintain a robust backup and archival solution using both on-premises and cloud-based resources.
- Configuration Management: Implement and maintain an enterprise asset management solution.


Typical week: 

- Participate in the daily Dev/SecOps scrum.
- Redesign network topology to improve segmentation, resilience, and routing efficiency.
- Spend a couple of hours architecting enhanced storage solutions with various Technology & Quantitative leaders.
- Modify Terraform scripts to rebuild portions of the non-PROD environment.
- Write a Go module to implement an authentication plugin.
- Evaluate a new secure Database Authentication mechanism.


Qualifications

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or similar discipline 
- 8+ years’ experience with Infrastructure/DevOps/SecOps
- Demonstrated knowledge of managing Firewalls, Routers, and other critical network components
- Demonstrated knowledge of at least one Intrusion Detection product
- Experience with CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins, and Jira
- Experience with IaC scripting (such as Terraform)
- Strong proficiency with Linux
- Deep understanding of File Systems
- Experience with observability frameworks such as ELK (Elastic, Logstash and Kibana)
- Mastery of at least one scripting language such as Bash, Python, etc.
- Working knowledge of SQL/S3


Preferred Skills 

- Knowledge of front and middle office trading and risk systems
- Knowledge of storage systems
- A technical blog or other relevant publications


Compensation and Benefits
In return for a long-term commitment, Millennium Advisors offers a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary commensurate with experience, and incentive compensation, which could include equity in the firm. We have a comprehensive benefits package that includes:



- Daily breakfast (Charlotte) and lunch provided
- Paid time off and various leave options 
- Company-sponsored medical and dental plans 
- 401(k) (US) / Pension plan (UK) with company matching contributions


Culture
At Millennium, you will join a team of intelligent, ambitious, and positive professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration and innovation. Our Charlotte office features amenities such as pool and ping pong tables, music, and comfortable spaces for meetings and team activities. We maintain a casual dress code and a strong focus on building meaningful relationships among team members. 


We are committed to building an outstanding small company culture, where people like to work and like each other, where engineers can be challenged intellectually, exercise their creative and entrepreneurial interests, and still have a life outside of work. 


If you’re seeking to join a company focused on global expansion and are a forward-thinking individual with a passion for driving impactful innovation, we invite you to join us and shape the future of Millennium Advisors. 


How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter via this link: https://millenniumadvisors.recruitee.com/o/senior-infrastructure-engineer

descriptionHtml:
About Makai

Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people because technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions.

About The Role

At Makai, we build and run cloud platforms for clients in healthcare and other high-stakes industries. You take a platform from an empty Azure subscription to production, make the architecture calls and live with them, and own the infrastructure as code, the pipelines and the monitoring. Much of this runs inside our clients’ own Azure environments, so you work with their infrastructure teams daily: reviewing their designs, explaining what we need and why, and keeping work moving when it depends on them.

The ideal candidate will be able to

  • Design, build and maintain Azure environments with Terraform across multiple subscriptions, from networking and identity to a running application
  • Build and maintain CI/CD for applications and infrastructure in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and similar platforms: release promotion with approvals, secure deployment identities and repository synchronization
  • Operate the compute and runtime platforms, from virtual machines to containers and PaaS: base images, upgrades, patching, rolling deployments, autoscaling and capacity planning
  • Design and tune monitoring, logging and alerting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights
  • Design and operate the identity and access model: Entra ID, SSO, workload identities, role- and attribute-based access control, privileged and just-in-time access, and secrets in Key Vault
  • Design and maintain secure network architectures: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, private endpoints and DNS, Application Gateway and WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs and isolation between environments
  • Maintain security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, patching, Azure Policy, and audits against client policies and regulatory frameworks
  • Design and run backup, high availability and disaster recovery: recovery objectives, zone and region redundancy, restore testing, DR drills and failover
  • Own production changes and incidents: formal change management with verification and rollback, and troubleshooting through to root cause
  • Act as the technical counterpart to clients’ infrastructure and security teams: design reviews, proposals, change requests and runbooks

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and operating production Azure environments
  • Expert-level Terraform: you have owned large multi-environment, multi-subscription Azure codebases, designed their code and state structure, and carried out major refactors and state migrations on live infrastructure
  • Proven experience designing CI/CD systems for both applications and infrastructure on Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms, across many repositories and environments
  • Strong Linux systems administration background, with a deep understanding of how servers are provisioned, configured and run, and hands-on troubleshooting of services, containers, storage and networking at the OS level
  • Fluency in Bash and PowerShell; Python is a plus
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and of identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, and of Azure’s control-plane and data-plane authorization models
  • Proven experience designing, implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for production systems, with a solid understanding of the SLAs and recovery limits of Azure services
  • Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as Virtual Machines and VM Scale Sets, App Service and Container Apps
  • Experience building observability on Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, and fluency in KQL
  • Solid working knowledge of Azure networking, particularly hub-and-spoke topologies, private connectivity and DNS
  • Experience operating Azure data services such as Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Redis, Cosmos DB and Azure Storage
  • Excellent technical writing and live communication: documentation others can act on without you, and a composed, precise manner on client calls and during incidents
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.

How We Work

Small senior teams, real ownership. We'd rather have one engineer who understands a platform top to bottom than several who each own a slice.

Core values for Makai employees

  • Be a flexible, innovative and creative thinker
  • Be congenial and a team player
  • Be self-sufficient
  • Be self-driven with an ownership mentality
  • Have a strong work ethic

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Systems Engineer at our Dallas, TX, office .

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Sr. Systems Engineer to join our Business Technology team. In this role, you will report to the Sr. Director, Infrastructure & Operations, and will be responsible for building and maintaining application infrastructure environments primarily on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will play a critical role in enabling our development teams to deploy applications efficiently and reliably through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) practices and cloud-native solutions.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented engineer who enjoys working with automation tools, particularly Terraform, and has a solid understanding of cloud services and architectural patterns. You'll collaborate with development teams, infrastructure engineers, and cloud architects to build scalable, reliable infrastructure solutions that support our business objectives.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable application infrastructure across Azure and AWS using Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and reusable provisioning modules and templates.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage cloud services including compute, storage, databases, networking, load balancing, auto-scaling, content delivery, and container platforms such as Kubernetes and AWS ECS.
  • Design and maintain cloud networking and security configurations, including VNets/VPCs, subnets, routing, network security groups, and supporting infrastructure controls.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and application deployment processes.
  • Apply Azure and AWS Well-Architected and cloud adoption principles to infrastructure design, cloud migrations, application modernization, and ongoing architectural improvements.
  • Implement and manage monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity management, and performance optimization to maintain infrastructure availability, reliability, and application performance.
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, adjusting infrastructure capacity based on application demand and operational requirements.
  • Implement and maintain backup, disaster recovery, security patching, and infrastructure resilience capabilities for critical application environments.
  • Partner with application development, Cloud, and architecture teams to define infrastructure requirements, integrate provisioning into deployment pipelines, and implement standardized architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Provide ongoing operational support, incident response, troubleshooting, and on-call support, while maintaining infrastructure documentation, procedures, troubleshooting guides, and driving continuous improvements in reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience
  • 5 years minimum of prior relevant experience
  • Skills Required: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, cloud architecture patterns, CI/CD pipelines, containerization and orchestration, networking and security, monitoring and logging, automation and scripting, version control systems, problem-solving and troubleshooting, cross-functional collaboration, technical documentation, and continuous learning mindset

Compensation & Benefits

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; based on the type of position
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

descriptionHtml:
CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.


THE OPPORTUNITY

The Engineer – Platform Engineering (Cloud Engineer) is responsible for building and managing Chipotle’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a focus on automation and scalability. You will implement and maintain core platform services (such as cloud resources, servers, and CI/CD pipelines) that power our restaurants and enterprise systems. By utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code and robust monitoring, you’ll drive improvements in reliability, performance, and security. This role plays a key part in Chipotle’s modernization initiatives, contributing to cloud adoption and platform innovation in line with our Infrastructure Strategy.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Configure, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and on-prem servers, ensuring systems are set up following best practices for security and performance.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code templates and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Terraform scripts, Azure DevOps tasks) to automate provisioning and configuration of resources.
  • AI & Automation: Comfortable leveraging leading LLMs and hybrid AI models to accelerate engineering work, including generating and validating Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripts, automation, and troubleshooting workflows.
  • Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for platform components to quickly detect issues and optimize system performance
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues (network, OS, or cloud service problems), working with cross-functional teams to restore service and identify root causes.
  • Research and introduce new technologies or tools (containers, configuration management, AIOps platforms) that can improve infrastructure efficiency, scalability, or cost-effectiveness.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4-year college or university.
  • 3-5 year’s experience
  • Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS), virtualization, and containerization, along with a strong grasp of core infrastructure components (servers, storage, networks, security).
  • Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines) to build and manage infrastructure as code, driving consistency and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with leading LLMs and AI coding tools, including using AI to generate, review, and validate Infrastructure as Code and automation, plus an understanding of hybrid AI architectures.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for infrastructure issues – able to dissect complex problems under pressure and implement reliable solutions.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally (e.g. with developers, support teams) and clearly document technical processes.
  • A security-minded and detail-oriented approach – you follow best practices for cloud governance, identity/access management, and compliance in everything you build.


PAY TRANSPARENCY

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $87,000.00–$120,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.

With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

descriptionText:
CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD
Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.


THE OPPORTUNITY
The Engineer – Platform Engineering (Cloud Engineer) is responsible for building and managing Chipotle’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a focus on automation and scalability. You will implement and maintain core platform services (such as cloud resources, servers, and CI/CD pipelines) that power our restaurants and enterprise systems. By utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code and robust monitoring, you’ll drive improvements in reliability, performance, and security. This role plays a key part in Chipotle’s modernization initiatives, contributing to cloud adoption and platform innovation in line with our Infrastructure Strategy.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Configure, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and on-prem servers, ensuring systems are set up following best practices for security and performance.
- Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code templates and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Terraform scripts, Azure DevOps tasks) to automate provisioning and configuration of resources.
- AI & Automation: Comfortable leveraging leading LLMs and hybrid AI models to accelerate engineering work, including generating and validating Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripts, automation, and troubleshooting workflows.
- Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for platform components to quickly detect issues and optimize system performance
- Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues (network, OS, or cloud service problems), working with cross-functional teams to restore service and identify root causes.
- Research and introduce new technologies or tools (containers, configuration management, AIOps platforms) that can improve infrastructure efficiency, scalability, or cost-effectiveness.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

- Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4-year college or university.
- 3-5 year’s experience
- Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS), virtualization, and containerization, along with a strong grasp of core infrastructure components (servers, storage, networks, security).
- Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines) to build and manage infrastructure as code, driving consistency and efficiency.
- Hands-on experience with leading LLMs and AI coding tools, including using AI to generate, review, and validate Infrastructure as Code and automation, plus an understanding of hybrid AI architectures.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for infrastructure issues – able to dissect complex problems under pressure and implement reliable solutions.
- Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally (e.g. with developers, support teams) and clearly document technical processes.
- A security-minded and detail-oriented approach – you follow best practices for cloud governance, identity/access management, and compliance in everything you build.


PAY TRANSPARENCY
A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $87,000.00–$120,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.

Job Summary & Responsibilities

The Sr. Cloud Engineer will report to the Cloud Engineering Manager in the Technology Department. This role is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, and support of the enterprise infrastructure for a dynamic, growing business. The environment spans private and public clouds, networks, firewalls, servers, operating systems, applications, mobile devices, process schedulers, telecommunications, and general databases. The SCE will interface closely with the development teams, client service teams and business leaders to integrate, support, operate and provide infrastructure related to the Platform Architecture within Millennium Trust. Working within a team environment, the SCE participates directly in solution creation, providing hands-on support as well as operational support and training. This individual must be creative, client focused, solutions-driven, organized, and have the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.

  • Provide direct support and improve the day-to-day operations of hardware and operating systems, including Cloud Services:
  • Evaluate system utilization, monitor response time, and provide primary support for detection and correction of operational problems.
  • Coordinate and perform additions and changes to servers, network, operating systems and attached devices, including investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation and testing of new network hardware and software.
  • Ensure servers, operating systems and network components are implemented and adhere to the information security policies and infrastructure standards.
  • Utilize metrics and cloud native consumption-based services to improve cost efficiencies.
  • Implement and Configure Cloud native services in CI/CD pipelines using IAC tools.
  • Implement and Configure Istio Service Mesh and Helm Chart Deployments
  • Implement and Configure firewalls and security appliances.
  • Implement and Configure the Disaster Recovery and Business Resumption Plan as it relates to the backup and restoration of the technology infrastructure.
  • Ensure run books are updated on a regular basis.
  • Maintain the VMware and Cloud virtual environments.
  • Maintain the Microsoft Active Directory Domain
  • Mentor fellow Cloud Admins and Engineers
  • Manage, monitor, troubleshoot and support existing projects and processes; collaborate with various cross-functional teams to determine and define software requirements and propose software solutions.
  • Provide technical subject matter expertise and work with a wider team to ensure development activities are aligned with the scope, schedule, priority, and business objectives.
  • Maintaining and upgrading the deployment platforms as well as system infrastructure with Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform or ARM templets or PowerShell or similar.
  • Troubleshooting AKS cluster-based issues, deployment through the ADO pipeline
  • CLI, Powershell, ARMExperience working with teams to deliver complete azure solutions (security, operations, engineering, application team)
  • Provide infrastructure problem resolution for various applications throughout the organization.
  • Provide general SQL Server database troubleshooting and support.
  • Utilize programming skills to design and develop programs or scripts for various repetitive functions.
  • Performs all duties with a focus on goals of Inspira, which includes risk mitigation.
  • Support inbound calls/emails, maintaining tickets within the issue tracking application related to Infrastructure Support
  • Cross-train other team members to facilitate coverage.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

Years of Experience:

  • 5-7 years of experience in Computer Science or equivalent experience . Degree:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience . Certification:
  • Certification: AZ-900, AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-500 . Skills & Abilities:
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience with:
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure ADO while collaborating across teams to improve build, integration & release processes.
  • Assist in root cause analysis efforts and improvements to system reliability using techniques like self-healing, canary deployments, and alerting.
  • Build and deploy container workloads using Terraform.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes, AKS, Azure ADO, and Terraform.
  • Complex projects involving multiple teams and partners.
  • Implementing and configuring resilient, highly available IT systems
  • Windows and/or Linux Operating systems that include building, security and deployment in both a physical and Cloud environment.
  • Microsoft Azure PaaS and SaaS solution development technologies including Azure API Management, Azure Functions, Logic Apps etc.
  • JSON, REST and data-based APIs and high scale performance services
  • Azure Service Bus and Azure Notifications Hub
  • Exposure to logging and monitoring tools of native Azure
  • Exposure to building DR and HA solutions
  • Create clear & concise documentation of Cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure development and standards.
  • Networking knowledge and the skill sets to configure, maintain, and support Cisco Meraki devices, Azure VNETS, VPN Gateways, Route Servers, Route Tables, and Private Endpoints.
  • Implement and Configure Infrastructure as Code utilizing CI/CD Pipelines
  • Applying rule sets in Information Security best practices and ability to apply information security methodology to operating systems, network, and databases.
  • Scripting languages such as Powershell, Bash, JS, Python, etc.
  • Experience with Cloud Services Azure (preferred), Google or AWS
  • Experience with BDR solutions such as Veeam, VMWare Site Recovery, and Azure Backup/Site Recovery
  • Implement Microsoft 365 Services (Exchange, Intune, Sharepoint, and Teams)
  • Ability to Implement and Configure Kubernetes deployments utilizing custom resources.
  • Experience with general SQL Server database troubleshooting
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills, follow-up capability, and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to conduct research into hardware and software issues and products as required.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to use strong interpersonal and presentation skills to share ideas, solutions, and strong working relationships with business units including non-technical users, technical leads, and developers.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP protocol and firewalls
  • Knowledge of Virtual Machines and Container concepts.
  • Knowledge of Security as it relates to Cloud Environments including the Shared Security Model
  • Experience working with a ticketing system and internal clients.
  • Ability to respond to emails and text messages after hours to resolve critical issues.
  • Must possess strong skills in personal diplomacy and client service while consistently demonstrating a high level of motivation, commitment to teamwork, professionalism, and trustworthiness.
  • Strong vendor management skills
  • Highly self-motivated and directed.
  • Experience in a high availability environment preferred.
  • Knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices and framework preferred.

Pay Range

$100,200-$137,000 per year

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities.

Inspira provides industry-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program.

Job Description

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.

As a Lead Infrastructure Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Platform Migration Engineering and VSI team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate resilient infrastructure platforms across virtualized and containerized environments.
  • Build and maintain VMware-based virtualization solutions, including platform configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support.
  • Engineer and support Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes environments, including cluster operations, workload deployment, scaling, security, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and comparable tools.
  • Automate platform provisioning, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and routine operational tasks.
  • Apply practical AI capabilities to infrastructure engineering—for example, to assist with operational analysis, troubleshooting, automation, and knowledge retrieval—while following applicable security and data-handling requirements.
  • Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, documentation, and operational practices.
  • Diagnose complex infrastructure issues, lead root-cause analysis, and drive sustainable remediation.
  • Collaborate with application, security, architecture, and operations teams to deliver platform solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, mentoring, and guidance to other engineers.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting VMware virtualization solutions.
  • Practical experience with Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes in production or similarly complex environments.
  • Strong understanding of containerization concepts, including container images, registries, networking, storage, and orchestration.
  • Experience developing and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and/or comparable tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate infrastructure and operational workflows using suitable scripting or automation tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, virtualization, containers, and platform services.
  • Experience working with reliability, security, change management, and operational support practices.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience with CI/CD practices and integrating infrastructure changes into delivery pipelines.
  • Familiarity with configuration management, observability, platform security, and secrets management.
  • Experience operating infrastructure across hybrid or cloud environments.
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools or techniques to support engineering workflows, with sound judgment about validation, security, and data privacy.
  • Relevant certifications in VMware, Red Hat, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related technologies.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

About The Team

Our Corporate Technology team relies on smart, driven people like you to develop applications and provide tech support for all our corporate functions across our network. Your efforts will touch lives all over the financial spectrum and across all our divisions: Global Finance, Corporate Treasury, Risk Management, Human Resources, Compliance, Legal, and within the Corporate Administrative Office. You'll be part of a team specifically built to meet and exceed our evolving technology needs, as well as our technology controls agenda.

Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting, maintaining, and enhancing the firm's trading Linux infrastructure
  • Supporting, maintaining, and enhancing the firm's HPC infrastructure for research
  • Providing support specifically for the Linux and HPC environments including:
    • Emergency response
    • Execution of planned changes, updates, and deployment projects within the Linux server infrastructure
    • Manage HPC systems to support trading operations and Condor Job scheduler
    • Advanced profiling and troubleshooting of performance issues specifically within the Linux servers environment
    • Contributing to the development and refinement of tools and systems to automate provisioning, configuration, and monitoring of thousands of Linux servers
    • Management of essential core services such as DHCP, LDAP, DNS, and NFS for on-prem and hosted data centers as well as public clouds
    • Participating in an on-call rotation and occasional weekend shifts
    • Engaging in daily direct communication with trading teams and core engineering
    • Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices in HPC, storage, and GPU computing.
Qualifications

  • Experience in maintenance, operation, and administration of a sufficiently advanced Linux environment
  • Daily use of and contribution to developing automation and monitoring tools
  • Comprehensive understanding of Linux OS concepts and internals
  • Working knowledge of Intel-based hardware and server components
  • Good knowledge of Python, expert knowledge of Bash for scripting and automation tasks in a Linux environment
  • Understanding of Linux server-side networking and typical network protocols
  • Participation in open source or personal projects is a plus
  • Understanding of Linux configuration management, source control, CI/CD, and automated deployment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.

Preferred Qualifications (not Required)

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of parallel file systems (e.g., GPFS), batch systems (e.g., Slurm, Grid Engine, Condor), and high-performance network interconnects.
  • Experience with VAST and Weka storage solutions is highly desirable.
  • Solid understanding of trading infrastructure and low-latency systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Skills in managing hybrid cloud/on-premises environments.
  • Experience proposing and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices from the ground up.

Anticipated New York annual base salary range $100,000-$165,000 plus eligible for discretionary bonus.

Benefits

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.

At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.

Our benefits include:

  • Generous paid time off policies
  • Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
  • Hybrid working opportunities
  • Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
  • In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
  • Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
  • Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
  • Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
  • Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.

Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Summary

The IT Senior Cloud and Network Engineer reports to the IT Director of Cloud and Network Ops and provides technical leadership in the design, support and management of the entire network and server infrastructure at company data centers, co-location facilities, cloud tenants, and properties. Core areas of job responsibilities include Internet and network connectivity, cloud infrastructure administration, identity and domain services administration, virtual host and guest server management, storage administration, system security, email system administration, system backup and recovery, infrastructure-as-code, automation, and support portal duties.

The successful candidate will embody and work to reinforce MAA’s Core Values. Those values include:

  • Appreciating the uniqueness of each individual
  • Communicating openly and with integrity
  • Embracing opportunities
  • Doing the right thing at the right time for the right reasons

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Network Engineering
    • Technical lead for deployment and management of all network appliances, including routers, core MDF and IDF switches, wireless access points, virtual servers and hosts, and load balancer appliances.
    • Installs and troubleshoots networking hardware; recommends apartment property network configurations, maintains proper network segmentation, VPN Tunnel management and manages critical primary and ancillary network systems.
    • Works with 3rd party service providers; 3rd party resource dispatch and project management (planning, documentation, scheduling, reviews, and quality control).
    • Leads in managing wide area data center site connectivity (Meraki, IPsec VPN tunnels, SD-WAN).

  • Identity Administration
    • Manages all hybrid Active Directory and Entra (Azure AD) services and all directory integrations with 3rd party applications and platforms such Okta, Microsoft Azure and o365 environments, and other hybrid/cloud resources.
    • Assists in managing security updates, group policies objects and permissions.
    • Maintains and supports domain controllers and domain controller roles across multiple locations.

  • Collaboration Administration
    • Supports the day-to-day operations of the Microsoft Exchange environment (on-Premise and cloud model) to ensure proper system functionality. Includes but is not limited to ensuring proper mail flow, database integrity, policies, add-ins, virtual servers and IIS functionality and transport rules.
    • Deployment and maintenance of email integrations with other applications such as Mimecast, Azure apps, and Webex Collaboration tools.
    • Investigates and assists in remediating all email performance and security related incidents.

  • System Security and Recovery
    • Leads in managing network and server security. Includes but is not limited to privileged user access, malware and antivirus endpoint protection, data loss prevention and maintaining an overall healthy security posture.
    • Leads maintenance and management of on-premise and cloud backups for data and disaster recovery.
    • Assists Security teams with SIEM and IPS/IDS management and incident resolution.
    • Leads teams in supporting and implementing a comprehensive operating system patching policy.

  • Infrastructure Administration and Automation
    • Configures and maintains virtual server environment and documents VM environment details and design.
    • Utilize infrastructure-as-code tools for infrastructure deployment and configuration, covering both on-premises and cloud deployments.
    • Hypervisor administration to deploy virtual servers and appliances, perform storage and host migrations as needed, and balance resources across VM data centers and hosts.
    • Build and maintain current templates for on-prem and cloud infrastructure.
    • Provides reporting, monitoring and maintenance of virtual machines and hosts.
    • Configures and maintains storage connectivity and documents storage environment details and design.
    • Prioritize operational automation for repetitive tasks and delegation of support.
    • Performs other related duties as assigned to meet the needs of the business.

    Required Qualifications

    • 7+ years of progressive systems and network engineering experience required
    • Experience supporting corporate networks and environments in an ITIL structure required
    • Experience managing and supporting Azure cloud infrastructure and services required

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Certifications in network routing & switching (CCNA, CCNP) strongly preferred
    • Certifications in Azure Concepts, Microsoft Server Operating Systems, and/or Active Directory Services preferred
    • Specific training and certifications in storage management and hypervisor management preferred
    • Experience with Ansible or Terraform for infrastructure orchestration and configuration preferred
    • Certification in network security (CISSP or CompTIA Security +) preferred
    • ITIL Certification or equivalent training in process management preferred

    Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

    • Extensive knowledge of network security, routing, and switching
    • Experience managing firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, or Palo Alto)
    • Knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server operating systems and Active Directory Services, both on-prem and Entra (Azure AD)
    • Highly proficient in managing a windows forest/domain (maintains and configures DNS zones and records as needed, GPOs, PowerShell scripting, creating health reports and alerts) and cloud integrations
    • Proficient in infrastructure-as-code automation using tools like Ansible and Terraform
    • Knowledge of administration infrastructure-as-code and scripting tools for automated work
    • Knowledge of identity provider and SSO platforms such as Okta
    • Knowledge of VMware, vCenter and ESXi host maintenance, as well as VMware alternatives
    • Knowledge of external storage management (provisioning storage pools, LUNs, datastores, etc.) and managing storage for virtual machines
    • Knowledge of change management, impact/risk assessment and analysis, and process documentation best practices
    • This position requires the ability to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation

    Physical And Environmental Requirements

    • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
    • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
    • This position requires the ability to occasionally lift office products and supplies, up to 20 pounds.
    • This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

    Disclaimer

    Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Department: Information Technology

Job Number: 100666

Offices: Boston; Chicago; Los Angeles; Washington, D.C.; Tampa

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities



- Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads.  
- Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards.  
- Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities.  
- Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices.  
- Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines.  
- Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics.  
- Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency.  
- Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization.  
- Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.  
- Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.  
- Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities.  

Qualifications



- Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.  
- Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations.  
- Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management.  
- Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling.  
- Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies.  
- Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID.  
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.  
- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations.  
- One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus.  
- Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus.  
- Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert.  

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

descriptionHtml:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

Build the infrastructure that engineering and business teams rely on. Take new systems, network, and cloud capabilities from design to production, using automation and reusable patterns to make each build easier to deliver and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver new infrastructure for services, environments, and sites, balancing reliability, security, capacity, and cost.
  • Build connected systems, network, and cloud foundations, including compute, storage, identity, connectivity, and core network services.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and retirement through reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, scripts, and APIs.
  • Create tested delivery pipelines and self-service tools, with version control, review, drift detection, secure defaults, and rollback.
  • Build and support internal AI tooling that helps teams automate work and access approved AI capabilities. Partner with the AI Platform Engineer on secure integrations and reusable infrastructure, with appropriate access controls and human review for consequential actions.
  • Validate builds before handoff, including connectivity, monitoring, backups, recovery, and failover. Resolve recurring problems through engineering improvements and share knowledge with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, including ownership of new builds from design through production.
  • 3+ years building infrastructure automation with infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or Ansible) and scripting in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Hands-on experience deploying infrastructure on at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Strong systems or networking expertise, with working knowledge of operating systems, virtualization, storage, identity, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and connectivity.
  • Experience delivering repeatable infrastructure changes through Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and configuration validation or drift detection.
  • Ability to build secure internal tools and API integrations, manage permissions and secrets, document designs, and communicate technical tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with new-site builds, hybrid environments, or infrastructure delivery in a growing engineering or manufacturing organization.
  • Experience delivering internal AI tools or agent workflows with evaluations, access controls, and appropriate human review.
  • Relevant cloud, networking, or automation certifications; experience building self-service platforms used by multiple teams.

Additional Requirements

  • Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Pay Range

$170,000—$225,000 USD

At Mach, we believe that compensation is more than just a paycheck. It's a comprehensive package designed to reward the time, skills, and expertise you bring to our team. We are committed to offering competitive compensation that is equitable, transparent, and aligned with market trends.

Key Elements Of Our Compensation Philosophy

  • Competitive Salaries: We continuously research market rates to ensure our salaries are competitive with those in our industry and geographic location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Our bonus structure is tied to both individual and company performance, creating a win-win scenario that motivates our team members to excel.
  • Equity Participation: We offer stock options or equity to employees, ensuring that you share in the success and growth of the company.
  • Benefit Packages: Our benefits include healthcare, dental and vision plans, retirement savings, and paid time off, because we understand that your well-being extends beyond the office.
  • Professional Development: We allocate funds for continuing education, training, and career growth.
  • Transparency: We are committed to openness about our compensation tiers and how decisions are made, ensuring trust and mutual respect.

By joining Mach, you’re not just accepting a job—you’re becoming a key part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your growth. Together, we aim to create a rewarding environment that sets the stage for long-term success.

Data Privacy

To view Mach Industries candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://machindustries.com/privacy-policy.

Disclosures

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
