descriptionHtml:
This role is located in New York City and will require a hybrid work schedule of at least 2 days in office per week.


This role is open to Assistant Vice President and Vice President level candidates depending on experience.


About the Bank:

Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited was established through the merger of The Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co., Ltd with Chuo Mitsui Trust and Banking, Ltd. on April 1, 2012. We are one of the largest asset managers in Asia and number one among Japanese financial institutions by AUM, with approximately $850 Billion USD in AUM. The Bank provides an assortment of financial solutions and manages a broad spectrum of financial products across its global branches.


Department Overview:

The Americas Division (“AD”) was established in the Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited, New York Branch) (“SMTBNY”) to perform corporate functions and supervise U.S. entities. Established under the AD are the “Global Banking Unit (“GBU”), Americas Division” and “Global Markets Unit (“GMU”), Americas Division” which performs business functions. The Information Technology Department (“ITD”) provides the users of the Branch’s information systems with sufficient and appropriate system resources and functionality to complete their day-to-day business and keeps security and consistency of the important information that is stored in the systems.


Your Role Overview:


The Infrastructure & Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization's enterprise infrastructure environment. This hands-on role supports Windows Server, VMware, VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), AWS, storage, backup, identity and access management, Workspace ONE, networking, and cybersecurity platforms.

The role is primarily focused on infrastructure engineering and operations, including Windows Server, VMware/VCF, Horizon VDI, AWS, storage, backup, identity management, Workspace ONE, and virtualization platforms, while also supporting enterprise networking and security technologies such as Cisco switching/routing and Fortinet firewalls.

The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining the reliability, security, and availability of business-critical systems, troubleshooting complex technical issues, coordinating with vendors, and participating in after-hours maintenance, weekend support, and on-call activities as required.


Your Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. Administer, maintain, and support Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure and related enterprise services, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
  2. Support and maintain identity and access management solutions, including PingFederate Single Sign-On (SSO), PingID Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Workspace ONE Access, and CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  3. Administer and maintain VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), ESXi, vCenter, and VMware Horizon VDI environments.
  4. Administer and support Workspace ONE UEM (Mobile Device Management), Workspace ONE Access, device enrollment, compliance policies, application deployment, and endpoint management services.
  5. Support compute infrastructure including Cisco UCS, HPE, and Dell server platforms, encompassing hardware lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, performance optimization, and operational administration.
  6. Administer and support enterprise storage platforms, including NetApp and Pure Storage environments.
  7. Manage enterprise backup and recovery solutions, including backup monitoring, recovery testing, restore validation, retention management, and backup reporting.
  8. Support AWS cloud services, including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, VPN connectivity, and hybrid cloud integrations.
  9. Perform administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the HPE NonStop system and related infrastructure components.
  10. Monitor infrastructure performance, capacity, availability, and overall operational health across enterprise systems and cloud environments.
  11. Engineer, evaluate, test, and implement new infrastructure solutions, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
  12. Implement infrastructure security best practices, system hardening standards, vulnerability remediation activities, and security compliance initiatives.
  13. Coordinate remediation of infrastructure-related audit findings, security recommendations, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  14. Collaborate with Information Security teams and assist with internal audits, regulatory examinations, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
  15. Plan, coordinate, and perform operating system patching, firmware upgrades, application updates, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure maintenance activities to maintain security, compliance, and operational stability.
  16. Participate in approved change management processes and perform scheduled maintenance activities during evenings, weekends, holidays, and other maintenance windows as required.
  17. Respond to critical production incidents, support on-call responsibilities, and participate in escalation, troubleshooting, and recovery activities.
  18. Assist with disaster recovery planning, testing, recovery validation, business continuity exercises, and infrastructure resiliency initiatives.
  19. Lead and support infrastructure projects, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh initiatives from planning through implementation. Develop and maintain technical documentation and automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, APIs, and related technologies to improve operational efficiency.
  20. Support enterprise networking infrastructure, including Cisco switching, routing, VLAN administration, WAN connectivity, VPN technologies, and remote access solutions.
  21. Administer and maintain Fortinet firewalls, including firewall policy management, VPN configurations, NAT rules, security updates, and troubleshooting.
  22. Troubleshoot network, firewall, DNS, routing, switching, VPN, and connectivity issues across on-premises and cloud environments.
  23. Work with network service providers, vendors, and technology partners to resolve infrastructure, security, and connectivity issues.
  24. Coordinate with vendors and internal teams, provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to team members, maintain operational procedures and documentation, and perform additional duties as assigned by management.
  25. Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management


Your Qualifications:


  1. 8+ years of enterprise infrastructure administration, systems engineering, or infrastructure support experience.
  2. Strong experience administering Microsoft Windows Server (Windows 2019, 2022, 2025) environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and related Microsoft infrastructure services.
  3. Advanced experience with VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), ESXi, vCenter, and VMware Horizon VDI environments.
  4. Experience supporting enterprise compute and hardware platforms, including Cisco UCS, HPE, and Dell server infrastructure.
  5. Strong experience with enterprise storage and backup technologies, including NetApp, Pure Storage, Veeam, or equivalent backup and recovery solutions.
  6. Experience administering and supporting AWS cloud services, including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, VPN connectivity, and hybrid cloud environments.
  7. Experience supporting identity and access management technologies, including PingFederate SSO, PingID MFA, Workspace ONE Access, CyberArk PAM, and related authentication and security solutions.
  8. Experience administering Workspace ONE UEM (MDM), mobile device lifecycle management, endpoint compliance policies, application deployment, mobile security controls, and Workspace ONE Access.
  9. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, including vulnerability remediation, system hardening, privileged access management, security compliance, and audit support activities.
  10. Intermediate knowledge of Cisco networking technologies and Fortinet firewalls, including switching, routing, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, TCP/IP, WAN connectivity, and working knowledge of OSPF and BGP routing protocols.
  11. Knowledge of HPE NonStop (HP Tandem) systems is preferred.
  12. Experience troubleshooting infrastructure, cloud, networking, firewall, storage, backup, and connectivity issues across on-premises and cloud environments.
  13. Experience developing automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or similar scripting technologies, along with strong troubleshooting, documentation, organizational, and project execution skills.
  14. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment, manage multiple priorities, participate in disaster recovery and business continuity activities, and perform after-hours maintenance, weekend support, patching, system upgrades, on-call responsibilities, and emergency production support when required.


Preferred Certifications


  1. VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
  2. VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Certification (preferred)
  3. Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
  4. AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate
  5. CyberArk Defender Certification
  6. ITIL Foundation
  7. Cisco CCNA or equivalent networking certification
  8. Fortinet NSE / FCP / FCSS Certification


Why you should join SuMi Trust:

SuMi Trust embraces flexible ways of working when the business and role permits. We provide employees with a hybrid working model, allowing for in-office work and work from home. Our diverse and inclusive environment along with our global presence enables us to collaborate and communicate to meet our business needs. We believe that efficient teams need truth, loyalty, and a strong sense of purpose to balance risk and their targets. We make sustainable business decisions to improve our society and the world. We believe that each person brings a unique value that drives the business though their creativity and passion.

  • The Employee Benefits package includes: Paid Time Off, medical, HSA, vision, dental, FSA, 401(k), profit sharing, legal plan, cancer indemnity plan, disability insurance, life insurance, employee assistance program, commuter benefits, business travel accident, paid volunteer day, paid memberships, paid seminars, and tuition assistance.
  • We offer many socialization opportunities for wellness, financial wellbeing, runs/walks, team building, happy hours, and activities to support the Sustainable Developmental Goals.

Check out our LinkedIn for our employee experience: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smtbny


We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. SuMi Trust provides reasonable accommodations for employees and applicants with disabilities consistent with applicable law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please let us know when the Human Resources staff reaches out to you for an interview.

The anticipated salary range for this role is listed above. The specific salary offered to an employment applicant is based on the individual’s qualifications, experiences, the job responsibilities, an analysis of the current compensation paid for similar roles in the local geographic area, and key distinctions of the job as compared to current jobs in the Branch. The role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.


Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited New York Branch is a branch of Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holding Group. Learn more about the company, the values, and vision at https://www.smth.jp/english/about_us/philosophy

Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Platform Service Engineer you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. You will be part of a team that is responsible for operating the Critical Infrastructure Platform (CIPT) across our unified global datacenters; managing the demand planning and capacity utilization; and responsible for running the physical infrastructure (including supply chain, hardware, power, security, and workflow teams). We emphasize automation, data driven engineering, cost-effectiveness, and environmental sustainability. You will join a team of Platform Service Engineers who are passionate about designing, building, and operating the world's most advanced cloud infrastructures. You will work on cutting-edge technologies and projects that enable Microsoft to deliver innovative solutions and services to our customers while collaborating with other teams across the company and learning from the best in the industry. If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career, this is the role for you. This is a flexible work opportunity role offering the option for partial remote work from home. 

As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 150 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.   

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

This role targets an immediate start date.

Responsibilities

Technical Knowledge and Expertise  

  • Supports a hybrid Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CD) DevOps virtualized infrastructure consisting of Windows & Linux Server Operating System, Hyper-V, Active Directory, Domain Name System, PowerShell scripting, with a focus on data protection technologies, service metrics and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting, documentation skills, along with interpersonal awareness, proactivity, and a proven ability to manage and drive delivery of multiple simultaneous cross-group dependent server and service-based projects at scale.
  • Performs, maintains, and continuously improves automated operating system installation and configuration.  
  • Configures and maintains hands-on bare metal enterprise-class server systems, including automated periodic firmware and driver updates at scale, Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID) and Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI) configurations and hardware troubleshooting.  

Operational Excellence 

  • Monitors servers, ensure service levels and KPIs are met and maintained, provide security conscience outcomes maintaining compliance alignment, and ensure 24/7/365 service and infrastructure operations support with continuous optimizations. 
  • Transitions manual operational processes to automation while leveraging CI/CD DevOps principles. 

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing 

  • Partners with a global team while helping bring projects to successful outcomes and delivering rigorous documentation artifacts. 
  • Shares responsibility for automating, securing, configuring, and delivering support of the Critical Environments infrastructure (CIPT) & related programs and projects in existing and future datacenters.  

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Trade Certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional/Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND an internship in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, or systems engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise large-scale cloud or distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of Windows Server OS and UNIX-based operating systems including enterprise-level Linux distributions performing automated system installation and configuration, file system concepts, resource monitoring, user administration, package management, and process control & management.
  • Demonstrate basic understanding of Configuration management with PowerShell DSC, Puppet, Chef or similar.
  • Project or lab work with server & tooling platforms for multiple infrastructure services such as Windows Server 2022/2019, Linux Server distributions, Hyper-V, Azure Arc, MIT Kerberos, Active Directory, DNS, PowerShell/Python infrastructure-as-code scripting, data protection technologies, service monitoring, incident alarming, compliance, and other services to aid in fulfilling operational monitoring, audit logging of events, compliance requirements, outages, or security-related issues.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $111,100 - $183,700 per year.

descriptionHtml:
As a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will help build and look after the cloud and virtualized infrastructure. This

is a hands-on, mid-level role where your work has real impact: working from the team's architecture and standards,

you will set up cloud environments, make deployments faster and more reliable through Terraform and Ansible, care

for Linux and Windows systems, and put identity and access controls in place.


Key Responsibilities

● Implement and configure GCP environments (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage with retention policies,

VPC networking) for centralized security applications

● Build and maintain virtualized on-premises and cloud-hosted infrastructure

● Deploy high-availability mechanisms, failover, clustering and load-balancing and validating

redundancy behavior after implementation.

● Author and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and Ansible; contribute to orchestration

and configuration management via Puppet, Git, PowerShell

● Automate routine provisioning and sustainment tasks through Python and Bash scripting to reduce

manual effort and configuration drift.

● Provision and administer infrastructure IAM across operating systems, enforcing least-privilege and

least-service models.

● Configure tiered storage and database resources in line with retention, uptime and auditability

requirements.

● Provide implementation-tier support for escalations from operations and sustainment teams, escalating

design-level issues to L3 with detailed handover notes.

● Produce and maintain runbooks, configuration records and Technical Design Documentation (TDD)

artifacts

Required Qualifications & Skills

● 5–8 years of hands-on experience in cloud and enterprise infrastructure engineering, with

demonstrated delivery in production environments.

● Working proficiency in GCP core services — Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC and IAM — and

cloud-native high-availability patterns.

● Practical Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and Ansible (mandatory); scripting in

Python, Bash and PowerShell; familiarity with Puppet and Git.

● Linux and Windows enterprise OS administration; virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V); Dell iDRAC

and DellOME for hardware management.

● Ability to provision IAM across OS and cloud (Active Directory, Google IAM, RBAC) under least-

privilege enforcement.

● Clear technical documentation skills (runbooks and TDD contributions); willingness to work business

hours with on-call escalation in a global support model.

● Certifications — Required: GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).

Beneficial: HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat RHCE, ITIL Foundation.

Tools Required

● Cloud & Environment: GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC, IAM) for building and

sustaining centralized security-application infrastructure.

● IaC & Orchestration: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Git, PowerShell, Bash, Python for automated

deployment, configuration management and sustainment.

● Hardware & OS: Dell iDRAC, DellOME, Linux (RHEL / Ubuntu) and Windows Server

● Identity & Governance: Active Directory, Google IAM, RBAC for least-privilege access;

Programme PM Workflow (BRD / TDD / Project Charter) for project governance.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD). 
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems. 
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda. 
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault. 
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams. 
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you. 

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services
  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $119,000-$154,000 in Kansas, $130,900-$169,400 in Chicago, and $148,750-$192,500 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview

We are seeking a well rounded Senior Systems Engineer to interface and partner with key business and technology teams to understand business processes and requirements in order to design, develop and support cross technology solutions in a Hybrid Cloud/On-Prem environment.

The Senior Systems Engineer will be responsible for the administration, automation, security, and lifecycle management of Windows Servers and the VMWare Virtualization Platform. This role is critical for building and maintaining security compliance, vulnerability remediation, operating system patching, and application deployment.

This position will help ensure the secure delivery of endpoint services through Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, Jamf Pro, and Ivanti Endpoint Manager while supporting ongoing vulnerability management and cybersecurity initiatives.

The Senior Systems Engineer will be responsible for the design, administration, and support of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including storage platforms, virtualization environments, Windows Server systems, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

This position will help ensure the availability, performance, security, and scalability of critical IT services through proactive monitoring, automation, troubleshooting, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.

Responsibilities

As a valuable East West Bank team member, your duties (not limited to) will include:

  • Design, implementation and management of high availability VMWare environments
  • Configure and manage storage solutions (Pure, HPE)
  • Collaborate with other engineers to develop deployment strategies for existing and new services
  • Remediate and patch system vulnerabilities as required
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft Public Key Infrastructure
  • Evaluate and implement technologies that improve efficiency, performance, and reliability
  • Develop and deliver creative solutions that automate systems engineer functions
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft Active Directory (Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, Entra)
  • Configure, and administer Microsoft O365 Services
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server related issues
  • Maintain operating systems with regular maintenance
  • Manage assigned projects
  • Provide technical assistance and support
  • Collaborate with Systems Engineering Team Members and Management as well as Development, and Application Support Teams
  • Any other duties as assigned by management

Qualifications/Requirements

 Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience as a Microsoft Systems Engineer
  • Experience building and managing Azure Virtual Desktops
  • Experience with administrating and managing Microsoft O365 products and services
  • Experience with MS Windows and VMWare required
  • Experience with High Availability/Site Recovery design principles
  • Experience with Azure and AWS (Compute, Storage Accounts, Networking, Conditional Access Policies)
  • Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage to tight deadlines with a mindset for flexibility
  • Excels in a fast-paced environment and ability to partner, dynamically adjust priorities and deadlines as need to meet the larger business goals

Nice To Have

  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Load Balancers

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $120,000.00/Yr. - USD $170,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Job Description:

Position Summary

We are seeking an Infrastructure & Cluster Engineer to manage the administration, health, and performance of the foundational compute environment under the User Facing and Data Center Services (UDS) contract at GDIT. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end administration of a dedicated customer compute cluster. Your primary mission is to ensure a highly available, secure, and optimized hardware foundation. By maintaining a robust infrastructure, you will directly contribute to the critical technology integration and performance engineering efforts, ensuring a highly reliable platform for integrating and executing complex customer workloads.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Cluster Administration: Manage the day-to-day operations of the customer compute cluster, including Linux operating system administration, hardware monitoring, patching, and system upgrades.
  • Resource and Job Management: Configure, maintain, and optimize workload management and orchestration platforms, utilizing the Run:AI job scheduler to ensure efficient distribution of intensive AI/ML workloads across the cluster.
  • Infrastructure Optimization: Tune cluster performance at the hardware, operating system, and network levels to maximize compute efficiency and data throughput for customer workloads.
  • Storage and Network Management: Administer storage solutions and high-speed networking fabrics. Support the transition to and ongoing management of an InfiniBand GPU-to-GPU network infrastructure to minimize latency for distributed operations.
  • Environment Configuration: Partner with technology integration teams to provision specific environments, dependencies, and container platforms, specifically leveraging Red Hat OpenShift, required for seamless customer model deployment.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure components remain compliant with federal security standards, implementing strict access controls and maintaining system accreditations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Clearance: Active TS/SCI with the ability to obtain CI Poly.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration and infrastructure management with a specific focus on high-performance computing environments.
  • Location: Springfield, VA
  • Technical Skills:
    • Expertise in managing bare-metal servers, enterprise storage arrays, and advanced network configurations (Experience with InfiniBand).
    • Strong proficiency with workload managers, job schedulers, and AI orchestration tools (e.g., Run:AI, SLURM).
    • Hands-on experience with enterprise container orchestration platforms, specifically OpenShift or Kubernetes.
    • Experience writing automation and configuration scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) to streamline cluster maintenance.
  • Troubleshooting Focus: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex hardware, network, and OS-level issues.
Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with parallel file systems and high-throughput storage architectures.
  • Prior experience engineering or managing high-speed GPU-to-GPU communication topologies.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

  • 401K with company match
  • Comprehensive health and wellness packages
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
  • Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
  • Cutting-edge technology you can learn from
  • Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays

#RoverGSS

The likely salary range for this position is $119,850 - $162,150. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

None

Telecommuting Options:

Onsite

Work Location:

USA VA Springfield

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards At GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.

We are seeking an experienced IT Systems / Microsoft 365 Cloud Engineer to support and optimize enterprise infrastructure, cloud services, networking, and security environments. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in Microsoft 365 administration, Windows Server management, Azure cloud technologies, networking, automation, and cybersecurity.

Key Responsibilities Windows Server & Azure Cloud

  • Administer and support Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and DNS.
  • Configure, deploy, and maintain Windows Server infrastructure.
  • Manage and support virtualized environments utilizing VMware, KVM, and Hyper-V.
  • Perform system upgrades and maintain cloud-hosted and on-premises applications.
  • Implement Azure cloud solutions using modern cloud adoption and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Drive cloud transformation initiatives, including automation, DevSecOps, and AI-enablement strategies.
  • Automate administrative and operational tasks through PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $100,000.00/annually Networking

  • Install, configure, and maintain network infrastructure and related hardware.
  • Diagnose and resolve network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Design and deploy wired and wireless network solutions.
  • Manage networking services including DNS, DHCP, routing, and VLANs.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, security, connectivity, and mobile device issues.
  • Maintain current knowledge of networking, operating systems, and cloud technologies while ensuring adherence to industry best practices.

Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Manage and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Entra ID (Azure Active Directory).
  • Administer user accounts, groups, licensing, permissions, and security policies.
  • Configure and manage access control across Windows, macOS, and cloud environments.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications and services.
  • Monitor system performance, reliability, and service availability.
  • Evaluate and recommend adoption of new Microsoft 365 features and capabilities.
  • Develop end-user training and documentation to maximize productivity and platform usage.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Deploy and maintain software, operating systems, devices, peripherals, and related technologies.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and manage security controls using Microsoft security technologies, including Defender, Intune, and related platforms.
  • Enforce security policies and compliance standards across cloud and endpoint environments.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and information protection practices.
  • Analyze recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term remediation strategies.
  • Manage system logging, monitoring, and event analysis tools.
  • Support backup, disaster recovery, and data restoration processes.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of IT systems administration experience.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting desktop systems, networks, and Windows Server environments.
  • 7+ years of Microsoft 365 administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure planning, implementation, management, and support.
  • Experience supporting mixed operating system environments, including Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft data management, reporting, and security technologies, including Power BI.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and technical certification attainment.

  • Detail-oriented and highly conscientious.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Cloud Engineering team within AV Core Infrastructure. AV Cloud Engineering owns core IaaS and PaaS capabilities that support autonomous vehicle development and runtime environments.

This role is for an engineer who treats cloud infrastructure as a product and is motivated by building a reliable, easy-to-consume platform that helps AV engineers build, test, and run faster with less operational friction. You will work on the platform capabilities, abstractions, and self-service workflows that power AV workloads at scale. You should be comfortable turning broad infrastructure problems into durable engineering solutions and improving developer velocity through software, automation, and thoughtful platform design.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and evolve internal platform capabilities, self-service workflows, APIs, and automation that make the right path the easiest path for AV engineering teams.
  • Design clean abstractions that allow product and research teams to consume complex infrastructure, including specialized hardware such as GPUs, without deep infrastructure expertise.
  • Improve platform primitives across traffic, service mesh, runtime configuration, and connectivity for distributed AV workloads.
  • Reduce toil and improve reliability through reusable platform tooling, declarative automation, strong service ownership, observability, and SLIs/SLOs.
  • Take ownership of complex platform initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, and adoption.
  • Partner with adjacent AV infrastructure teams to reduce developer friction and improve the reliability of the platform AV engineers depend on.
  • Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication.


Skills & Abilities:

  • Required: Fully qualified proficiency in Kubernetes (GKE) and the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, including VPC, IAM, etc.
  • Required: Hands-on experience implementing high-availability systems and managing the lifecycle of production-grade clusters.
  • Required: Strong proficiency in software engineering and DevOps principles, specifically using Golang/Python and Terraform.
  • Required: Ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment and translate high-level requirements into clear technical tasks.
  • Required: A "Growth-based Mindset" with a commitment to continuous upskilling and a belief that team capacities are developed through effort and coaching.
  • Required: Professional experience managing the trade-offs between hardware-level performance (GPU passthrough) and clean cloud abstractions.
  • Preferred: Experience with Service Mesh (Istio) and managing large-scale DNS/Traffic configurations in a global environment.


Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

  • 5+ years of experience or proven record of defining and executing technical strategy that required coordination across multiple teams, senior executives, and front-line engineers
  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field OR equivalent work experience
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production and strong familiarity with at least one major cloud ecosystem such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Go, Python, or similar languages, with the ability to build reusable automation, services, APIs, or controllers.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and operating large-scale, high-availability distributed systems in production.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio and large-scale DNS or traffic management.
  • Experience with GKE and the broader GCP ecosystem, including networking and IAM; equivalent experience with EKS/AWS or AKS/Azure is also valuable.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML workloads or working with ML platforms and related tooling ecosystems.
  • Experience owning or influencing platform SLOs and availability targets in production.
  • Experience driving technical strategy or cross-functional alignment across multiple teams.


Additional Context

This role is best suited for engineers who want to build an internal platform product for other engineers. It is less suited to candidates whose background is primarily ticket-driven infrastructure support or one-off environment operations.

Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Sunnyvale or Austin office three times per week, at minimum.

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, secure and highly available cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI). The role focuses on infrastructure automation, reliability, resiliency, networking, security and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments. You will collaborate with application, security and operations teams to implement best practices for deployment, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI) to meet availability, performance and security requirements.
  • Build and manage virtual networks (VCN/VNet), subnets, route tables, DNS, VPNs, FastConnect/ExpressRoute and cross-tenancy routing to support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
  • Implement and operate load balancers, storage solutions, backups, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure resiliency and data protection.
  • Manage identity and access (IAM), whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall policies to secure cloud environments and enforce least privilege.
  • Develop, maintain and run automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash and REST APIs to provision infrastructure, orchestration and configuration management.
  • Create and maintain monitoring, logging and dashboarding (metrics, logs, alerts) to enable rapid detection and incident response; participate in on-call rotations and incident post-mortems.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure issues across compute, networking and storage layers, drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to improve reliability.
  • Perform capacity planning, cloud optimization and cost control activities, recommending improvements and right-sizing resources.
  • Document architecture, operational runbooks, topology diagrams, network configurations and standard operating procedures for teams and audits.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, applications, networking, SRE) to deliver secure, compliant and production-ready platforms and to drive continuous improvement.
  • Implement server administration tasks, manage IP addressing, and maintain firewalls and routing for complex deployments.
  • Design and run tests for disaster recovery and failover, validate backup/restoration procedures and maintain recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years experience working with cloud platforms (must have Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud / OCI experience).
  • Strong practical knowledge of networking concepts including VCN/VNet, subnets, route tables, DNS, VPN, FastConnect/ExpressRoute, IP addressing and routing.
  • Skilled in automation and scripting using Terraform, Python, PowerShell and Bash; experience consuming REST APIs for infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with identity and access management (IAM), security controls, whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall management in cloud environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboards, incident response and troubleshooting server, storage and networking issues.
  • Preferred certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Fundamentals, Cloud Infrastructure Foundations, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate.
  • Hands-on experience with OCI-specific features (VCN, FastConnect, Load Balancer, Object/Block Storage) and cross-tenancy designs a plus.
  • Background as an Infrastructure Engineer or SRE and familiarity with disaster recovery, backups, resiliency, cloud optimization and capacity planning a plus.
  • Experience with Terraform modules, CI/CD integration, cloud cost optimization tools, dashboarding platforms and log aggregation systems a plus.
  • Strong written documentation skills, clear communication, collaborative mindset, problem-solving orientation and a focus on continuous improvement.

Benefits

PTO, Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, Vision, 401K, bonus and profit sharing

The Linux Systems Engineer III leads the design, installation, operation, support, upgrades, and maintenance of infrastructure, including software, servers, networking and storage. Administers, maintains, and supports complex and critical infrastructure in a Linux VMWare and Windows server environment.

FGCU is building a culture of curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We value employees who successfully work with others and drive positive change through critical thinking and decisive action. If you thrive in an environment of innovation, accountability and mutual respect, you will find a good home here.

At Florida Gulf Coast University, employees are expected to work on campus as part of a collaborative, mission-driven environment. While this role does not directly interact with students, its on-site presence is essential to supporting the university’s operations and advancing student learning across the institution.

Job Description

Typical duties include but are not limited to:

  • Leads the design, installation, operation, support, upgrades, and maintenance of infrastructure, including software, servers, and storage in a Linux and Windows server environment.
  • Administers, maintains, and supports complex and critical infrastructure using automation such as Ansible / Red Hat Satellite.
  • Administers application security and configurations.
  • Coordinates application testing with functional areas.
  • Analyzes infrastructure performance and resolves problems or makes appropriate recommendations.
  • Leads troubleshooting of application, operating system server hardware, network communications and storage problems within infrastructure.
  • Ensures data/media recoverability by implementing a schedule of system backups and database archive operations.
  • Conducts routine infrastructure and security audits to ensure compliance with established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines.
  • Monitors and maintains continuity with system licensing and maintenance agreements.
  • Serves as an escalation point for Systems Engineers.
  • Tracks problems in the work order system.
  • Maintains records, forms, and standard operating procedures documentation.
  • Develops new techniques and procedures to enhance university systems infrastructure.
  • Reviews processes, evaluates results, recommends new processes, and promotes best practices.

Other Duties

  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Additional Job Description

Required Qualifications:

  • This position requires either nine years of directly related full-time experience or, as an alternative, a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Computer Science or related field and five years of full-time experience directly related to the job functions.
  • Professional full-time experience with Linux based enterprise systems and applications.
  • Experience with large enterprise computing environments that include multiple site locations.
  • Any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience, and/or certifications may be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Five years professional full-time experience with application system support and implementation in a medium to large computing environment.
  • Professional full-time experience with enterprise systems and applications and current versions of Windows Server/Linux or other enterprise services.

  • Demonstrated track record of reliability, meeting goals, and holding oneself accountable.

Overview

Looking to make a difference and help modernize critical government missions? Join Acuity's team supporting the U.S. Department of State. As a Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer (IaaS), you will provide hands-on engineering support for mission-critical data center, virtualization, compute, storage, hybrid-cloud, and globally distributed infrastructure. This role is deeply focused on enterprise VMware environments, Windows Server and Linux platforms, hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), SAN/NAS storage, and the resilient infrastructure services that support Department of State operations worldwide.

Working closely with the Cloud Technical Lead, Cloud Engineers, Automation Engineers, Network Engineers, Cybersecurity teams, and government stakeholders, you will provide Tier 3 infrastructure engineering and troubleshooting, support infrastructure lifecycle modernization, and ensure the availability, security, resiliency, capacity, and performance of enterprise systems across domestic, overseas, on-premises, and cloud environments.

Why Acuity?

Are you ready to use your expertise in the areas of IT Modernization, Data Enablement, and Hyperautomation to make a real difference? Join Acuity, Inc., a technology consulting firm that supports federal agencies. We combine industry partnerships and long-term federal experience with innovative technical leadership to support our customers’ critical missions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, administer, and maintain enterprise data center, compute, virtualization, storage, HCI, operating system, and hybrid-cloud infrastructure supporting mission-critical operations.
  • Provide significant hands-on administration and engineering support for enterprise VMware environments, including VMware ESXi, vCenter, clusters, virtual networking, resource management, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle activities.
  • Deploy, configure, administer, patch, harden, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux operating systems supporting enterprise applications and infrastructure services.
  • Engineer and support enterprise compute and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), including integration with virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and disaster recovery services.
  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise SAN/NAS storage platforms and virtualization-storage integrations, including capacity, performance, availability, connectivity, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Provide Tier 3 infrastructure troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex issues spanning servers, virtualization, storage, operating systems, cloud services, and dependent infrastructure components.
  • Design, implement, test, and maintain high-availability, disaster recovery, backup, resiliency, and business-continuity capabilities for mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure lifecycle activities, including technology refresh, patching, upgrades, migrations, and remediation of end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) hardware and software.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, and performance using enterprise monitoring and observability platforms; identify trends, constraints, and opportunities for proactive remediation and optimization.
  • Use PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, administration, compliance, and repetitive operational tasks.
  • Support Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and hybrid-cloud environments using at least one major cloud service provider such as AWS or Microsoft Azure, including integration between cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support overseas and globally distributed infrastructure deployments and coordinate with geographically dispersed or remote teams to maintain consistent, reliable infrastructure services across locations and time zones.
  • Operate within established ITSM disciplines, including change, incident, problem, configuration, and release management; participate in root cause analysis and continuous service improvement.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement federal security and configuration requirements, including system hardening, vulnerability remediation, secure baselines, STIG-aligned controls, NIST/RMF compliance, and continuous monitoring.
  • Collaborate with Cloud and Automation Engineers to implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, standardized deployment patterns, and infrastructure modernization while maintaining operational stability.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, infrastructure diagrams, configuration standards, runbooks, operational procedures, and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned in support of customer mission objectives.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, systems engineering, data center operations, or Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
  • Significant hands-on enterprise VMware experience, including VMware ESXi and vCenter administration, troubleshooting, patching/upgrades, cluster management, and virtualization lifecycle support.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting both Windows Server and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise compute and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) platforms in highly available production environments.
  • Experience administering enterprise SAN and/or NAS storage and supporting storage integration with virtualized infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated Tier 3 infrastructure troubleshooting and root cause analysis experience across compute, virtualization, storage, operating systems, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting high availability, disaster recovery, backup, resiliency, and business-continuity solutions.
  • Experience managing infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, technology refresh, and EOL/EOS remediation.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure monitoring, capacity management, performance analysis, and availability management.
  • Hands-on scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting at least one major cloud service provider (AWS or Microsoft Azure) and hybrid-cloud integration with enterprise on-premises infrastructure.
  • Experience working within ITSM processes and disciplines, including change management, incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience implementing federal security and configuration compliance requirements, such as NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, STIGs, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, or comparable federal standards.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting globally distributed, overseas, or remote enterprise infrastructure environments, particularly environments requiring coordination across geographically dispersed teams.
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or equivalent VMware certification.
  • Experience with enterprise HCI platforms such as VMware vSAN/VxRail, Nutanix, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies and vendors supporting SAN/NAS, backup, replication, and disaster recovery.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Microsoft server certification, or comparable operating system certification.
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of State or other federal civilian agencies.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, capacity, and performance-management platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, or related enterprise container technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure hybrid-cloud infrastructure architectures.


Clearance Requirement

  • Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance required.


Min

USD $145,000.00/Yr.

Max

USD $170,000.00/Yr.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position represents Acuity's good faith estimate of the compensation for this job title at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, education, certifications, skills, geographic location, contract requirements, applicable labor categories, and, where applicable, contract award and funding.

Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD). 
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems. 
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda. 
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault. 
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams. 
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you. 

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services
  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $119,000-$154,000 in Kansas, $130,900-$169,400 in Chicago, and $148,750-$192,500 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

descriptionHtml:
Torch Technologies

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies is seeking an experienced Cloud/Infrastructure Engineer to join our team in Colorado Springs, CO, supporting critical Department of Defense enterprise and mission infrastructure. In this role, you will be instrumental in modernizing, securing, and sustaining mission-critical hybrid cloud infrastructure, integrating commercial cloud services with robust on-premises virtual environments and identity services. You will collaborate closely with system architects, software developers, and cybersecurity professionals to ensure operational reliability, defense-in-depth compliance, and high availability across classified and unclassified networks.

As a Cloud / Infrastructure Engineer, your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:

Cloud Infrastructure & Virtualization

  • Design, deploy, configure, and maintain scalable hybrid cloud solutions and on premises virtual machine (VM) environments.
  • Manage hypervisor and virtualized compute resources, networking, storage, and associated workloads.
  • Monitor system health, performance, and availability; proactively troubleshoot operational incidents and optimize system resources.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and disaster recovery guides.

Identity & Systems Administration

  • Manage Active Directory (AD) accounts, including user and security group lifecycle provisioning, privilege allocation, and directory maintenance.
  • Administer and maintain Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to enforce system configurations, access controls, and security baselines.
  • Support enterprise systems management, baseline configuration, and server administration across Windows and Linux environments.

Cybersecurity & Compliance

  • Implement DoD security hardening guidelines (e.g., DISA STIGs) and ensure adherence to defense cybersecurity directives.
  • Partner with security teams to conduct routine vulnerability assessments, analyze scan findings, and execute timely remediation.
