Job Title: Systems Administrator & Network Engineer (Hybrid Role)


Location: Hybrid (On-site + 1 Day Remote)


Experience Level: Mid to Senior (4–8+ years)


Compensation

$66,852 – $86,908 annually | Midpoint $76,880


Placement within the range is based on relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated competencies, and internal equity.


Esperanza Health Center offers a comprehensive benefits package to eligible full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; retirement contributions; and other benefits designed to support employee well-being and professional growth.






Position Overview


We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile Systems Administrator & Network Engineer to manage, maintain, and enhance our IT infrastructure. This hybrid role combines deep systems administration expertise with advanced network engineering capabilities. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience delivering infrastructure projects, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across both systems and network environments. While supporting a robust data driven high availability Clinical Environment.


Key Responsibilities


Systems Administration




  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, operating systems (Windows Server, VMware Virtual Servers, Wyse Clients, Laptops and Desktops), and enterprise applications.




  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and group policies using Active Directory and related identity systems.




  • Perform routine system maintenance, upgrades, and patch management.




  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability; proactively address issues.




  • Develop and manage Veeam backups and disaster recovery strategies to ensure data integrity and business continuity.




  • Automate administrative and operational tasks using scripting tools such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.




Network Engineering




  • Design, implement, and manage scalable and secure network infrastructures (LAN, WAN, WLAN).




  • Configure and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, and load balancers.




  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues such as outages, bottlenecks, and latency.




  • Implement network security measures, including firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and access controls.




  • Support cloud and hybrid networking environments (Azure, SD-WAN).




  • Maintain and update network documentation including diagrams, configurations, and procedures utilizing tools such as Scribe software and Microsoft Visio.




Cross-Functional & Project Work




  • Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects (e.g., Server migrations, EMR and equipment upgrades, cloud adoption, network redesign).




  • Collaborate with IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to implement new technologies and optimize systems.




  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry security standards.




  • Provide Tier 2/3 support  IT staff when needed.




Required Skills & Qualifications


Technical Expertise




  • Strong knowledge of operating systems: Windows Server, Windows 11 and ThinOS.




  • Deep understanding of networking protocols: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP.




  • Experience with enterprise hardware: routers, switches, firewalls (Fortigate, Fortinet, or equivalent).




  • Familiarity with virtualization and cloud platforms (VMware, Azure).




  • Proficiency in scripting/automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python).




  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools for systems and networks.




Professional Experience




  • 4–8+ years of hands-on experience in systems administration and/or network engineering roles.




  • Proven track record of delivering infrastructure or network-related projects (e.g., deployments, migrations, upgrades).




  • Experience supporting hybrid or multi-site environments.




Education & Certifications




  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).




  • Relevant certifications preferred:




    • CompTIA Server+, RHCSA, or Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator




    • CCNA / CCNP or equivalent networking certifications




    • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure) are a plus






Soft Skills




  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.




  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.




  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently or in a team.




  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on system reliability and security.




Preferred Qualifications




  • Experience with automation frameworks or Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).




  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and compliance standards.




  • Exposure to DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.




What Success Looks Like




  • High system and network uptime with minimal disruptions.




  • Efficient resolution of incidents and proactive issue prevention.




  • Successful delivery of infrastructure projects on time and within scope.




  • Continuous improvement through automation and optimization.




Work Environment




  • Hybrid work model on-site support and one remote day.




  • May require occasional after-hours support for maintenance or critical incidents.








This role is ideal for a well-rounded IT professional who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys working across both systems and networking domains to deliver robust, secure, and scalable infrastructure solutions.

descriptionHtml:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

Platform Infrastructure Engineers (PIEs) are responsible for managing, maintaining, and evolving the foundational infrastructure that supports our internal Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform. PIEs specialize in building robust, scalable, and highly available systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud environments. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to ensure a reliable infrastructure foundation for all platform services and applications.

Our team helps to improve automation infrastructure reliability. It empowers Braze’s other engineering teams to leverage the infrastructure products and platforms we create easily. Braze operates at a massive scale with over 3.3 billion monthly active users across our customers, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end-users daily. We use a diverse technology stack rooted in Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, and more. As a Platform Software Engineer at Braze, you will collaborate with your team and consumer engineering teams to build and continuously improve the infrastructure as a service platform that every other team at Braze depends on.

  • Design and Manage Infrastructure:
    • Build, optimize, and manage foundational systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud resources (e.g., EC2, S3)
    • Develop automation frameworks for provisioning and maintaining infrastructure at scale
    • Design scalable architectures to support seamless operations of platform services
  • Ensure Reliability and Performance:
    • Implement high-availability and fault-tolerant infrastructure strategies
    • Collaborate with Platform Software Engineers and Product teams to establish and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for infrastructure components
    • Continuously monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to meet evolving demands
  • Incident Response and Resilience:
    • Be part of a PagerDuty rotation to respond to infrastructure-related incidents
    • Implement failover strategies, backups, and disaster recovery plans to mitigate risks
    • Conduct root cause analyses and retrospectives to improve system resilience
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
    • Partner with Platform Software Engineers to integrate infrastructure with service abstractions and APIs
    • Document processes, tools, and best practices to streamline development and operations
    • Share expertise and mentor team members to foster a culture of operational excellence
  • Innovate and Automate:
    • Stay ahead of emerging trends in infrastructure technology and integrate innovative solutions
    • Reduce manual tasks by developing automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and maintenance
    • Optimize for performance, security, and scalability in all aspects of infrastructure design
Who You Are

  • Experience:
    • 4+ years managing and scaling large-scale infrastructure systems in production environments
    • Proven expertise with Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and configuration management tools
  • Skills:
    • Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar
    • Strong understanding of network architecture, security, and performance tuning
    • Familiarity with containerization, service discovery, and load-balancing technologies
    • Have an excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and expectations at once
  • Mindset:
    • Focused on building robust, scalable systems that enhance developer productivity
    • Collaborative and communicative, with a strong desire to document and share knowledge
    • Committed to continuous improvement, staying ahead of technological advancements
  • Have an urge to collaborate, document, and deliver quickly
    • Collaborating across the global remote teams, often working asynchronously
    • Document everything so you don't need to learn the same thing (or plan the same work) twice
    • Delivering fast to delight our customers–even internal ones
For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $118,545 - $196,364/annually, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $130,400 - $216,000/annually (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

What We Offer

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

About Braze

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

descriptionText:

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Platform Infrastructure Engineers (PIEs) are responsible for managing, maintaining, and evolving the foundational infrastructure that supports our internal Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform. PIEs specialize in building robust, scalable, and highly available systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud environments. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to ensure a reliable infrastructure foundation for all platform services and applications.

Our team helps to improve automation infrastructure reliability. It empowers Braze’s other engineering teams to leverage the infrastructure products and platforms we create easily. Braze operates at a massive scale with over 3.3 billion monthly active users across our customers, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end-users daily. We use a diverse technology stack rooted in Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, and more. - Build, optimize, and manage foundational systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud resources (e.g., EC2, S3)
- Develop automation frameworks for provisioning and maintaining infrastructure at scale
- Design scalable architectures to support seamless operations of platform services
- Ensure Reliability and Performance:

- Implement high-availability and fault-tolerant infrastructure strategies
- Collaborate with Platform Software Engineers and Product teams to establish and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for infrastructure components
- Continuously monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to meet evolving demands
- Incident Response and Resilience:

- Be part of a PagerDuty rotation to respond to infrastructure-related incidents
- Implement failover strategies, backups, and disaster recovery plans to mitigate risks
- Conduct root cause analyses and retrospectives to improve system resilience
- Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:

- Partner with Platform Software Engineers to integrate infrastructure with service abstractions and APIs
- Document processes, tools, and best practices to streamline development and operations
- Share expertise and mentor team members to foster a culture of operational excellence
- Innovate and Automate:

- Stay ahead of emerging trends in infrastructure technology and integrate innovative solutions
-  Reduce manual tasks by developing automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and maintenance
- Optimize for performance, security, and scalability in all aspects of infrastructure design

- Proven expertise with Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and configuration management tools
- Skills:

- Strong understanding of network architecture, security, and performance tuning
- Familiarity with containerization, service discovery, and load-balancing technologies
- Have an excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and expectations at once
- Mindset:

- Focused on building robust, scalable systems that enhance developer productivity
- Collaborative and communicative, with a strong desire to document and share knowledge
- Committed to continuous improvement, staying ahead of technological advancements
- Have an urge to collaborate, document, and deliver quickly

- Delivering fast to delight our customers–even internal ones

About Kirkland & Ellis

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

What You’ll Do

Are you passionate about building and operating secure, scalable AI platforms that power real-world innovation?

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll play a key role in shaping and supporting a modern AI platform within the Information Technology team, specifically the AI Infrastructure group. You’ll help ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of shared AI services, enabling engineering and automation teams to deliver impactful solutions efficiently. Working closely with Cloud Engineering and other technology partners, you’ll contribute to a high-performing, enterprise-grade environment supporting advanced AI capabilities across the firm.

  • Platform Build & Configuration: Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or Bicep, maintain standardized Azure environments, and manage core services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure AI Search.
  • Cloud Environment Management: Configure and maintain networking (private endpoints, hub-and-spoke architecture, network security groups), identity and access (Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity), and secrets (Azure Key Vault) aligned to security best practices.
  • Operational Monitoring & Reliability: Monitor platform health using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics; respond to alerts, troubleshoot incidents, and support on-call rotations to maintain service continuity.
  • Capacity & Performance Optimization: Manage quotas, scaling, and performance for AI services while supporting capacity planning aligned to business growth.
  • Change & Release Enablement: Execute platform updates, maintenance, and upgrades using established change management processes while supporting onboarding of new AI workloads.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce security controls, governance policies, and Responsible AI practices; remediate vulnerabilities and support audit and compliance reporting.
  • Cost Management & Optimization: Drive visibility into platform usage and costs, ensuring proper tagging, rightsizing, and efficient resource allocation.
  • Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures while contributing to platform enhancements and roadmap evolution.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, along with relevant Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator Associate or similar).
  • Experience: 4–6 years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability roles, including at least 3 years working with Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience managing Azure services, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes (AKS), and enterprise cloud environments with a focus on reliability and scalability.
  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting capabilities in Python and PowerShell to support automation, tooling, and operational efficiency.
  • Networking & Identity: Solid understanding of enterprise networking, access management, and secure cloud architecture.
  • Monitoring & DevOps Practices: Experience with observability tools, CI/CD pipelines, and modern deployment practices, including GitOps and policy-as-code.
  • AI Platform Exposure: Familiarity with Azure-based AI services and platform-level considerations such as capacity management, content controls, and governance.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams while translating complex technical concepts into practical outcomes.
  • Operational Excellence Mindset: Experience in incident response, on-call support, and continuous improvement within production environments.

If you’re excited to help build and operate cutting-edge AI infrastructure, collaborate with high-performing teams, and drive meaningful platform innovation in this AI Infrastructure Engineer role, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in Chicago. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range

Chicago: $133,000 - $166,000

How to Apply

Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now."

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others at Kirkland.

descriptionHtml:
About Fervo Energy

Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America’s most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.

Position Description

The Senior Cloud Engineer builds, automates, and operates Fervo’s Azure-native cloud platform, turning architectural designs into repeatable, well-governed infrastructure. The role centers on infrastructure as code, GitHub-based delivery, self-service platform capabilities, and automated configuration of Linux and Windows systems. Success requires hands-on engineering, demonstrated coding ability, and the discipline to manage infrastructure through version-controlled, peer-reviewed practices rather than manual change.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure as Code & Delivery

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep) and reusable modules to provision Azure resources consistently across environments and sites.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and enforce GitOps workflows where changes flow through version control, pull requests, and peer review.

Platform Engineering & Self-Service

  • Build and iterate golden paths and self-service capabilities, with guardrails codified as policy to keep provisioning within security, cost, and tagging standards.
  • Document platform capabilities so internal teams can consume them without one-to-one engineering support.

Systems Configuration & Fleet Management

  • Manage Linux and Windows configuration through automation—Ansible and SUSE Manager (or equivalent) for Linux; Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy for Windows—rather than manual, host-by-host changes.
  • Maintain baseline images and standards so new hosts, including field and edge compute, are provisioned in a known, compliant state.

Operations, Security & Compliance

  • Operate Azure landing zones and platform services within an Entra ID / Zero Trust model, with observability across monitoring, logging, alerting, and cost.
  • Ensure changes flow through auditable pipelines supporting SOX ITGC, and apply NERC CIP-aligned controls where platform components support in-scope systems.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8 years in infrastructure support or engineering with demonstrated progression.
  • 6+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, or platform engineering.
  • Production experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep), including reusable modules and state management.
  • Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD or similar product.
  • Demonstrated coding ability in Python and/or PowerShell, evidenced by repositories or work samples.
  • Experience managing both Linux and Windows systems through automation (e.g., Ansible, Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy).

Preferred

  • Platform engineering experience: internal developer platforms, golden paths, and self-service provisioning.
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience; Azure remains the primary platform.
  • SUSE Manager (or equivalent, such as Red Hat Satellite) and Microsoft Intune at scale.
  • Policy-as-code (Azure Policy, Open Policy Agent) and secrets management (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
  • Regulated-sector experience and familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or NERC CIP.
  • Certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

Location

Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position will be eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in-office presence at our Houston office will be required.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer-paid basic life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match
  • Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave
  • Family-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot
  • A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses
  • An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care
  • Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo’s Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as LTI and bonus opportunities for eligible roles

Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change.

Our Workplace

Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

Job Description

Designs, implements, and manages enterprise cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Ensures cloud and supporting Windows infrastructure is reliable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with architecture and operational standards. Applies advanced technical judgment to evaluate design options, resolve complex issues, automate operations, and recommend improvements across cloud, container, networking, security, and infrastructure services. Partners with development, security, and IT teams and provides technical guidance, documentation, and project support for enterprise initiatives.

  • Designs, deploys, manages, and optimizes GCP infrastructure and core services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC networks, load balancing, Cloud CDN, and related platform components, to meet availability, scalability, performance, and cost requirements.
  • Designs and supports Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) environments and collaborates with development teams to integrate, deploy, and operate applications using reliable container and cloud architecture practices.
  • Leads or contributes to cloud and infrastructure projects, manages assigned milestones and stakeholder communications, maintains technical and operational documentation, and provides technical guidance and support to IT team members.
  • Investigates and resolves complex cloud, server, networking, and platform incidents; evaluates possible causes and recovery options, coordinates escalation when needed, and supports backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Designs, administers, and troubleshoots Windows Server and Active Directory services that support cloud and enterprise infrastructure, including integration, authentication, availability, and operational support requirements.
  • Monitors cloud infrastructure, logging, capacity, performance, reliability, and cost using GCP tools and Datadog; analyzes trends and exceptions and recommends or implements corrective and optimization actions.
  • Automates cloud and infrastructure operations using infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Jenkins, or similar technologies to improve consistency, security, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

• Preferred: Google Cloud Professional, Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or other relevant Google Cloud certification.

• Preferred: Datadog certification or demonstrated hands-on experience with Datadog monitoring and logging.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or platform engineering experience, including at least 3 years working with Google Cloud Platform.

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or comparable enterprise Kubernetes platforms.

• Preferred 8 years of progressively responsible cloud and infrastructure engineering experience in an enterprise environment.

• Preferred 8 years experience supporting Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, security, automation, CI/CD, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.

• Strong knowledge of GCP architecture and services, including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and Cloud Pub/Sub.

• Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, cloud networking, identity and access management, encryption, security controls, compliance requirements, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.

• Ability to analyze ambiguous or complex technical issues, compare alternatives, assess risk and operational impact, and make or recommend sound architecture and troubleshooting decisions.

• Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Bitbucket, Datadog, or similar tools.

• Knowledge of DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including integrating security and operational controls into automated delivery pipelines.

• Familiarity with GCP database services, including Cloud SQL, Spanner, AlloyDB, Bigtable, and BigQuery.

• Strong project management, documentation, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage milestones, communicate with stakeholders and management, and provide technical guidance.



Additional Information

• Primarily office-based in Frisco, Texas, with extended periods of computer use.

• Expected to work in the office five days per week, with up to three flexible remote days per month in accordance with company policy.

• Requires occasional work outside normal business hours, including weeknights and weekends, to support maintenance, incidents, releases, or project activities.

• May require participation in scheduled on-call or escalation support based on business needs.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

**Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.**

descriptionHtml:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

Knack Works is seeking a qualified and highly motivated DevOps engineer to support the design, implementation and maintenance of our infrastructure in the Chantilly, VA office. The role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing, configuring, and maintaining computer systems, servers, networks and IT infrastructure to ensure high availability, security and reliable operation.

Duties/Task And Responsibilities

  • Proficient with Windows and Linux systems
  • Manage systems hardware and software infrastructure for both on prem and in the cloud
  • Provide hardware and software support for users, customers and personnel
  • Collaborate with a team of engineers to design, implement and test features and functionality to support Knack Works’ high-performance computing products
  • Support the development of system documentation
  • Develop and define techniques and tools to support the most efficient solution to meet program needs
  • Maintain and provide technical expertise in all areas of hardware, software and networking
  • Ability to troubleshoot systems, performance, and security issues
  • Perform hardware and software installation, cabling coordination, and basic networking
  • Follow change management and implementation best practices
  • Collaborate with systems, security, and support teams as needed
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Powershell, C#, C++, XML, JSON, etc)
  • Execute and coordinate the end-to-end remediation of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, including analysis, patching, mitigation, and validation.
  • Deploy, upgrade and manage containerized applications in a Kubernetes Cluster
  • Build containerized applications to include building containers, writing helm charts, and testing helm deployments in Dev and Test Kubernetes Clusters
  • Automate infrastructure tasks using tools such as Ansible, Python or Bash


Here's what you'll need

Clearance

Current active TS/SCI

2-5 years of hands-on Windows Server OS and Linux system administration experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Solid understanding of

  • Windows OS
  • Linux
  • Experience with installation and implementation of hardware, software and networking equipment
  • Familiarity with common hardware vendors (e.g., HP, Dell, etc.) and cloud providers (e.g. AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Good communication and collaborations skills with the ability to work in a team environment
  • Experience with LAN/WAN operations and protocols
  • Experience working in development and operational environments
  • Current active TS with SCI eligibility and willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Ability to obtain a CompTIA Security+ CE certification within the first 6 months of employment
  • Experience working in development and operational networking environments


Desired Requirements

  • A valid CompTIA Security+ CE certification


Experience With

  • System monitoring tools
  • Exposure to cloud networking (AWS, Azure or similar)
  • Experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environments


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to grow
  • Hands-on exposure to real-world network projects
  • Supportive team environment with mentoring
  • Competitive salary and outstanding benefits package
  • Training and certification support


Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and Profit-Sharing Plan (PSP) which includes both PSP contributions and an optional 401(k) plan (available immediately (i.e., no deferment or wait period), and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $120,000.00 to $150,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on November 10, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

Onsite employees are expected to attend a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of their role.

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Position Summary

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) seeks a Infrastructure Engineer to support, secure, and modernize enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, data center, server, identity, network, wireless, backup, and Microsoft 365 environments. This role is responsible for maintaining system availability, performance, reliability, and security; troubleshoots complex issues; improves automation and disaster recovery readiness; and partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application, and business teams. The Cybersecurity team defines and approves security policy, while this role implements, operates, and maintains approved controls. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings a modern infrastructure mindset, and is passionate about cloud, automation, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Systems, Cloud, and Identity: Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, SQL databases, Microsoft 365 integrations, and related hybrid services.
  • Virtualization and Patching: Manage Nutanix Acropolis provisioning, capacity, and performance. Perform server patching, operating system upgrades, and security updates through scheduled change controls and defined patching service levels.
  • Security Platforms: Experience administering secure web gateways, zero-trust access, endpoint security, or enterprise security platforms. Implement approved security baselines, vulnerability remediation, access controls, endpoint hardening, and incident-response support in coordination with Cybersecurity.
  • Network and Wireless: Configure and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, NAT, threat-prevention features, Arista and Cisco switches, VLANs, routing, spanning tree, port security, QoS, firmware, and Aruba wireless controllers, access points, SSIDs, guest access, and RF performance.
  • Backup, Recovery, and Availability: Manage Commvault backup scheduling, monitoring, disaster recovery planning, recovery testing and restoration activities. Maintain and continuously improve disaster recovery readiness to ensure critical systems can be recovered within defined recovery objectives. Proactively identify and remediate system, network, security, performance, and capacity issues before business impact.
  • Automation and Monitoring: Automate recurring tasks with PowerShell and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform. Review alerts, monitor infrastructure health and performance trends, establish operational baselines, and improve service reliability.
  • Projects and Documentation: Support infrastructure projects, migrations, upgrades, cloud adoption, network vendor consolidation, and platform standardization from planning through implementation. Maintain procedures, diagrams, inventories, and technical standards.
  • Support and Collaboration: Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support, work with outside vendors, communicate technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders, and participate in the on-call rotation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
  • Five or more years of experience as a Systems Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer, or similar enterprise infrastructure role.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, SQL databases, Microsoft server technologies, and enterprise infrastructure operations.
  • Hands-on knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, firewall administration, enterprise security principles, PowerShell automation, and monitoring and alerting platforms.
  • Experience administering secure web gateway, zero-trust access, or similar security platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, documentation, collaboration, vendor-management, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Nutanix Acropolis, Microsoft Azure administration, hybrid cloud connectivity, Commvault, Palo Alto Networks, Arista or Cisco switching, and Aruba wireless infrastructure.
  • Experience with infrastructure migrations, network vendor consolidation, platform migrations, or multi-vendor-to-standardized-platform transitions.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Zscaler Certified Administrator, Commvault, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Cisco CCNA, or Aruba credentials.

Work Environment and Additional Requirements:

  • On-site presence at NAR's DC office three days per week.
  • Participation in a scheduled on-call rotation and approved evening or weekend maintenance windows.
  • Occasional lifting and handling of data center hardware and equipment.
  • Ability to travel up to 5% for business, training, or project-related activities.

Compensation: $120,000- $135,000

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.

Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation. It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

descriptionHtml:
Join Our Team at Kaukauna Utilities!


Kaukauna Utilities is seeking a skilled and motivated Infrastructure Engineer to help design, strengthen, and modernize the technology infrastructure that supports our electric and water utility operations.


This position plays an important role in ensuring our IT and operational technology (OT) systems remain reliable, secure, and resilient. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing long-term infrastructure solutions, and working collaboratively across teams to support critical utility services.


What You'll Do

As our Infrastructure Engineer, you will take an active role in designing, implementing, and improving the technology systems that support our organization. Key responsibilities include:




  • Infrastructure Design & Engineering: Design and improve enterprise networks, servers, virtualization, storage, and related infrastructure to support reliability, performance, and security.




  • Infrastructure Security & Reliability: Design and maintain secure, reliable infrastructure through network segmentation, system configurations, and infrastructure improvements that support operational continuity.




  • Systems & Cloud Technologies: Support identity and access management, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and other enterprise platforms and cloud services.




  • Resiliency & Disaster Recovery: Develop and improve backup, recovery, redundancy, and disaster-recovery capabilities to maintain critical services.




  • Infrastructure Projects & Modernization: Lead and support infrastructure upgrades, migrations, technology evaluations, and long-term lifecycle planning.




  • Collaboration & Technical Support: Work closely with IT, OT, Cybersecurity, Operations, and external partners to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions.




What We're Looking For


  • Bachelor's or associate degree in information technology, cybersecurity, networking, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.




  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT infrastructure, networking, systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field.




  • Experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure solutions.




  • Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, servers, virtualization, identity and access management, backup and recovery, and Microsoft cloud technologies.




  • Ability to manage multiple projects, solve complex technical problems, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.




  • Experience in a utility, industrial, public-sector, or critical-infrastructure environment is a plus.




  • Valid Wisconsin driver's license.




Why Kaukauna Utilities?

At Kaukauna Utilities, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the technology systems that help deliver safe and reliable electric and water services to our community.


You'll join a collaborative team where your technical expertise, ideas, and problem-solving skills will contribute directly to the reliability, security, and future of our utility operations.



Kaukauna Utilities is committed to maintaining a safe, reliable, and productive workforce. As a condition of employment, candidates who accept an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check and drug screen.

Why WWT?

At World Wide Technology, we work together to make a new world happen. Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. WWT is dedicated to achieving its mission of creating a profitable growth company that is also a Great Place to Work for All. We achieve this through our world-class culture, generous benefits and by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients.

Founded in 1990, WWT is a global technology solutions provider leading the AI and Digital Revolution. WWT combines the power of strategy, execution and partnership to accelerate digital transformational outcomes for organizations around the globe. Through its Advanced Technology Center, a collaborative ecosystem of the world's most advanced hardware and software solutions, WWT helps clients and partners conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology solutions for the best business outcomes and then deploys them at scale through its global warehousing, distribution and integration capabilities.

With over 12,000 employees across WWT and Softchoice and more than 60 locations around the world, WWT's culture, built on a set of core values and established leadership philosophies, has been recognized 14 years in a row by Fortune and Great Place to Work® for its unique blend of determination, innovation and creating a great place to work for all.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

What is the Government Services Team and why join?

Our Government Services team provides cleared resources with a global reach to federal civilian, Department of Defense (DoD), and intelligence community markets. We excel at delivering innovative, operationally ready, and cost-effective IT solutions that accelerate the interoperability and resiliency of mission-critical systems.

What will you be doing?

WWT is looking for an Infrastructure & Cluster Engineer to own the health, performance, and day-to-day operations of a high-performance compute environment supporting a federal intelligence community customer. You’ll be the person responsible for keeping a dedicated GPU compute cluster running at peak performance, ensuring the platform is stable, secure, and ready for the AI/ML workloads running on top of it. This is a hands-on infrastructure role where your work directly enables mission-critical technology integration and performance engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle of a customer compute cluster: Linux OS administration, hardware health monitoring, patching, firmware updates, and system upgrades
  • Manage workload scheduling and resource allocation across the cluster using Run:AI, ensuring GPU-intensive AI/ML jobs are distributed efficiently and without contention
  • Tune system performance across the hardware, OS, and network layers to maximize compute throughput and minimize bottlenecks for customer workloads
  • Administer high-speed networking infrastructure, including supporting the deployment and ongoing management of InfiniBand GPU-to-GPU fabric to reduce latency for distributed compute operations
  • Manage enterprise storage solutions and ensure data throughput meets the demands of large-scale processing pipelines
  • Work alongside technology integration teams to stand up environments, dependencies, and container platforms (Red Hat OpenShift) for customer model deployment
  • Maintain compliance with federal security standards, enforce access controls, and support system accreditation requirements
  • Write and maintain automation scripts (Bash, Python) to streamline routine cluster maintenance and reduce manual intervention

,

Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain CI Polygraph
  • 5+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration and infrastructure management, with direct experience in high-performance computing environments
  • Strong experience managing bare-metal servers, enterprise storage arrays, and advanced networking configurations, including InfiniBand
  • Proficiency with workload managers and AI orchestration tools (Run:AI, SLURM, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration at scale, specifically OpenShift or Kubernetes
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues across hardware, networking, and OS layers
  • Scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) applied to infrastructure operations

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with parallel file systems and high-throughput storage architectures
  • Background in engineering or managing GPU-to-GPU communication topologies for distributed AI/ML workloads

Want to learn more about Government Services? Check us out on our platform: https://www.wwt.com/public-sector https://www.wwt.com/government-services

Preferred locations: Springfield, VA

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including shift, location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position

in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base pay.

The well-being of WWT employees is essential. So, when it comes to our benefits package, WWT has one of the best. We offer the following benefits to all full-time employees:

  • Health and Wellbeing: Health, Dental, and Vision Care, Onsite Health Centers, Employee Assistance Program, Wellness program
  • Financial Benefits: Competitive pay, Profit Sharing, 401k Plan with Company Matching, Life and Disability Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off: PTO and Sick Leave (starting at 20 days per year) & Holidays (10 per year), Parental Leave, Military Leave, Bereavement
  • Additional Perks: Nursing Mothers Benefits, Voluntary Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Discount Program

We strive to create an environment where all employees are empowered to succeed based on their skills, performance, and dedication. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for All! ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our Client is a global specialty insurance organization offering a broad range of insurance solutions across international markets. With a long-standing record of growth, stability, and industry expertise, Our Client combines innovation, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial mindset to help customers confidently pursue opportunities and manage complex risks.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Client is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support and optimize the on-premises and cloud infrastructure powering critical business systems. This role will help strengthen infrastructure reliability, resilience, performance, and scalability while advancing automation through Infrastructure-as-Code and supporting monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the server lifecycle, including installation, upgrades, decommissioning, and ongoing support for VMware vSphere, vCenter, Windows, and Linux systems
  • Administer Distributed File Systems and vSAN storage platforms
  • Plan and execute infrastructure patching and version upgrades
  • Perform root-cause analysis for infrastructure-related incidents and implement appropriate resolutions
  • Participate in infrastructure design and documentation while collaborating across teams on major enterprise projects
  • Implement operating system improvements that enhance reliability, performance, and scalability
  • Support and maintain Rubrik backup and recovery systems
  • Ensure data integrity through appropriate software and hardware controls
  • Provide technical support for remote access technologies and Windows Active Directory administration
  • Contribute to business continuity initiatives through disaster recovery planning and cross-site replication support
  • Perform scheduled hardware maintenance and manage third-party application environments
  • Serve as second-level escalation support for desktop and infrastructure issues
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for off-hours support

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum of five years of progressive, hands-on experience in systems engineering or systems administration
  • Experience managing VMware environments, including vSphere and vCenter
  • Experience administering Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025
  • Experience working with major Linux distributions, including Red Hat, Ubuntu, and CentOS
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Active Directory, Citrix, MECM/SCCM, MS-SQL, and IIS
  • Strong troubleshooting skills within multi-site, mixed-technology enterprise environments
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and technologies, including TCP/IP, routing, and switching
  • Knowledge of remote access technologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong analytical and organizational capabilities
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office applications

BENEFITS

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental benefits effective on the date of hire
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing professional development opportunities
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with a 6% company match
  • 20 days of paid time off
  • Two floating holidays
  • Approximately 11 paid holidays
  • Volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to a comprehensive wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • Opportunity to perform meaningful work within a collaborative and innovative organization

descriptionHtml:
About Shamrock Trading Corporation

Shamrock Trading Corporation is a family of brands that has been serving the transportation and logistics industries since 1986. Shamrock offers factoring solutions, export financing, third-party logistics, a fuel card program and trucking technology.

Shamrock’s mission since the start has been to create value and success for our customers, our partners and our people. Strong ethics, dedication to our customers and close attention to the marketplace are critical to the success and growth of the Shamrock brands. Shamrock is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, with multiple offices throughout the U.S. Overland Park is a great place to live, work and play, being conveniently located within driving distance of everything Kansas City has to offer. Housed within the heart of Overland Park, our offices include 4 gorgeous towers on the East and West sides of Metcalf Ave. With a heavy community presence and a winning culture, Shamrock is a great place to work in Overland Park!

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Our award-winning culture is a testament to our commitment to growth, recognition and empowerment. From day one, we prioritize employees first, encouraging them to think and act like owners and providing endless opportunities for growth and self-development, both personally and professionally. Shamrock has been recognized as one of America’s 2025 “Most Loved Workplaces” by Newsweek.

Benefits

At Shamrock, we hire bright, ambitious people and give them the tools they need for a successful, long-term career here. Shamrock also offers a premier set of benefits for employees and their families:

  • Training and Development: Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Medical: Fully paid healthcare, dental and vision premiums for employees and eligible dependents, and gym benefits
  • Financial: Generous company 401(k) contributions and employee stock ownership after one year
  • Work-Life Balance: Competitive PTO and fully paid time off opportunities to volunteer within your community

Regular onsite attendance is an essential function of this position. The role requires direct collaboration with cross-functional teams, real-time problem-solving, and timely responses to customer and operational needs. As a customer-facing position, onsite presence facilitates efficient communication with colleagues and subject matter experts, enabling effective service delivery and faster resolution of customer inquiries and issues. The role also requires participation in team meetings, operational processes, and occasional onsite trainings that are critical to achieving customer service objectives.

About The Role

Shamrock is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer that will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our organization's systems infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security. This position is responsible for driving change in technology through advanced communication skills, automation skills, and the ability to make recommendations around future architecture. 

What You’ll Do

  • Design, deploy, and proactively maintain cloud technologies, on-premises systems, and other related technologies using Infrastructure-as-Code principles, to ensure maximum uptime and security.
  • Lead and execute troubleshooting exercises to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Work effectively with other teams within the Technology department and 3rd party vendors.
  • Lead technical project planning and ensure milestones/tasks are completed on time.
  • Provide peer review for change requests ensuring they meet our technical standards.
  • Efficiently prioritize triage issues; perform root cause analysis.
  • Take the initiative to improve our operations and stay educated on the latest relevant technologies.
  • Implement automations to improve engineer and end-user efficiency.
  • Consistently follow organizational policies, such as access, change, incident, and problem management.
  • Take part in the development of technical processes and documentation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and be onsite as needed.
  • Other duties, as needed.

What You’ll Bring

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or evidence of exceptional ability.
  • 5+ years of experience in Active Directory administration and troubleshooting.
  • 5+ years of experience in automation of tasks via PowerShell and SCCM.
  • 5+ years of experience in VMWare patching and administration.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and administering production systems in AWS.
  • Deep understanding of data center architecture, maintenance, and repair.
  • Deep understanding of Windows Server operating systems.
  • Advanced experience with application virtualization technology (Citrix and RemoteApp).
  • Advanced production experience administering backup systems.
  • Advanced production experience administering monitoring systems.
  • Some experience with Linux administration.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must possess a passion for technology, the ability to learn new skills quickly, and the ability to mentor junior team members.
  • Must possess initiative and analytical skills to resolve issues before they become critical.
  • Must possess strong people skills and the ability to work as a team member, collaborating and partnering with internal and external team members to address issues.
  • Must be self-motivated, able to respond quickly when on-call, and willing to work outside the core area.
  • Administration experience: Nutanix, Pure Storage, Rubrik, Zabbix 
  • Deployment experience: Terraform, Git, Ansible, AWX, Jenkins 
  • Preferred VMware VCP certified 

Apply Today!

We’re so excited to connect with you! If you want to work with forward-thinking people in an award-winning culture, submit your application today.

Having trouble submitting your application? Contact us at Recruiting@shamrocktradingcorp.com for support.

Overview

At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours. Ready to write your story?

Join MoFo as a Senior Cloud Systems Engineer on our Information Technology team!

This role can be based in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, San Diego, Austin, New York, Boston or Washington D.C.

https://www.mofo.com/offices

About The Role

The Senior Cloud Systems Engineer is responsible for the architecture, engineering, security, and operation of the Firm’s Microsoft Azure environment and Microsoft Entra identity platform. This individual will serve as a senior technical authority for Azure landing zones, governance, networking, and resiliency, and for Microsoft Entra ID identity and access management, including Conditional Access, authentication, privileged access, and application integration. They will manage cloud endpoint and virtual desktop services, including Microsoft Intune and Azure Virtual Desktop. They will lead cloud infrastructure projects from conception through Firm-wide deployment, automating build and operations through infrastructure as code and scripting.

Microsoft Azure Platform Engineering

  • Architects and maintains the Firm’s Microsoft Azure environment, including landing zones, management group hierarchy, and subscription design, in alignment with the Cloud Adoption and Well-Architected Frameworks.
  • Establishes and enforces cloud governance through Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), and naming and tagging standards; remediates non-compliance across all subscriptions.
  • Designs, builds, and supports Azure infrastructure and platform services, including virtual machines and scale sets, App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, and Key Vault.
  • Engineers Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke topology, network security groups, private endpoints, Private DNS, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute, and Azure Front Door with Web Application Firewall.
  • Builds and maintains hardened, standardized virtual machine images with Azure VM Image Builder and Azure Compute Gallery; keeps Azure-hosted servers patched through Azure Update Manager.
  • Designs for resiliency using availability zones, paired regions, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery; performs backup, restore, data migration, and disaster recovery testing.
  • In partnership with Information Security, implements cloud security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, managed identities, Key Vault, and least-privilege access, and remediates findings.
  • Monitors platform health, performance, capacity, and cost using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Azure Cost Management; supports the Firm’s Cloud FinOps practice through rightsizing, reservations, and cost allocation.
  • Develops infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM, and/or Terraform) and PowerShell automation using Azure Resource Manager and Microsoft Graph REST APIs, delivering repeatable, self-service deployment patterns within governance guardrails.

Microsoft Entra Identity and Access Management

  • Serves as senior administrator and subject matter expert for the Firm’s Microsoft Entra ID tenant, including identity architecture, tenant configuration, and least-privilege delegated administration.
  • In partnership with Information Security, designs and maintains Conditional Access policies, including authentication strengths, device compliance, and Continuous Access Evaluation; validates changes in report-only mode before enforcement.
  • Leads the Firm’s adoption of phishing-resistant and passwordless authentication, including Microsoft Authenticator, passkeys (FIDO2), Windows Hello for Business, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Administers Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for just-in-time access to Entra and Azure roles, and maintains emergency access accounts.
  • Integrates applications with Entra ID using SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM provisioning; governs app registrations, API permissions, and consent.
  • Manages workload identities, including service principals, managed identities, and workload identity federation, and their secret and certificate lifecycles.
  • Manages hybrid identity, including Microsoft Entra Connect synchronization with Active Directory Domain Services and Microsoft Entra Kerberos, while advancing the Firm’s transition to cloud-native identity.
  • Administers identity governance, including access reviews, entitlement management, dynamic groups, and group-based licensing, as well as B2B guest access and cross-tenant access settings.
  • Investigates risky users and sign-ins with Microsoft Entra ID Protection; troubleshoots complex authentication and Conditional Access issues through sign-in and audit log analysis; automates identity tasks with Microsoft Graph.

Endpoint and Virtual Desktop Services

  • Manages Microsoft Intune for Windows and mobile endpoints, including Windows Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, security baselines, application packaging and deployment, and Windows Update for Business and Windows Autopatch.
  • Engineers and supports Azure Virtual Desktop, including host pools, session host images, scaling plans, and FSLogix profile containers on Azure Files.
  • Leads the design and support of infrastructure for AI solutions, including Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure-hosted AI services, in alignment with Firm security and information governance requirements.

Operations and Support

  • Provides Tier III support; accepts, responds to, and resolves escalated incidents on a timely basis, engaging Microsoft and other providers as needed. Monitors team incidents to ensure SLAs and OLAs are met and communicates resolution to users.
  • Participates in Problem and Knowledge Management initiatives, including root cause analysis of major incidents.
  • Adheres to departmental policies such as thorough testing and rollback plans and adherence to maintenance windows, and observes Change Management policies and procedures.
  • Works closely with Information Security, application owners, and office technology staff to maintain production, development, and test environments; provides technical guidance and mentoring to other IT analysts and engineers.
  • Prepares and maintains technical documentation, including architecture diagrams and runbooks; ensures non-technical decision makers understand technical matters.
  • Responds to after-hours escalations as needed.

About You

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent education and work experience.
  • A minimum of eight years of enterprise systems engineering experience, including at least five years engineering and administering Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory).
  • Enterprise experience (2,000+ users in multiple geographic locations) required. Large law firm experience desired.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cloud migration, modernization, or identity initiatives.
  • Microsoft certifications strongly preferred, including Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), and Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300). Additional certifications such as SC-500 (or legacy AZ-500), AZ-700, AZ-140, or MD-102 a plus.

Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Entra Expertise

  • Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Azure architecture, governance, networking, and platform services, including landing zones, Azure Policy, RBAC, hub-and-spoke networking, Private Link, and private DNS.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, passwordless authentication, Privileged Identity Management, ID Protection, identity governance, and B2B collaboration.
  • Deep understanding of modern authentication and application identity (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and workload identities) and of hybrid identity with Entra Connect, Active Directory Domain Services, and Kerberos.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Azure Virtual Desktop, and the Microsoft Defender portfolio.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting skills, including direct use of Azure Resource Manager and Microsoft Graph REST APIs; Python and Azure CLI experience a plus.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM, and/or Terraform), Git source control, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and KQL, Azure Cost Management, and core network technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, and PKI.

About Mofo

At MoFo, we collaborate as one firm, across borders, practice areas, and business functions and value fresh ideas and innovation over conformity and competition.

  • About Us: https://www.mofo.com/about
  • Inclusion + Engagement: https://www.mofo.com/community/we-at-mofo
  • Commitment to Pro Bono: https://www.mofo.com/community/pro-bono
  • The MoFo Foundation: https://www.mofo.com/culture/mofo-foundation

About Our Benefits

MoFo offers a comprehensive benefits package starting on your first day.

  • A variety of options for medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage to meet the needs of you and your family.
  • Industry-leading parental leave and family benefits including adoption and fertility treatment options and backup child and elder care.
  • Global wellness program, including free access to Talkspace and Calm apps.
  • Annual community service day to make an impact on your community and a birthday holiday just for fun.
  • Education reimbursement annually.
  • Dedicated Talent Development team.
  • Competitive annual profit-sharing contribution.

Where required by law, salary ranges are stated below. Additional compensation may include a discretionary bonus, overtime as applicable, health/welfare benefits, retirement contributions, paid holidays, and PTO. The range displayed is specifically for positions performed in those cities/states and may vary based on factors including but not limited to the following: local market data and ranges; an applicant's skills and prior relevant experience; and certain degrees, licensing, and certifications. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances.

San Francisco, Palo Alto, New York salary range: $140k to $185k

Los Angeles, San Diego, Boston, Washington D.C., salary range: $133k to $180k

For questions regarding this position, please e-mail jobs@mofo.com
