Job Description

Everforth ECS is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer - Active Directory and Windows to work in our Fairfax, VA office.

Everforth ECS is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer - Active Directory and Windows to join a team responsible for managing and maintaining multiple network enclaves to support the DoD community. A successful candidate will design, operate, Active Directory and Windows OS and improve identity and Windows Server services in a Multi-cloud environment spanning Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). This engineer will support cloud-hosted directory services, Windows workloads, and integrations with Multiple Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud environments. The role focuses on secure, reliable operations and automation across both cloud platforms. This is a demanding, high-energy position that requires innovative solutions to network, hardware, and software problems. The ideal candidate possesses excellent communication skills; is a motivated, self-starter who enthusiastically tackles operational challenges, and can quickly grasp and implement creative solutions; and is both customer-service and career growth-oriented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain cloud-hosted Active Directory Domain Services and Windows Server environments in Azure and AWS.
  • Design and support identity integrations among Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS services, Keycloak, and AppGate.
  • Manage directory objects, organizational units, group policy, DNS, domain controllers, trusts, and access controls.
  • Build, configure, patch, harden, and troubleshoot Windows Server and desktop workloads.
  • Implement and maintain identity lifecycle, authentication, authorization, and privileged access controls.
  • Monitor directory and Windows services for availability, performance, security events, and capacity.
  • Automate routine administration and configuration using PowerShell and infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Apply security baselines, vulnerability remediation, logging, and audit requirements to Windows and directory services.
  • Develop backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures for directory services and Windows workloads.
  • Collaborate with cloud, security, and application teams to plan changes, resolve incidents, and support deployments.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, diagrams, and change records.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Salary: $130,000-165,000

Benefits

General Description of Benefits

Required Skills

  • U.S. Citizen.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelors in a related field of study and 5+ years of experience. Alternatively, High School Diploma and 9+ years of relevant experience.
  • Ability to obtain DoD 8140 IAT Level II Security+ (or higher) within 60 days of hire.
  • Experience with the following:
    • Administering Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services and Windows Server in production environments.
    • Microsoft Entra ID, including synchronization or identity integration concepts, single sign-on, enterprise applications, and conditional access.
    • PowerShell scripting for administration and automation.
    • Building, maintaining, patching, and versioning standardized Windows operating system images for cloud deployments, including AWS AMIs and custom Azure virtual machine images.
    • Applying DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to Windows Server images and workloads, validating compliance, remediating findings, and documenting approved exceptions.
    • Designing, deploying, and maintaining Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments, including host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, and user access.
    • Managing AVD session host images, including image creation, updates, patching, testing, and deployment.
    • Documenting technical procedures and participating in incident and change management.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • DNS, Group Policy, domain controller management, directory replication, OU Design, Site Design, authentication, and access management.
    • Networking concepts relevant to cloud-hosted directory services, including VPCs or virtual networks, routing, firewalls, and name resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Supporting Windows workloads in at least one major cloud platform: Azure or AWS.
    • FSLogix profile containers and troubleshooting user profile, sign-in, and session issues.
  • Ability to:
    • Troubleshoot identity, authentication, Single Sign-on, Windows operating systems, and connectivity issues.
    • Monitor and troubleshoot AVD performance, availability, capacity, and user experience; experience configuring autoscaling or host-pool scaling is preferred.
  • Knowledge of AVD identity, access, and networking requirements, including Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory integration, role-based access control, and connectivity to required services.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across infrastructure, security, and application teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate solution.
  • Highly developed interpersonal and oral/written communication skills, with the ability to effectively and professionally interact with a diverse set of stakeholders (from peers to end-users to executive management).
Desired Skills

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Security Engineer, AWS SysOps Administrator, or AWS Security Specialty.
  • Experience with the following:
    • Operating Windows and directory services across both Azure and AWS.
    • AWS Managed Microsoft AD, AWS Directory Service, or Azure-hosted Active Directory Domain Services.
    • Microsoft Entra Domain Services or other managed directory offerings.
    • Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Bicep.
    • Configuration management or automation tools such as Ansible, DSC, or Azure Automation.
    • Designing highly available directory services, backup strategies, disaster recovery, and recovery testing.
  • Familiarity with:
    • AWS IAM and Azure role-based access control, including identity federation and single sign-on.
    • Cloud monitoring, security information and event management, and centralized logging platforms.
  • In-depth knowledge of, and experience with:
    • Web server administration (IIS, Apache, NGINX, etc.).
    • DevOps technologies.
    • Storage technologies and procedures.
    • Patch Management solution implementation.
    • System orchestration (Chef, Puppet, Ansible, etc.).
    • AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform.

descriptionHtml:
Infrastructure Engineer Summary:

Tenstreet is a fast-growing, market-dominating SaaS-based solutions provider to the trucking industry. Tenstreet’s platform is hosted between its own hardware within a colocation facility and multiple cloud providers. Tenstreet’s Infrastructure team handles everything necessary to manage a highly scalable and secure environment, including specifying, purchasing, implementing, administering, securing, and monitoring hardware, software, and third-party services. This position is a hybrid role.


Our infrastructure engineering team has broad expertise in on-prem and cloud architecture, performance, security, system administration, network administration and analysis, database administration, automation, incident response, troubleshooting, access control, and audit.

A perfect fit for this Infrastructure Engineer position isn’t a person who already has deep experience with every specific tool and technology we use in our environment (some of which are mentioned below).


Rather, our perfect fit is a person who has a demonstrated ability to learn, implement, and manage technologies that may be new to the person. Further, this is a person who makes sound decisions and gets stuff done. The Infrastructure Engineer works within an established framework of standards and procedures but operates with tremendous autonomy and responsibility.


As an Infrastructure Engineer you’ll be specifically responsible for:

  • On premises and cloud server and service administration, including the designing, building, monitoring, and securing of various Linux virtual servers and containers.
  • Managing our NetApp storage tier and other file servers.
  • Using tools such as Ansible Automation Platform to automate routine activities (server building and provisioning, administration activities, configuration management, etc.)
  • Working with our development and product teams to ensure the infrastructure scales and meets the needs of the business
  • Using monitoring and analysis tools such as Datadog and Wazuh IDS to collect and analyze system performance metrics for capacity planning, proactive response, and troubleshooting.
  • The application and oversight of information security controls across various operating environments.
  • Understanding and assisting in the management of our network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, and third-party services such as Cloudflare for WAF/DDOS.


More broadly, as an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Building and supporting resilient and scalable systems that achieve high availability.
  • Managing environmental and architectural changes with a mind to maximize the pace of implementation without compromising security or functionality.
  • Identifying technological and procedural impediments to Tenstreet, devising solutions to improve the company’s effectiveness.
  • Coherently communicating technical topics and concerns to a diverse assortment of internal and external audiences.
  • Administration of a variety of applications and services for both internal and external users.
  • Balancing the need to "keep things running" with allocating time to system enhancements and new strategic initiatives.
  • Mentoring or training other team members and colleagues from other roles.
  • Participating in on-call rotations.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving production issues (hardware/software/applications).


You might be a good fit as an Infrastructure Engineer if you:

  • Have demonstrated the ability to learn new technologies that may or may not be related to what you already know.
  • Make sound decisions and work well both autonomously and with a team.
  • Have at least 3-5 years’ experience in Linux systems administration, especially coming from a DevOps-oriented background.
  • Have experience with an assortment of common applications and protocols, such as Apache, MySQL, NFS, Squid, Redis, Docker, DHCP, SSH, DNS, LDAP, SMTP, etc.
  • Have some software development and scripting experience, preferably using common interpreted languages (PHP, Perl, Python, Ruby, etc.)
  • Have a knack for problem solving, asking the right questions and gathering the right data to take appropriate action.
  • Have experience with configuration management and automation tools (Ansible preferred).
  • Have a thorough understanding of networking concepts (OSI model, NAT, VLANs, packet filtering, application proxies, etc.)
  • Are comfortable working alone when necessary, hunting down answers, thinking critically and solving problems.
  • Play well with others and have learned to collaborate, disagree, compromise, and build new things with a team.
  • Can juggle multiple projects with competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Can communicate well and can walk others through complex processes and problems easily and naturally. This includes both written and verbal communications.
  • Jump at the chance to deploy automated solutions to eliminate toil.


What we’ll provide you:

  • A great compensation plan
  • A positive and generative work environment enabling you to develop your skills, collaborate with other professionals and invest in others.
  • A work community that strives to take great care of you through great benefits like health insurance, dental, vision, 401k, PTO and others.

Salary: $130,000–$150,000 annually

Employment: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Leon Recruitment is seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer to support cloud infrastructure, application deployments, automation, and daily operations for a Fortune 200 client.

This hands-on role centers on Microsoft Azure, with additional responsibilities supporting AWS environments. You’ll help deploy cloud services, troubleshoot production issues, strengthen security, and improve the reliability and efficiency of cloud resources. The position combines engineering work with operational support, including incident and service request management through ServiceNow.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage cloud infrastructure: Configure, administer, and maintain Azure virtual machines, storage, and networking resources; support AWS environments as needed.
  • Support application deployments: Work with development and infrastructure teams to deploy applications and services, troubleshoot issues, and support transitions into production.
  • Handle operational support: Investigate incidents and service requests through ServiceNow, document resolutions, and coordinate with colleagues to restore service and address recurring issues.
  • Automate routine work: Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to streamline administration, improve consistency, and reduce manual tasks.
  • Maintain security and access: Administer Windows Server and cloud identity services, including Microsoft Entra ID/Azure Active Directory, roles, permissions, and security policies.
  • Monitor and optimize: Assess cloud performance, availability, utilization, and costs; identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Support recovery readiness: Execute backup and recovery procedures in alignment with established disaster recovery plans.
  • Connect systems and maintain documentation: Support integration between on-premises and cloud environments, and maintain accurate configuration records, procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related technical role, including hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
  • Practical experience configuring and supporting cloud compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting applications or services in cloud environments.
  • PowerShell scripting skills and experience automating infrastructure or administrative tasks.
  • Experience administering Windows Server and cloud identity and access services.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and connectivity between cloud and on-premises systems.
  • Understanding of cloud security controls, including role-based access control and network security groups.
  • Experience supporting production environments and using ServiceNow for operational workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


Additional Experience Valued

  • AWS administration and troubleshooting.
  • Linux systems support.
  • Cloud monitoring, cost optimization, backup, and disaster recovery.


Work Location

This position requires onsite work in Miami or St. Petersburg, Florida, with approximately 10–20% travel.

Description

Are you experienced in managing Windows and Linux systems with a passion for building highly-available infrastructure at massive scale? Join us in driving cloud innovation and automation, deploying mission-critical systems that power global operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services designs, delivers, and operates the global infrastructure that keeps AWS running. We manage the critical data center components - from servers and networking to power and cooling - that ensure continuous service for our customers. Within this organization, the Controls Fleet team builds and supports critical infrastructure services that power the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments.

We are seeking a passionate and motivated Systems Engineer to join our team of Windows and Linux experts. In this role, you'll deploy infrastructure and build automated solutions across our growing environment. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Windows Server administration and Linux systems, hands-on experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash), and solid understanding of networking and distributed systems. Strong communication and documentation skills are essential, as you'll be collaborating closely with global teams. We value candidates who solve complex technical challenges through root cause analysis, can adapt to a fast-paced environment, and effectively communicate technical concepts. You'll make an impact by deploying and managing critical infrastructure, creating automated solutions for large-scale deployments, collaborating with teams to improve system reliability, and implementing solutions to technical challenges.

You will be working in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. You must be flexible and adapt well to a wide range of tasks and technologies.

At Amazon, it is expected that your technical knowledge demonstrates both depth and breadth. Leveraging the strengths of individual team members as peers and delegating tasks appropriately within the group for long term projects will all be critical tasks for this role. Deep knowledge of the domain and is sought after as a thought-leader across the organization. If you are passionate about technology, excited by the prospect of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, and driven to solve complex problems, we would love to hear from you.

Minimal Travel Required. You are expected to be onsite at a minimum five days a week.

Key job responsibilities

  • IT Infrastructure: Deploy, manage, and support large-scale Windows and Linux environments, including virtualization platforms and networking components
  • Automation & Development: Create and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, or Bash, focusing on scalable deployment processes and infrastructure management
  • Cloud Services: Work with AWS or similar cloud platforms to support hybrid infrastructure environments
  • System Design: Architect and implement secure, scalable solutions while considering system interdependencies and limitations
  • Problem Solving: Analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions through root cause analysis
  • Documentation & Training: Create and maintain technical documentation, develop training materials, and support team knowledge sharing
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with global teams, provide technical consultation, and support cross-functional projects
  • Security & Compliance: Identify security risks, develop mitigation plans, and participate in compliance efforts
  • Operational Support: Available for 24/7 on-call rotation and up to 20% travel

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
  • 4+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
  • 2+ years of building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments experience
  • Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
  • Experience working in 24/7 production environment

This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

descriptionHtml:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate DRW's cloud and hybrid infrastructure across a diverse multi-cloud environment, taking ownership and accountability for the reliability, security, and performance of what you deliver. This role helps ensure our cloud infrastructure is secure, highly available, and optimized to support our continued success and growth.

You will partner closely with engineering, security, networking, operations, and business teams to enable appropriate use of public cloud, private infrastructure, and hybrid architectures.

What You'll Do

  • Platform Management: Manage and evolve cloud platforms, including but not limited to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud), and Snowflake, along with the associated hybrid and on-premises dependencies required to operate them reliably.
  • Cloud Foundations: Design and maintain cloud foundations, including account/subscription/project organization, identity integration (federation, workload identity), policy guardrails, logging, tagging, and shared services.
  • Operational Excellence: Serve as the escalation point for complex production and cloud/hybrid-infrastructure issues, owning root cause analysis and holding yourself accountable for durable fixes, engaging cloud provider and partner support teams as needed.
  • Automation & Standards: Build and maintain automation, standards, reference architectures, and documentation that strengthen deployment consistency and enable teams to consume cloud services safely and consistently.
  • Integration & Collaboration: Engineer and support resilient cloud connectivity, including transit architectures and connectivity between cloud providers and on-premises environments.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Implement and improve observability across cloud services, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and capacity dashboards.
  • Stakeholder Support: Advise application and infrastructure teams on cloud, hybrid, and on-premises architecture choices based on reliability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Cost Management: Partner with Finance and Purchasing on cloud cost visibility, forecasting, and commitments, holding yourself accountable for the team's FinOps and efficiency goals.
  • Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and implement new cloud services and capabilities that improve reliability, developer experience, security, or efficiency.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience engineering and administering production cloud environments in multi-cloud and hybrid settings, with strong AWS experience, exposure to one or more of Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud), and Snowflake; and integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation, including Terraform, Python, APIs/SDKs, CI/CD, and Git.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including VPCs, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, and interconnect providers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, including IAM, encryption/key management, secrets management, and least-privilege design.
  • Experience with cloud observability, monitoring, and alerting, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex production problems while making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Understanding of cloud cost models and practical approaches to cost allocation, optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and adapt to changing technologies and business needs while working effectively across technical teams and cloud providers.
  • A proven track record of delivering secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions, with strong ownership and accountability for production outcomes.
  • Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation supporting production cloud environments.
  • Previous experience in financial services or trading environments is a plus.

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

 California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Job Summary

The City of Virginia Beach is seeking a highly skilled System Engineer to design, implement, secure, and maintain the city’s enterprise infrastructure. This role ensures the reliability, performance, and scalability of systems that support critical municipal operations and public‑service delivery. The System Engineer will work closely with IT teams, vendors, and city departments to support infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, and long‑term technology planning.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to supporting the city’s mission through resilient and secure technology systems.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Engineering & Administration

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise systems, servers, storage, and virtualization environments.
  • Manage system performance, capacity planning, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability.
  • Configure and support Windows/Linux servers, cloud services, and hybrid infrastructure components.
  • Maintain system monitoring, alerting, and performance‑optimization tools.

Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Implement and maintain security controls, patching, and hardening standards in alignment with city cybersecurity policies.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, backup strategies, and business continuity operations.
  • Ensure systems comply with municipal, state, and federal security and data‑protection requirements.
  • Conduct vulnerability remediation and collaborate with cybersecurity teams on risk mitigation.

System Integration & Technical Support

  • Integrate enterprise systems with applications, databases, and cloud platforms.
  • Troubleshoot complex system issues and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors.
  • Support automation initiatives, scripting, and configuration management to improve operational efficiency.
  • Provide Tier III technical support for escalated infrastructure issues.

Project Delivery & Collaboration

  • Participate in planning and execution of infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Work with city departments to understand operational needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
  • Contribute to technology roadmaps and long‑term infrastructure strategy.

Requirements

  • Must be a US citizen.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, OR 6 or more years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in system engineering, infrastructure administration, or enterprise IT operations.
  • Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server environments, virtualization platforms, and system monitoring tools
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or similar) and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, security principles, and system integration.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Successful background and drug screening check.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience working in local government or public‑sector IT environments.
  • Knowledge of municipal systems, public‑safety infrastructure, or enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with automation tools (PowerShell, Python, Ansible, etc.).
  • Certifications such as Microsoft (Azure/Server), VMware, CompTIA (Security+, Network+), or similar.
  • Experience supporting modernization, cloud migration, or large‑scale infrastructure upgrades.

Core Competencies

  • Technical Problem Solving
  • Infrastructure Design & Optimization
  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Security Awareness & Risk Management
  • Adaptability & Continuous Improvement
  • Public‑Service Orientation & Accountability

Physical Demands Or Work Environment

The work environment characteristics and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The majority of the time is spent in an office setting.
  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance, vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus.

About ZelTech

Founded in 1988 by Ret. Col. Jack L. Ezzell Jr., Zel Technologies is a trusted leader in national security, providing comprehensive research, development, engineering, and operational support to the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, and federal agencies. Originally focused on leveraging operational and software expertise to improve time-critical targeting capabilities for the military, the company advanced its capabilities to provide scientific and HUMINT expertise for CBRNE collection and analysis. In the wake of 9/11, Zel Technologies rapidly expanded its capabilities to provide turnkey ISR support services to US Special Operations Forces (SOF), as well as advanced technical & operational intelligence, physical & data science, and engineering support services to the greater Intelligence and SOF Communities supporting global counterterrorism and CWMD operations.

Today, Zel Technologies remains at the forefront of intelligence missions, advancing CWMD and global counterterrorism efforts, while also addressing emerging threats posed by near-peer adversaries. Our team remains committed to delivering adaptive, innovative, and cost-effective solutions across multiple domains, in alignment with the mission priorities of the U.S. Government and its partner nations.

descriptionHtml:
About impact.com:

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

The Cloud Operations Engineer will work within Impact's Data Group and is responsible for designing, scaling, and maintaining the infrastructure powering our core Data Platform. Working alongside our senior engineers, the individual will operate within a high-throughput Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment, supporting squads across the R&D organization. Key responsibilities include administrating high-volume event streaming platforms (Cloudera Kafka), optimizing distributed databases (SingleStore, Bigtable), provisioning secure application access paths, and automating deployment workflows using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. The individual will also spearhead platform observability initiatives for high-throughput data architectures—integrating telemetry, centralized logging, and proactive alerting across Kafka, SingleStore, and adjacent GCP environments—to bolster system resilience and streamline incident remediation workflows.

What You'll Do:

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Networking: Manage daily operations, networking configurations, and infrastructure projects in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Design and implement Private Service Connect (PSC) endpoints, Internal Application Load Balancers (ILBs), Serverless Network Endpoint Groups (NEGs), custom firewall rules, and DNS configurations.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Standardize and deploy all cloud resources programmatically using Terraform, managing states and pipelines across staging and production workspaces via Terrakube.
  • Access Control & Secrets Management: Securely manage project-level IAM, Google Groups access structures, and workload authorization. Implement Workload Identity Federation (WIF) for secure cross-organization data exchange and CI/CD pipelines, configure Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) for internal tools, and manage production credentials utilizing HashiCorp Vault.
  • Streaming & Distributed Data Systems:
    • Kafka (Cloudera): Administer public cloud Kafka clusters, configure topics, manage consumer groups, coordinate SASL authentication schemas, and define granular topic ACLs using Apache Ranger.
    • SingleStore & ProxySQL: Architect and scale database workspaces, optimize high-demand resource pools, configure intelligent read/write routing using ProxySQL, and monitor queries for performance bottlenecks.
    • Bigtable & BigQuery: Provision instances, define schemas, optimize storage lifecycles (including GCS bucket Autoclass policies), and manage tables using the cbt CLI.
  • Observability & Telemetry: Drive platform observability by designing and deploying OpenTelemetry (OTEL) collectors, JMX Prometheus exporters, and metrics agents. Build rich dashboards in Grafana Cloud and configure proactive alerting frameworks.
  • CI/CD & Containerization: Support continuous integration and deployment pipelines to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) using Helm charts and ArgoCD. Manage and audit automated build pipelines using Google Cloud Build and GitHub Actions.
  • Team Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional squads—including Data Enablement, InfoSec, Data Science, and MLOps—to translate business demands into highly secure, performant technical solutions. Assist internal engineering teams with infrastructure onboarding and troubleshooting.
  • On-Call & Uptime: Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to ensure continuous uptime and operational integrity of production data pipelines. Respond to and remediate system alerts via OpsGenie and Slack.

What You Bring:

  • Need to understand how an operating system works and use this knowledge to set up and configure a reliable operating system to ensure minimal or no downtime.
  • Very good knowledge of virtualization products, how they work, how to set up a virtual infrastructure and perform maintenance periodically.
  • Excellent knowledge of storage solutions and how to set up, configure and administrate the storage devices.
  • Knowledge of Network and Internet protocols (TCP, UDP and HTTP).
  • Configuration management tools (e.g. puppet)
  • Scripting languages (bash, python, ruby, etc.)
  • Experience working with Load Balancers
  • 5+ years experience working in highly available global technology infrastructure in a collaborative environment, preferably with some leadership
  • 3+ years Virtual infrastructure - Google Cloud preferred
  • 3+ years Systems and networks infrastructure, including design & architecture
  • 2+ years Database administration / SQL
  • 5+ years working in Linux System Administration
  • Leverages deep professional experience in combination with AI-driven research to accelerate best practice adoption, develop company-compliant implementation plans, and proactively identify system performance bottlenecks (including the ongoing migration of elastic query metrics to Grafana for enhanced observability).

Salary Range: $130,000 - $150,000 per year, plus an additional 5% variable annual bonus contingent on Company performance and eligible to receive a Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant. *This is the pay range the Company believes is equitable for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Office-only catered lunch every Thursday, a healthy snack bar, and great coffee to keep you fueled
  • Flexible spending accounts and 401(k)
  • Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
  • Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
  • A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
  • Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
  • Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
  • Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

Title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer

Location: Irving, Tx


Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Lead or Senior Engineer with strong experience in enterprise infrastructure, hybrid cloud, Kubernetes and OpenShift. The engineer will design, build and support scalable infrastructure and container platforms across on-premises and public cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and support hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions.
  • Work with VMware, physical servers, storage, network switches and data-center infrastructure.
  • Design and manage Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, including EKS, GKE and AKS.
  • Support microservices, serverless and stateful workloads on container platforms.
  • Implement container security, image registry and cluster lifecycle standards.
  • Support service mesh technologies such as Istio and Envoy.
  • Standardize CI/CD and GitOps processes using Argo CD or Flux.
  • Support canary and blue-green deployment strategies.
  • Improve platform availability, performance, monitoring and cost efficiency.
  • Lead technical design reviews and coordinate with cloud, DevOps, network, security and application teams.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform, systems or network engineering.
  • Hands-on experience at Senior Engineer, Lead Engineer or Technical Lead level.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise environments and modernization programs.
  • Strong communication, documentation and technical design skills.
  • Ability to create technical diagrams using Visio, Draw.io or PowerPoint.
  • Experience with monitoring and IT operations tools such as Grafana, Orion, ServiceNow or BMC.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift and at least one public cloud platform: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, container security and platform automation.
  • Good understanding of high availability, capacity planning, FinOps and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Preferred Certifications

  • Red Hat certification.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).
  • TOGAF or Zachman certification is an advantage.

Key Skills

Hybrid Cloud, VMware, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, Platform Engineering, Container Security, Istio, Envoy, Argo CD, Flux, CI/CD, GitOps, FinOps, Grafana, ServiceNow.

Collaborative Culture

    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports
Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Cloud Engineering team at Euna is building the secure, reliable cloud infrastructure that powers our public applications. As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will own the design, automation, monitoring, and disaster recovery of that infrastructure while guiding junior engineers. If you want to own the cloud foundation behind critical public-facing products, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure that meets Euna's requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and performance for public applications.
  • Own cloud infrastructure projects from start to finish, partnering with development, SRE, and security teams to align with business objectives.
  • Implement automation tools and frameworks for efficient deployment and management of cloud resources.
  • Implement monitoring and alert strategies for cloud infrastructure, and take part in on-call rotations to respond to incidents.
  • Ensure cloud resources comply with industry standards and company policies for security and data protection, and manage access controls.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and control cloud costs without compromising performance or security.
  • Guide and develop junior cloud engineers, and write clear documentation and diagrams that explain complex systems.

What You Bring

  • You have 8+ years in cloud computing, with deep AWS expertise across services such as EC2, S3, RDS, EKS, ECS, and Lambda.
  • You bring extensive experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native tools like CloudFormation, ARM, and Terraform.
  • You are proficient in at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and in Git version control with GitHub, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.
  • You have a SaaS background across multiple product lines, with proficiency in CDN technologies and a solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
  • You solve problems analytically and communicate well, working across departments and with external parties.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Expertise in Azure, and expertise in GCP as an additional plus
  • Experience in cloud security and StateRAMP certification
  • Previous experience with Jira
  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer certification, or equivalent

Location

This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our Atlanta, GA office.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's What That Actually Looks Like

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

🧘 Eunafier Days

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

🤝 Philanthropy Time

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

🎉 Real connection at scale

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

📈 Room to grow

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

About Euna Solutions

Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit www.eunasolutions.com. Euna's privacy policy is available here.

Please visit our website: https://eunasolutions.com/careers/ and check out our LinkedIn Pages https://www.linkedin.com/company/eunasolutions/

We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

For any inquiries or requests regarding accessibility at Euna Solutions, please email recruiting@eunasolutions.com or call our office at 1.877.707.7755. Upon request, appropriate accessible formats or arrangements will be provided as soon as practicable.

Job Title: Infrastructure/System Administrator SME

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of intelligence systems? CACI is seeking a talented Infrastructure/System Administrator SME to join our team in Sterling, VA. In this role, you'll design cutting-edge system architectures for new and existing computer systems, coordinating all aspects of development including design, modeling, security, integration, and testing. Your expertise will be crucial in achieving project milestones and developing innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. Join us at CACI and be part of a team that's pushing the boundaries of technology in support of our nation's intelligence capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Support the design, security and maintenance across the cloud and hybrid/cloud computing environments that power our software development lifecycle.
  • Act as a critical bridge between system operations and development teams, managing a robust infrastructure that spans AWS cloud services and on-premises data centers.
  • Manage a highly available, scalable, and automated environments, ensuring developers have the secure access, CI/CD tools, and computing resources they need to build, test, and deploy code efficiently.
  • Perform systems design, development, and integration throughout the entire system life cycle.
  • Implement moderately complex infrastructure, including installing, configuring, testing, and maintaining operating systems, application software, and system management tools.
  • Conduct systems modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize performance and efficiency.
  • Maintain robust security measures, including backup and redundancy strategies.
  • Prepare and comprehensive documentation for processes and procedures related to engineering projects.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance (Willing and able to obtain a polygraph)
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, a relevant field or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 7 years' experience as an IT system administrator, or related experience.
  • Technical understanding of: Cloud Infrastructure: Deep expertise in AWS core services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and Systems Manager (SSM). Hybrid Networking: Proven experience configuring AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPNs, and hybrid DNS architectures. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on proficiency with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation to provision multi-environment stacks. CI/CD Platform Support: Experience maintaining and scaling the infrastructure for GitLab CI or GitHub Actions. Operating Systems & Scripting: Advanced administration of Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Windows Server environments, utilizing Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation.
  • Demonstrated proficiency as a Linux system administrator.
  • Strong scripting and coding skills, particularly in Python, or similar languages.

Desired

  • Expertise in operational support and system maintenance.
  • Familiarity with Containerization & Orchestration, managing native Kubernetes clusters and AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) or native Kubernetes clusters with Ansible automation.
  • Certifications (Preferred): AWS Certified SysOps Administrator
  • Experience with automation and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, virtual networking)

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$103,800 - $218,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

  • Deliver end‑to‑end milestones on the traffic platform, from problem definition to rollout and follow‑up, breaking complex problems into clear tasks and keeping progress and risks visible for the team and key stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of complex and sometimes ambiguous problems, analyzing options and trade‑offs, and proposing clear, pragmatic solutions that balance reliability, performance, security and effort.
  • Ensure the stability and quality of what you and the team ship: design with failure in mind, put the right tests and observability in place, and react quickly to incidents, driving follow‑ups that prevent them from happening again.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product and partner teams to understand needs, align on priorities and turn them into clear technical plans and milestones that are connected to the team’s goals.
  • Use AI and agents in an AI‑first way in your routine to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solution options and automate repetitive work, helping the squad adopt safe, effective AI workflows rather than just individual usage.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks that help other engineers understand, use and operate the traffic platform with confidence, and share knowledge through reviews, sessions and participation in function‑level initiatives.
  • Help other engineers grow by giving and receiving feedback through code reviews, design discussions, pairing and day‑to‑day collaboration, acting as a reference for good engineering practices inside the team.
  • Participate in support and on‑call routines for the area, using incidents, tickets and metrics as input to suggest and drive medium‑term improvements to the platform and to how we work.

  • Operated large-scale, high-performance synchronous distributed systems in the cloud, working directly with load balancers, reverse proxies, TLS/mTLS and routing, and using metrics, logs and traces to debug issues, optimize performance and improve overall reliability.
  • Worked hands-on with Kubernetes-based infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling — defining and evolving manifests, routing and deployment strategies, and managing DNS configuration — with a solid understanding of how these pieces fit together to deliver resilient traffic paths in production.
  • Uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow, leveraging AI tools and agents to investigate issues, write and review code, explore solutions and automate repetitive work, while consistently validating outputs and holding quality and safety as non-negotiable standards.
  • Led end-to-end infrastructure platform projects from design to production go-live, breaking work into clear milestones, coordinating across stakeholders, managing risks and trade-offs, and following through post-rollout to stabilize and evolve the solution.
  • Experience with Istio or other service-mesh technologies such as Linkerd or Envoy-based solutions — or legacy stacks like Finagle — designing and evolving traffic policies, resilience features and observability for service-to-service communication.
  • Worked with AWS networking and compute primitives (ALB/NLB, security groups, VPC, Route 53, IAM) in production environments, with an understanding of how these layers interact with application traffic.
  • Hands-on experience using Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform to design, version and roll out changes to cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure in a safe, repeatable way.
  • Previously built platform capabilities or shared libraries for other engineers — abstractions, SDKs or internal tooling — that make it easier and safer for product teams to consume traffic and networking capabilities at scale.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Computing Engineer specializing in Amazon WorkSpaces to design, implement, optimize, and support our cloud-based virtual desktop environment. This role will serve as the primary technical owner for AWS WorkSpaces architecture, image management, automation, identity integration, security, monitoring, and platform operations.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across AWS WorkSpaces, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Windows endpoint management, cloud networking, automation, and authentication technologies. This individual will lead platform engineering efforts, establish operational standards, drive automation initiatives, support large-scale desktop deployments, and help evolve our virtual desktop strategy from traditional on-premises VDI solutions toward a modern cloud-based desktop platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical leadership, troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to independently own complex infrastructure initiatives from design through production support.

About The Clearing House: The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high-value wire-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country’s first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). TCH also operates a bank account number tokenization service, runs a payments association known as the TCH Payments Authority, and maintains the rules for private-sector check image exchange through its ECCHO® business line.

Key Responsibilities

AWS WorkSpaces Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale Amazon WorkSpaces environments.
  • Architect and manage AWS WorkSpaces deployments across multiple environments.
  • Develop long-term platform strategy, scalability planning, and operational standards.
  • Evaluate and implement new AWS EUC technologies and features.
  • Conduct capacity planning, performance analysis, and platform optimization.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery validation procedures.
  • Perform root cause analysis for complex platform-wide issues.
  • undefined

Image Management & Desktop Engineering

  • Build, maintain, and optimize AWS WorkSpaces custom images and bundles.
  • Create standardized gold images aligned with security and operational requirements.
  • Validate Windows updates, application patching, and security configurations before promotion to production.
  • Manage image lifecycle processes, testing procedures, rollback strategies, and release documentation.
  • Implement automation for image creation, validation, and deployment.
  • Ensure image consistency across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Establish desktop hardening standards and compliance baselines.

Identity, Directory Services & Authentication

  • Design and support integrations between AWS WorkSpaces, Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Manage AWS Directory Services and hybrid identity configurations.
  • Troubleshoot directory synchronization, computer object creation, OU placement, and authentication workflows.
  • Support hybrid identity solutions involving Active Directory, Entra Connect, and Intune.
  • Configure and maintain MFA integrations utilizing RADIUS authentication.
  • Lead initiatives to migrate legacy authentication methods toward SAML-based federation.
  • Support Single Sign-On solutions and modern authentication architectures.

Intune & Endpoint Management Integration

  • Partner with Endpoint Engineering teams to integrate AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Intune.
  • Ensure proper enrollment and management of hybrid-joined WorkSpaces devices.
  • Support application deployment, policy management, compliance enforcement, and reporting through Intune.
  • Troubleshoot device registration and management issues involving Entra ID and Intune.
  • Develop standards for cloud-hosted desktop management using Microsoft technologies.
  • Collaborate on endpoint security, patching, and configuration management initiatives.

Cloud Infrastructure & Networking

  • Administer AWS networking components supporting WorkSpaces environments.
  • Manage Route 53 DNS configurations and name resolution services.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, firewall, VPN, and DNS-related issues.
  • Work closely with network engineering teams to optimize cloud connectivity and user experience.
  • Understand VPC design, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, and routing principles as they relate to WorkSpaces deployments.
  • Support desktop access from Windows, macOS, thin clients, and mobile platforms.

Automation & Platform Engineering

  • Develop automation solutions utilizing AWS Lambda, PowerShell, Python, and AWS native services.
  • Automate provisioning, monitoring, remediation, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Create self-healing mechanisms for common platform issues.
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code standards where applicable.
  • Reduce operational overhead through orchestration and automation initiatives.

Monitoring & Operational Excellence

  • Configure and maintain CloudWatch dashboards, metrics, alarms, and logging.
  • Develop proactive monitoring and alerting capabilities.
  • Analyze performance trends and resource utilization.
  • Implement operational reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Participate in incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Drive continuous service improvements and platform optimization efforts.

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure AWS WorkSpaces environments meet security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and monitoring.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and platform hardening initiatives.
  • Participate in audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Maintain secure access standards, least privilege permissions, and identity governance controls.
  • Support logging, monitoring, and security event investigations.

Operational Requirements

  • Execute infrastructure changes under strict Change Management procedures.
  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and support guides.
  • Participate in after-hours maintenance activities as required.
  • Provide Level 3 engineering support and escalation assistance.
  • Collaborate across cloud, infrastructure, security, networking, and endpoint management teams.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of AWS engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of Amazon WorkSpaces administration and architecture experience.
  • Deep understanding of AWS WorkSpaces Images, Bundles, Directories, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.
  • Experience integrating AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Entra ID and Intune.
  • Experience supporting RADIUS MFA authentication and SAML federation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts including Route 53, DNS, VPCs, subnets, routing, and security controls.
  • Experience with AWS CloudWatch monitoring and alerting.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation experience.
  • Experience utilizing AWS Lambda for operational automation.
  • Knowledge of endpoint deployment and application delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting Windows 11 enterprise desktop environments.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Work Conditions & Expectations

  • Hybrid Schedule: 3 days onsite (Charlotte NC preferred, occasional asks to report to Winston-Salem NC as needed); remaining days remote. On-site requirement can change at any time.
  • Operational Flexibility: Ability to perform after-hours changes and participate in on-call rotations when required.
  • Dynamic Environment: Work involves frequent troubleshooting, collaboration across teams, and adapting to evolving technologies.
  • Security & Compliance: Must adhere to strict Change Management processes and participate in security reviews as needed.
  • Standard Office Setup: Role primarily uses standard IT equipment (laptops, conferencing tools, monitoring systems) with occasional interaction with server rooms or networking hardware.

Your Tasks

  • Build, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure services, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and monitoring.
  • Support cloud migrations, legacy infrastructure upgrades, automation initiatives, and modernization projects.
  • Administer and support enterprise IT infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy.
  • Implement cloud security, access management, governance controls, and operational standards.
  • Collaborate with software development, automation, cybersecurity, and global cloud teams to support deployments and resolve technical issues.

  • Hands-on cloud engineering experience, preferably with Microsoft Azure, supported by a solid foundation in enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting cloud migrations, infrastructure automation, legacy system upgrades, or other technology modernization initiatives.
  • Practical knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, networking, infrastructure troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and adapt to changing requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and developing technical capabilities as technologies and business needs evolve.

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented DevOps Engineer to join our team in Herndon, Virginia.   • Administer, secure, and maintain bare-metal servers running Enterprise Linux 8 and 10.
  • Provision, upgrade, and manage multi-cluster Kubernetes environments utilizing Rancher.
  • Deploy and manage core Kubernetes resources by developing scalable YAML manifests and Helm charts, including , including StatefulSets, Deployments, DaemonSets, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Persistent Volumes.
  • Build and maintain GitOps-driven deployment pipelines and automated cluster synchronization using ArgoCD.
  • Integrate and maintain standard CI/CD pipelines and version control workflows via Git.
  • Document all work in JIRA and Confluence

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma and 4+ years of Linux system administration experience.
  • Experience in Enterprise Linux.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Kubernetes experience, or an active Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) credential
  • 1+ years’ experience managing version control workflows, repository management, and CI/CD pipeline integrations using GitLab or Bitbucket.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or relevant technical field.
  • Experience deploying, patching, and maintaining Linux and Kubernetes infrastructure within an air-gapped network environment with zero internet connectivity.
  • Experience implementing GitOps-driven deployment pipelines and automated cluster synchronization via ArgoCD.
  • Experience configuring Kubernetes worker nodes with NVIDIA GPUs, including the installation and troubleshooting of the NVIDIA Container Toolkit, CUDA drivers, and GPU operators.
  • Experience utilizing bare-metal IPMI/iLO/iDRAC for out-of-band server hardware management, remote console/firmware management, and telemetry monitoring.
  • Experience handling multi-cluster administration, ingress control, and configuring RBAC security policies via Rancher

Clearance Requirements

  • Current/active TS/SCI with polygraph clearance is required.

Physical Requirements

  • The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
