descriptionHtml:
The Senior Systems Engineer owns and raises the standard for the core infrastructure the business runs on: virtualization, identity, patching, backup and disaster recovery, and security and audit support. The Systems and Network team runs a large, regulated hybrid environment spanning Windows and Linux servers and endpoints across on-premises VMware and Azure. This senior individual contributor serves as a technical anchor on a small team, automating repetitive work, deepening coverage across identity and core platforms, and addressing the infrastructure improvement backlog.


The role owns the on-premises server platforms, Active Directory and identity services, enterprise patching, and the backup platform, and is the systems-side owner of the IT general controls that depend on them. Windows and Linux workloads hosted in Azure are supported under standards set by the cloud platform team, which owns the Azure platform itself. Information Security owns the security tooling, vulnerability-management program, and audit findings; this role is its primary engineering partner for server-estate remediation.


World Finance (World Acceptance Corporation, NASDAQ: WRLD) has served customers’ financial needs for 60+ years through roughly 1,000 community branches. This role helps keep a stable, publicly traded business running and secure while modernizing infrastructure that matters.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own and optimize VMware (ESXi/vCenter), Windows Server, and Linux (primarily RHEL): lifecycle, performance, hardening, and uptime, plus SAN and clustered storage.
  • Own Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID, and deepen expertise and coverage across ADFS and automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning (IAM).
  • Own enterprise patching across Windows and Linux and drive it to automation through phased rings, maintenance windows, automated pre- and post-checks and rollback, and backlog clearance. Remediate vulnerability and penetration-test findings routed by Information Security. Keep IT general controls supporting SOX and audit obligations stable and audit-ready, including evidence for patching, backups, and access.
  • Own the enterprise backup platform: jobs, retention, immutable and offsite copies, and scheduled restore testing. Participate in BCP/DR exercises and audit-readiness programs.
  • Use PowerShell, Bash, and Python to automate provisioning, patching, backup validation, and reporting. Develop golden images and templates to eliminate configuration drift, with strong monitoring and alerting.
  • Build, patch, and support Windows and Linux virtual machines hosted in Azure, following the cloud platform team’s landing-zone, networking, and security standards.
  • Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot agents and server-side infrastructure for endpoint protection, vulnerability management, file-integrity monitoring, inventory, and patch management tools, in partnership with Information Security, which owns the tooling and program.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 and the email security platform.
  • Administer the managed file transfer platform: workflows, partner connections, certificates and keys, and monitoring.
  • Provide hands-on enterprise switching, firewall, and SD-WAN support as backup to the network architect.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:

  • 7+ years in Windows/Linux systems administration or infrastructure engineering, at a senior level.
  • Strong Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity (Entra ID) depth.
  • Hands-on VMware (ESXi/vCenter) and Azure experience, including virtual machines, networking, and security.
  • Enterprise patching and vulnerability remediation across Windows and Linux, including RHEL.
  • Enterprise backup platform experience, including restore testing.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Space and Intelligence Division provides professional services to the US Space Force, Combatant Commands, Intelligence Community, and NASA. Our work includes enterprise architectural assessments, systems engineering and integration, test, planning and execution, cost estimating and analysis, acquisition support, and cybersecurity. We are trusted partners developing approaches and concepts to meet emerging high priority needs, assessing cutting-edge technologies, and supporting capabilities for our National Defense. Come join the fastest growing Division at Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc.!

The Space Systems Group (SSG), part of SPA ’s Space and Intelligence Division, provides timely and objective assessments and recommendations integrating technical, operational, programmatic, policy and business analysis. We focus on our key clients in the Space community including the US Space Force’s Space Systems Command (USSF/SSC), one of the three designated Field Commands under USSF. We work tirelessly to provide integrated solutions based on information and communications throughout the chain of command. We provide clear and consistent analysis and recommendations which are aligned to strategic and leadership goals while balancing the ability to execute on time and on budget within the technical communities. Come join an organization responsible for being a key enabler of Spacepower!

SPA has an immediate need for a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer.

Responsibilities

SPA is seeking a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer to design, develop, operate, and improve the secure on-premises infrastructure supporting our platform as a service solution for Space Systems Command. This role serves as the team’s hands-on networking specialist while contributing across servers, virtualization, storage, automation, and cloud-native infrastructure. You will configure and troubleshoot enterprise networks, maintain reliable connectivity and platform services, and resolve complex issues affecting mission-critical software delivery. As a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer, the successful candidate will work alongside established platform, Kubernetes, systems, and cybersecurity engineers to sustain operational performance, strengthen security, and modernize infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate is a versatile, hands-on engineer with deep networking expertise and practical experience across Windows and Linux systems, enterprise virtualization, and infrastructure automation. Success in this role requires sound engineering judgment, the ability to independently resolve production challenges, and effective collaboration within an established engineering team.

This is a full-time, on-site position at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, working a standard five-day, eight-hour schedule with participation in rotating 24/7/365 on-call incident response.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Engineer, configure, secure, and maintain enterprise networks supporting the on-premises platform, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
  • Own network troubleshooting, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis to maintain reliable connectivity across compute, storage, and platform services.
  • Install, administer, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux servers, including system configuration, patching, access controls, and operational maintenance.
  • Support physical and virtualized infrastructure across compute, storage, and private cloud technologies, including VMware vSphere/vCenter, VMware Cloud Foundation, Azure-based systems, and enterprise storage.
  • Work closely with Kubernetes engineers to diagnose cluster networking, ingress, DNS, load balancing, and connectivity issues affecting containerized mission workloads.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code and automation using technologies such as PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Bicep, and enterprise configuration management tools.
  • Monitor and improve infrastructure health, availability, capacity, and observability to detect and prevent network and platform disruptions.
  • Troubleshoot complex production incidents spanning networking, operating systems, virtualization, storage, Kubernetes, and application infrastructure dependencies.
  • Apply secure configuration, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and change management practices in coordination with cybersecurity and platform engineering teams.
  • Execute engineering improvements that stabilize existing services, reduce operational risk, and advance infrastructure reliability and modernization.
  • Develop network diagrams, configuration baselines, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers, cybersecurity specialists, and mission stakeholders to implement integrated infrastructure solutions that support dependable software delivery.

Expected Outcomes

  • Maintain a secure, reliable, and highly available on-premises network and infrastructure foundation for mission software delivery.
  • Reduce recurring infrastructure disruptions through proactive troubleshooting, monitoring, automation, and root-cause remediation.
  • Improve network performance, platform resilience, and operational consistency across physical and virtualized systems.
  • Deliver infrastructure improvements that simplify sustainment, strengthen security, and support modernization.
  • Serve as a trusted hands-on network and infrastructure specialist within the broader platform engineering team.

Qualifications

About the Must Haves

  • Active Secret clearance at time of application
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience
  • Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience engineering and operating enterprise networks and production on-premises infrastructure
  • Current CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent Department of Defense approved Information Assurance certification
  • Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting enterprise networking, including switching, routing, firewalls, VLANs, network segmentation, and TCP/IP services
  • Demonstrated proficiency administering Windows and Linux servers, including scripting and operational troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting virtualization, compute, and enterprise storage infrastructure; familiarity with VMware vSphere/vCenter, VMware Cloud Foundation, Azure Stack Hub, or comparable platforms
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container networking with the ability to support cluster infrastructure and diagnose workload connectivity issues
  • Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code, and configuration management, including PowerShell and tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Bicep, or Microsoft Configuration Manager
  • Demonstrated ability to independently resolve production issues, document solutions, and contribute effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team

Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. California, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $160,000.00/Yr. - USD $210,000.00/Yr.

descriptionHtml:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

Atom Computing is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to enhance our software development workflows and maintain the critical infrastructure that powers our quantum computer. In this role, you’ll work across the entire stack, enabling engineers and physicists to seamlessly deploy software and operate the system with reliability and efficiency. Our environment combines both on-premises and cloud infrastructure, requiring innovative approaches to managing and scaling each. You'll collaborate closely with a talented, tight-knit team of engineers and physicists, reporting to the Software Engineering Manager.

Due to the mix of on-prem and cloud infrastructure, this role is required to be in the office in Boulder at least 3 days per week.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain a fleet of on-premise Linux servers (and a few Windows VMs) to ensure reliable and performant operation of the quantum computing environment
  • Design and implement automated workflows for managing and scaling cloud and on-premise infrastructure
  • Build and optimize monitoring, alerting, and performance metrics systems to support both development and production environments
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment efficiency



Experience & Education

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent on-the-job experience
  • 5+ years of post-degree professional experience maintaining large scale distributed systems



Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of cloud deployment and infrastructure management using Azure, AWS or GCP
  • Experience with on-premise hardware services, including virtualization and containerization management solutions such as Proxmox VE, Docker and Podman
  • Solid knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions
  • Ability to optimize and tune on-premise hardware for performance and low latency using tools such as perf, systemd-analyze, iostat, and tuning profiles
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing metrics, monitoring, and alerting pipelines using Datadog, Grafana, or other observability tools
  • Skilled in architecting infrastructure workflows with tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or Kubernetes



Nice to Haves

  • Building and scaling a developer operations team, including workflow automation, access management, and infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Having managed and optimized databases either in the cloud or on-site
  • Familiarity and experience implementing security best practices
  • Having set up or configured networks, both physical and virtual
  • Interfacing with and controlling cameras, motors, lasers, and other third party devices



Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, we offer unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The salary range for this position is between $165,000 - $200,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

descriptionHtml:
Here at ScottsMiracle-Gro there is no such thing as a typical day. Our culture is constantly energized by new and exciting growth opportunities and at a rapid pace. Below are details on an open job. If the role interests you and you would like to be considered we encourage you to apply!

Job Profile Summary

As a Senior Analyst in Cloud Computing Engineering, you will build, administer, and support Scotts Miracle-Gro’s cloud and server infrastructure. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is our primary platform, and this role places special focus on GCP Identity and Access Management (IAM).

You will bring strong Linux administration and solid Windows Server skills, along with scripting, Kubernetes/Helm, and monitoring experience. You will work closely with the Infrastructure team, application teams, and Information Security, and report to the Director, Infrastructure Operations & Services.

In this role you will:


  • GCP Engineering & Operations: Build, configure, and support GCP infrastructure — Compute Engine, GKE, VPC networking, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and load balancing — including changes, deployments, and break/fix work.
  • GCP Identity & Access Management: Administer GCP IAM across the organization, folder, and project levels — roles, custom roles, service accounts, groups, organization policies, and access reviews — using least-privilege principles.
  • Linux & Windows Administration: Patch and harden Linux servers, maintain scripts and cron jobs, manage users and passwords through Active Directory (Centrify), support NFS and CIFS/NFS interoperability, and lead in-depth Linux troubleshooting. Provide Windows Server administration support.
  • Containers & Automation: Deploy and support workloads on Kubernetes using Helm, automate server builds and configuration with Ansible and Terraform, and write Bash and Python scripts.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Configure and maintain monitoring and alerting, track infrastructure and application performance, and lead troubleshooting of performance issues.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply cloud and server security best practices and support audit and compliance requirements with Information Security.
  • Cost Analysis: Analyze cloud resource usage and costs and recommend savings.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain documentation and runbooks, and work with application teams, database administrators, and other Infrastructure teams on projects and incidents.


What you’ll need to be successful:

Required


  • Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience (bachelor’s preferred).
  • 4–7 years of infrastructure, systems administration, or cloud engineering experience.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non-technical partners.

- Amazon EKS and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) experience.

About The Role

Rightfiber is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll be responsible for evaluating, standardizing, and maintaining server operating systems, applications, management systems, element management systems, and the security for DCN and DMZ networks used in Rightfiber’s Service Provider Network. Excellent communication and project skills are needed along with the ability to evaluate new technologies and systems.

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________

What You'll Do

  • Maintains Linux, Unix, and Windows servers including Apache and IIS, MySQL and MS-SQL databases, Linux based mail server software, DNS, backup software, and other service provider applications;
  • Provides support for all Linux-hosted applications, such as BIND, Incognito Broadband Commander, Sendmail, as well as other applications not listed;
  • Works to ensure high availability, performance, and security of the VMWare and Azure Local hypervisor platforms;
  • Collaborates with Architecture and Engineering teams to support application deployment and maintenance;
  • Works to establish and deploy security standards, firewall designs, and security documentation;
  • Performs and analyzes packet captures when needed;
  • Works with server virtualization and administering/deploying various operating systems in a virtualized environment.

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Knowledge of VMWare vSphere and Azure Local hypervisor platforms, their deployment, management and upgrades;

  • Knowledge of network system design, development methods, and techniques;
  • Knowledge of network management practices and procedures;
  • Knowledge and the ability to design Layers 1, 2, and 3 of the OSI model;
  • Skill in reading and interpreting technical documents, vendor deployment guidelines, white papers and configuration manuals.

We believe our people are the foundation of our success. That's why we're committed to providing an environment where employees can build rewarding careers while making a meaningful impact.

Apply today and become part of a team that's connecting communities, creating opportunities, and shaping the future.

Stronger Together. Right For What's Next.

Journey with us! Combine your career goals and sense of adventure by joining our exciting team of employees. Royal Caribbean Group is pleased to offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, and excellent career development opportunities, each offering unique ways to explore the world.

We are proud to be the vacation-industry leader with global brands — including Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea Cruises — the most innovative fleet and private destinations, and the best people. Together, we are dedicated to turning the vacation of a lifetime into a lifetime of vacations for our guests.

The Royal Caribbean Group’s IT- Oper Exc Infrastructure Team has an exciting career opportunity for a full time Sr. Engineer, Platform reporting to the Manager, Platform Engineering.

 The position is onsite and based in Miramar, Florida.

The position is also not eligible for work authorization sponsorship.

Position Summary

Royal Caribbean Group’s IT Department seeks a highly talented and motivated Senior Platform Engineer to join our fast-pace and innovative Windows Server Technology team.

The core function of the Platform Engineering, Sr role is to provide an infrastructure for supporting many of the business's compute needs along with ancillary tooling and services. Our customers consist of various business and product teams as well as many RCG partners around the globe. The core function of the Platform Engineering team is to provide core infrastructure for a wide array of compute needs along with any supporting tools and services. Sr. Platform Engineers are provided a unique opportunity to work across a broad set of systems and are encouraged to take on cross-functional challenges and projects. This flexibility allows the team to make impact in the areas they are most passionate about while still being able to experience a broad set of disciplines providing value to RCG.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Maintain RCG’s internal, globally distributed virtual compute environment with a focus on the performance, availability, cybersecurity compliance, and business growth needs of the company.
  • Design and maintain our monitoring, reporting and capacity planning functions using RCG’s internal monitoring and data systems.
  • Design and maintain a virtualization DR strategy that integrates with RCG’s production strategies and targets.
  • Work with hardware vendors in conjunction with RCG’s own infrastructure and capacity teams to deliver a set of compute and storage strategies that align with RCG’s cybersecurity standards and lifecycle management.
  • Build effective partnerships with business and product teams along with relevant service owners to provide a first-class compute infrastructure.
  • Plan and lead the implementation of complex application and core server system designs.
  • Develop and champion efforts to improve processes through automation.
  • Defines interdependency with other disciplines and is involved in the testing and

certification processes.

  • Lead, direct, and provide technical guidance to team of systems engineers.
  • Recommend process, organizational, and system changes to support key team objectives.
  • Support, operate, and maintain computer systems and software applications.
  • Interpret, refine, and apply methods and procedures in accordance with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Information Technology industry standards and best practices as defined by Royal Caribbean Group.
  • Remain current with industry trends to conceive, prototype and recommend technical approaches for IT systems and solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Able to travel as necessary to perform required job duties.
  • Perform other duties as required. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their supervisor or management.

Qualifications

  • Expert level knowledge of Hyper-V and VMWare virtualization technology (8+ years of experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid cloud computing environments (Azure/AWS).
  • 5+ years of experience managing a Windows Server environment.
  • 3+ years working with Cisco UCS server platform.
  • 3+ years managing hyperconverged server infrastructure.
  • Experience with automation tools simplifying deployments of Windows and VMware resources to on-prem and cloud.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell.
  • 5+ years of Group Policy and Desired State Configuration authoring experience.
  • Experience with automation tools simplifying deployments of Windows and VMware resources to on-prem and cloud.
  • 3+ years hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management systems including Terraform, PowerShell Desired State Configuration (DSC), Puppet, Ansible, etc.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelors’ degree or equivalent preferred.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and customer-service skills.
  • Must possess and have proven troubleshooting skills and independently manage projects and issues.
  • Candidate should be detail oriented, organized, and the ability to multi-task.
  • Ability to demonstrate supportive relationships with peers, clients, partners, and IT leadership.
  • Must have the ability to remain professional and navigate high pressure situations.
  • Ability to retain and protect confidential material.

Experience With The Following a Plus

  • Designing, building, and managing Ai models and infrastructure.
  • Relevant VMware, Windows Server, and cybersecurity certifications are a plus. (Administering Windows Server AZ-802 preferred)
  • Ensuring compliance with cybersecurity standards in server technology and Active Directory such as CIS, NIST, etc.
  • Managing enterprise Hyper-V or other hypervisors in a stretch cluster.
  • Azure Arc hybrid and multi-cloud management.
  • Linux distribution systems.
  • Programming in Python, PowerCLI, Go, Ruby, PowerShell, BASH.
  • Understanding of multi-tiered web service architecture and SaaS model.
  • Maintaining systems in a load-balanced environment.
  • Enterprise system monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, etc.
  • Managing server systems in travel/leisure industry.

Financial Responsibilities

  • Solid understanding of accounting rules for expense and capital activities.
  • Solid understanding of IT estimation activities. May lead large/complex estimation activities.
  • Meets expectations in meeting deadline within budget, schedule and appropriate quality
  • Accountable for financial implications and cost of systems and services.
  • Responsible for defining optimization opportunities to manage expenses.
  • Create build of materials (BOMs) and review vendor quotes for services/material.

Key Traits About You

  • A team player motivated to achieve and drive business value.
  • Can influence and lead a team of talented system engineers.
  • Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage unexpected change in direction.
  • Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement.
  • Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility and a positive outlook in the face of challenges.

Physical Demands

Eventual light duty equipment lifting and carrying, standing for extended periods of time during inspections, driving between sites, pulling/pushing light duty equipment.

Work Environment

Position is hybrid based in Miramar, FL. Up to 70% international travel required.

Agency and Third-Party Submissions: Please note this is a direct search by the Company, and applications through agencies and other third parties will not be accepted, nor will fees be paid for unsolicited resumes. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered the Company's property.

We know there's a lot to consider. As you go through the application process, our recruiters will be glad to provide guidance, and more relevant details to answer any additional questions. Thank you again for your interest in Royal Caribbean Group. We'll hope to see you onboard soon!

It is the policy of the Company to ensure equal employment and promotion opportunity to qualified candidates without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, sexuality, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Royal Caribbean Group and each of its subsidiaries prohibit and will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

JOB SUMMARY: The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer I will be part of a team that manages the provisioning, monitoring, recovery, and updating of cloud infrastructure (inclusive of the automation of these functions). The individual should have the desire to continually improve the Bank's cloud infrastructure design and provide a secure and highly available computing platform. In addition, the Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will configure and maintain existing infrastructure components, implement upgrades, and utilize management tools to monitor & report on the reliability of the environment. The role will also be responsible for finding opportunities to improve the Bank's architecture using cloud and cloud-native technologies.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Participates in post-Incident reviews of all Major Incidents and assists toward determining action Items required to avoid similar issues/minimize downtime for future incidents.
  • Provides reliable, predictable deployment and maintenance of distributed systems adhering to security best practices.
  • Assists in the day-to-day operations of managing the Bank's Cloud Infrastructure Services including software deployment and upgrades, system setup, system administration, monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, configuration and change management, capacity planning, availability management, disaster recovery and routine update of services.

  • Creates and maintains automated monitoring and reporting solutions for cloud infrastructure health, performance and cost optimization.
  • Monitors cloud infrastructure to identify areas of improvement, reliability, cost savings, etc.

  • Performs configuration management, review, and governance of cloud resources, including Identity and Access management (IAM), etc.
  • Actively troubleshoots issues that arise during testing and production, identifying and resolving problems before deployment.
  • Participates in disaster recovery planning and testing.
  • Performs back-up and recovery of cloud-hosted systems.
  • Provides troubleshooting and technical support services.
  • Provides Level 2 production support.
  • Participates in routine on-call rotations.
  • Ensures and facilitates knowledge sharing within the department.
  • Maintains current knowledge of cloud trends and developments.
  • Contributes to the development of cloud standards, best practices, and organizational cloud capabilities.
  • Researches and drives adoption of cloud-native technologies.
  • Adheres to and complies with applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to anti-money laundering (i.e. Bank Secrecy Act, US PATRIOT Act, etc.).
  • Adheres to Bank policies and procedures and completes required training.
  • Identifies and reports suspicious activity.

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

Qualifications

Education

  • College degree or equivalent management/work experience (At least 2 years), which includes practical experience in Information Technology and IT Security. Experience with cloud-based enterprise infrastructure architecture and/or operations required

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience architecting, designing, developing, and implementing cloud solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience designing applications (eg web, client/server, COM+, etc).
  • Experience supporting automation teams using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins.
  • 3+ years of infrastructure experience, including monitoring, DNS, DHCP, Backups, and Disaster Recovery.
  • Researches and drives adoption of cloud-native technologies.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Microsoft or AWS related industry certifications preferred (AWS Certified Solutions Architect -- Associate).
  • Terraform Associate Certification

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of cloud technology.

Understanding of the Five Pillars of the Well-Architected Framework.

Ability to work with cloud services and tools from an Infrastructure as Code perspective.

Understanding of networking and internet protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, HTTP and distributed networks.

Understanding of information security/governance controls.

Ability to work within a platform product team to understand the technical requirements and deliver creative solutions that meet or exceed business needs.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to remain focused on completing tasks and achieving goals in a fast-paced environment.

Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.

Ability to work independently.

Self-motivated and results-oriented.

Ability to set goals and effectively manage progress toward achieving them.

Ability to effectively mentor team members and direct reports.

Strong customer service skills and stakeholder management skills.

Additional Information

  • Candidates residing in locations within BankUnited's footprint may be given preference.

Los Angeles, CA (Westside), 5 days onsite

$180,000 – $200,000 base salary plus bonus

About The Client

A global financial firm with offices across the US, Europe, the Middle East and Asia. The IT team is small and growing, and this is a visible seat that works directly with senior leadership.

Role Overview

You will be the senior technical owner of the firm’s cloud, network and identity infrastructure. The environment is cloud-first with very little on-prem, and several projects are already under way. You will stay hands-on and personally build and operate the work. This is not a seat for someone who wants to manage or step back from the technology.

Responsibilities

  • Own the design, build and day-to-day operation of the firm’s Azure environment, including networking, compute, storage, backup and disaster recovery
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform and Azure DevOps, and support the firm’s data platform, including Databricks
  • Manage enterprise networking and security across offices, including Meraki and Palo Alto, VPN, wireless, routing, DNS and DHCP
  • Administer identity and access with Entra ID, Okta and Active Directory, including Microsoft 365 integration
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex infrastructure, cloud, network and identity issues
  • Support security tooling and practices, including endpoint protection, vulnerability management, patching and hardening
  • Automate repetitive work with PowerShell and other tooling, and document standards, runbooks and architecture
  • Support and administer enterprise AI tools, and build automations, pipelines or agents that improve how IT delivers
  • Support office moves, expansions and global connectivity
  • Work with vendors and partners, and explain technical risks and recommendations clearly to non-technical leaders


Skills And Experience

  • 8+ years in infrastructure, systems or cloud engineering, including 3+ years as a senior technical lead on complex projects
  • Deep hands-on Microsoft Azure experience, with Terraform or another infrastructure as code tool
  • Strong identity experience with Entra ID and Okta, and Microsoft 365 administration
  • Working knowledge of enterprise networking and firewalls, ideally Meraki and Palo Alto
  • PowerShell scripting and automation
  • Practical AI and automation experience. We want to hear what you have built, such as workflows, agents or pipelines, not just prompting
  • Willing to do the work yourself, with the judgment to own a platform end to end
  • Collaborative and mature, with composure in a high-demand environment


Nice to Have

  • Background in private equity, credit, financial services or a law firm
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Databricks, Intune, CrowdStrike, Defender or Veeam
  • Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect certification


Interview Process: Two to three stages with technology leadership, finishing with an onsite conversation with a senior executive. The team wants someone in seat as soon as possible and moves quickly once they find the right person.

Please note we are unable to offer employer sponsorship for this

descriptionHtml:
Department: Technology

Location: US - Texas

Description

We’re looking for an experienced Infrastructure Operations Engineer to help keep CFC’s global infrastructure reliable, secure and resilient.

With a particular focus on Microsoft Azure, you’ll use your infrastructure support experience to operate and improve our cloud and hybrid services across compute, storage and networking. You’ll take ownership of complex technical issues, help reduce operational risk and make sure the services our teams rely on are performing at their best.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll have the opportunity to solve challenging problems and make improvements that stick. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, Information Security and engineering, bringing your expertise while continuing to build your own.

At CFC, we trust people to take ownership, welcome ideas from every level and encourage people to make things better, making this a great environment for someone who enjoys combining technical depth with initiative

About the role

  • Manage and support our Microsoft Azure infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, monitoring and identity integrations.
  • Take ownership of infrastructure incidents, problems and service requests across cloud and hybrid environments, seeing them through to resolution.
  • Monitor availability, capacity, performance and security, spotting potential risks early and implementing sustainable improvements.
  • Deliver infrastructure changes, upgrades, patching and lifecycle activities in line with change management and operational controls.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Azure, Windows Server, storage, backup, DNS, routing, VPNs and firewalls.
  • Support backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements, helping ensure critical services are recoverable and regularly validated.
  • Partner with Technology, Information Security and engineering colleagues to automate, standardise and document secure, scalable infrastructure services.
  • Provide desktop support to the Austin team during planned holidays and periods of sickness.

About you

You’ll bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or infrastructure engineering within a complex organisation, alongside experience supporting business-critical services.

You’ll be confident working across Azure and hybrid environments and comfortable taking ownership when high-impact infrastructure incidents arise.

Technically, you’ll bring:
  • Strong Microsoft Azure knowledge across virtual machines, storage, virtual networking, monitoring and Entra ID integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, enterprise storage and backup.
  • A solid grounding in networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls and routing.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security, access management, audit evidence, change control and incident management.
  • A disciplined approach to risk, documentation and operational controls, with the judgement to escalate when needed.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously, prioritise competing demands and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with PowerShell or infrastructure automation would be a bonus, rather than essential.

Description

﻿SAIC is a premier technology integrator driving our nation’s technology transformation, and we are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team in Charleston, SC or New Orleans, LA. In this role, you will support the day-to-day operations of AWS cloud environments that host mission-critical applications in a Navy/DoD cloud hosting environment. You will perform foundational system administration and operational tasks, such as monitoring, security hardening, backup and recovery, automation, and ticket resolution, so that mission owners have reliable, secure, and consistently managed platforms. You will work as part of a cloud operations team, and you will have room to build your technical skills and certifications as you grow.

Note Candidates must reside in either Charleston, SC or New Orleans, LA for this onsite role.

Job Duties

  • Manage and maintain existing AWS infrastructure, including EC2 instances, S3 buckets, VPCs, RDS instances, and related AWS services.
  • Configure and manage security groups, network access control lists (ACLs), and other security controls that protect cloud infrastructure and data.
  • Monitor system performance and health using Amazon CloudWatch, dashboards, and other monitoring tools, and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and system errors.
  • Implement and manage backup and disaster recovery solutions, such as AWS Backup, snapshots, and Data Lifecycle Manager.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools that streamline operational tasks and improve efficiency.
  • Manage and resolve support tickets within established Service Level Agreement (SLA) priority levels.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with customers and teammates by providing exceptional customer service.
  • Stay current on new AWS services, features, and best practices.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure system availability and respond to incidents outside of normal business hours.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical documentation.

Qualifications

Required Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree and five (5) or more years of work experience.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in cloud engineering, with a focus on AWS.
  • Systems AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, and CloudWatch).
  • DoD 8570/8140 Must meet IAT Level II requirements, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, CASP+, or CISSP.

Required Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance at start, with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Required Certifications

  • Vendor/platform certification Must have a vendor or platform certification, such as AWS Cloud Practitioner.
  • Agile certification Must obtain an Agile Developer certification or a Certified Scrum Developer certification.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with both Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Knowledge of DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).
  • An advanced AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator.

Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Sabel Systems is a digital engineering and DefenseTech company that helps Department of War (DoW) programs connect the tools, data, models, and teams behind modern weapon systems. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Dayton, Ohio, we serve the Air Force, Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, and Space Force with teams in 37 states.

Our flagship platform, 97Helix, is a digital engineering ecosystem that unifies more than 80 engineering tools — MBSE, PLM, requirements, simulation, and sustainment data — into one secure environment, proven in IL5 and IL6. The FY27 NDAA directs DoW to scale digital engineering and PLM adoption under DoDI 5000.97 — the same governed, enterprise-scale capability, reused across programs rather than rebuilt from scratch, that 97Helix delivers today. Its modules (nimbusCORE, dataCORE, collabCORE, and connectCORE) give programs a single digital thread from design through sustainment.

Our product family also includes:
TDPWerx — validates technical data packages in weeks instead of months
Code Foundry — secure software factory capability for defense programs
Spacestation — digital engineering and agile transformation platform for Space Force programs

We solve four critical DoW problems:
Integration Delay — 6+ months of tool reconciliation eliminated
Late Discovery — Design defects caught in integrated models, not at CDR
Rebuild Cycles — Phase transitions without 12-18 month restarts
Portfolio Fragmentation — Shared baselines and inherited practices across the DoD

Proven across naval shipbuilding, aviation, unmanned systems, and Space Force operations, Sabel's modular open systems approach keeps DoW free of vendor lock-in while sustaining authoritative digital engineering infrastructure.

Our commitment: Remove friction that delays capability. When decision friction is eliminated, programs execute at mission tempo. The warfighter waits for nothing.

descriptionHtml:
Why Sabel Systems

Sabel Systems designs and delivers digital engineering ecosystems for DoW programs, enabling teams to connect data, systems, and personnel within secure, scalable environments. Our solutions empower programs to make faster decisions, close sustainment gaps, and meet the digital acquisition requirements.

Rather than simply proposing transformation, we implement and operate it at scale. Our method is clear: we orchestrate existing tools into a governing system of record, ensuring government ownership of infrastructure and traceable decisions. There’s no vendor lock, no proprietary baselines, and no need for ATO rebuilds during transitions.

Sabel Systems is redefining modern defense acquisition. If you seek to solve complex challenges at scale and want your work to directly accelerate military capability while reshaping the DoW’s approach to digital engineering, this is the place for you.

Complexity Simplified. Mission Amplified.

What You’ll Do

Cloud Infrastructure & System Administration

  • Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including virtual machines, containers, storage services, networks, and security groups.
  • Design and implement secure cloud network architectures, including subnets, routing, VPN connectivity, firewalls, and access controls.
  • Administer AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud environments supporting Digital Engineering workloads.
  • Apply DoD security baselines, STIGs, and cybersecurity best practices across cloud-hosted systems.
  • Perform operating system patching, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure system reliability and compliance.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, capacity, and availability using enterprise observability tools.

DevSecOps & CI/CD Platform Engineering

  • Develop, maintain, and support CI/CD pipelines utilizing tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and container platforms.
  • Troubleshoot build failures, deployment issues, pipeline performance concerns, and integration challenges.
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize software delivery workflows and automate deployment processes.
  • Support database integrations, API connectivity, and platform services required for automated software delivery.
  • Contribute to the implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation solutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across cloud and platform resources.
  • Support vulnerability scanning, remediation efforts, and security incident response activities.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD, NIST, and organizational cybersecurity requirements.
  • Implement encryption, auditing, logging, and monitoring controls across the platform.
  • Participate in security assessments and authorization activities as required.

Platform Operations & Customer Support

  • Serve as a technical resource supporting platform users and project teams.
  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform-related incidents and service requests.
  • Engage with customers and stakeholders as a subject matter expert on platform capabilities, DevSecOps workflows, and cloud technologies.
  • Support hosted engineering tool suites, including GitLab, Atlassian products, and other Digital Engineering services.
  • Escalate complex technical issues and coordinate resolution across engineering teams.

Documentation, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, system documentation, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base content.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual operational and support activities.
  • Contribute to training materials, user guides, and platform onboarding resources.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and Digital Engineering technologies.
  • Support continuous process improvement initiatives across the platform ecosystem.

What You Bring Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, System Administration, DevOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
  • Strong communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience managing cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and/or DoD cloud platforms preferred)
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Podman.
  • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar tooling
  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps Administrator, Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Azure Administrator Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or similar are a plus
  • Ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance eligibility.

Our Core Values

  • Bias for Action: Decisive. Purposeful. Agile. We move with the speed of relevance to drive impact and progress.
  • Integrity: Respect. Ethics. Transparency. We do what’s right and earn lasting trust.
  • Delivery Excellence: Customer-obsessed. Mission-focused. Quality-driven. We deliver innovative outcomes that exceed expectations.

Our EVP Promise

Join Sabel Systems, where your contributions drive impact, your growth is continuously supported, and your well-being is at the center of how we work. Together we can build the future with purpose. Rewarding Impact. Building Futures Together.

Compensation

Compensation will be determined in partnership with the Hiring Manager and may vary based on factors such as contract and labor category alignment, relevant experience, skills, education, certifications or licenses, and geographic location.

Sabel Systems is committed to offering all employees a competitive benefits and compensation package that is comprehensive enough to meet their goals and needs. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and one of Sabel Systems largest financial investments is our benefits program. As a valued member of the organization, employees are provided with a host of benefits to include healthcare; financial assistance in the event of illness, injury, disability, loss of work, or death; health savings accounts; retirement plans; paid time off; paid holidays; education and training program reimbursement, to name a few.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Sabel Systems is an equal opportunity employer. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business need. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind across all employment practices within our organization. Sabel Systems participates in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program.

Reasonable Accommodation

Sabel Systems is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and ensuring an accessible application process for all candidates. Applicants with disabilities who require reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process are encouraged to contact us at recruiting@sabelsystems.com for assistance.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and evolving our enterprise business platforms landscape across commercial and government environments. You will be responsible for maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud and infrastructure services while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable business solutions.

You will:

  • Design, implement, and support infrastructure solutions across Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, and AWS environments.
  • Manage and maintain Windows Server, Linux, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure platforms to ensure stability, performance, and security.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Service Principals, Managed Identities, and related authentication services.
  • Support enterprise applications, databases, and business-critical platforms by ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, database, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, security, and availability while proactively identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Lead and participate in cloud modernization, migration, automation, and digital transformation efforts.
  • Develop automation solutions using tools such as PowerShell, Python, and AI-enabled technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Evaluate and leverage Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and other AI-driven technologies to streamline IT operations, support processes, and user experiences.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, application, identity, database, and networking issues across enterprise environments.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to continuously improve platform reliability, security, and service delivery.


This is a site‑based role, employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.

The day-to-day

In this role, you will balance operational support, infrastructure engineering, security administration, and continuous improvement activities across cloud and on-premises environments. Typical responsibilities include:

  • Managing and supporting infrastructure across Azure Commercial, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid environments.
  • Administering Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, IAM, Service Principals, Managed Identities, and authentication services.
  • Monitoring system health, security, performance, and availability, and responding to incidents, alerts, and service requests.
  • Supporting Windows and Linux servers, cloud resources, enterprise applications, and business-critical platforms.
  • Troubleshooting infrastructure, application, database, networking, and access-related issues to minimize business impact.
  • Managing SSL/TLS certificates, PKI integrations, and identity-related services.
  • Working closely with application owners, security teams, database administrators, and network engineers to resolve technical issues and implement improvements.
  • Supporting SQL Server and Oracle environments, including connectivity, access, and infrastructure-related administration.
  • Implementing and maintaining security controls to meet organizational and regulatory requirements, including NIST, CMMC, ITAR, and FedRAMP frameworks.
  • Automating routine operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Evaluating and supporting AI-enabled solutions, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, and automation technologies that improve operational efficiency.
  • Participating in cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Maintaining technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture diagrams, and support runbooks.
  • Participating in on-call support and incident response activities as required.


What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, Service Principals, and Managed Identities.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting or administering SQL Server and/or Oracle database environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills across infrastructure, application, identity, and networking technologies.
  • Experience managing certificates, SSL/TLS, PKI, and security-related technologies.
  • Exposure to cloud automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, FedRAMP, or SOX.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or other AI-enabled automation solutions.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to improve operational efficiency, support processes, and system management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and eligible to support government-regulated environments.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Experience working in hybrid cloud environments spanning Azure, Azure Government, AWS, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity governance, authentication, and access management concepts.
  • Familiarity with Service Principals, Managed Identities, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Experience supporting environments subject to government, defense, or regulated industry compliance requirements such as NIST, CMMC, ITAR, or FedRAMP.
  • Proficiency with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or cloud-native automation tools.
  • Exposure to AI-powered technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, and AI-assisted operational workflows.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve troubleshooting, operational efficiency, documentation, monitoring, and incident response processes.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, modernization, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across infrastructure, security, networking, database, and application teams.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and mission-critical systems in production environments.
  • Ability to prioritize work effectively, manage multiple activities simultaneously, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), Azure AI Engineer (AI-102), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, or similar cloud and security certifications.


Salary range

$121,000.00 - $191,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $150,000.00- $225,000.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits.

EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook.

Guardant's HPC team builds and operates the computational technology backbone of the company. This includes scalable data storage that holds petabytes of genomics data, high-performance compute clusters running a custom bioinformatics pipeline in production and R&D environments, and the software infrastructure that hosts an ecosystem of services for internal data processing and external data integration.

The HPC engineering team is looking for a Staff-level engineer with broad, all-round HPC competency and specialized depth in one or more of the following: Red Hat-family OS management, networking, storage, Kubernetes, or Slurm. Experience applying these skills both on-premise and in the cloud is a plus, as we continue to evolve our HPC footprint. This role carries technical depth and cross-team representation for HPC compute, networking, and storage-integration initiatives, partnering closely with our engineering team and our managed service provider (MSP) as we scale operations. To support Guardant Health's fast growth over the next few years, we need a strong technical engineer who can help maintain and grow the HPC infrastructure through this expansion while working closely with corporate IT, SQA, and DevOps/SRE teams. Strong teamwork and the ability to manage multiple in-flight, cross-functional projects at once are essential for success in this role.

About The Role

You enjoy an agile, very fast paced and highly technical environment. You are a self-driven, accomplished technologist who strives to continually improve your skills as the HPC landscape evolves and the computational infrastructure scales. You are dedicated to engineering excellence yet pragmatic and flexible. You have the ability to maintain the day-to-day support SLA while running various key projects that move the business forward. You are comfortable being the deepest technical voice in the room on your declared specialism, even among more senior colleagues, while operating as a peer to the other engineers on the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Broad HPC Skills (all-round)

  • Manage multiple HPC clusters and cluster file systems
  • Integrate cloud bursting as part of the HPC abstraction work
  • Research, develop, and implement the next generation HPC solutions
  • Troubleshoot the production system stack down to source code level, e.g shell scripts, Python, and others
  • Maintain, monitor, and support the infrastructure environment and/or facilities
  • Use and maintain enhanced production monitoring and addition capability
  • Support improvements for increased system reliability and performance
  • Support multiple systems or applications of medium to high complexity complexity defined by size, technology used, and system feeds and interfaces) with multiple concurrent users, ensuring control, integrity, and accessibility
  • Support systems at remote locations, including internationally
  • Mentor junior engineers on HPC best practices
  • Work with offsite consultants to maintain the infrastructure
  • Work with vendors to troubleshoot, upgrade, and repair systems as needed
  • Represent HPC infrastructure networking and storage-integration topics in cross-functional planning with networking, SQA, DevOps/SRE, and the MSP
  • Set up and ownership supporting XDMoD instances for HPC metric and monitoring
  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Networking

  • Act as the technical peer for HPC networking and interconnect initiatives with the dedicated networking engineer
  • Collaborate on design, performance tuning, and troubleshooting of HPC Ethernet
  • Work with enterprise networking on integration of HPC systems with the bandwidth-on-demand system that connects our sites and cloud infrastructure
  • Work with the networking infrastructure team to manage and optimize connectivity to and from HPC systems and global locations

Storage

  • Act as the technical peer for the architecture and integration strategy for. HPC storage in partnership with the dedicated storage engineer and MSP
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for the MSP storage relationship and help define and evolve SLAs, validate delivery, and escalate technical issues
  • Support the transition of day-to-day storage operations to the MSP without loss of performance or reliability

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 8–12 years of relevant experience; Master’s degree with 6–8 years of relevant experience; or PhD with 3–5 years of relevant experience
  • Strong experience in systems and/or infrastructure engineering, including Linux/Unix administration and TCP/IP networking.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools, such as Ansible or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with high-performance networking technologies, such as InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, or equivalent, including troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data storage and high-performance computing (HPC)/compute environments.
  • Experience working with both on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure, such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, or similar environments.
  • Experience developing and supporting software release, operations, and infrastructure automation processes and toolsets.
  • Strong experience creating and maintaining system administration and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification
  • Experience with Arista and compatible networking, up to and including 400 Gb/s links
  • Experience administering IBM's General Parallel File System (GPFS)
  • Experience administering the Slurm scheduler
  • Experience using Warewulf
  • Linux support and OS management. Red Hat family is a must, but Debian or Suse is nice to have.
  • Experience with cloud bursting technologies
  • Experience with wide area file systems
  • Experience with Docker and Apptainer container technologies
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Operating infrastructure compliant with HIPAA and SOX standards

AI & Digital Fluency

  • Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

Hybrid Work Model: This section is applicable to onsite employees who are eligible for hybrid work location as specified by management and related policies. Guardant has defined days for in-person/onsite collaboration and work-from-home days for individual-focused time. All U.S. employees who live within 50 miles of a Guardant facility will be required to be onsite on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. We have found aligning our scheduled in-office days allows our teams to do the best work and creates the focused thinking time our innovative work requires. At Guardant, our work model has created flexibility for better work-life balance while keeping teams connected to advance our science for our patients.

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. This range does not include benefits or, if applicable, bonus, commission, or equity. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, education, job-related skills, job duties, and business need. Primary Location: Palo Alto, CA Primary Location Base Pay Range: $173,000 - $237,950 Other US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $147,100 - $202,300 If the role is performed in Colorado, the pay range for this job is: $155,700 - $214,150

Employee may be required to lift routine office supplies and use office equipment. Majority of the work is performed in a desk/office environment; however, there may be exposure to high noise levels, fumes, and biohazard material in the laboratory environment. Ability to sit for extended periods of time.

Guardant Health is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our hiring processes for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health conditions, or sincerely held religious beliefs. If you need support, please reach out to Peopleteam@guardanthealth.com

A background screening including criminal history is required for this role. GH will consider qualified applicants with criminal arrest or conviction histories in a manner consistent with applicable law including but not limited to the LA County Fair Chance Policies and the Fair Chance Act (Gov. Code Section 12952).

Guardant Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To learn more about the information collected when you apply for a position at Guardant Health, Inc. and how it is used, please review our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants.

Please visit our career page at: http://www.guardanthealth.com/jobs/
