Job Description

OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) AI Infrastructure is at the forefront of building a cutting-edge, ultra-high-performance GPU platform designed to support AI/ML/HPC workloads. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution, creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance.

  • Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability.
  • Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance.
  • Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
  • Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs.
  • Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.


Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.

–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.

Compliance & Security:

–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management:

–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.

–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Looking to make a difference and help modernize critical government missions? Join Acuity's team supporting the U.S. Department of State. As a Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer (IaaS), you will provide hands-on engineering support for mission-critical data center, virtualization, compute, storage, hybrid-cloud, and globally distributed infrastructure. This role is deeply focused on enterprise VMware environments, Windows Server and Linux platforms, hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), SAN/NAS storage, and the resilient infrastructure services that support Department of State operations worldwide.

Working closely with the Cloud Technical Lead, Cloud Engineers, Automation Engineers, Network Engineers, Cybersecurity teams, and government stakeholders, you will provide Tier 3 infrastructure engineering and troubleshooting, support infrastructure lifecycle modernization, and ensure the availability, security, resiliency, capacity, and performance of enterprise systems across domestic, overseas, on-premises, and cloud environments.

Why Acuity?

Are you ready to use your expertise in the areas of IT Modernization, Data Enablement, and Hyperautomation to make a real difference? Join Acuity, Inc., a technology consulting firm that supports federal agencies. We combine industry partnerships and long-term federal experience with innovative technical leadership to support our customers’ critical missions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, administer, and maintain enterprise data center, compute, virtualization, storage, HCI, operating system, and hybrid-cloud infrastructure supporting mission-critical operations.
  • Provide significant hands-on administration and engineering support for enterprise VMware environments, including VMware ESXi, vCenter, clusters, virtual networking, resource management, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle activities.
  • Deploy, configure, administer, patch, harden, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux operating systems supporting enterprise applications and infrastructure services.
  • Engineer and support enterprise compute and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), including integration with virtualization, networking, storage, backup, and disaster recovery services.
  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise SAN/NAS storage platforms and virtualization-storage integrations, including capacity, performance, availability, connectivity, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Provide Tier 3 infrastructure troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex issues spanning servers, virtualization, storage, operating systems, cloud services, and dependent infrastructure components.
  • Design, implement, test, and maintain high-availability, disaster recovery, backup, resiliency, and business-continuity capabilities for mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure lifecycle activities, including technology refresh, patching, upgrades, migrations, and remediation of end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) hardware and software.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, and performance using enterprise monitoring and observability platforms; identify trends, constraints, and opportunities for proactive remediation and optimization.
  • Use PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, administration, compliance, and repetitive operational tasks.
  • Support Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and hybrid-cloud environments using at least one major cloud service provider such as AWS or Microsoft Azure, including integration between cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support overseas and globally distributed infrastructure deployments and coordinate with geographically dispersed or remote teams to maintain consistent, reliable infrastructure services across locations and time zones.
  • Operate within established ITSM disciplines, including change, incident, problem, configuration, and release management; participate in root cause analysis and continuous service improvement.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement federal security and configuration requirements, including system hardening, vulnerability remediation, secure baselines, STIG-aligned controls, NIST/RMF compliance, and continuous monitoring.
  • Collaborate with Cloud and Automation Engineers to implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, standardized deployment patterns, and infrastructure modernization while maintaining operational stability.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, infrastructure diagrams, configuration standards, runbooks, operational procedures, and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned in support of customer mission objectives.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, systems engineering, data center operations, or Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
  • Significant hands-on enterprise VMware experience, including VMware ESXi and vCenter administration, troubleshooting, patching/upgrades, cluster management, and virtualization lifecycle support.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting both Windows Server and Linux operating systems in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise compute and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) platforms in highly available production environments.
  • Experience administering enterprise SAN and/or NAS storage and supporting storage integration with virtualized infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated Tier 3 infrastructure troubleshooting and root cause analysis experience across compute, virtualization, storage, operating systems, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting high availability, disaster recovery, backup, resiliency, and business-continuity solutions.
  • Experience managing infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, technology refresh, and EOL/EOS remediation.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure monitoring, capacity management, performance analysis, and availability management.
  • Hands-on scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting at least one major cloud service provider (AWS or Microsoft Azure) and hybrid-cloud integration with enterprise on-premises infrastructure.
  • Experience working within ITSM processes and disciplines, including change management, incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience implementing federal security and configuration compliance requirements, such as NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, STIGs, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, or comparable federal standards.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting globally distributed, overseas, or remote enterprise infrastructure environments, particularly environments requiring coordination across geographically dispersed teams.
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or equivalent VMware certification.
  • Experience with enterprise HCI platforms such as VMware vSAN/VxRail, Nutanix, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies and vendors supporting SAN/NAS, backup, replication, and disaster recovery.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Microsoft server certification, or comparable operating system certification.
  • Experience supporting the U.S. Department of State or other federal civilian agencies.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, capacity, and performance-management platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, or related enterprise container technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure hybrid-cloud infrastructure architectures.


Clearance Requirement

  • Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance required.


Min

USD $145,000.00/Yr.

Max

USD $170,000.00/Yr.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position represents Acuity's good faith estimate of the compensation for this job title at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, education, certifications, skills, geographic location, contract requirements, applicable labor categories, and, where applicable, contract award and funding.

As an engineer on the Strategic Customer Engineering team plays a critical role in aligning technical details across various service teams, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving end-to-end execution of complex projects. This engineer will design, coordinate, and execute technical solutions that have huge impact to our customer experience and scalability. Understanding various cloud technologies and technical trade-offs, the ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, have a well-rounded technical background, and come with a history of leading large-scale projects end-to-end.

Qualifications

Your experience should be both deep and wide-ranging, with strengths in internetworking, cloud infrastructure, Linux system internals, workflow scalability, and organizational effectiveness.

  • 4–8+ years distributed cloud engineering experience in a software development environment
  • Development experience in Java/C++/C# as well as scripting languages. Experience in scripting and automation using tools like Ansible, Terraform, and/or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools for managing distributed systems.
  • Strong Linux skills with hands-on experience in Oracle Linux/RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, and Debian distributions, including system administration, package management, shell scripting, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with other cloud platform teams and accommodating requirements from those teams (compute, networking, storage, identity).
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear, concise manner to all audiences
  • Strong documentation skills with experience documenting infrastructure designs, configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps to facilitate knowledge sharing, ensure maintainability, and enhance team collaboration.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our cloud infrastructure solutions are designed and built with the highest level of scalability in mind. You will partner with other development teams responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing solutions within a distributed computing environment that lead to the best customer experience. Job Title

Senior Network & Systems Engineer

Job Description

The most security-conscious organizations trust Telos Corporation to protect their vital IT assets. The reputation of our company rests on the quality of our solutions and the integrity of our people. Explore what you can bring to our solutions in the areas of cyber, cloud and enterprise security.

Be a part of the Telos culture and see what sets us apart! Salary: $100,000-120,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Telos offers an excellent compensation package with benefits that include generous paid time off, medical, dental, vision, tuition reimbursement, and 401k. Our employees enjoy more than just a great work environment!

This position will be based at Ashburn/Hybrid.

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Network & Systems Engineer to support mission-critical infrastructure across on-premises data center and AWS GovCloud environments.

This position extends beyond traditional network engineering and requires strong expertise in Cisco networking, Windows Systems Administration, virtualization, cybersecurity, and AWS GovCloud. The successful candidate must be capable of independently troubleshooting across the complete infrastructure stack, identifying root cause, and taking ownership of complex technical issues through resolution.

Responsibilities

Network & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Configure, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot enterprise Cisco network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, routing, ACLs, VPNs, and wireless technologies.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 2 through Layer 7 connectivity, routing, DNS, firewall, performance, and application communication issues.
  • Support secure connectivity between on-premises infrastructure, AWS GovCloud, government partners, customers, and external systems.
  • Analyze network traffic using packet captures, Wireshark, PowerShell, Netstat, and network monitoring tools.
  • Maintain network configurations, diagrams, documentation, and operational procedures for highly available, mission-critical infrastructure.

Windows Systems Administration & Virtualization

  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, IIS, certificates/PKI, TLS, Kerberos, authentication, permissions, and Windows services.
  • Perform server builds, configuration, patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and lifecycle management.
  • Administer and support Microsoft Hyper-V clustered and virtualized server infrastructure.
  • Use PowerShell for administration, troubleshooting, automation, system analysis, and compliance evidence collection.

AWS GovCloud

  • Administer and troubleshoot AWS GovCloud (US) infrastructure, including EC2, VPCs, subnets, route tables, Security Groups, NACLs, VPC endpoints, Route 53, load balancers, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Security Hub, and Systems Manager.
  • Support and troubleshoot hybrid connectivity between AWS GovCloud, on-premises infrastructure, and external systems.
  • Administer Windows EC2 instances and troubleshoot issues spanning AWS networking, security controls, operating systems, DNS, certificates, and application connectivity.
  • Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to deploy and maintain environments based on technical requirements from development teams, government partners, and customers.

Cybersecurity & Compliance

  • Support infrastructure operating under federal cybersecurity and compliance requirements, including NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes.
  • Perform vulnerability analysis, remediation, validation, security hardening, and configuration management.
  • Work with technologies such as Tenable/Nessus, SIEM/logging platforms, endpoint security solutions, firewalls, and network security tools.
  • Evaluate vulnerability findings for technical applicability and implement appropriate remediation.
  • Support security assessments, audits, incident response, and compliance activities, including development of technical documentation and supporting evidence.

Job Requirements

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in network engineering, systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or a comparable technical role.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Cisco enterprise networking and strong knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, switching, ACLs, NAT, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, wireless networking, and network troubleshooting.
  • Strong hands-on Windows Server Systems Administration experience, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, Kerberos, certificates/PKI, TLS, and Windows security.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Hyper-V clustered environments or comparable enterprise virtualization technologies.
  • Strong PowerShell administration, automation, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on AWS experience, preferably AWS GovCloud, with knowledge of VPC networking, cloud security, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation, patching, system hardening, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, servers, cloud infrastructure, security controls, and applications.
  • Ability to collaborate directly with government agencies, customers, development teams, vendors, and external partners to gather technical requirements and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • Strong technical documentation and verbal/written communication skills.
  • Ability to lift, install, and manipulate physical IT and network equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for required local travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government, regulated, or mission-critical production environments.
  • Experience with NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and ATO processes.
  • Experience with Tenable/Nessus, SIEM/logging platforms, endpoint security solutions, and enterprise firewall technologies.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Dell hardware procurement, licensing, maintenance, and support processes.
  • AWS, Cisco, Microsoft, or cybersecurity certifications preferred; equivalent demonstrated hands-on experience will be considered.

Security Requirements

  • Must meet applicable U.S. Government personnel security and system-access requirements.
  • Must be able to successfully obtain and maintain a Level 2 Public Trust background investigation/suitability determination as required for access to federal government systems and information.
  • Continued assignment may be contingent upon maintaining the required federal suitability determination and system access.

The successful candidate must meet eligibility requirements to access sensitive information, which requires US citizenship.

We're looking for a talented, senior engineering professional ready to take their career to new heights at one of the world's most influential companies.

As a Senior Lead Infrastructure Engineering at JPMorgan Chase within Enterprise Technology, Compute Platform Engineering team, you will engineer enterprise-scale Microsoft Hyper-V infrastructure across global data centers, partnering inclusively across engineering, operations, security, and capacity teams to deliver resilient, performant virtualization services that support tens of thousands of workloads.

Job Responsibilities

  • Architect Hyper-V cluster designs across global pools, including WSFC, live migration, S2D, and vSwitch/SET topologies.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance enforcement, and decommissioning using PowerShell, DSC, and platform APIs.
  • Develop and enhance a custom C#/.NET 8 workload management platform to scale operational workflows and orchestration.
  • Benchmark compute and storage performance using industry-standard tooling to validate changes and guide capacity decisions.
  • Diagnose full-stack issues across compute, storage, networking, clustering, and hypervisor layers using structured troubleshooting methods.
  • Evaluate proposed server BOMs for Hyper-V suitability, providing performance-focused feedback on CPU, memory, storage, and network characteristics.
  • Harden environments by partnering with security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and enforce platform baselines at scale.
  • Document reference architectures, decision records, and operational runbooks to improve repeatability and auditability.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance that raises the bar for platform quality.
  • Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate analysis of complex infrastructure signals and documentation of mitigation options, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
  • Leads reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted practices across delivery and automation routines to reduce recurring issues, ensuring changes are validated, traceable and auditable, and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification in infrastructure disciplines, plus 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in enterprise or large-scale environments.
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V at scale, including WSFC, live migration, S2D, and virtual networking (vSwitch/SET).
  • Strong PowerShell skills for automation, operational tooling, and configuration management.
  • Demonstrated experience performing full-stack performance auditing across compute, storage, networking, and hypervisor layers.
  • Proven ability to analyze and optimize storage performance in virtualized environments (throughput, latency, IOPS, queueing).
  • Experience with data-center-scale automation/configuration tooling (e.g., DSC, SCCM, Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Ability to plan and deliver production changes with disciplined risk management, including zero-downtime upgrade strategies.
  • Working proficiency in C#/.NET (or equivalent) to maintain and extend automation/orchestration services.
  • Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for infrastructure automation artifacts.
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience operating dual-hypervisor environments (e.g., VMware ESXi and/or KVM in addition to Hyper-V).
  • Strong server hardware fluency (Intel Xeon, AMD EPYC, NVMe, GPU) and comfort translating workload needs into platform requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced virtual networking concepts (VLANs, SDN, teaming/SET, load balancing patterns).
  • Experience with Microsoft System Center tooling (e.g., VMM, SCOM, SCCM) in large environments.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability remediation workflows (e.g., Qualys) and baseline enforcement at scale.
  • Practical performance tooling experience (e.g., elbencho, VMFleet, diskspd, fio) for repeatable benchmarking.

descriptionHtml:
Forrest T. Jones & Company, Inc., and its affiliates (“FTJ”), provide insurance and insurance related services to clients, corporations, employers, and individuals. These services include providing benefits through innovative life and health insurance plans, financial services, and customized insurance products for niche markets.

Position Summary

Responsible for building, automating, and operating cloud-based infrastructure and applications; delivering changes through infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines; monitoring system reliability and responding to incidents; and building tools that automate repetitive tasks to minimize errors and prevent downtime.

Expectations

  • Manage and maintain Microsoft Azure services to include Entra ID, Azure networking, Azure Data Factory, etc. using infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, internal and third-party application deployments
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and service level objectives (SLOs) across the Azure environment
  • Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews for production systems
  • Maintain company’s security standards in the Azure ecosystem
  • Create system diagrams, runbooks, and documentation as needed
  • Provide Tier 3 operational support as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Competencies

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong team building/support skills
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem solving, and analytical skills
  • Self-motivated and self-directed
  • Automation-first mindset focused on reliability and continuous improvment

Requisites

  • Bachelor’s Degree, University Program Certificate or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum of one IT industry certification, e.g., Azure Administrator, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, etc.
  • Two or more years’ experience in a cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE role in an enterprise environment, including scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

We offer comprehensive benefits to full-time employees including company-paid medical, STD, LTD and life insurance plus voluntary dental, vision, life/AD&D insurance, 401(k) with company matching, generous paid time off and much more.

We encourage applicants of all ages and experience, as we do not discriminate on the basis of an applicant’s age.

ALL OFFERS OF EMPLOYMENT ARE CONTINGENT UPON THE PASSING OF A DRUG SCREEN AND BACKGROUND CHECK.

Position Summary


UT Medical Center seeks a skilled, motivated Server Engineer to support, maintain, and enhance our enterprise infrastructure across on-premises data centers, private cloud, and public cloud environments. This position is responsible for configuring, integrating, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting server infrastructure from the operating system layer through physical hardware.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical foundation in server administration, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, and hybrid cloud technologies. This individual will play an important role in ensuring the availability, reliability, security, and performance of the infrastructure supporting UTMC's technology environment.

We are looking for a proactive problem-solver who can diagnose complex technical issues, collaborate across IT teams, document solutions, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, standardization, and emerging technologies.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Server and Infrastructure Management

• Install, configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot physical and virtual server environments.

• Manage server operating systems, hardware resources, system performance, and capacity planning.

• Perform routine system maintenance, security patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management.

• Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, application infrastructure, and connectivity issues.

• Participate in the design, implementation, and deployment of new infrastructure solutions.


Virtualization, Cloud, and Identity Management

• Administer and support hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises and cloud environments.

• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot virtualization platforms, including VMware, Nutanix, and Citrix technologies.

• Support hybrid Active Directory environments and Microsoft Azure identity services.

• Maintain and support Microsoft 365 and related enterprise infrastructure services.

• Support private cloud infrastructure, including Dell VxRail and VMware Cloud Foundation environments, as applicable.


Storage, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

• Monitor, manage, and troubleshoot Storage Area Network (SAN) environments, including iSCSI and Fibre Channel technologies.

• Maintain backup infrastructure, monitor backup jobs, investigate failures, and resolve backup-related issues.

• Perform routine restore testing to validate data recoverability and support disaster recovery readiness.

• Monitor storage capacity, performance, and utilization to ensure reliable service delivery.


Security, Reliability, and Operational Excellence

• Maintain systems in accordance with established security standards, policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Monitor system health and resource utilization to identify potential issues before they affect operations.

• Follow established change management processes and maintain accurate technical documentation.

• Manage assigned service tickets, prioritize incidents, and meet established Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure reliability, operational efficiency, and security posture.


Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

• Collaborate with infrastructure, networking, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve technical issues and deliver projects.

• Participate in cross-functional infrastructure projects, including large-scale deployments and system upgrades.

• Develop and maintain documentation covering configurations, installations, troubleshooting procedures, and system maintenance.

• Recommend and implement automation, standardization, and process improvements to reduce repetitive tasks and improve consistency.

• Maintain current technical knowledge through independent learning, professional development, training, and knowledge sharing with team members.


Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience in server administration, systems engineering, or enterprise infrastructure support.

• Strong understanding of server hardware, operating systems, virtualization, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting enterprise IT environments, including server maintenance, monitoring, patching, and incident resolution.

• Knowledge of storage technologies, backup and recovery processes, and infrastructure security best practices.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, work collaboratively, and meet service commitments.

• Ability to follow established policies, procedures, and change management practices.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Nutanix and VMware virtualization technologies.

• Experience with Citrix infrastructure and virtual desktop environments.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and hybrid identity management.

• Experience with SAN technologies, including iSCSI and Fibre Channel.

• Knowledge of Dell VxRail, VMware Cloud Foundation, or comparable private cloud infrastructure.

• Experience with enterprise backup solutions, disaster recovery, and restoration testing.

• Familiarity with scripting, automation, infrastructure monitoring, and configuration standardization.

• Experience supporting healthcare IT infrastructure or other environments with high availability, security, and compliance requirements.


Key Competencies

• Technical expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and systems administration.

• Problem-solving: Ability to investigate complex issues, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.

• Initiative: Proactively identifies opportunities to improve existing systems and processes.

• Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams and shares technical knowledge.

• Accountability: Manages assigned work, follows through on commitments, and meets ticket and SLA expectations.

• Adaptability: Maintains awareness of emerging technologies and applies new knowledge to improve infrastructure services.

• Attention to detail: Maintains accurate documentation and follows established operational and security procedures.


Work Environment and Expectations

This role supports the infrastructure that enables critical healthcare technology services. The successful candidate must be committed to maintaining dependable, secure, and well-documented systems while contributing to a collaborative IT environment.

The Server Engineer is expected to balance daily operational support with project work, participate in continuous improvement initiatives, share knowledge with colleagues, and maintain compliance with organizational policies and applicable regulations.


Join Our Team

At UT Medical Center, technology plays an essential role in supporting healthcare operations. Join a team where your technical expertise, ideas, and commitment to continuous improvement can help strengthen the infrastructure our organization depends on.

Essential services power the real economy. Every one of us interacts with these industries repeatedly throughout our lives.

But these large businesses face real-world constraints—human labor, external volatility, compliance, logistics, and physical infrastructure. Their operations are complex and often rely on outdated systems and manual workflows, and they can’t access the frontier technologies that drive digital-first businesses.

In a world where startups mostly build for startups, we serve the large enterprises in real industries and end users that keep America running. descriptionHtml:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll architect and scale the backbone supporting our autonomous AI agents—tackling real-world challenges with immediate, tangible impact. You’ll collaborate with a driven team of builders to shape infrastructure and processes from the ground up, leveraging cutting-edge cloud and orchestration technologies. If you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are excited to set new standards in the agentic space, this is your opportunity to build and leave your mark.

What You'll Do

  • Build cloud infrastructure: Design and operate the backbone that hosts our AI agents and supports our platform.
  • Automate operations: Create infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines for reliable releases.
  • Enable scale: Implement systems that handle usage spikes gracefully through autoscaling and multi-region support.
  • Create observability: Build monitoring, logging, and dashboards that provide real-time visibility into system health.
  • Maintain security: Implement security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, and audit trails.

What You'll Bring

  • Infrastructure experience: Seasoned in running distributed systems at scale with major cloud platforms (we use GCP but AWS and Azure is great, too).
  • Automation skills: Proven record of owning infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines (Terraform, Git Actions, etc).
  • Performance expertise: Experience optimizing systems and databases to meet latency and cost targets under multi-modal workloads. For example, experience with pgBouncer, Kubernetes-based autoscaling, and similar tools.
  • Observability knowledge: Fluent with modern monitoring and tracing tooling (we use Datadog) and built-in tools in Vercel or GCP.
  • Security awareness: Understanding of enterprise security requirements and compliance needs like authentication and service proxies.
  • Product mindset: Treat infrastructure as a product and prioritize ambiguous requirements to see around the corner for 1-2 years ahead of our current systems—measure impact and iterate continuously.

Our values

  • Obsess over the customer
  • Every second counts
  • Sweat the details

There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll architect and scale the backbone supporting our autonomous AI agents—tackling real-world challenges with immediate, tangible impact. You’ll collaborate with a driven team of builders to shape infrastructure and processes from the ground up, leveraging cutting-edge cloud and orchestration technologies. descriptionHtml:
What We Need

Brady Corporation is seeking an exceptional Cloud Engineer to design, build, administer, maintain, and optimize our growing multi-cloud infrastructure and Google Workspace ecosystem. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional software and security teams to deploy highly available, cost-effective cloud solutions while driving collaboration and productivity through Workspace optimizations. You will play a vital part in modernizing our technological footprint and establishing best practices for cloud adoption across our global operations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Implement and maintain secure cloud infrastructure (primarily GCP and Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize the Google Workspace environment (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Chat, etc.) to ensure a seamless and productive experience for end-users.
  • Manage unified user provisioning, Cloud Identity, and role-based access control (RBAC) linking GCP and Google Workspace.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage containerized applications utilizing Docker and Kubernetes (GKE/AKS).
  • Monitor cloud performance, troubleshoot complex system issues, and optimize resource utilization for FinOps cost efficiency.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to streamline automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate on the migration of legacy on-premise systems and applications to modern, scalable cloud architectures.
  • Ensure all cloud deployments meet strict internal security standards and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis to ensure high availability of critical services.

What You Will Need To Be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, IT infrastructure, or software development.
  • Exceptional working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Microsoft Azure services.
  • Proven experience administering Google Workspace, Cloud Identity, and associated enterprise collaboration tools.
  • Experience with container orchestration tools and methodologies.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) and automation frameworks.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot distributed systems.
  • Professional and courteous communication skills to effectively collaborate with both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

About Us

Who we are:

Brady makes products that make the world a safer and more productive place. We are a global leader in safety, identification and compliance solutions for a diverse range of workplaces. From the depths of the ocean to outer space, from the factory floor to the delivery room - we're just about everywhere you look. Companies around the world trust Brady because of our deep expertise and knowledge across a wide range of industries and applications - powered by our world-class manufacturing capabilities.

We have a diverse customer base in industries including electronics, telecommunications, manufacturing, electrical, construction, healthcare, aerospace and more. As of July 31, 2025, Brady employed approximately 6,400 people in our worldwide businesses. Our fiscal 2025 sales were approximately $1.51 billion. Brady stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol BRC. You can learn more about us at www.bradycorp.com.

Why Work At Brady

A career at Brady means working for a global company that has thrived for over 100 years, and whose innovative spirit drives our future growth.

Brady offers competitive pay and great benefits, supported by a culture that encourages collaboration and innovation. We strive to foster an inclusive workplace where diverse talent can learn, grow, and succeed. And with deeply rooted values, no matter where you work at Brady, you'll feel connected to the community through our charitable contributions and opportunities to give back.

Our headquarters are in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, but we have more than 70 locations globally, giving our employees the opportunity to work with colleagues around the world.

Our Benefits

  • Comprehensive insurance coverage starting on your first day of employment, including medical, dental, and vision
  • Generous 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Opportunity to participate in incentive programs for all full-time employees
  • Family planning benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption and surrogacy assistance
  • Education reimbursement opportunities
  • Scholarship program for children of Brady employees
  • A variety of Employee Resource Groups to provide you with unique networking, development, and volunteer opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Program and related wellness programs (mental and behavioral health, family counseling, financial management)
  • Dress-for-your-day dress code
  • Charitable contributions matched through Brady's Matching Gift program

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Systems Engineer in our Chantilly, VA office in support of our Department of Defense (DoD) Community customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high-performing team. As part of the infrastructure as a service team, you will support an exciting program which involves design, development, test, and deployment of an exciting and complex system in an Agile construct to contribute to mission success for a variety of stakeholders. Join us and be part of the next generation of innovators as we blaze a trail forward for our profession and company.

What you'll do:

  • Work closely with our DoD customer and stakeholders throughout system lifecycle in development, integration & test, deployment, and operations of a highly sophisticated ground system architecture
  • Help build mission-critical, highly available, high-performance networked systems in a team-oriented environment. Build and deploy cloud instances and applications utilizing automation tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency
  • Develop deploy and maintain Ansible playbooks for the purpose of automating rapid installation and system patching within multiple large-scale environments
  • Develop systems engineering-related documentation to include operational concept, requirements, specifications, interface control documents, and validation & verification plans
  • Conduct system planning and design for expansion of these resources to meet program needs
  • Support ground system related trade studies

#Typhon

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • This position requires the candidate to possess a minimum of Top-Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI. The candidate must maintain the clearance.
  • Associates degree and 10+ years of experience in a systems engineering related field; OR bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field and 8+ years of experience in a systems engineering related field; or a master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field and 6+ years of experience in a Systems Engineering related field. Four (4) years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree
  • Meet DoD 8140 foundational requirements for a System Developer with a proficiency of advanced.
  • High proficiency with Linux and Windows-based operating systems to include a deep, core understanding of the operating systems' concepts and functionality, experience building and configuring systems from scratch, experience troubleshooting functionality, and performing all functions leveraging automation tooling where possible
  • High proficiency in installing, configuring, and deploying services from scratch to include configuration of security, certificate, and authentication settings following industry standard best practices
  • High proficiency creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Ansible playbooks for system configuration and system sustainment activities (e.g. patching)
  • High proficiency in the use of scripting languages such as Ansible, Bash, or Python for task automation such as package installation and configuration across an array of physical and/or virtual hosts
  • Experience using Git to include collaboration, configuration management tracking, and code review facilitation
  • Experience creating and updating process documentation to include infrastructure deployments, application installation, and system sustainment activities
  • Direct experience with host/application integration into an Identity and Access Management (IDAM) system such as Active Directory, FreeIPA, or other similar systems, including deploying PKI infrastructure and troubleshooting PKI related issues
  • Direct experience with RHEL 9.x and above to include building systems up from bare metal, performing software package installation and update, operating system configuration, and application troubleshooting
  • Direct experience troubleshooting application and system level issues caused by PKI configuration, networking, firewalls, or other similar OS/infrastructure layers
  • High proficiency in leveraging automation tools to perform security hardening to include patching for vulnerabilities, configuration changes, experience configuring and troubleshooting SELinux, and debugging/troubleshooting system and application functionality because of hardening changes
  • Proficiency with multiple Red Hat tools, to include Red Hat OpenStack (RHOSP), Red Hat OpenShift (RHOCP), Red Hat OpenStack Services on OpenShift (RHOSO), and Red Hat Satellite, or similar related technologies

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes to include troubleshooting containerized workloads, investigating node related issues, and deploying/upgrading solutions using YAML manifests, Helm, or GitOps CD
  • Experience deploying, configuring, managing databases such as deploying/operating PostgreSQL/MySQL (backups, HA patterns)
  • Experience deploying, configuring, managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) technologies such as ADFS/Keycloak/Okta, SAML/ODIC
  • Experience implementing and leveraging system monitoring tools, to include log aggregation (Splunk, Elasticsearch), infrastructure telemetry (Sensu, Prometheus), and visualization (Grafana, Kibana)
  • Experience with engineering infrastructure solutions that maximize uptime, reduce repetitive tasking, and mitigate human error
  • Experience with out-of-band (OOB) technologies to manage remote resources such as iDRAC/iLO/IPMI
  • Ability to express yourself confidently, concisely, and accurately through written and oral communications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with management, the customer and tenants across DoD
  • Detail oriented, can multi-task, and can work with minimal supervision

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

About Mindful Support Services  

Mindful Support Services is a business-to-business support organization that empowers independent mental health professionals by providing administrative services, infrastructure, and business tools to grow their private practices. Supporting over 2,000 providers and rapidly expanding into new states and virtual platforms, our mission is to increase access to high-quality mental health care through operational excellence, innovation, and compassionate service.

About The Role 

The Network and Systems Engineer serves as a key technical resource responsible for maintaining and enhancing our infrastructure while planning, designing, and deploying new solutions to support our growing business needs. This role partners with internal engineering teams and business stakeholders to implement scalable technologies, recommend improvements, and ensure a secure, reliable, and high-performing environment.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience with Azure networking and compute services, enterprise network infrastructure, and systems administration. Success in this role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving, a commitment to operational excellence, and hands-on experience with technologies such as Fortinet or other enterprise networking platforms.

Location & Travel

This is a full-time position based at the headquarters of Mindful Support Services, LLC in Mountlake Terrace, WA. Some travel may be required to engage with stakeholders, visit local MSS branch office networks, or participate in industry events.

Requirements

What You Will Do:

  • Manage Azure Private networks, including route tables, network security groups, private endpoints, Front Door WAF, and Container Apps network environments.
  • Maintain and configure traditional firewalls and web application firewalls in Azure and on-prem.
  • Deploy and maintain Azure compute resources such as VMs, App Services, and Containers.
  • Perform backups of Azure VMs, firewalls, databases, etc. and complete disaster recovery testing to validate the functionality of backups.
  • Maintain and upgrade VPNs (IPSec and SSL) for remote access and site-to-site functionality.
  • Develop shell scripts to automate routine processes in Azure, on servers, and other devices.
  • Configure settings in M365 or other cloud admin portals in collaboration with internal teams as necessary.
  • Troubleshoot network and system outages.
  • Implement long term network and system improvements both on prem and in the cloud.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, engineers, and external vendors on systems and networking projects.
  • Provide tier 3 support for escalated issues from internal technology teams.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to answer urgent escalations per the on-call schedule.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, networking, or systems, or equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
  • Maintains Networking+, Security+, or other professional certifications.
  • 4+ total years of total experience in Information Technology, including 2+ years of experience in systems/network administration or engineering.
  • Strong cloud systems and networking fundamentals, primarily for Azure.
  • Experience with Fortinet, Meraki, or other enterprise network solutions.
  • Experience performing system administration tasks in Linux, Windows, and MacOS environments.
  • Ability to create shell scripts in Bash or PowerShell.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code solutions such as Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or Bicep.
  • Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize deliverables without direct supervision.
  • Background working in healthcare or knowledge of HIPAA compliance.

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits:

  • 75% employer covered Health, Dental & Vision benefits plan
  • 401(k) savings plan with employer matching upon eligibility
  • 8 paid holidays
  • 15 PTO days accrued annually
  • Professional and career development opportunities
  • Compensation evaluated with opportunities for advancement

Location: Mountlake Terrace, Wa, hybrid options available

Salary: $100,000 - $110,000 annually, DOE

About Mindful Support Services  

Mindful Support Services is a business-to-business support organization that empowers independent mental health professionals by providing administrative services, infrastructure, and business tools to grow their private practices. Supporting over 2,000 providers and rapidly expanding into new states and virtual platforms, our mission is to increase access to high-quality mental health care through operational excellence, innovation, and compassionate service.

About The Role 

The Network and Systems Engineer serves as a key technical resource responsible for maintaining and enhancing our infrastructure while planning, designing, and deploying new solutions to support our growing business needs. This role partners with internal engineering teams and business stakeholders to implement scalable technologies, recommend improvements, and ensure a secure, reliable, and high-performing environment.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience with Azure networking and compute services, enterprise network infrastructure, and systems administration. Success in this role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving, a commitment to operational excellence, and hands-on experience with technologies such as Fortinet or other enterprise networking platforms.

Location & Travel 

This is a full-time position based at the headquarters of Mindful Support Services, LLC in Mountlake Terrace, WA. Some travel may be required to engage with stakeholders, visit local MSS branch office networks, or participate in industry events.

Requirements

What You Will Do: 



-  Manage Azure Private networks, including route tables, network security groups, private endpoints, Front Door WAF, and Container Apps network environments. 
- Maintain and configure traditional firewalls and web application firewalls in Azure and on-prem. 
- Deploy and maintain Azure compute resources such as VMs, App Services, and Containers. 
- Perform backups of Azure VMs, firewalls, databases, etc. and complete disaster recovery testing to validate the functionality of backups. 
- Maintain and upgrade VPNs (IPSec and SSL) for remote access and site-to-site functionality. 
- Develop shell scripts to automate routine processes in Azure, on servers, and other devices. 
- Configure settings in M365 or other cloud admin portals in collaboration with internal teams as necessary. 
- Troubleshoot network and system outages. 
- Implement long term network and system improvements both on prem and in the cloud. 
- Collaborate with internal teams, engineers, and external vendors on systems and networking projects. 
- Provide tier 3 support for escalated issues from internal technology teams. 
- Participate in an on-call rotation to answer urgent escalations per the on-call schedule. 

What We Look For:



-  Bachelor's degree in computer science, networking, or systems, or equivalent combination of experience and certifications. 
- Maintains Networking+, Security+, or other professional certifications. 
- 4+ total years of total experience in Information Technology, including 2+ years of experience in systems/network administration or engineering. 
- Strong cloud systems and networking fundamentals, primarily for Azure. 
- Experience with Fortinet, Meraki, or other enterprise network solutions. 
- Experience performing system administration tasks in Linux, Windows, and MacOS environments. 
- Ability to create shell scripts in Bash or PowerShell. 
- Familiarity with infrastructure as code solutions such as Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or Bicep. 
- Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders. 
- Ability to work independently and prioritize deliverables without direct supervision. 
- Background working in healthcare or knowledge of HIPAA compliance. 

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits:



- 75% employer covered Health, Dental & Vision benefits plan
- 401(k) savings plan with employer matching upon eligibility
- 8 paid holidays
- 15 PTO days accrued annually
- Professional and career development opportunities
- Compensation evaluated with opportunities for advancement

descriptionHtml:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

Operate and improve production infrastructure that supports engineering and business teams. Apply established systems, network, or cloud patterns, automate recurring work, and keep services dependable. Handle routine changes independently within agreed limits, seeking review for unfamiliar designs or higher-impact work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate assigned infrastructure services, maintaining configurations, dependencies, inventory, and approved access controls while coordinating service needs with engineering and business partners.
  • Provision resources using established infrastructure-as-code patterns and automate recurring tasks with maintainable, reviewable scripts; request review for unfamiliar designs.
  • Monitor health, capacity, configuration drift, and resource use; investigate incidents and escalate unfamiliar failures or broader risks with diagnostic evidence.
  • Deliver scoped patches, upgrades, and configuration changes with impact checks, peer review, validation, rollback guidance, and documented recovery exercises.
  • Maintain runbooks, backup and configuration-recovery workflows, and incident records; share service knowledge and turn recurring operational problems into reusable improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering experience, including hands-on administration and troubleshooting of production services within an assigned domain.
  • Practical knowledge of operating systems, networking, or cloud services, including related dependencies and recognizing when specialist support is needed.
  • Ability to use version control, infrastructure definitions, and scripting to deliver repeatable changes with understandable error handling and reviewable implementation.
  • Experience using monitoring and diagnostic evidence to investigate incidents, assess capacity or resource use, and communicate findings to service partners.
  • Ability to carry out controlled changes and restore or configuration-recovery procedures, including validation, rollback planning, and applying approved access controls.
  • Clear documentation and collaboration skills, with sound judgment about assigned service responsibilities, timely escalation, and follow-through on operational improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting connected infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, including understanding their operational dependencies and constraints.
  • Experience improving shared infrastructure-as-code modules or reusable operational workflows through peer-reviewed contributions and clear documentation.
  • Experience using incident and maintenance findings to reduce repeated manual work and improve operational runbooks.

Additional Requirements

  • Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Pay Range

$115,000—$175,000 USD

At Mach, we believe that compensation is more than just a paycheck. It's a comprehensive package designed to reward the time, skills, and expertise you bring to our team. We are committed to offering competitive compensation that is equitable, transparent, and aligned with market trends.

Key Elements Of Our Compensation Philosophy

  • Competitive Salaries: We continuously research market rates to ensure our salaries are competitive with those in our industry and geographic location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Our bonus structure is tied to both individual and company performance, creating a win-win scenario that motivates our team members to excel.
  • Equity Participation: We offer stock options or equity to employees, ensuring that you share in the success and growth of the company.
  • Benefit Packages: Our benefits include healthcare, dental and vision plans, retirement savings, and paid time off, because we understand that your well-being extends beyond the office.
  • Professional Development: We allocate funds for continuing education, training, and career growth.
  • Transparency: We are committed to openness about our compensation tiers and how decisions are made, ensuring trust and mutual respect.

By joining Mach, you’re not just accepting a job—you’re becoming a key part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your growth. Together, we aim to create a rewarding environment that sets the stage for long-term success.

Data Privacy

To view Mach Industries candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://machindustries.com/privacy-policy.

Disclosures

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws. If you’d like to defend the American way of life, please reach out!

Position Summary

Two Sigma is a leading quantitative investment management and trading firm. The company applies a scientific approach to investing, combining cutting-edge technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and quantitative research with rigorous human inquiry to capitalize on market opportunities and deliver alpha for investors.

Our team of engineers, quantitative researchers and data scientists looks beyond the traditional to test hypotheses and develop creative solutions to some of the world’s most complex economic problems.

The Infrastructure Engineering team focuses on developing and supporting the core of Two Sigma's Linux environment. You'll work closely with collaborators across the company to ensure that our innovative research and trading software can run across multiple environments at substantial scale. You'll lead a variety of critical tasks, including modifications of upstream Debian images for bare metal/VMs/containers, compiling custom kernels, configuration management, server monitoring and telemetry, and much more. Your focus will be across the full stack - from hardware to the virtualization layer to the OS, automating lifecycle management of our enterprise Linux environment.

You Will Take On The Following Responsibilities

  • Improve and manage the Linux platform, focusing on performance improvements and reducing operational complexity
  • Develop automation to maintain our Linux environment
  • Solve sophisticated issues across the stack, from kernel-level problems to application performance
  • Lead the full lifecycle of Linux systems from certification of new hardware, image creation, installation, upgrades and overall lifecycle management

You Should Possess The Following Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience required; 1-5 years of experience preferred working in a Linux systems, software or reliability engineering capacity
  • Experience running and configuring large-scale Linux environments (100s-1000s of servers)
  • Proven programming experience in Python, Go or a similar programming language
  • Understanding of system design principles, including distributed systems architecture and networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, and firewalls
  • Deep knowledge of Linux internals including the scheduler, memory management, and network stack
  • Experience with low-latency tuning techniques such as busy polling, huge pages, real-time kernels, and isolcpus
  • Familiarity with kernel bypass networking, FPGA integration, or direct market access connectivity is highly desirable
  • Experience with containers, Kubernetes, and/or C to help compile and troubleshoot kernel issues is a plus

You Will Enjoy The Following Benefits

  • Core Benefits: Fully paid medical and dental insurance premiums for employees and dependents, competitive 401k match, employer-paid life & disability insurance
  • Perks: Onsite gyms with laundry service, wellness activities, casual dress, snacks, game rooms
  • Learning: Tuition reimbursement, conference and training sponsorship
  • Time Off: Generous vacation and unlimited sick days, competitive paid caregiver leaves
  • Hybrid Work Policy: Flexible in-office days with budget for home office setup

The base pay for this role will be between $165,000 and $250,000. This role may also be eligible for other forms of compensation and benefits, such as a discretionary bonus, health, dental and other wellness plans and 401(k) contributions. Discretionary bonus can be a significant portion of total compensation. Actual compensation for successful candidates will be carefully determined based on a number of factors, including their skills, qualifications and experience.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Two Sigma is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

If you believe you need an accommodation, please visit our website for additional information.
