descriptionHtml:
L2T is seeking a motivated and technically skilled Systems Engineer to support the design, integration, implementation, and sustainment of complex information technology and mission-support systems. The Systems Engineer will play a key role in translating customer requirements into technical solutions, supporting system architecture development, and ensuring reliable performance across hardware, software, networking, and cloud-based environments. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and mission-focused solutions for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior technical resource and escalation point for complex production issues
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across systems, networks, applications, and services
  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise Linux systems and network infrastructure
  • Architect and support scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure solutions
  • Lead automation initiatives using SaltStack and other infrastructure automation tools
  • Engineer and maintain Cisco and Juniper network environments to meet performance, security, and reliability requirements
  • Administer and support identity management services, including FreeIPA/IPA
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, documentation, and operational procedures
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and make recommendations for infrastructure improvements and modernization
  • Ensure systems and networks meet or exceed security, compliance, and operational standards
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster technical growth across the team
  • Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams to develop solutions that meet current and future business requirements
  • Participate in architecture reviews, capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives


The ideal candidate is a hands-on senior engineer with deep Linux and networking expertise, strong automation skills, and a proven ability to solve complex infrastructure challenges. They possess a strong engineering mindset, thrive in highly technical environments, and are passionate about building reliable, scalable, and secure systems. Cloud experience is a plus but not required.

  • 10+ years of experience in Systems, Network, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Expert-level knowledge of Linux administration in enterprise or mission-critical environments
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, including system calls, processes, memory management, filesystems, and performance tuning
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise infrastructure environments
  • Hands-on experience with SaltStack (Salt) and infrastructure automation
  • Experience administering identity and access management solutions, including FreeIPA/IPA
  • Strong networking expertise, including
    • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs
    • Routing and switching technologies
    • OSPF, BGP, policy-based routing, and network security
    • Cisco and Juniper network platforms
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, hypervisors, and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI)
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Experience developing and maintaining secure, hardened system and network configurations
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, network infrastructure, applications, and distributed systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

L2T is a fast-growing, high-tech, mission-driven company based out of Reston, Virginia that prides itself on delivering technical and mission-related solutions that allow our customers to succeed in achieving their most challenging goals.

We are a close-knit team of highly motivated and skilled individuals that are focused on a commitment to facing the most complex and difficult efforts head-on with a balance of creativity and discipline, and an unwavering nerve.  

Our Team embraces the concept that the sky's the limit. Regardless of where you are at in your career, our goal is to work with you to refine your skills, add to your technical tool belt, and aid you in your growth as a professional.  We offer growth opportunities such as leadership training, industry conferences, and mentorship from experienced, passionate individuals.

Our Benefits

  • 401(k) match of 6% with immediate vesting
  • Highly subsidized Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Legal resource plan
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • 11 Federal holidays
  • Life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage paid by the company
  • Team activities and gaming


We believe in paying fairly and competitively based on the value each team member brings to the role. Individual compensation is determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, certifications, location, and market data. The anticipated salary range for this position is $170,000 - $200,000 annually.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, national origin, color, age, military service eligibility or veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other protected class. We encourage and support workplace diversity.

Employment Type: Direct Hire


About the Opportunity

Are you currently working for an MSP and looking for an opportunity to earn more, advance your technical career, and work with a wider range of technologies instead of being stuck handling the same support tickets every day?

We're partnering with an award-winning, rapidly growing Cloud & Managed Services Provider that's expanding its engineering team in Northern Virginia.

This organization has earned national recognition as a leading MSP, including placement on the MSP 501, MSP 500, CRN Tech Elite 250, and fastest-growing technology company lists. With more than 36 technologies in its environment, a strong investment in employee development, and a culture built around teamwork, this is an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded infrastructure engineer.


Previous Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is required.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Support, administer, and troubleshoot client infrastructure across Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Azure, networking, and virtualization environments.
  • Take ownership of technical issues involving servers, endpoints, cloud services, and network infrastructure.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 environments, including Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, SharePoint, and related services.
  • Configure, support, and troubleshoot network infrastructure involving Cisco, SonicWall, and HP/Aruba technologies.
  • Support VMware virtualization environments, Windows Server infrastructure, and Active Directory.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, including server deployments, cloud migrations, network upgrades, and system improvements.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple client environments, identifying root causes rather than relying on temporary fixes.
  • Support network security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, endpoint security, and access management.
  • Assist with backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
  • Work with senior engineers on infrastructure design, technical escalations, and project implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes through scripting, automation, and documentation.
  • Communicate directly with clients to understand technical issues and provide effective solutions.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket updates, and client environment records.
  • Participate in scheduled after-hours support or project work when needed.


What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience supporting both Windows and macOS environments.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience, including Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, and SharePoint.
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows Server environments and infrastructure-related issues.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across servers, endpoints, cloud services, and networking.
  • Ability to independently investigate technical issues and identify root causes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with clients.
  • Strong work ethic, accountability, and a team-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continue developing technical skills.
  • Microsoft Azure or AWS administration.
  • VMware virtualization and infrastructure engineering.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation.
  • Endpoint detection and response (EDR) or security compliance tools.
  • Google Workspace administration.
  • API integrations and workflow automation.
  • Advanced networking, firewall configuration, and security technologies.
  • Microsoft, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience with infrastructure projects, migrations, or technical leadership.


A Real Investment in Your Career

Unlike organizations that expect engineers to learn everything on their own, this company provides a structured three-month training program, dedicated professional development time, certification resources, webinars, conferences, training camps, and hands-on mentorship.

Dedicated Time for Professional Development

Employees receive approximately 1.75 hours per week specifically allocated to professional development, allowing you to continue building your technical skills while working full-time.

Exposure to 36+ Technologies

Develop experience across cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, automation, and more. The engineering environment is designed to avoid technical silos, helping you become a more versatile, well-rounded engineer.

Grow From Tier 2 Into Advanced Engineering

The company is open to strong Tier 2 engineers with the right technical foundation and attitude. You'll have opportunities to work alongside experienced engineers, take on more advanced responsibilities, and develop toward higher-level systems and infrastructure engineering.

Outstanding Health & Retirement Benefits

Enjoy 90% employer-paid health insurance for employees, 60% coverage for dependents, fully covered dental and vision benefits, and a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.

A Company That Values Work-Life Balance

Join a team whose leadership emphasizes working to live, not living to work. Employees receive generous PTO, federal holidays, and even their birthday off.

Recognized MSP With a Strong Technical Culture

Work for an organization recognized nationally for its growth, technical expertise, and managed services capabilities, including Microsoft Modern Work recognition and Apple Premium Partner status.


Compensation & Benefits

  • $100,000–$120,000 annual salary
  • Annual profit-sharing bonus (historically approximately 10.5%; not guaranteed)
  • 90% employer-paid employee health insurance
  • 60% employer-paid dependent health coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental and vision coverage
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company matching contributions
  • Generous paid time off
  • Paid federal holidays
  • Your birthday off
  • Complimentary XCAL gym membership

  • Approximately 1.75 hours per week dedicated to professional development
  • Certification training materials and development support
  • Technical conferences, webinars, training camps, and peer mentorship
  • Exposure to 36+ technologies
  • Opportunities for technical growth and advancement


  • MSP experience is required. Strong Microsoft 365, networking, Windows/macOS, and infrastructure troubleshooting experience is essential.

Job Summary:

At Delta Dental of Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana we work to improve oral health through benefit plans, advocacy and community support, and we amplify this mission by investing in initiatives that build healthy, smart, vibrant communities. We are one of the largest dental plan administrators in the country, and are part of the Delta Dental Plans Association, which operates two of the largest dental networks in the nation.

At Delta Dental, we celebrate our All In culture. It’s a mindset, feeling and attitude we wrap around all that we do – from taking charge of our careers, to helping colleagues and lending a hand in the community.

Position Description:

Implements and maintains physical and virtual infrastructure and services. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure the scalability, availability, and security of the systems.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Deploys physical and virtual solutions based on business requirements and leverages available technologies.
  • Implements architecture strategies and standards to deliver optimal performance, security, and cost efficiency within guidelines.
  • Applies and enforces security measures and best practices to protect systems and data.
  • Participates in cross-functional teams on systems management strategies for systems.
  • Builds and updates infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scripts and templates to support automated deployments by using tools and Git repositories.
  • Assists in the development and maintenance of operational policies, procedures, and documentation related to infrastructure.
  • Identifies and resolves routine issues related to physical and virtual services, collaborating with Operations and Application teams and vendors as needed.
  • Participates in capacity planning, performance analysis, and system tuning activities.
  • Proposes innovative solutions by staying current with infrastructure technology trends. Participates in on-call rotation.
  • Supports development teams by providing infrastructure engineering assistance for application deployment and integration.

Perform other related assigned duties as necessary to complete the Primary Job Responsibilities as described above.

Minimum Requirements:

Position requires a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field and three years' experience in the application of infrastructure technologies with hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and managing physical and virtual infrastructure. Certifications such as Red Hat Systems Engineer, Windows Administrator, or VMware Data Center Virtualization are preferred. Will accept any suitable combination of education, training, or experience.

Position requires a knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as physical and virtual compute including rack and blade servers, DAS and SAN storage, physical and virtual networks systems from vendors such as Supermicro, Dell, and CISCO; a proficiency with virtualization technologies and concepts, such as virtual machines (VMs), servers, storage, and compute management with common hypervisors such as VMware, KVM, OpenStack, or Nutanix AHV; a proficiency with the use of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Terraform, BitBucket and Git; the ability to manage compute, storage, and network infrastructures, including CPU and memory controls, storage management, and system networking; the ability to manage, optimize, plan, and design infrastructure that uses Server Operating Systems such as Microsoft Windows, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and Ubuntu, and related technologies such as Active Directory and DNS; a familiarity with security best practices and tools for cloud environments, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, and monitoring; strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a physical and virtual environment; the ability to provide on-call support twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week; basic scripting and automation skills using languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, BitBucket and Git; and solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

General Position Summary

The Cloud Platform Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, automating, and evolving cloud infrastructure and platform services. This position develops resilient infrastructure patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, disaster recovery capabilities, and platform modernization by partnering with Cloud Architecture, Cloud Operations, DevOps, Security, Support, and application teams, driving a more scalable, secure, automated, and operable cloud platform.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and improve Azure infrastructure and platform service patterns.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules, deployment patterns, and platform automation standards.
  • Design and implement networking, compute, storage, PaaS, resiliency, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Support disaster recovery design, recovery readiness, failover planning, and resilience engineering activities.
  • Automate repeatable platform operations using scripting, pipelines, and cloud-native tooling.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Architecture on reference architecture implementation and platform standards.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on deployment orchestration, pipeline integration, and infrastructure delivery processes.
  • Mentor CloudOps team members and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, or operational handoffs.
  • Document design decisions, standards, implementation patterns, operational handoff requirements, and support considerations.
  • Lead complex technical remediation, modernization, and platform improvement efforts.

Job Required Knowledge And Skills

  • AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AZ-700 Azure Network Engineer Associate.
  • AZ-400 DevOps Engineer Expert, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or equivalent automation / IaC experience.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, CI/CD integration, and cloud platform modernization.

descriptionHtml:
OMS National Insurance Company (OMSNIC) is a nationally recognized medical professional liability insurer dedicated exclusively to protecting oral and maxillofacial surgeons and dental specialists. Our mission is clear and purposeful: to serve as trusted advocates for highly skilled professionals when it matters most.

We offer a robust array of benefits to support our employees – generous PTO, long-term incentive plan, affordable and comprehensive benefits plans, a hybrid work schedule, and opportunities to advance your career. What makes us special is our collaborative culture and the impact we make as a team.

As our Network and Cloud Administrator, you'll be hands-on with the technology that keeps our business running — supporting AKS clusters, Azure DevOps pipelines, cloud networking, and security as we move more of our environment into Microsoft Azure. If you enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and seeing your work make a difference, we'd love to meet you.

Position Summary

The Network and Cloud Administrator helps operate, secure, and support OMSNIC's cloud and hybrid infrastructure, with a focus on Microsoft Azure. This role supports containers, AKS, Azure DevOps, cloud networking, firewall systems, and certificate management, while also assisting with on-premises Active Directory and virtualization.

  • We have flexibility to fill this position as a Network and Cloud Administrator or Senior Network and Cloud Administrator based on candidate experience*

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Cloud Platform and Containers

  • Supports Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including monitoring, scaling, upgrades, and troubleshooting
  • Builds, deploys, and maintains containerized workloads using Docker and Azure Container Registry
  • Supports Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines and repositories with the development team
  • Assists with Microsoft Fabric administration, including workspaces, access, and monitoring
  • Helps manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, tagging, and cost reporting following established standards
  • Assists with migrating on-premises and third-party hosted workloads to Azure, including testing and post-migration validation
  • Automates routine tasks using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and AI-assisted tools

Cloud Networking and Security

  • Maintains cloud networking, including virtual networks, subnets, peering, NSGs, private endpoints, DNS, and VPN connectivity
  • Administers firewall rules and policies across Azure Firewall, NSGs, and perimeter firewalls under the direction of senior staff
  • Supports Imperva WAF and DDoS protection, including rule updates and alert review
  • Supports the Cisco Meraki environment, including security appliances, switches, wireless, and VPN
  • Manages SSL/TLS certificate renewals, installation, inventory, and expiration tracking (e.g., Azure Key Vault)
  • Administers Microsoft Entra ID users, groups, MFA, Conditional Access, and SSO
  • Applies patches, remediates vulnerabilities, and maintains CIS Benchmark hardening

Operations and Hybrid Support

  • Monitors cloud, network, and system performance; troubleshoots issues and escalates complex problems as appropriate
  • Performs and verifies backups and participates in disaster recovery testing (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery)
  • Supports on-premises Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and VMware vSphere
  • Maintains infrastructure documentation and helps gather evidence for internal and external audits
  • Works with managed service providers and vendors on support cases; provides escalation support to the Help Desk
  • Participates in after-hours maintenance and on-call support as needed

Qualifications

 Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience with relevant certifications
  • 3+ years of IT infrastructure, network, or systems administration experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure experience in Azure and/or AWS (Azure preferred)
  • 2+ years of Microsoft Entra ID experience, including user management, MFA, and Conditional Access
  • Working knowledge of Docker, containers, and Kubernetes (AKS or Amazon EKS)
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD tools
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking (virtual networks, NSGs, DNS, VPN)
  • Hands-on experience with firewall systems and SSL/TLS certificate management
  • Experience with or exposure to Imperva and Cisco Meraki
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell and/or Azure CLI

Preferred

  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric
  • Participation in a cloud migration project
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates)
  • On-premises Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP
  • VMware vSphere, Nutanix, and/or HPE Morpheus
  • Azure Monitor and Defender for Cloud; Windows Server 2019+ and Linux
  • Using AI tools to automate IT tasks
  • Familiarity with Sophos, ManageEngine Endpoint Central and ServiceDesk Plus, Intune, Mimecast, Tenable, MS SQL, and ImageRight

Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), preferred, or willingness to obtain within the first 12 months
  • A plus: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Cisco Meraki (CMNA) or CCNA, Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)

Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud, container, network, and security environments
  • Understanding of security principles, including least privilege
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation and explaining technical issues to employees and vendors
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks, prioritize, and meet deadlines
  • Collaborative, positive working relationships with staff, managed service providers, and vendors
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies, especially Azure, and adapt priorities to meet company needs

Physical Demands

  • Occasionally (several times a week) lifts, carries, or otherwise moves and positions objects weighing up to 10 pounds while fulfilling responsibilities
  • Frequently sits for long periods of time

Work Environment

  • Performs work in an office environment (hybrid schedule of 3 days per week in-office, after initial training period)
  • Participates in after-hours maintenance and on-call support as needed

Salary: $100,000-$130,000

The salary range represents the entirety of the pay grade for this role. Specific salaries will be determined using a variety of factors, including specific skills, qualifications, and years of experience

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Short and Long-term disability
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free onsite fitness center membership
  • Long-term incentive plan
  • Educational Assistance and rewards program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid parental leave

We have an inclusive, supportive, collaborative culture that makes National Philanthropic Trust one of the most rewarding places to work.

What You'll Do

The Lead Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting the organization’s cloud and infrastructure platforms. This role focuses on Microsoft Azure Landing Zones, cloud networking, infrastructure automation, governance, and platform modernization initiatives.

The position serves as a lead individual contributor for infrastructure engineering. They will partner with security, architecture, application development, IT operations, and external vendors to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions that support organizational operations and business objectives.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support the organization’s Microsoft Azure environment, including Landing Zones, subscription strategy, governance, policies, and resource organization.
  • Lead cloud and infrastructure projects from planning through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design, implement, and support cloud networking, connectivity, routing, VPN, firewall, identity, and security solutions across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Support SaaS integrations, including internal and external-facing multi-tier applications, and coordinate infrastructure requirements for application connectivity, identity, certificates, networking, monitoring, and secure platform integration.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking and connectivity issues involving cloud platforms, firewalls, VPNs, wireless networks, identity services, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage and support certificate services, including public and private certificates, certificate lifecycle management, renewal processes, certificate-based authentication, and integration with enterprise platforms.
  • Partner with security, architecture, application development, IT operations, and vendors to deliver infrastructure initiatives and platform improvements.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide technical leadership during incident response and root cause analysis activities.
  • Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, documentation, architecture diagrams, and platform governance practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, operational efficiency, automation, and cost optimization.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource, mentor, and technical lead for infrastructure initiatives across the technology organization.


What You Bring

  • Strong experience designing, implementing, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Landing Zones, governance, and cloud architecture best practices.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or similar technologies).
  • Experience developing automation solutions using PowerShell, scripting, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of cloud and enterprise networking, including routing, VPN technologies, firewalls, DNS, load balancing, and network security.
  • Experience managing PKI, SSL/TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, and certificate lifecycle processes.
  • Experience with Entra ID management, conditional access, Intune, and RBAC policies preferred.
  • Experience with monitoring and recovery responsibilities, including Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and disaster recovery testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex networking, identity, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to make sound technical decisions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders.


Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 8 years of relevant, progressive infrastructure engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience leading infrastructure, cloud, or platform modernization projects.
  • Relevant Microsoft Azure, Terraform, DevOps, cloud architecture, or security certifications are preferred.


Hybrid Work Schedule:

  • This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires onsite presence in our Conshohocken, PA office every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.


Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 15 pounds.
  • Occasional travel between company offices or vendor locations may be required.

  • Architecture, Information Security, development, and data teams.

  • Implement monitoring and security telemetry using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender and related enterprise security platforms.
  • Participate in architecture, security, vulnerability, configuration, and operational-readiness reviews.
  • Support backup, recovery, resiliency, and disaster-recovery capabilities based on approved RTO/RPO requirements.
  • Assist with cloud capacity planning, consumption monitoring, optimization, reservations, and cost forecasting.

Projects 25%

  • Effectively manage time and priorities.
  • Participate directly with implementation partners during the design and implementation of the RHTP technology platform.
  • Perform hands-on implementation alongside implementation partners to develop internal operational knowledge of the RHTP environment.
  • Review vendor-developed infrastructure configurations, deployment processes, documentation, architecture, and operational procedures before transition to production support.
  • Ensure infrastructure delivered by implementation partners conforms to Vaya Partners architecture, security, operational, and support standards.
  • Identify operational gaps, technical debt, support dependencies, and risks prior to production transition.
  • Develop runbooks, support procedures, monitoring requirements, recovery procedures, and technical documentation required for ongoing operations.
  • Participate in design reviews, implementation planning, testing, production-readiness reviews, and deployment activities.
  • Deliver assigned projects on schedule and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and technical issues to project and ISD leadership.
  • Provide technical recommendations and designs that support RHTP business and technology objectives.

Other Duties as Assigned 5%

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Ability to install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, and software is required.
  • In depth knowledge of Linux
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Microsoft Azure and related cloud platforms
  • Power Platform, application integration, data services
  • Identity, networking, monitoring, security
  • Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery
  • Coordinate integrated network operation efforts, IT planning, security, and other technical areas at assigned data centers
  • Apply critical thinking to quickly identify problems and implement solutions with minimal downtime.
  • Utilize software and hardware diagnostic tools to identify, diagnose, and repair complex problems affecting system availability and performance.
  • Using logic and wholistic analysis identify the strengths and weaknesses of different approaches. Be able to qualify decisions with solid reasoning and justification.
  • Ability to multitask and perform a multitude of administrative and engineering tasks at one time unsupervised. Effectively collaborate in a team environment or work independently as needed.
  • Provide mentorship to others and perform knowledge transfer as required.
  • Maintain awareness of advances in information technology and developments in cyber security realms.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
  • Strong work ethic is required.

Education/Experience Required: High School graduate or equivalent and Minimum of five (5) years experience in some combination of Azure Cloud System/Server Engineering or Network Infrastructure.

Must have ability to physically come into the office as needed.

Education/Experience Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.

Licensure/Certification Requirements: N/A

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (RAPTOR)

SpaceX is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer with a strong drive to solve challenging problems in the Raptor engine organization. You will be empowered to solve a wide range of systems engineering problems – including High Performance Computing, System performance, networking, manufacturing infrastructure – with the singular goal of accelerating the pace of rocket engine development and delivering excellent results. You will work with engineering, analysis, IT, and facilities teams to identify and solve fundamental challenges to scaling the department engineering output.

Responsibilities

  • Manage server infrastructure, HPC systems, storage systems, networks, and high-speed interconnect (Infiniband).
  • Design, procure, and integrate infrastructure systems.
  • Work with propulsion engineering staff to solve critical bottlenecks.
  • Coordinate and communicate with company -wide infrastructure and IT teams.
  • Support application deployment (ANSYS, StarCCM+, manufacturing software) for best performance of software on real-world systems.

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with client and server hardware/software, management tools, enterprise networking, virtualization, and security technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience with Linux and Windows server software.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • 1+ year of systems engineering experience
  • Experience with scripting languages (Bash, Python), automation (Puppet, Ansible), and other common sysadmin tools.
  • Experience building, deploying, and troubleshooting large-scale compute systems.
  • Familiarity with resource development and management (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Familiarity with engineering and analysis applications, such as CFD and FEA.
  • Familiarity with diagnosing bottlenecks and designing systems for performance.
  • Able to work effectively in a dynamic environment while assuming high levels of responsibility and demonstrating accountability for rocket engine-level outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Pay range:

Site Reliability Engineer/Level 1: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00/per year

Site Reliability Engineer/Level 2: $145,000.00 - $175,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Itar Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are building the next generation of cloud-native infrastructure to build a system that will have a positive impact on the intelligence community (IC). We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated senior Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to join our growing team. If you have a passion for automation, cloud infrastructure, and Kubernetes, and you're excited to use the latest open-source tools, this is the role for you.

As an experienced Infrastructure Cloud engineer on our team, you will use your development experience to build, deploy, and manage a cloud agnostic platform for a multi-tenant environment. You will collaborate with engineering teams to design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient infrastructure solutions, ensuring seamless operation and deployment of cloud-native applications. Join our team as we build tools to transform the future of the IC.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or infrastructure engineering
  • Experience in Kubernetes architecture, deployment, management, container orchestration, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting
  • Experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining Linux server systems in the Cloud
  • Experience with automation tools
  • Knowledge of AWS services and how to integrate them with Kubernetes
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with scripting or object-oriented programming in Bash, Python, Groovy, or Golang
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm for Kubernetes, or Terragrunt
  • Experience with Kubernetes Operators, Rancher, and RKE2

Job Overview:

Join us as a Senior Microsoft Azure Engineer, where you'll be integral to designing, implementing, and maintaining our Windows Server infrastructure. Your role will be crucial in ensuring maximum system availability, performance, and security, aligning with our organization's mission of delivering exceptional service to our clients.

Please note: This position does not offer work authorization sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must have valid U.S. work authorization that does not require employer sponsorship.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer and manage Active Directory infrastructure to maintain an efficient and secure user environment.
  • Monitor server performance and conduct system health checks to proactively identify and resolve issues, optimizing performance for financial applications.
  • Collaborate with other IT teams to plan and implement server infrastructure upgrades, patches, and migrations, ensuring minimal disruption to financial operations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server-related incidents and problems, minimizing impact on financial business processes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing and ensure accurate system recovery processes.
  • Drive architecture designs with an 'automation first' approach, focusing on Infrastructure as Code.
  • Identify risks in the environment that threaten stability, resiliency, performance, and security.
  • Responsible for operating system templates and deployment automation.
  • Evaluate tools/products to resolve technology gaps and participate in application roadmap planning.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices, recommending enhancements to meet evolving business needs.


What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • Azure Services and Architecture: 7+ years of Azure services across compute, storage, networking, and databases, along with understanding Azure architecture principles for designing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions.
  • Azure Security and Identity Management: 5+ years Azure security features such as role-based access control (RBAC), Azure Security Center, and Azure Key Vault, coupled with expertise in Azure Active Directory (AAD) for identity and access management.
  • Azure Monitoring and Management: 5+ years monitoring and managing Azure resources using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Management Groups, ensuring optimal performance, availability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Azure DevOps and Governance: 5+ years of Azure DevOps services for CI/CD and infrastructure as code (IaC), along with knowledge of Azure governance concepts using Azure Policy, Azure Blueprint, and Azure Cost Management for compliance and cost control.
  • Azure Hybrid Solutions and Data Services: 5+ years of hybrid cloud solutions integrating on-premises infrastructure with Azure using Azure Arc, as well as familiarity with Azure data services for data integration, analytics, and big data processing.


Core Competencies:

  • Proficiency in Windows Server OS, Domain Controller management, Active Directory, Azure management, DNS, ACL, Windows Server CIS hardening controls, Audit Compliance, and Microsoft PowerShell.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages for automation and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with server monitoring and management tools.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Preferences:

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (GitHub, Atlassian, Jenkins, Puppet, Terraform, Ansible), Manage Engine, Infoblox, Service Now, and JIRA.
  • Overall, a Microsoft Azure engineer is expected to have a comprehensive understanding of Azure services, architecture, security, networking, monitoring, and management to design, implement, and manage cloud solutions effectively.


Please note: This position does not offer work authorization sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must have valid U.S. work authorization that does not require employer sponsorship.

Pay Range:

$112,476.00 - $187,460.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Bring your IT experience to Boise Cascade as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer! You will work on the Infrastructure Team of our Corporate IT Department and report to the Infrastructure Services Manager.

  • This position is on site at the corporate office in Boise, Idaho

Pay Range: $90,000 to $115,000

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, plan, design, install, maintain, manage, coordinate, and integrate network, server, storage and voice infrastructure components on-premise and in the public cloud required to support operations throughout the corporation on an enterprise and site-by-site basis.
  • Provide technical and interpersonal leadership, promoting accountability, innovation and teamwork within the Corporate IT infrastructure team to deliver results. Work with other areas of IT to insure current and/or planned applications and databases are supported across the infrastructure.
  • Implement and maintain ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) capabilities, including configuration management, service mapping, event management, and discovery, to improve visibility and operational support across enterprise infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable Configuration Management Database (CMDB) data, ensuring infrastructure components, dependencies, ownership, and relationships are documented and aligned with operational standards.
  • Demonstrate basic understanding of network, server, storage and cloud technologies.
  • Develop documentation on system specification and operating instructions. Develop scripts to assist in automation of routine tasks, alerts and notifications.
  • Determine best systems software and hardware configurations, ensuring hardware and software suitability.
  • Review changes to IT systems to ensure compliance with security standards. Recommend and coordinate the implementation of technical controls to support and enforce defined security policies. Assist in designing, implementing and enforcing security polices to protect systems and data from access by unauthorized individuals.
  • Maintain operating systems across all infrastructure components with current service packs and security packages.
  • Monitor and respond to user problems using diagnostic/monitoring tools, identifies root cause, recommends solutions, coordinates repair/resolution.
  • Maintain up-to-date disaster recovery documentation and procedures and incorporates disaster recovery needs in the design and configuration of system architecture.
  • Interface with vendors of assigned systems and/or equipment providers to ensure problem resolution and required level of support is provided.
  • Participate in 24/7 Infrastructure Department on-call rotation.
  • Demonstrate strong commitment to safety, quality, environmental awareness, and continuous process improvement.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • College Degree, or equivalent work experience in related job function
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in related job function, or advanced degree and / or superior technical skills
  • 5+ Years of Experience on VMWare vSphere
  • 5+ Years of Experience on Cisco Networking (Route, Switch, NXOS & Wireless)
  • 5+ Years of Experience Storage Area Network (SAN) Management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Information Systems/MIS, Computer Science, or Networking degree or associated experience/certifications
  • Experience on Palo Alto Networks
  • Experience with ServiceNow ITOM, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB administration or data-quality practices.
  • Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or comparable automation technologies.

descriptionHtml:
About Torus

We are a Utah-based company that designs, engineers and manufactures energy and AI computing infrastructure for utilities and businesses. Torus is the world’s first flexible energy infrastructure built to unite people and communities through sustainable, secure, and intelligent power. We build the hardware, write the software and maintain the systems. Nearly 400 of us work across three facilities in the state, and the biggest is GigaOne, our 545,000-square-foot manufacturing plant in Salt Lake City.

Our energy storage systems pair fast-responding flywheels with batteries. Installed close to where the power is used, they help utilities and businesses manage peak demand and make better use of the grid infrastructure that’s already in place. Our newest product, Torus Foundry, brings AI computing to sites that have spare electrical capacity on an existing grid connection. Customers can have it running in 12 to 16 weeks instead of waiting years for new power plants and transmission lines to be built.

In November 2026, Torus secured $500 million in new funding, on top of the more than $267 million raised earlier. That investor confidence reflects the strength of our team and technology, as well as the scale of the problem we’re solving. Torus was named Battery Manufacturer of the Year at the 2026 Battery Awards, and Fast Company put us on its 2026 Next Big Things in Tech list.

Working at Torus means building infrastructure that people count on. The systems you help design, build or support will help keep the grid steady and critical facilities running for years to come. We value accountability, collaboration and clear thinking. We’re looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter.

About The Role

The Systems Engineer II will build, run, and improve the platforms that connect Torus sites: provisioning and operating systems, secure remote access, telemetry collection, and the integration of industrial controllers and facility equipment into our central monitoring environment. You will own the day-to-day health of these systems and drive them toward more automation, reliability, and visibility.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable crossing boundaries between servers, networks, and industrial equipment. You will work closely with network, compute, and controls teams to bring data from the field into our platforms, and you will administer the core infrastructure tooling that keeps it all running.

Who You Are

You build technology people can rely on, and when it breaks, you find out why. You write down what you learn so the next engineer doesn’t start from zero.

  • You ask before you push back. You find out what others know about the environment before you reject a design or change a config, and you assume good intent.
  • You say it early and directly. You flag risks and missed windows as soon as you see them, give clear feedback, and praise good work openly.
  • You build on strengths. You look for what each teammate does well and use it to cover the team’s gaps.
  • You lead with the answer. Incident updates, change requests, and runbooks open with the status and the action needed.
  • You move fast and test first. You automate repeatable work and validate before rollout.
  • You think in systems. Network, compute, software, and security decisions depend on each other, and on power and cooling at the site. You use telemetry and logs to make the call, and when a technical preference conflicts with what the customer needs, the customer wins.

Responsibilities

Provisioning and operating systems

  • Administer and operate MAAS (Metal as a Service) for bare-metal provisioning, including machine enlistment, commissioning, and deployment workflows
  • Build and maintain standardized OS images, cloud-init configurations, and deployment templates for Linux hosts
  • Automate OS patching, configuration management, and baseline compliance across the fleet
  • Troubleshoot provisioning, boot, and OS-level issues, and document root causes and fixes
  • Work with Compute Engineering on the handoff between hardware standards (BIOS, boot order, BMC) and the MAAS workflow

Secure remote access and connectivity

  • Deploy and maintain Tailscale subnet routers and related access infrastructure across sites, designed for high availability so that no single router is a single point of failure for site access
  • Manage Tailscale ACLs, tags, and access policies based on least-privilege principles, and support third-party and vendor access requests
  • Monitor tunnel health and connectivity, and troubleshoot routing, DNS, and ACL issues using a tiered diagnostic approach
  • Keep subnet routers and supporting hosts patched, hardened, and consistently configured

Telemetry and monitoring

  • Build, deploy, and operate telemetry collection servers and data pipelines that aggregate sensor and device data from field sites, including BMCs (IPMI and Redfish), PDUs, power shelves, cooling distribution units, and network gear
  • Integrate with vendor REST and JSON-RPC APIs, SNMP, and industrial protocols to collect operational data
  • Configure polling, collection intervals, retention, and alerting for operational data
  • Integrate telemetry sources with monitoring, logging, and visualization platforms (for example Datadog)
  • Maintain accurate inventories of data sources, device registers, and collection configurations

Controller and PLC integration

  • Support integration of PLCs and industrial devices (for example chiller and cooling controllers) into central monitoring and control systems, using protocols such as Modbus TCP and other industrial standards
  • Work with controls engineers and vendors on register maps, protocol gateways (serial-to-IP converters, protocol translators), addressing, and test plans
  • Help design network segmentation for controllers and gateways in coordination with network engineering, and validate that integrations stay within defined security boundaries
  • Support commissioning and troubleshooting of controller integrations in the field

Administrative platforms and management plane

  • Administer the management plane of enterprise network and security platforms, including Arista, Cisco, and Palo Alto environments, covering user and role management, configuration backups, firmware upgrades, and logging
  • Maintain management-plane standards: access control, MFA, credential vaulting and rotation across BMCs, PDUs, and network devices, audit logging, and configuration baselines
  • Use centralized management tools (for example, Arista CloudVision, Cisco management platforms, and Panorama) to push and verify configurations
  • Contribute to change management by testing, documenting, and implementing approved changes, working with Network Engineering, who own data-plane design and templates

Documentation, reliability, and collaboration

  • Write and maintain runbooks, diagrams, configuration records, and integration documentation
  • Support security and compliance efforts with NIST and CIS-aligned evidence and configuration documentation
  • Participate in a defined on-call rotation for the platforms you operate
  • Mentor interns and junior staff as opportunities arise

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a similar role
  • Strong Linux administration skills (Ubuntu preferred), including networking, services, storage, and command-line troubleshooting
  • Experience with automated or bare-metal provisioning tools (MAAS, Foreman, PXE/iPXE, Kickstart, cloud-init, or similar)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, firewall concepts, and VPN technologies
  • Experience administering enterprise network or security platforms (Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto, Juniper, Fortinet, or comparable)
  • Proficiency in Python or Bash, including integrating with REST or JSON APIs, plus familiarity with configuration management (Ansible or similar)
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, or telemetry systems
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation and follow change-control procedures
  • Self-directed problem solving with the judgment to know when to escalate
  • Willingness to be part of an on-call rotation
  • Willingness to travel within Utah, with occasional travel to remote sites

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Tailscale, WireGuard, or other mesh or overlay VPNs, including high-availability subnet routing
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, DNP3, BACnet) and experience integrating PLCs or sensors with IT systems
  • Experience with PLC or SCADA platforms (for example CODESYS or Ignition)
  • Experience with serial-to-IP gateways and protocol translation devices
  • Experience with time-series databases and telemetry stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, InfluxDB, Datadog, or similar)
  • Experience with secrets management and credential rotation at fleet scale
  • Familiarity with centralized management platforms such as CloudVision, Panorama, or Cisco Catalyst Center
  • Experience with endpoint security and device management tools (EDR, MDM)
  • Background in OT/ICS, energy, or critical infrastructure environments
  • Knowledge of NIST, CIS, IEC 62443, NERC CIP, CMMC, and similar security frameworks
  • Relevant certifications (CCNA/CCNP, PCNSA/PCNSE, Arista ACE, RHCSA, Linux Foundation)

Additional Details

Background Check All candidates are subject to a background check.

Location This role is a hybrid remote position based in Salt Lake City. The Engineer will be expected to travel to Torus locations located in Salt Lake and Utah counties as needed.

Compensation $100,000 - 160,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.)

Work Authorization Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship.

Physical Requirements

  • Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse.
  • Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job.
  • Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required.
  • When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet.
  • When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and to occasionally rack and install equipment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation, including responding to alerts outside business hours.
  • Ability to travel to Torus sites in Salt Lake and Utah counties and occasionally to remote sites.

Our Perks & Benefits

Benefits eligibility is based on employment status.

Financial

  • Employee Rewards Package including equity
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Torus paid life and AD&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage
  • Voluntary short- and long-term disability insurance

Health & Wellness

  • Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance
  • Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more.

Time Off

  • Unlimited discretionary PTO or 10 days annual PTO
  • 10 paid company holidays
  • Waiting period-free 100% paid parental leave

Culture & Community

  • Regular company-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together.
  • Team members receive Torus branded gear
  • Peer Recognition Program
  • Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel.

Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Torus participates in E-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

Infrastructure Engineers are responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of core infrastructure services across database systems, network infrastructure, end-user computing, and middleware platforms. The team collaborates with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain mission-critical information technology (IT) systems, providing both day-to-day operational support and long-term strategic improvements. The Core Services team focuses specifically on system administration, network administration, and cloud engineering. These roles play a critical part in building and maintaining robust, scalable, and secure environments across on-premises data centers, hybrid cloud, and public cloud platforms. Employees serving at this level - Infrastructure Engineer III - are expected to perform as advanced professionals, handling most non-standard situations independently.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Infrastructure Development: Designs and implements scalable, reliable network infrastructure solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Leads the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new network tools, platforms, or services to improve operational capabilities. Serves as a subject matter expert (SME) in core networking domains such as routing, switching, wireless connectivity, and network security.
  • Operations: Leads the day-to-day operations of critical network infrastructure with a focus on uptime, reliability, and performance. Manages and optimizes on-call rotations for high-impact network services; leads major incident response efforts with urgency and professionalism. Drives continuous improvement efforts in network monitoring, alerting, and traffic visibility.
  • Maintenance: Oversees network device patching, firmware upgrades, and configuration management, ensuring alignment with compliance and security standards. Leads performance tuning and advanced troubleshooting across routing, switching, wireless, and network security layers to resolve complex connectivity issues.
  • Performance & Issue Resolution: Conducts deep-dive root cause analysis of recurring or high-severity network issues; delivers post-mortem documentation and lessons learned. Mentors less-experienced engineers in network diagnostic methods and structured troubleshooting techniques.
  • Documentation: Develops and maintains detailed network architecture documentation, network diagrams, implementation guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Horizon Scanning: Proactively evaluates and recommends new network technologies, cloud networking services, and automation frameworks to enhance network capabilities. Contributes to Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) initiatives, including network resiliency planning, testing, and execution. Contributes to team knowledge-sharing, mentoring less-experienced engineers and guiding cross-functional stakeholders through technical processes.
  • Automation and Modernization: Leads the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and network automation solutions using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar platforms. Promotes network standardization, reusability, and scalability through automated deployments and configuration management practices.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  • Networking: Ability to work with full competence in networking concepts including Internet Protocol (IP) routing, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), subnets, Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), and network segmentation. Capable of designing, configuring, and troubleshooting complex network architectures and integrations across hybrid environments.
  • Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Framework: Ability to apply ITIL practices with full competence, leading incident management, change implementation, and root cause analysis for high-impact systems. Ability to participate in continuous service improvement initiatives and contribute to maturing IT service processes.
  • Command-Line Interfaces and Scripting: Proficient in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python to support operational tasks, automate deployments, and manage system configurations. Ability to work with full competence in command-line environments for system and network administration.
  • Cloud Platforms: Ability to work with full competence in designing, configuring, and maintaining network infrastructure on Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS), including virtual networks, subnets, routing, network security, and network monitoring. Experienced in supporting hybrid cloud connectivity, including virtual private networks (VPNs), private connectivity, and network peering.
  • Tooling and Technology: Ability to work with full competence in a broad range of infrastructure tools, including monitoring / observability platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, Datadog), configuration and deployment tools (e.g., Group Policy, System Center Configuration Manager [SCCM], Terraform, Ansible), continuous integration and continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD) and version control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps), and identity and access management (IAM) platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD). Ability to apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation practices to streamline operations and improve reliability.
  • Communication and Documentation: Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to contribute to documentation, architectural design reviews, and cross-team technical planning efforts.

descriptionHtml:
Requisition Id 16980

Overview

The National Center for Computational Sciences (NCCS) at Oak Ridge National Lab (ORNL), which hosts several of the world’s most powerful computer systems, is seeking a highly qualified individual to play a key role in improving the security, performance, and reliability of the NCCS computing environments. This includes supporting one of the fastest supercomputers in the world, Frontier, along with numerous commodity clusters and specialized programs and partnerships. Frontier is one of the scientific research community's most powerful computational instruments for exploring solutions to some of today's most challenging problems.

As an HPC Linux Systems Engineer, you will work within the HPC Scalable Systems Group inside of the NCCS Systems Section to support numerous activities of the center. The Scalable Systems group oversees, administers and supports system installation, deployment, acceptance, performance testing, upgrades, problem diagnosis, and troubleshooting of large-scale HPC computational resources. The Systems Section is within the National Center for Computational Sciences Division (NCCS). The HPC Systems Section is responsible for the division’s computing, storage, networking, and infrastructure systems and services.The NCCS provides state-of-the-art computational and data science infrastructure, coupled with dedicated technical and scientific professionals, to accelerate scientific discovery and engineering advances across a broad range of disciplines. NCCS hosts the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility, one of DOE’s National User Facilities.

Major Duties/Responsibilities

  • Install, integrate, and administer HPC Linux clusters and high-speed networks
  • Diagnosing system operational problems quickly and effectively
  • Coordinating with vendors to resolve hardware and software problems
  • Recommending, planning, and coordinating hardware and software changes with customer participation using change management processes
  • Porting and writing system management tools
  • Documenting system administration procedures for routine and complex tasks
  • Participating in a 24-hour, 7-day on-call support rotation and off-hours maintenance windows
  • System implementation/integration into the NCCS environment and systems performance analysis.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific or technical field
  • 5+ years of Linux systems experience is required
  • Demonstrated experience working in classified environments, including a thorough understanding of security policies, compliance frameworks, and associated standard processes (e.g., NIST, DISA STIGs).
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing Linux operating systems in a large-scale system environment
  • Solid understanding of networked computing environment concepts
  • 5+ years of experience with Linux Cluster Administration
  • Ability to develop and maintain programs and scripts that aid in the operation and automation of administrative tasks using various shell and scripting languages (bash, Python, Go)
  • Experience with Lustre and GPFS file systems
  • Experience with batch schedulers (particularly SLURM)
  • Experience deploying and maintaining automated configuration management software such as Puppet
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to work as a team player
  • Proactive and solution-oriented problem solver
  • Prior project and/or team leadership experience

Special Requirements

  • Security, Credentials, and Eligibility Requirements: Q clearance with SCI: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. In addition, due the SCI, you may also be subject to random polygraph testing.
  • Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Hybrid/Onsite: In addition, we offer a flexible work environment that supports both the organization and the employee. A hybrid/onsite working arrangement may be available with this position.

About ORNL

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain talented people. The laboratory offers many employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to help you and your family live happy and healthy. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also provided for convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

System Engineer

Carmel, IN


About the Opportunity


A well-established national manufacturer is growing its infrastructure team. After several acquisitions, the company’s server footprint has roughly doubled, and it needs a hands-on engineer to help bring a mix of inherited environments under one standard. This is a working engineer role, not a management or pure architecture seat. You’ll build, fix, and improve the systems yourself.


What You’ll Do


• Run and maintain core Windows and Linux services: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file and print

• Support on-prem, virtualized, and cloud environments end to end: builds, patching, upgrades,

monitoring, security, and cost control

• Manage AWS resources across compute, storage, databases, monitoring, and security

• Maintain and harden VMware environments, including troubleshooting and performance tuning

• Automate repeatable work with PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools

• Build scripts, reports, and integrations that cut manual effort

• Own backup, recovery, and DR testing for assigned systems, aligned to RTO/RPO targets

• Write and maintain runbooks, standards, and technical documentation

• Assess legacy systems, plan consolidations and migrations, and help decommission what’s no longer needed
