Senior Systems Engineer – TS/SCI Clearance Required – Port San Antonio – San Antonio, TX

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation, administration, modernization, and sustainment of complex enterprise server and computing environments.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware virtualization technologies, enterprise storage systems, backup and recovery solutions, and core infrastructure services.

The successful candidate must demonstrate advanced technical proficiency in Windows Server administration, Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter Server, and enterprise storage technologies.

This position requires an engineer capable of independently designing, deploying, configuring, administering, securing, and troubleshooting complex physical and virtual server infrastructure while ensuring system availability, performance, reliability, and operational continuity.

Job Responsibilities

Microsoft Windows Server and Enterprise Services

  • Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server environments.
  • Administer Windows Server 2019, 2022, 2025, and supported enterprise server operating systems.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Active Directory Domain Services, including domain controllers, organizational units, forests, trusts, and replication.
  • Design, implement, and administer Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and enterprise configuration policies.
  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, DFS, SMB file services, and Windows infrastructure services.
  • Manage Active Directory Certificate Services, including enterprise certificate authorities, certificate templates, certificate enrollment, renewal, revocation, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot Kerberos, LDAP, authentication, authorization, and domain-related issues.
  • Perform Windows Server upgrades, patch management, security hardening, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Maintain system configurations, administrative access controls, and operational documentation.


VMware Virtualization and Compute Infrastructure

  • Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot VMware vSphere virtualization environments.
  • Install, administer, and upgrade VMware ESXi hypervisors and vCenter Server appliances.
  • Configure and manage VMware clusters, High Availability (HA), Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS), resource pools, and virtual machine lifecycle operations.
  • Administer vMotion, Storage vMotion, virtual machine templates, snapshots, and provisioning.
  • Implement, administer, and troubleshoot VMware vSAN storage clusters.
  • Configure and maintain virtual machine storage policies, capacity management, performance optimization, and cluster health.
  • Support VMware lifecycle management, host upgrades, firmware compatibility, and infrastructure modernization.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex virtualization performance issues, hypervisor failures, and virtual machine availability problems.
  • Perform infrastructure capacity planning, resource optimization, and hardware refresh activities.


Enterprise Storage Infrastructure

  • Configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise storage systems, including Pure Storage FlashArray.
  • Provision and manage storage volumes, LUNs, file systems, datastores, and storage access permissions.
  • Support enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and SMB.
  • Configure and manage storage snapshots, replication, capacity utilization, and performance monitoring.
  • Integrate enterprise storage platforms with Windows Server and VMware virtualization environments.
  • Diagnose and resolve storage availability, performance, capacity, and data access issues.
  • Support enterprise storage upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh activities.


Backup, Recovery, and Data Protection

  • Administer enterprise backup and recovery solutions, including Cohesity.
  • Configure and maintain backup jobs, retention policies, protection groups, and recovery schedules.
  • Monitor backup infrastructure health, job execution, capacity utilization, and protection coverage.
  • Perform file-level, virtual machine, and system recovery operations.
  • Develop and maintain documented backup and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Conduct periodic restoration testing to validate data integrity and system recoverability.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, business continuity requirements, and recovery validation.


Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and Endpoint Systems

  • Administer and maintain VMware Horizon virtual desktop infrastructure.
  • Configure and support Horizon Connection Servers, virtual desktop pools, golden images, and user entitlements.
  • Maintain VMware Unified Access Gateway appliances as components of the Horizon infrastructure.
  • Configure and troubleshoot FSLogix profile containers, profile management, and user environment persistence.
  • Support IGEL OS and IGEL Universal Management Suite for centrally managed thin-client environments.
  • Diagnose and resolve virtual desktop provisioning, authentication, user profile, and performance issues.
  • Manage virtual desktop image updates, patching, optimization, and lifecycle maintenance.


Linux and Enterprise Operating Systems

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux server operating systems.
  • Support common Linux distributions such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu Server.
  • Perform Linux operating system patching, package management, service administration, and security configuration.
  • Manage user permissions, file systems, system services, scheduled tasks, and operating system logs.
  • Troubleshoot Linux server performance, storage utilization, service failures, and system availability issues.
  • Support integration of Linux servers with enterprise authentication, virtualization, backup, and storage platforms.


Systems Security and Infrastructure Management

  • Implement operating system hardening and secure system configuration baselines.
  • Administer privileged accounts, service accounts, permissions, and role-based access controls.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, operating system security patching, and configuration compliance activities.
  • Maintain enterprise PKI infrastructure, certificate trust chains, and system certificate deployments.
  • Support systems logging, auditing, monitoring, and security-related troubleshooting.
  • Participate in technical change management, system configuration reviews, and compliance validation.


Automation, Documentation, and Engineering Support

  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for server administration, reporting, maintenance, and automation.
  • Utilize automation tools to streamline system provisioning, configuration management, and operational support.
  • Perform complex root-cause analysis across Windows, Linux, VMware, and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Develop and maintain system architecture diagrams, build documentation, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures, and recovery instructions.
  • Support system migrations, infrastructure upgrades, equipment replacements, and technology refresh projects.
  • Collaborate with other engineering disciplines to support enterprise applications and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Participate in engineering design reviews, change control processes, and infrastructure validation testing.


Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field
  • Security+ certification or higher
  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • Experience related to these 5 areas:
    • Windows Server & Active Directory: Advanced experience administering, configuring, securing, upgrading, and troubleshooting Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, and enterprise authentication services.
    • VMware Virtualization: Extensive experience deploying, managing, upgrading, and troubleshooting VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, clusters, HA, DRS, vMotion, and vSAN infrastructure.
    • Enterprise Storage & Backup: Hands-on experience managing SAN/NAS storage, provisioning datastores, configuring storage protocols, and maintaining enterprise backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.
    • Systems Engineering & Infrastructure Modernization: Proven ability to independently deploy, secure, maintain, and optimize enterprise infrastructure, including system migrations, patching, lifecycle management, automation, and PowerShell scripting.
    • Technical Troubleshooting & Collaboration: Strong expertise in complex infrastructure troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, technical documentation, and collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications

  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Microsoft infrastructure or Windows Server certifications.
  • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and SDDC Manager.
  • Experience with Pure Storage FlashArray administration.
  • Experience with Cohesity backup and recovery platforms.
  • Experience with VMware Horizon virtual desktop infrastructure.
  • Experience administering FSLogix, IGEL OS, and IGEL Universal Management Suite.
  • Experience administering Linux servers in enterprise environments.
  • Experience with automation technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible, and infrastructure management APIs.
  • Experience supporting enterprise PKI and certificate authority architecture.
  • Experience supporting secure government, enterprise, or systems integration laboratory environments.
  • Familiarity with system security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance requirements.


Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Time Off, Paid Federal Holidays, Education and Certification Reimbursement Program, 401(k) retirement plan with safe harbor employer match after 3 months, Prepaid Legal Plan and Identity Protection Plan available, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance available.

EEOC Statement

IPSecure does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management.

Position Description

We are urgently seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer III to design, build, integrate, and sustain secure cloud infrastructure and application runtime environments supporting mission-critical systems. This role will work across cloud compute, storage, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, monitoring, and security to provide reliable and scalable platforms for operational applications. The candidate will collaborate with software, platform, network, cybersecurity, and systems engineering teams to integrate commercial, government, and proprietary software into cohesive cloud-based environments. The role requires strong cloud and Linux fundamentals, hands-on troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to solve complex infrastructure challenges while contributing to the continued evolution of scalable, automated, and secure cloud architectures.

Incorporated in 2002, The Marlin Alliance is a digital transformation company dedicated to ensuring our clients compete and win in tomorrow's digital world. We specialize in creating technical solutions that allow for seamless execution of automated business processes and the generation of governed, machine-consumable data. From strategic planning to advanced analytics and cybersecurity, our team provides cutting-edge, cross-disciplinary solutions. We are seeking motivated professionals who share our agile, solution-oriented mindset and are ready to deliver the real, practical results relied upon by our clients.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, configure, and sustain production cloud infrastructure supporting compute, storage, networking, containerized applications, and mission-critical workloads.
  • Manage cloud compute and storage resources, including EC2 instances and block, file, and object storage, to maintain system availability, data persistence, performance, reliability, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and microservices across Kubernetes environments, including container runtime, workload scheduling, service discovery, networking, ingress, and application availability.
  • Implement and optimize dynamic resource management and scaling strategies across cloud and Kubernetes environments using workload demand, performance requirements, operational needs, and infrastructure cost considerations.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement application orchestration and runtime environments that integrate decoupled services, commercial products, Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) software, and proprietary applications into cohesive application workflows.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and health telemetry across cloud infrastructure, compute resources, containers, applications, and storage to support proactive system management and rapid troubleshooting.
  • Configure and maintain cloud networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, NACLs, load balancers, and supporting network services required for secure application connectivity.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and engineering teams to implement operating system hardening, least-privilege access, IAM controls, secure network configurations, data protection requirements, and applicable security and compliance baselines.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, and operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, CI/CD, and other automation technologies where appropriate.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support across cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, application, network, storage, and security environments while documenting architectures, configurations, procedures, and recommended solutions.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education And Experience

  • Strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, systems administration, DevOps, or related technical disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, administering, troubleshooting, and sustaining cloud-based compute, storage, networking, and application infrastructure.
  • Experience administering Linux-based systems and troubleshooting operating system, application, resource utilization, connectivity, and infrastructure performance issues.
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications using Docker, containerd, Kubernetes, or similar container and orchestration technologies.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes architecture and operations, including workloads, Pods, Services, networking, ingress, resource management, scaling, and application deployment.
  • Experience with cloud networking concepts, including virtual networks, subnets, routing, security groups, access controls, load balancing, and secure connectivity.
  • Experience implementing or supporting monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability capabilities for infrastructure and application environments.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, least-privilege access, system hardening, data protection, network security, and secure configuration practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose complex issues spanning cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, containers, applications, storage, networking, and security.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with software, infrastructure, platform, networking, cybersecurity, program, and operational stakeholders.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, EBS, EFS, S3, VPCs, subnets, Security Groups, route tables, NACLs, IAM, Auto Scaling Groups, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience administering AWS EKS or self-managed Kubernetes clusters and supporting containerized microservices in production environments.
  • Experience implementing Kubernetes scaling and resource management using Horizontal Pod Autoscalers, Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, resource requests and limits, quotas, or similar capabilities.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or similar declarative provisioning tools.
  • Experience integrating cloud and container deployments with CI/CD or GitOps technologies such as GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Flux, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages to automate infrastructure provisioning, administration, maintenance, monitoring, and health checks.
  • Experience integrating GOTS, Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS), third-party, legacy, or proprietary software into modern cloud and containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with AMI management, CIS Benchmarks, STIGs, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secrets management, and other security practices applicable to government cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting distributed, hybrid cloud, or other complex application environments.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, classified, or other security- and compliance-driven cloud environments.

Education And Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Experience
  • Current Security+ Certificate

Citizenship And Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • No dual citizenship
  • TS/SCI Eligible, security clearance required

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

  • Frequent work under deadlines.

Job Classification

descriptionHtml:
The Cloud and Infrastructure team owns and operates the systems that power the business: Azure, on-premises hyperconverged infrastructure, and the networking and telephony that connect them. We are growing the team to reduce single points of ownership, build deeper coverage across our platforms, and shift more of our work from manual support toward engineering, automation, and self-service.

We're looking for a Cloud and Automation Engineer who thinks in systems, not just tools. You should be comfortable moving between cloud and on-premises environments, understand how infrastructure, identity, networking, and applications depend on one another, and be driven to replace repetitive manual work with code and process. You'll work as part of cross-functional squads alongside engineering, security, and business partners, so strong collaboration and communication matter as much as technical depth.

This role is well suited to someone who has built real depth in systems and cloud engineering, who is genuinely energized by learning new platforms and approaches, and who wants to help mature a team's practices rather than just execute a backlog. This role is on a hybrid schedule, with office presence expected two days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate infrastructure across Azure and on-premises hyperconverged environments, applying consistent engineering principles regardless of platform.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks using infrastructure-as-code practices, reducing manual and repetitive work across the environment.
  • Partner with cross-functional squads to translate business and application requirements into resilient, secure, and maintainable infrastructure designs.
  • Co-design systems and platforms with application developers, favoring immutable infrastructure patterns so environments are consistently rebuilt from code rather than patched or drifted over time.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our hybrid cloud strategy: helping decide what belongs in the private data center versus Azure, and building the automation that makes those workloads portable and consistently managed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that span cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, and identity layers.
  • Establish and document standards, patterns, and runbooks that reduce tribal knowledge and make systems easier for the team to support.
  • Embed SRE principles and engineering practices into how systems are built and how the team works day to day, favoring measurable reliability, proactive detection, and repeatable process over reactive firefighting.
  • Identify opportunities to insource work currently handled by external managed-service partners, and build the automation and monitoring needed to support it internally.
  • Contribute to shifting the team's focus away from bespoke, hand-managed infrastructure and toward *aaS models and reusable, codified platforms, freeing capacity to focus on the systems that enable differentiated business capabilities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and incident response, contributing to root-cause analysis and durable fixes rather than one-off remediation.
  • Stay current with evolving cloud, virtualization, and automation practices, and bring new approaches back to the team.

Requirements

Experience

  • A solution-oriented systems engineering mindset, paired with continuous improvement and being easy to work with across teams.
  • 5-10 years of demonstrated experience integrating and automating infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code approaches, in a public cloud (Azure preferred) and in a virtualized or hyperconverged on-premises environment.
  • A track record of solving problems that cross multiple layers of the stack, not just working within a single platform or tool.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or squad-based delivery models, partnering with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders outside your immediate team.

Skills And Approach

  • Demonstrated experience with Terraform and Ansible, ideally applied in an Azure environment.
  • Strong grounding in core systems and cloud engineering principles: availability, scalability, security, cost, and operability, and the ability to reason about trade-offs between them.
  • A builder's mindset: default to automating and codifying solutions rather than performing repeated manual work.
  • A drive to optimize and re-engineer processes where it makes sense, rather than simply automating what's done today as-is.
  • Comfort operating across a hybrid environment, understanding how workload placement decisions affect cost, performance, resiliency, and support burden.
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to work back from symptoms to root cause across interdependent systems.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and standards that other engineers can follow.
  • A genuine appetite for learning: comfortable picking up new platforms, tools, and practices as the environment evolves, rather than anchoring to a fixed toolset.
  • Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to simplify rather than automate around unnecessary complexity.
  • A reuse- and security-first mindset, applied in a way that keeps sight of user and developer experience rather than adding friction for its own sake.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to identity and access management, networking, or telephony systems in addition to core infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to architecture decisions or documentation (e.g., ADRs) rather than only implementing them.
  • Familiarity with reducing reliance on outsourced managed services through internal automation and tooling.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with the risk, compliance, and change-control expectations common there.

Pay: $145,000 to $175,000 per year

Benefits: medical, dental and vision coverage, an employer HSA contribution, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, company paid long-term disability, a 401(k) with match, pre-tax commuter accounts, student loan assistance, tuition reimbursement, vacation and flex time, parental and family leave, and back-up child and elder care.

These tools may review application materials and analyze interview responses to provide insights about a candidate's experience and qualifications. AI output informs our recruiters; decisions about whether to advance or present a candidate are made by people.
